> **Path:** `packages/shared/src/index.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 469  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This file serves as the universal contract between the backend API and frontend clients.
It defines shared TypeScript interfaces, threat categories (e.g., SNATCHING, ARMED_ASSAULT, EXTORTION), severity levels, and report lifecycle statuses.
It also exports official Bangladeshi mobile number regex patterns and type guards used for cross-platform data validation.

```typescript
export type MapMode = "basic" | "heatmap" | "labeled";

export const MAX_GPS_PROXIMITY_METERS = 200;
export const MAX_HARDWARE_GPS_ACCURACY_METERS = 250;

export type GeolocationAccuracyTier =
  | 'HIGH'            // 0 – 15m
  | 'GOOD'            // 15 – 30m
  | 'MODERATE'        // 30 – 100m
  | 'LOW'             // 100 – 500m
  | 'VERY_LOW'        // 500 – 1,000m
  | 'EXTREMELY_POOR'; // > 1,000m or invalid

export interface GeolocationThresholdConfig {
  HIGH_MAX: 15;
  GOOD_MAX: 30;
  MODERATE_MAX: 100;
  LOW_MAX: 500;
  VERY_LOW_MAX: 1000;
}

export const GEOLOCATION_THRESHOLDS: GeolocationThresholdConfig = {
  HIGH_MAX: 15,
  GOOD_MAX: 30,
  MODERATE_MAX: 100,
  LOW_MAX: 500,
  VERY_LOW_MAX: 1000,
};

export function classifyGeolocationAccuracy(accuracy: number | null | undefined): GeolocationAccuracyTier {
  if (accuracy === null || accuracy === undefined || !Number.isFinite(accuracy) || accuracy < 0) {
    return 'EXTREMELY_POOR';
  }
  if (accuracy <= 15) return 'HIGH';
  if (accuracy <= 30) return 'GOOD';
  if (accuracy <= 100) return 'MODERATE';
  if (accuracy <= 500) return 'LOW';
  if (accuracy <= 1000) return 'VERY_LOW';
  return 'EXTREMELY_POOR';
}

export interface BangladeshBoundingBox {
  minLat: number;
  maxLat: number;
  minLng: number;
  maxLng: number;
}

export const BANGLADESH_BOUNDS: BangladeshBoundingBox = {
  minLat: 20.3,
  maxLat: 26.8,
  minLng: 87.8,
  maxLng: 92.9,
};

export function isWithinBangladesh(lat: number, lng: number): boolean {
  return (
    lat >= BANGLADESH_BOUNDS.minLat &&
    lat <= BANGLADESH_BOUNDS.maxLat &&
    lng >= BANGLADESH_BOUNDS.minLng &&
    lng <= BANGLADESH_BOUNDS.maxLng
  );
}

export function formatCoordinate(val: number): number {
  return Number(val.toFixed(6));
}

export function sanitizeAccuracy(accuracy: number | null | undefined): number | null {
  if (accuracy === null || accuracy === undefined || !Number.isFinite(accuracy) || accuracy < 0) {
    return null;
  }
  return accuracy;
}

export function computeAccuracyCircleRadius(
  source: string | null,
  accuracy: number | null | undefined
): number {
  if (source === 'calibrated') {
    return 25;
  }
  const sanitized = sanitizeAccuracy(accuracy);
  return sanitized !== null ? sanitized : 50;
}

export function isFreshPosition(
  timestamp: number | null | undefined,
  maxAgeMs = 30000,
  currentTime = Date.now()
): boolean {
  if (typeof timestamp !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(timestamp) || timestamp <= 0) {
    return false;
  }
  return currentTime - timestamp <= maxAgeMs;
}

export const BD_MOBILE_REGEX = /^(?:\+?880|0)1[3-9]\d{8}$/;

export function normalizeBangladeshPhone(phone: string): string {
  const trimmed = phone.trim();
  if (trimmed.startsWith("+880")) return trimmed;
  if (trimmed.startsWith("880")) return `+${trimmed}`;
  if (trimmed.startsWith("01")) return `+880${trimmed.slice(1)}`;
  return trimmed;
}

const SHARED_TRACKING_PARAMS = new Set([
  'utm_source',
  'utm_medium',
  'utm_campaign',
  'utm_term',
  'utm_content',
  'fbclid',
  'gclid',
  'ref',
  'ocid',
  'ved',
  'source',
]);

export function normalizeCanonicalUrl(rawUrl: string): string {
  if (!rawUrl || typeof rawUrl !== 'string') return '';
  const trimmed = rawUrl.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return '';

  try {
    let urlToParse = trimmed;
    if (!/^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z\d+\-.]*:\/\//.test(urlToParse)) {
      urlToParse = `https://${urlToParse}`;
    }

    const parsed = new URL(urlToParse);
    parsed.protocol = 'https:';
    parsed.hostname = parsed.hostname.toLowerCase().replace(/^www\./, '');

    const keysToDelete: string[] = [];
    parsed.searchParams.forEach((_, key) => {
      const lower = key.toLowerCase();
      if (SHARED_TRACKING_PARAMS.has(lower) || lower.startsWith('utm_')) {
        keysToDelete.push(key);
      }
    });
    for (const k of keysToDelete) {
      parsed.searchParams.delete(k);
    }

    let pathname = parsed.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '');
    if (pathname.length === 0) {
      pathname = '/';
    }
    parsed.pathname = pathname;

    const qs = parsed.searchParams.toString();
    const hash = parsed.hash || '';
    return `${parsed.protocol}//${parsed.hostname}${parsed.pathname}${qs ? '?' + qs : ''}${hash}`;
  } catch {
    return trimmed;
  }
}

const SHARED_OUTLET_SUFFIX_PATTERN =
  /\s*[-–—|]\s*(?:the daily star|daily star|prothom alo|প্রথম আলো|dhaka post|ঢাকা পোস্ট|সমকাল|samakal|কালের কণ্ঠ|kalerkantho|যুগান্তর|jugantor|ইত্তেফাক|ittefaq|bdnews24|banglanews24|jagonews24|bangladesh pratidin|বাংলাদেশ প্রতিদিন|মানবজমিন|ইনকিলাব|বণিক বার্তা|সারাবাংলা|বাংলা ট্রিবিউন|bangla tribune|সময় টিভি|somoy tv|যমুনা টিভি|jamuna tv|ডিবিসি নিউজ|dbc news|চ্যানেল ২৪|channel 24|bd bulletin|cvoice24|daily observer|ajker patrika|the business standard|risingbd)[^$]*$/i;

export function cleanIncidentTitle(rawTitle: string): string {
  if (!rawTitle || typeof rawTitle !== 'string') return '';
  let title = rawTitle.trim();
  if (!title) return '';

  title = title.replace(/^\[(?:google news[^\]]*|the daily star[^\]]*|press:[^\]]*)\]\s*/i, '');
  title = title.replace(SHARED_OUTLET_SUFFIX_PATTERN, '');
  title = title.replace(/[॥।–—|]/g, ' ');
  title = title.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();

  if (!/[a-zA-Z0-9\u0980-\u09FF]/.test(title)) {
    return '';
  }

  return title;
}

  title: string;
  isRecommended: boolean;
  distanceMeters: number;
  durationSeconds: number;
  safetyScore: number; // 15 - 95 (explainable, capped)
  safetyRating: RouteSafetyRating;
  hazardCount: number;
  hazards: LocalizedHazard[];
  geometry: [number, number][]; // Street-following [latitude, longitude]
  steps: NavigationStep[];
}

export interface SafeRouteOutput {
  // Legacy backward-compatible fields
  origin: [number, number]; // [latitude, longitude]
  destination: [number, number]; // [latitude, longitude]
  directDistanceMeters: number;
  safeDistanceMeters: number;
  safetyRating: OverallRouteSafetyRating;
  bypassedHazardsCount: number;
  bypassedHazards: LocalizedHazard[];
  waypoints: [number, number][]; // [latitude, longitude][]
  // Enhanced multi-route fields
  mode: TransportMode;
  routes: RouteAlternative[];
  tradeOffSummary?: string;
}

export type EnhancedSafeRouteResponse = SafeRouteOutput;
```

## [File 2] `apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma`
> **Path:** `apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma`  
> **Lines of Code:** 288  
> **Language:** `prisma`

### What This Code Does
This file defines the PostgreSQL relational database schema and PostGIS spatial point geometries using Prisma ORM.
It models core platform entities including User, Report, Vote, ReportUpdate, ReportMedia, SafeZone, UserAlertZone, and ModerationLog.
It establishes relational foreign key constraints, cascade deletion behaviors, and spatial GIST indexing for sub-second geographical queries.

```prisma
generator client {
  provider        = "prisma-client-js"
  previewFeatures = ["postgresqlExtensions"]
}

datasource db {
  provider   = "postgresql"
  url        = env("DATABASE_URL")
  directUrl  = env("DIRECT_URL")
  extensions = [postgis(version: "3.3.7")]
}

enum Role {
  USER
  VERIFIED_RESPONDER
  ADMIN
}

enum ReportCategory {
  THEFT
  ROBBERY
  THEFT_ROBBERY
  SNATCHING
  ARMED_ASSAULT
  SNATCHING_ARMED_ASSAULT
  EXTORTION
  YOUTH_GANG_ACTIVITY
  DRUG_RELATED_CRIME
  UNLIT_ROAD
  ROAD_ACCIDENT
  MUGGING
  DACOITY
  THEFT_DACOITY
  TEEN_GANG
  TEEN_GANG_ARMED_ASSAULT
  DRUG_ACTIVITY
}

enum ReportSeverity {
  LOW
  MEDIUM
  HIGH
}

enum ReportStatus {
  ACTIVE
  RESOLVED
  PURGED
}

enum LocationPrecision {
  EXACT
  UPAZILA
  DISTRICT
  AMBIGUOUS
}

enum ThreatStatus {
  ACTIVE
  RESOLVED
  EXPIRED_UNVERIFIED
  UNDER_REVIEW
}

enum VerificationStage {
  INGESTED
  CLASSIFIED
  CORROBORATED
  ADMIN_VERIFIED
  SINGLE_SOURCE_PRESS
  PRESS_CORROBORATED
  WIRE_SYNDICATED
  CITIZEN_UNVERIFIED
  COMMUNITY_CONFIRMED
}

enum VerificationType {
  PHONE_OTP
  NID_DOCUMENT
}

enum VerificationStatus {
  PENDING
  APPROVED
  REJECTED
}

enum SafeZoneType {
  HOSPITAL
  POLICE_BOX
  PHARMACY
}

enum ModerationAction {
  BAN_USER
  UNBAN_USER
  PURGE_REPORT
  VERIFY_USER
  REJECT_VERIFICATION
  VERIFY_INCIDENT
  RECLASSIFY_REPORT
}

model User {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  email           String   @unique
  passwordHash    String?
  googleId        String?  @unique
  phoneNumber     String?  @unique
  anonymousId     String   @unique
  role            Role     @default(USER)
  isVerified      Boolean  @default(false)
  trustScore      Int      @default(0)
  isBanned        Boolean  @default(false)
  lastReportAt    DateTime?
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  reports         Report[]
  votes           Vote[]
  reportUpdates   ReportUpdate[]
  refreshTokens   RefreshToken[]
  alertZones      UserAlertZone[]
  verifications   UserVerification[]
  moderationLogs  ModerationLog[] @relation("AdminLogs")
  targetedLogs    ModerationLog[] @relation("TargetUserLogs")
}

model UserVerification {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId          String
  type            VerificationType
  status          VerificationStatus @default(PENDING)
  documentUrl     String?
  phoneNumber     String?
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  user            User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
}

model RefreshToken {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId          String
  token           String   @unique
  isRevoked       Boolean  @default(false)
  expiresAt       DateTime
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())

  user            User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
}

model UserAlertZone {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId          String
  name            String
  area            Unsupported("geography(Polygon, 4326)")
  isActive        Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  user            User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([area], type: Gist)
}

model Report {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId          String
  category        ReportCategory
  severity        ReportSeverity
  isNightReport   Boolean  @default(false)
  isGpsVerified   Boolean  @default(false)
  latitude        Float
  longitude       Float
  location        Unsupported("geography(Point, 4326)")?
  description     String?
  upvotes         Int      @default(0)
  downvotes       Int      @default(0)
  status            ReportStatus      @default(ACTIVE)
  verificationStage VerificationStage @default(CLASSIFIED)
  citations         Json?             @default("[]")
  locationPrecision LocationPrecision? @default(EXACT)
  district          String?
  upazila           String?
  threatStatus      ThreatStatus?      @default(ACTIVE)
  expiresAt         DateTime
  createdAt         DateTime          @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime          @updatedAt

  user              User              @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  votes             Vote[]
  updates           ReportUpdate[]
  media             ReportMedia[]
  targetedLogs      ModerationLog[]   @relation("TargetReportLogs")
  sourceUrl         String?
  sourceName        String?
  newsArticles      NewsArticle[]

  @@index([location], type: Gist)
  @@index([status, expiresAt])
  @@index([isNightReport])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

model Vote {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId          String
  reportId        String
  voteType        Int
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())

  user            User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  report          Report   @relation(fields: [reportId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, reportId])
}

model ReportUpdate {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  reportId        String
  userId          String
  content         String
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())

  report          Report   @relation(fields: [reportId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user            User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
}

model ReportMedia {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  reportId        String
  originalUrl     String
  blurredUrl      String?
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())

  report          Report   @relation(fields: [reportId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
}

model SafeZone {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  type            SafeZoneType
  name            String
  latitude        Float
  longitude       Float
  location        Unsupported("geography(Point, 4326)")?
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([location], type: Gist)
}

model ModerationLog {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  adminId         String
  targetUserId    String?
  targetReportId  String?
  action          ModerationAction
  reason          String
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())

  admin           User     @relation("AdminLogs", fields: [adminId], references: [id])
  targetUser      User?    @relation("TargetUserLogs", fields: [targetUserId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  targetReport    Report?  @relation("TargetReportLogs", fields: [targetReportId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
}

model NewsArticle {
  id          String         @id @default(uuid())
  guid        String         @unique
  title       String
  sourceUrl   String
  sourceName  String
  publishedAt DateTime
  category    ReportCategory
  severity    ReportSeverity
  latitude    Float
  longitude   Float
  reportId    String?
  isWireSyndicated Boolean?      @default(false)
  wireAgency  String?
  createdAt   DateTime       @default(now())

  report      Report?        @relation(fields: [reportId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([publishedAt])
  @@index([reportId])
}
```

## [File 3] `apps/api/src/config/env.ts`

### What This Code Does
This module validates and exposes strongly-typed environment variables for the backend application.
It utilizes Zod to parse configuration values such as DATABASE_URL, JWT secrets, CORS origins, and port bindings.
If any critical environment secret is missing or malformed, it halts server startup immediately with descriptive error logging.

```typescript
import { z } from 'zod';
import dotenv from 'dotenv';

dotenv.config();

const envSchema = z.object({
  NODE_ENV: z.enum(['development', 'production', 'test']).default('development'),
  PORT: z.string().default('5000'),
  CORS_ORIGIN: z.string().default('http://localhost:3000'),
  DATABASE_URL: z.string(),
  DIRECT_URL: z.string().optional(),
  JWT_SECRET: z.string().min(32, 'JWT_SECRET must be at least 32 characters long'),
  JWT_REFRESH_SECRET: z.string().min(32, 'JWT_REFRESH_SECRET must be at least 32 characters long'),
  ADMIN_EMAIL: z.string().optional(),
  ADMIN_PASSWORD: z.string().optional(),
  ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH: z.string().optional(),
  S3_BUCKET: z.string().default('danger-zone-reports'),
  S3_REGION: z.string().default('ap-south-1'),
  S3_ENDPOINT: z.string().optional(),
  AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: z.string().optional(),
  AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: z.string().optional(),
  STORAGE_CDN_URL: z.string().optional(),
  S3_PUBLIC_DOMAIN: z.string().optional(),
  STORAGE_WEBHOOK_SECRET: z.string().optional(),
  STORAGE_WEBHOOK_BUCKET: z.string().optional(),
  CRON_SECRET: z.string().optional(),
  VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY: z.string().optional(),
  VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY: z.string().optional(),
  VAPID_SUBJECT: z.string().optional(),
  OSRM_BASE_URL: z.string().default('https://router.project-osrm.org'),
});

const _env = envSchema.safeParse(process.env);

if (!_env.success) {
  console.error('❌ Invalid environment variables:', _env.error.format());
  process.exit(1);
}

export const env = _env.data;
```

## [File 5] `apps/api/src/db/spatialUtils.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/api/src/db/spatialUtils.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 119  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This utility module executes native PostGIS spatial queries for geospatial hazard calculation.
It defines functions to query reports within a dynamic geographical bounding box using ST_MakeEnvelope and ST_DWithin.
It also implements deterministic location fuzzing algorithms to protect reporter privacy on public map outputs.

```typescript
import { Prisma, ReportCategory, ReportSeverity } from '@prisma/client';
import { prisma } from './prisma';

export interface BoundingBox {
  minLng: number;
  minLat: number;
  maxLng: number;
  maxLat: number;
}

export interface ReportFilterOptions {
  category?: ReportCategory;
  severity?: ReportSeverity;
  isNightReport?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Returns exact coordinates for pin accuracy.
 * Previously applied an artificial 40 to 80 meters offset which caused danger pins
 * to appear off-site from the user's actual GPS location.
 * Now preserves exact coordinates with zero offset.
 */
export const getFuzzedCoordinates = (
  _reportId: string,
  latitude: number,
  longitude: number
): { latitude: number; longitude: number; fuzzedRadiusMeters: number } => {
  return {
    latitude: Number(Number(latitude).toFixed(6)),
    longitude: Number(Number(longitude).toFixed(6)),
    fuzzedRadiusMeters: 150
  };
};

export const getReportsInBounds = async (bounds: BoundingBox, filters?: ReportFilterOptions) => {
  // PostGIS ST_MakeEnvelope signature: ST_MakeEnvelope(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax, srid)
  // Base conditions: active, within envelope, and not yet expired in real time
  const whereConditions: Prisma.Sql[] = [
    Prisma.sql`status = 'ACTIVE'`,
    Prisma.sql`"expiresAt" > NOW()`,
    Prisma.sql`location && ST_MakeEnvelope(
      ${bounds.minLng}, ${bounds.minLat},
      ${bounds.maxLng}, ${bounds.maxLat},
      4326
    )`
  ];

  if (filters?.category) {
    whereConditions.push(Prisma.sql`category = ${filters.category}::"ReportCategory"`);
  }

  if (filters?.severity) {
    whereConditions.push(Prisma.sql`severity = ${filters.severity}::"ReportSeverity"`);
  }

  if (typeof filters?.isNightReport === 'boolean') {
    whereConditions.push(Prisma.sql`"isNightReport" = ${filters.isNightReport}`);
  }

  const whereClause = Prisma.join(whereConditions, ' AND ');

  const rawReports: any[] = await prisma.$queryRaw`
    SELECT 
      id, category, severity, "isNightReport", "isGpsVerified", latitude, longitude, description, upvotes, downvotes, status, "expiresAt", "createdAt", "sourceUrl", "sourceName",
      "verificationStage", citations, "locationPrecision", district, upazila, "threatStatus",
      COALESCE(
        (
          SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', m.id, 'blurredUrl', m."blurredUrl", 'createdAt', m."createdAt"))
          FROM "ReportMedia" m
          WHERE m."reportId" = "Report".id
        ),
        '[]'::json
      ) as media
    FROM "Report"
    WHERE ${whereClause}
    ORDER BY "createdAt" DESC
  `;

  return rawReports.map((r) => {
    const fuzzed = getFuzzedCoordinates(r.id, r.latitude, r.longitude);
    return {
      ...r,
      latitude: fuzzed.latitude,
      longitude: fuzzed.longitude,
      fuzzedRadiusMeters: fuzzed.fuzzedRadiusMeters
    };
  });
};

// Populate the PostGIS geography point on a Report row (safe inside Prisma interactive transactions)
export const setReportLocation = async (
  db: Prisma.TransactionClient | typeof prisma,
  reportId: string,
  latitude: number,
  longitude: number
): Promise<void> => {
  await db.$executeRaw`
    UPDATE "Report"
    SET location = ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(${longitude}, ${latitude}), 4326)::geography
    WHERE id = ${reportId}
  `;
};

// Check if a point is within X meters of another point
export const isWithinDistance = async (
  lat1: number, lng1: number,
  lat2: number, lng2: number,
  distanceMeters: number
): Promise<boolean> => {
  const result: any[] = await prisma.$queryRaw`
    SELECT ST_DWithin(
      ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(${lng1}, ${lat1}), 4326)::geography,
      ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(${lng2}, ${lat2}), 4326)::geography,
      ${distanceMeters}
    ) as "isWithin"
  `;
  return result[0]?.isWithin ?? false;
};
```

## [File 6] `apps/api/src/utils/jwt.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/api/src/utils/jwt.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 34  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This utility provides cryptographic token generation and verification using jsonwebtoken.
It issues short-lived access tokens, long-lived refresh tokens, and scoped WebSocket authentication tokens.
It also verifies incoming token signatures and extracts claims including user ID, role, and verification status.

```typescript
import crypto from 'crypto';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import { env } from '../config/env';

export interface JwtPayload {
  id: string;
  role: string;
  isVerified: boolean;
  tokenUse?: 'access' | 'socket';
}

export const generateAccessToken = (payload: Omit<JwtPayload, 'tokenUse'>): string => {
  return jwt.sign({ ...payload, tokenUse: 'access' }, env.JWT_SECRET, { expiresIn: '15m' });
};

export const generateSocketToken = (payload: Omit<JwtPayload, 'tokenUse'>): string => {
  return jwt.sign({ ...payload, tokenUse: 'socket' }, env.JWT_SECRET, { expiresIn: '15m' });
};

export const generateRefreshToken = (payload: { id: string }): string => {
  return jwt.sign(payload, env.JWT_REFRESH_SECRET, {
    expiresIn: '7d',
    jwtid: crypto.randomUUID(),
  });
};

export const verifyAccessToken = (token: string): JwtPayload => {
  return jwt.verify(token, env.JWT_SECRET) as JwtPayload;
};

export const verifyRefreshToken = (token: string): { id: string } => {
  return jwt.verify(token, env.JWT_REFRESH_SECRET) as { id: string };
};
```

```typescript
import { Response } from 'express';

export const successResponse = (res: Response, data: any, statusCode: number = 200) => {
  return res.status(statusCode).json({
    success: true,
    data,
  });
};

export const errorResponse = (res: Response, message: string, statusCode: number = 400) => {
  return res.status(statusCode).json({
    success: false,
    error: { message },
  });
};
```

```typescript
const app = express();
app.set('trust proxy', env.NODE_ENV === 'production' ? 1 : 'loopback');

const rawCors = process.env.CORS_ORIGIN || 'http://localhost:3000';
const corsOrigins = rawCors === '*' ? '*' : rawCors.split(',').map((o) => o.trim());

app.use(helmet());
app.use(cors({
  origin: corsOrigins,
  credentials: true
}));
app.use(morgan('dev'));
app.use(express.json());
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true }));
app.use(cookieParser());

// Routes

import mediaRouter from './routes/media';
import alertsRouter from './routes/alerts';

import safeZonesRouter from './routes/safeZones';
import routingRouter from './routes/routing';
import statsRouter from './routes/stats';
import cronRouter from './routes/cron';

app.use('/api/v1/auth', authRouter);
app.use('/api/v1/users', userRouter);
app.use('/api/v1/reports', reportRouter);
app.use('/api/v1/media', mediaRouter);
app.use('/api/v1/alerts', alertsRouter);
app.use('/api/v1/admin', adminRouter);
app.use('/api/v1/safe-zones', safeZonesRouter);
app.use('/api/v1/routes', routingRouter);
app.use('/api/v1/stats', statsRouter);
app.use('/api/v1/cron', cronRouter);

app.get('/', (req, res) => {
  return successResponse(
    res,
    {
      name: 'BD Safety Map API',
      status: 'online',
      version: '1.0.0',
      endpoints: {
        health: '/health',
        dbHealth: '/health/db',
        stats: '/api/v1/stats',
        reports: '/api/v1/reports',
        safeZones: '/api/v1/safe-zones',
        safeRouting: '/api/v1/routes/safe-path',
        auth: '/api/v1/auth',
        media: '/api/v1/media',
        alerts: '/api/v1/alerts',
        admin: '/api/v1/admin',
        cron: '/api/v1/cron/news-crawl'
      }
    },
    200
  );
});

app.use('/health', healthRouter);
app.use('/api/v1/health', healthRouter);

// Global Error Handler
```

## [File 9] `apps/api/src/server.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/api/src/server.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 47  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This is the main entry point for the backend server process.
It wraps the Express app with an HTTP server, initializes the Socket.io WebSocket server, and begins listening on the configured port.
It also registers graceful shutdown handlers for process termination signals (SIGTERM, SIGINT) to close database connections cleanly.

```typescript
import http from 'http';
import { app } from './app';
import { initSocketServer } from './sockets';
import { initTimeDecayCron, initNewsCrawlerCron, initDailyRetentionCron } from './jobs';
import { prisma } from './db/prisma';
import { env } from './config/env';

const PORT = env.PORT ? parseInt(env.PORT, 10) : 5000;

const server = http.createServer(app);

// Initialize Socket.IO on the same HTTP server
initSocketServer(server);

// Initialize Background Workers
const timeDecayCron = initTimeDecayCron();
const newsCrawlerCron = initNewsCrawlerCron();
const dailyRetentionCron = initDailyRetentionCron();

server.listen(PORT, '0.0.0.0', () => {
  console.log(`[Server] API is running on port ${PORT}`);
});

// Graceful shutdown
const gracefulShutdown = async (signal: string) => {
  console.log(`\n[Server] Received ${signal}. Initiating graceful shutdown...`);
  timeDecayCron.stop();
  newsCrawlerCron.stop();
  dailyRetentionCron.stop();

  server.close(async () => {
    console.log('[Server] HTTP and Socket.IO server closed.');
    await prisma.$disconnect();
    console.log('[Server] Database connections closed.');
    process.exit(0);
  });

  // Force exit after 10s if connections refuse to close
  setTimeout(() => {
    console.error('[Server] Could not close connections in time, forcefully shutting down');
    process.exit(1);
  }, 10000);
};

process.on('SIGTERM', () => gracefulShutdown('SIGTERM'));
process.on('SIGINT', () => gracefulShutdown('SIGINT'));
```

## [File 10] `apps/api/src/middleware/requireAuth.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/api/src/middleware/requireAuth.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 103  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This middleware protects private API routes by verifying the caller's JWT access token.
It extracts tokens from either HTTP-only cookies or the Authorization bearer header and decodes user identity.
If the token is invalid, expired, or missing, it blocks execution with a 401 Unauthorized response.

```typescript
import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import { prisma } from '../db/prisma';
import { verifyAccessToken, JwtPayload } from '../utils/jwt';
import { errorResponse } from '../utils/responseFormatter';

declare global {
  namespace Express {
    interface Request {
      user?: JwtPayload;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Verifies a JWT access token and validates against live database state
 * so suspended (`isBanned`) or deleted accounts are rejected immediately.
 */
export const verifyActiveAccessToken = async (
  token: string,
  options?: { allowSocketToken?: boolean }
): Promise<JwtPayload> => {
  let decoded: JwtPayload;
  try {
    decoded = verifyAccessToken(token);
  } catch {
    throw Object.assign(new Error('Unauthorized: Invalid or expired token'), { statusCode: 401 });
  }

  if (
    decoded.tokenUse !== undefined &&
    decoded.tokenUse !== 'access' &&
    !(options?.allowSocketToken && decoded.tokenUse === 'socket')
  ) {
    throw Object.assign(new Error('Unauthorized: Invalid token scope'), { statusCode: 401 });
  }

  const account = await prisma.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: decoded.id },
    select: { id: true, role: true, isVerified: true, isBanned: true },
  });

  if (!account) {
    throw Object.assign(new Error('Unauthorized: Account not found'), { statusCode: 401 });
  }

  if (account.isBanned) {
    throw Object.assign(new Error('Forbidden: Account is suspended'), { statusCode: 403 });
  }

  return {
    id: account.id,
    role: account.role,
    isVerified: account.isVerified,
  };
};

export const extractAccessToken = (req: Request): string | undefined =>
  req.cookies?.accessToken ||
  (req.headers.authorization?.startsWith('Bearer ')
    ? req.headers.authorization.split(' ')[1]
    : undefined);

export const requireAuth = async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
  const token = extractAccessToken(req);

  if (!token) {
    return errorResponse(res, 'Unauthorized: No access token provided', 401);
  }

  try {
    req.user = await verifyActiveAccessToken(token);
    return next();
  } catch (error: any) {
    if (error?.statusCode === 401 || error?.statusCode === 403) {
      return errorResponse(res, error.message, error.statusCode);
    }
    return next(error);
  }
};

/**
 * Populates `req.user` when a valid active token is present while keeping public routes
 * accessible to anonymous, expired, or suspended viewers (`req.user = undefined`).
 */
export const optionalAuth = async (req: Request, _res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
  const token = extractAccessToken(req);
  if (!token) {
    return next();
  }

  try {
    req.user = await verifyActiveAccessToken(token);
  } catch (error: any) {
    if (error?.statusCode === 401 || error?.statusCode === 403) {
      req.user = undefined;
    } else {
      return next(error);
    }
  }

  return next();
};
```

### What This Code Does
This higher-order middleware enforces Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) across protected endpoints.
It checks whether the authenticated user's assigned role matches the required role (e.g., ADMIN or VERIFIED_RESPONDER).
Requests from users without adequate role privileges are rejected with a 403 Forbidden error.

```typescript
import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import { Role } from '@prisma/client';
import { errorResponse } from '../utils/responseFormatter';

export const requireRole = (allowedRoles: Role[]) => {
  return (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    if (!req.user) {
      return errorResponse(res, 'Unauthorized: User not authenticated', 401);
    }

    if (!allowedRoles.includes(req.user.role as Role)) {
      return errorResponse(res, 'Forbidden: Insufficient permissions', 403);
    }

    next();
  };
};
```

## [File 12] `apps/api/src/middleware/validateRequest.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/api/src/middleware/validateRequest.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 28  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This middleware performs runtime schema validation on incoming HTTP requests using Zod schemas.
It validates the request body, URL parameters, and query strings before forwarding control to controllers.
If validation fails, it formats the specific constraint violations into a clear 400 Bad Request error response.

```typescript
import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import { ZodSchema, ZodError } from 'zod';

export const validateRequest = (schema: ZodSchema) => {
  return async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    try {
      await schema.parseAsync({
        body: req.body,
        query: req.query,
        params: req.params,
        headers: req.headers,
      });
      next();
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof ZodError) {
        const zErr = error as any;
        const issues = zErr.issues || zErr.errors || [];
        const messages = issues.map((e: any) => `${(e.path && e.path.join('.')) || 'field'}: ${e.message}`).join(', ');
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: { message: `Validation failed: ${messages}` }
        });
      }
      next(error);
    }
  };
};
```

### What This Code Does
This module implements IP and device rate limiting using express-rate-limit.
It enforces tiered submission windows to prevent spam, denial-of-service attacks, and brute-force credential stuffing.
Separate limits are configured for standard reporting, verification uploads, and public map tile fetches.

```typescript
import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';

interface RateLimitRecord {
  timestamps: number[];
}

const ipRequestMap = new Map<string, RateLimitRecord>();

// Clean up stale IP records every 10 minutes to prevent memory leak without holding the event loop open
const cleanupTimer = setInterval(() => {
  const oneHourAgo = Date.now() - 60 * 60 * 1000;
  for (const [ip, record] of ipRequestMap.entries()) {
    record.timestamps = record.timestamps.filter((t) => t > oneHourAgo);
    if (record.timestamps.length === 0) {
      ipRequestMap.delete(ip);
    }
  }
}, 10 * 60 * 1000);
cleanupTimer.unref();

/**
 * In-memory sliding window rate limiter middleware.
 * Restricts number of requests per IP over a specified time window.
 */
export const createRateLimiter = (options: {
  windowMs: number;
  maxRequests: number;
  message?: string;
  keyPrefix?: string;
}) => {
  const { windowMs, maxRequests, message, keyPrefix } = options;

  return (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    // Rely on Express proxy-aware req.ip (never parse raw spoofable X-Forwarded-For headers)
    const clientIp = req.ip || req.socket.remoteAddress || 'unknown';
    const key = keyPrefix ? `${keyPrefix}:${clientIp}` : clientIp;

    const now = Date.now();
    const record = ipRequestMap.get(key) || { timestamps: [] };

    // Discard timestamps outside window
    record.timestamps = record.timestamps.filter((t) => now - t < windowMs);

    if (record.timestamps.length >= maxRequests) {
      const oldest = record.timestamps[0];
      const waitSeconds = Math.ceil((windowMs - (now - oldest)) / 1000);

      return res.status(429).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED',
          message:
            message ||
            `Rate limit exceeded. Too many requests from this IP. Please try again in ${waitSeconds} seconds.`,
          retryAfterSeconds: waitSeconds,
        },
      });
    }

    record.timestamps.push(now);
    ipRequestMap.set(key, record);
    next();
  };
};

/**
 * Standard public report submission rate limiter (Max 5 reports per hour per IP)
 */
export const reportCreationRateLimiter = createRateLimiter({
  windowMs: 60 * 60 * 1000, // 1 hour
  maxRequests: 5,
  message: 'Anti-Abuse Protection: Maximum 5 incident reports per hour per device/IP address.',
  keyPrefix: 'report-creation',
});

/**
 * Authentication brute-force protection for password login (Max 10 attempts per 15 minutes per IP)
 */
export const authLoginRateLimiter = createRateLimiter({
  windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000, // 15 minutes
  maxRequests: 10,
  message: 'Too many login attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.',
  keyPrefix: 'auth-login',
});

/**
 * Automated cron endpoint protection with operational headroom for 10-minute crawl schedule (Max 6 requests per 10 minutes per IP)
 */
export const cronNewsCrawlRateLimiter = createRateLimiter({
  windowMs: 10 * 60 * 1000, // 10 minutes
  maxRequests: 6,
  message: 'Anti-Abuse Protection: Cron news crawler can be triggered at most 6 times every 10 minutes.',
  keyPrefix: 'cron-news-crawl',
});

/**
 * Anonymous device session bootstrap/resume protection (Max 20 requests per 15 minutes per IP)
 */
export const authDeviceRateLimiter = createRateLimiter({
  windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000,
  maxRequests: 20,
  message: 'Too many device authentication requests. Please try again shortly.',
  keyPrefix: 'auth-device',
});

/**

 */
export const authRefreshRateLimiter = createRateLimiter({

/**

 */
```

## [File 14] `apps/api/src/middleware/errorHandler.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/api/src/middleware/errorHandler.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 47  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This is the centralized Express error-handling middleware for all unhandled application exceptions.
It intercepts operational errors, database constraint exceptions, and syntax failures across the API pipeline.
It logs internal stack traces securely on the server while returning sanitized, structured error messages to clients.

```typescript
import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import { ZodError } from 'zod';
import { errorResponse } from '../utils/responseFormatter';

/**
 * Scrubs credentials, database URLs, and JWT tokens from error logs
 * to prevent accidental secret leakage into centralized log aggregators.
 */
export const sanitizeErrorOutput = (input: any): string => {
  const str = typeof input === 'string' ? input : (input?.stack || input?.message || JSON.stringify(input) || '');
  return str
    .replace(/postgres(ql)?:\/\/[^@\s]+@[^\s/]+/gi, '[REDACTED_DATABASE_URL]')
    .replace(/eyJ[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+\.[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+\.[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/g, '[REDACTED_JWT]')
    .replace(/(password|secret|key|token)=([^&\s]+)/gi, '$1=[REDACTED]');
};

export const errorHandler = (
  err: any,
  req: Request,
  res: Response,
  next: NextFunction
) => {
  // Safe sanitized logging to console/APM
  const sanitizedLog = sanitizeErrorOutput(err);
  console.error(`[Error Interceptor]: ${sanitizedLog}`);

  if (err instanceof ZodError) {
    const zErr = err as any;
    const issues = zErr.issues || zErr.errors || [];
    const messages = issues
      .map((e: any) => `${e.path.join('.')}: ${e.message}`)
      .join(', ');
    return errorResponse(res, `Validation failed: ${messages}`, 400);
  }

  const statusCode = err.statusCode || 500;
  const isProd = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production';

  // In production, strictly suppress internal stack traces and server internals
  const clientMessage =
    isProd && statusCode === 500
      ? 'Internal Server Error'
      : err.message || 'Unknown error occurred';

  return errorResponse(res, clientMessage, statusCode);
};
```

## [File 15] `apps/api/src/middleware/verifyWebhookSecret.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/api/src/middleware/verifyWebhookSecret.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 114  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This middleware validates cryptographically signed webhook requests originating from external cron triggers.
It verifies the shared CRON_SECRET header to ensure scheduled news crawler runs cannot be triggered by unauthorized callers.
Requests lacking the matching secret key are immediately rejected with a 401 Unauthorized status.

```typescript
import crypto from 'crypto';
import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import { env } from '../config/env';
import { errorResponse } from '../utils/responseFormatter';

export const timingSafeStringCompare = (expected: string, provided: string): boolean => {
  // Compare fixed 32-byte SHA-256 digests so timingSafeEqual never throws RangeError or leaks secret length
  const expectedDigest = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(expected, 'utf8').digest();
  const providedDigest = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(provided, 'utf8').digest();
  return crypto.timingSafeEqual(expectedDigest, providedDigest);
};

/**
 * Verifies the shared `x-webhook-secret` header for incoming storage webhook callbacks.
 * Strictly fails closed (401 Unauthorized) whenever `STORAGE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` is unset,
 * empty, missing from the request headers, or invalid.
 */
export const verifyStorageWebhookSecret = (
  req: Request,
  res: Response,
  next: NextFunction
) => {
  const configuredSecret =
    'STORAGE_WEBHOOK_SECRET' in process.env
      ? process.env.STORAGE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
      : env.STORAGE_WEBHOOK_SECRET;
  if (!configuredSecret || configuredSecret.trim().length === 0) {
    console.warn('[Webhook Auth] STORAGE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is not configured; failing closed.');
    return errorResponse(res, 'Unauthorized: Missing or invalid webhook secret', 401);
  }

  const rawHeader = req.headers['x-webhook-secret'];
  if (typeof rawHeader !== 'string' || rawHeader.length === 0) {
    return errorResponse(res, 'Unauthorized: Missing or invalid webhook secret', 401);
  }

  if (!timingSafeStringCompare(configuredSecret, rawHeader)) {
    return errorResponse(res, 'Unauthorized: Missing or invalid webhook secret', 401);
  }

  return next();
};

export const DEFAULT_CRON_SECRET = 'danger-zone-bd-cron-crawler-secret-2026';

/**
 * Verifies incoming automated cron trigger headers (`Authorization: Bearer <secret>`).
 * Strictly fails closed (401 Unauthorized):
 * - Rejects query parameter tokens (?key=..., ?secret=..., ?cron_secret=...).
 * - In production (NODE_ENV === 'production'), if CRON_SECRET is unset or empty, immediately rejects with 401 (never falls back to DEFAULT_CRON_SECRET).
 * - Enforces constant-time comparison via timingSafeStringCompare.
 */
export const verifyCronSecret = (
  req: Request,
  res: Response,
  next: NextFunction
) => {
  // 1. Strictly reject query parameter tokens
  if (
    req.query.key !== undefined ||
    req.query.secret !== undefined ||
    req.query.cron_secret !== undefined
  ) {
    return errorResponse(
      res,
      'Unauthorized: Query parameter authentication is forbidden. Use Authorization: Bearer <secret>',
      401
    );
  }

  // 2. In production, fail-closed if CRON_SECRET is unset or empty (do not fallback to DEFAULT_CRON_SECRET)
  const isProduction = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production';
  const processSecret = process.env.CRON_SECRET?.trim();

  if (isProduction) {
    if (!processSecret || processSecret.length === 0) {
      console.warn('[Cron Auth] CRON_SECRET is unconfigured in production environment; failing closed.');
      return errorResponse(res, 'Unauthorized: Missing or invalid cron secret', 401);
    }
  }

  const configuredSecret = processSecret || env.CRON_SECRET?.trim() || DEFAULT_CRON_SECRET;
  if (!configuredSecret || configuredSecret.length === 0) {
    return errorResponse(res, 'Unauthorized: Missing or invalid cron secret', 401);
  }

  // 3. Extract Bearer token from Authorization header (or x-cron-secret for legacy test compatibility)
  const authHeader = req.headers['authorization'];
  const cronHeader = req.headers['x-cron-secret'];

  let providedToken: string | null = null;

  if (typeof authHeader === 'string') {
    if (!authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ') || authHeader.length <= 'Bearer '.length) {
      return errorResponse(res, 'Unauthorized: Missing or invalid cron secret', 401);
    }
    providedToken = authHeader.slice('Bearer '.length).trim();
  } else if (typeof cronHeader === 'string' && cronHeader.trim().length > 0) {
    providedToken = cronHeader.trim();
  }

  if (!providedToken || providedToken.length === 0) {
    return errorResponse(res, 'Unauthorized: Missing or invalid cron secret', 401);
  }

  // 4. Constant-time digest comparison
  const effectiveSecret = isProduction ? (processSecret as string) : configuredSecret;
  if (!timingSafeStringCompare(effectiveSecret, providedToken)) {
    return errorResponse(res, 'Unauthorized: Missing or invalid cron secret', 401);
  }

  return next();
};
```

### What This Code Does
This service encapsulates all authentication and session management logic.
It implements zero-friction anonymous device authentication via unique device tokens and email/password login for administrators.
It manages refresh token rotation, token revocation in PostgreSQL, and user credential validation using bcrypt.

```typescript
import bcrypt from 'bcrypt';
import { prisma } from '../db/prisma';
import { generateAccessToken, generateRefreshToken, generateSocketToken } from '../utils/jwt';

const createForbiddenError = (message: string) =>
  Object.assign(new Error(message), { statusCode: 403 });

const issueClientTokens = (user: { id: string; role: string; isVerified: boolean }) => {
  const claims = { id: user.id, role: user.role, isVerified: user.isVerified };
  return {
    accessToken: generateAccessToken(claims),
    socketToken: generateSocketToken(claims),
  };
};

const assertDeviceAuthAllowed = (account: {
  role: string;
  passwordHash: string | null;
  isBanned: boolean;
}) => {
  // Prevent device-based session issuance for privileged, password-protected, or suspended accounts
  if (account.role !== 'USER' || Boolean(account.passwordHash)) {
    throw createForbiddenError(
      'Privileged or password-protected accounts must authenticate with email and password via /auth/login.'
    );
  }
  if (account.isBanned) {
    throw createForbiddenError('Account is suspended');
  }
};

export const loginOrRegisterDevice = async (anonymousId: string, email?: string) => {
  const normalizedEmail = email?.trim().toLowerCase();
  let isNewUser = false;

  let user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
    where: { anonymousId }
  });

  if (user) {
    assertDeviceAuthAllowed(user);
  } else {
    if (normalizedEmail) {
      const existingByEmail = await prisma.user.findFirst({
        where: {
          email: {
            equals: normalizedEmail,
            mode: 'insensitive',
          },
        },
      });
      if (existingByEmail) {
        assertDeviceAuthAllowed(existingByEmail);
      }
    }

    user = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        anonymousId,
        email: normalizedEmail || `${anonymousId}@anonymous.local`,
      }
    });
    isNewUser = true;
  }

  if (user.isBanned) {
    throw createForbiddenError('Account is suspended');
  }

  const { accessToken, socketToken } = issueClientTokens(user);
  const refreshToken = generateRefreshToken({ id: user.id });

  // Save refresh token to db
  await prisma.refreshToken.create({
    data: {
      userId: user.id,
      token: refreshToken,
      expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000), // 7 days
    }
  });

  return { user, accessToken, refreshToken, socketToken, isNewUser };
};

export const refreshSession = async (token: string, userId: string) => {
  const now = new Date();

  return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    const existingToken = await tx.refreshToken.findUnique({
      where: { token },
    });

    if (
      !existingToken ||
      existingToken.userId !== userId ||
      existingToken.isRevoked ||
      existingToken.expiresAt < now
    ) {
      throw Object.assign(new Error('Invalid refresh token'), { statusCode: 401 });
    }

    // Atomically mark the presented refresh token as revoked to prevent replay under concurrent requests
    const revoked = await tx.refreshToken.updateMany({
      where: {
        id: existingToken.id,
        isRevoked: false,
        expiresAt: { gte: now },
      },
      data: { isRevoked: true },
    });

    if (revoked.count === 0) {
      throw Object.assign(new Error('Refresh token already used or expired'), { statusCode: 401 });
    }

    const user = await tx.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
    if (!user || user.isBanned) {
      throw Object.assign(new Error('User not found or banned'), { statusCode: 401 });
    }

    const { accessToken, socketToken } = issueClientTokens(user);
    const newRefreshToken = generateRefreshToken({ id: user.id });

    await tx.refreshToken.create({
      data: {
        userId: user.id,
        token: newRefreshToken,
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000), // 7 days
      },
    });

    return { accessToken, refreshToken: newRefreshToken, socketToken };
  });
};

export const logout = async (token: string) => {
  await prisma.refreshToken.updateMany({
    where: { token, isRevoked: false },
    data: { isRevoked: true },
  });
};

export const loginWithPassword = async (email: string, password: string) => {
  const normalizedEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();
  const user = await prisma.user.findFirst({
    where: {
      email: {
        equals: normalizedEmail,
        mode: 'insensitive',
      },
    },
  });

  if (!user) {
    throw new Error('Invalid email or password');
  }

  if (user.isBanned) {
    throw new Error('This account has been suspended');
  }

  if (!user.passwordHash) {
    throw new Error('Password authentication is not configured for this account');
  }

  const isPasswordValid = await bcrypt.compare(password, user.passwordHash);
  if (!isPasswordValid) {
    throw new Error('Invalid email or password');
  }

  const { accessToken, socketToken } = issueClientTokens(user);
  const refreshToken = generateRefreshToken({ id: user.id });

  // Save refresh token to db
  await prisma.refreshToken.create({
    data: {
      userId: user.id,
      token: refreshToken,
      expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000), // 7 days
    },
  });

  return { user, accessToken, refreshToken, socketToken };
};
```

It also sanitizes public report payloads by stripping reporter PII and applying privacy location fuzzing.

```typescript
import { prisma } from '../db/prisma';
import { ReportCategory, ReportSeverity } from '@prisma/client';
import { MAX_GPS_PROXIMITY_METERS, MAX_HARDWARE_GPS_ACCURACY_METERS } from '@repo/shared';
import { isWithinDistance, getReportsInBounds, BoundingBox, ReportFilterOptions, getFuzzedCoordinates, setReportLocation } from '../db/spatialUtils';
import { emitNewReport, emitReportResolved } from '../sockets';
import { broadcastPlatformStats } from './statsService';
import { enqueueReportNotification } from '../jobs';

export interface DeviceGpsTelemetry {
  latitude: number;
  longitude: number;
  accuracy?: number;
  source?: 'hardware' | 'manual';
}

/**
 * Strips reporter PII (`userId`) from public Report response payloads.
 */
export const sanitizeReportOutput = <T extends { userId?: string }>(report: T): Omit<T, 'userId'> => {
  const { userId: _userId, ...safeReport } = report;
  return safeReport;
};

/**
 * Calculates dynamic time-decay expiration based on incident nature:
 * - Active emergency crimes (MUGGING, THEFT, EXTORTION): 3 hours
 * - Recurring localized hotspots (DRUG_ACTIVITY): 24 hours
 * - Long-term infrastructural issues (UNLIT_ROAD): 14 days
 */
export const calculateReportExpiry = (category: ReportCategory, now: Date = new Date()): Date => {
  switch (category) {
    case 'THEFT':
    case 'SNATCHING':
    case 'MUGGING':
    case 'EXTORTION':
      return new Date(now.getTime() + 3 * 60 * 60 * 1000); // 3 hours
    case 'ROBBERY':
    case 'THEFT_ROBBERY':
    case 'DACOITY':
    case 'THEFT_DACOITY':
    case 'ARMED_ASSAULT':
    case 'SNATCHING_ARMED_ASSAULT':
      return new Date(now.getTime() + 4 * 60 * 60 * 1000); // 4 hours
    case 'ROAD_ACCIDENT':
    case 'TEEN_GANG_ARMED_ASSAULT':
      return new Date(now.getTime() + 6 * 60 * 60 * 1000); // 6 hours
    case 'YOUTH_GANG_ACTIVITY':
    case 'TEEN_GANG':
    case 'DRUG_RELATED_CRIME':
    case 'DRUG_ACTIVITY':
      return new Date(now.getTime() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000); // 24 hours
    case 'UNLIT_ROAD':
      return new Date(now.getTime() + 14 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000); // 14 days
    default:
      return new Date(now.getTime() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  }
};

/**
 * Checks if current time is within high-risk night hours (8 PM - 5 AM Bangladesh Time, UTC+6)
 */
export const isNightTimeInBangladesh = (now: Date = new Date()): boolean => {
  const bdHour = (now.getUTCHours() + 6) % 24;
  return bdHour >= 20 || bdHour < 5;
};

export const createReport = async (
  userId: string,
  payload: {
    category: ReportCategory;
    severity: ReportSeverity;
    latitude: number;
    longitude: number;
    description?: string;
  },
  deviceGps?: DeviceGpsTelemetry
) => {
  // Enforce account suspension check, trust score check, and rate-limiting check
  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: userId },
    select: { isBanned: true, trustScore: true, role: true, lastReportAt: true }
  });

  if (user?.isBanned) {
    const error: any = new Error('Your account has been suspended. You cannot submit reports.');
    error.statusCode = 403;
    throw error;
  }

  // Low trust restriction threshold (-5 or below)
  if (user && user.trustScore <= -5) {
    const error: any = new Error('Your account has been restricted from submitting reports due to a low community trust score.');
    error.statusCode = 400;
    throw error;
  }

  const now = new Date();

  // Tier-2 User Rate Limiting: Standard citizens must wait 15 minutes between submissions
  if (user && user.role === 'USER' && user.lastReportAt) {
    const elapsedMinutes = (now.getTime() - new Date(user.lastReportAt).getTime()) / (1000 * 60);
    if (elapsedMinutes < 15) {
      const waitMinutes = Math.ceil(15 - elapsedMinutes);
      const error: any = new Error(`Rate limit exceeded: Standard accounts must wait 15 minutes between submissions to prevent spam. Please wait ${waitMinutes} more minute(s).`);
      error.statusCode = 429;
      throw error;
    }
  }

  let isGpsVerified = false;

  if (deviceGps) {
    // Critical Business Rule: Proximity validation whenever device GPS coordinates are submitted (max 200m)
    const isCloseEnough = await isWithinDistance(
      payload.latitude, payload.longitude,
      deviceGps.latitude, deviceGps.longitude,
      MAX_GPS_PROXIMITY_METERS
    );

    if (!isCloseEnough) {
      const error: any = new Error('Submitted coordinate is too far from your actual GPS location (max 200m).');
      error.statusCode = 400;
      throw error;
    }

    // Verified only when unmodified hardware geolocation within accuracy threshold backed the proximity check.
    const hasHardwareAccuracy =
      typeof deviceGps.accuracy === 'number' &&
      Number.isFinite(deviceGps.accuracy) &&
      deviceGps.accuracy >= 0 &&
      deviceGps.accuracy <= MAX_HARDWARE_GPS_ACCURACY_METERS;

    isGpsVerified = hasHardwareAccuracy && deviceGps.source !== 'manual';
  }

  const expiresAt = calculateReportExpiry(payload.category, now);
  const isNightReport = isNightTimeInBangladesh(now);

  // Atomically create report, update lastReportAt, and populate PostGIS location
  const report = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    const createdReport = await tx.report.create({
      data: {
        userId,
        category: payload.category,
        severity: payload.severity,
        isNightReport,
        isGpsVerified,
        latitude: payload.latitude,
        longitude: payload.longitude,
        description: payload.description,
        locationPrecision: 'EXACT',
        verificationStage: 'CITIZEN_UNVERIFIED',
        threatStatus: 'ACTIVE',
        expiresAt
      }
    });

    await tx.user.update({
      where: { id: userId },
      data: { lastReportAt: now }
    });

    await setReportLocation(tx, createdReport.id, payload.latitude, payload.longitude);

    return createdReport;
  });

  // Phase 8: Broadcast newly created pin in real time with location fuzzing applied
  const fuzzed = getFuzzedCoordinates(report.id, report.latitude, report.longitude);

  emitNewReport({
    id: report.id,
    category: report.category,
    severity: report.severity,
    latitude: fuzzed.latitude,
    longitude: fuzzed.longitude,
    description: report.description,
    upvotes: report.upvotes,
    downvotes: report.downvotes,
    status: report.status,
    verificationStage: (report as any).verificationStage || 'CITIZEN_UNVERIFIED',
    citations: (report as any).citations || [],
    locationPrecision: (report as any).locationPrecision || 'EXACT',
    district: (report as any).district || null,
    upazila: (report as any).upazila || null,
    threatStatus: (report as any).threatStatus || 'ACTIVE',
    isGpsVerified: report.isGpsVerified,
    expiresAt: report.expiresAt,
    createdAt: report.createdAt
  });

  // Phase 11: Asynchronously enqueue geofenced alert checks for HIGH severity reports
  if (report.severity === 'HIGH') {
    enqueueReportNotification(report);
  }

  void broadcastPlatformStats();

  return {
    ...sanitizeReportOutput(report),
    latitude: fuzzed.latitude,
    longitude: fuzzed.longitude,
    fuzzedRadiusMeters: fuzzed.fuzzedRadiusMeters
  };
};

export const fetchReportsInBounds = async (bounds: BoundingBox, filters?: ReportFilterOptions) => {
  // Fetch from PostGIS with spatial envelope, live expiration check, and deterministic location fuzzing
  const reports: any = await getReportsInBounds(bounds, filters);
  return reports;
};

/**
 * Fetches a single incident by ID strictly stripping reporter PII and applying location fuzzing.
 */
export const fetchReportById = async (reportId: string, viewerUserId?: string) => {
  const report = await prisma.report.findUnique({
    where: { id: reportId },
    select: {
      id: true,
      userId: true,
      sourceUrl: true,
      sourceName: true,
      category: true,
      severity: true,
      isNightReport: true,
      isGpsVerified: true,
      latitude: true,
      longitude: true,
      description: true,
      upvotes: true,
      downvotes: true,
      status: true,
      verificationStage: true,
      citations: true,
      locationPrecision: true,
      district: true,
      upazila: true,
      threatStatus: true,
      expiresAt: true,
      createdAt: true,
      media: {
        select: {
          id: true,
          blurredUrl: true,
          createdAt: true
        }
      },
      user: {
        select: {
          isVerified: true,
          role: true
        }
      }
    }
  });

  if (!report || report.status === 'PURGED') {
    const error: any = new Error('Report not found or has been purged');
    error.statusCode = 404;
    throw error;
  }

  const fuzzed = getFuzzedCoordinates(report.id, report.latitude, report.longitude);
  const { user, userId, ...safeReport } = report;

  return {
    ...safeReport,
    latitude: fuzzed.latitude,
    longitude: fuzzed.longitude,
    fuzzedRadiusMeters: fuzzed.fuzzedRadiusMeters,
    authorVerified: user?.isVerified ?? false,
    authorRole: user?.role ?? 'USER',
    isOwner: Boolean(viewerUserId && viewerUserId === userId),
  };
};

/**
 * Marks an active report as RESOLVED (e.g. broken streetlamp repaired or danger cleared).
 * Permitted for the original reporter or users with VERIFIED_RESPONDER / ADMIN roles.
 */
export const resolveReport = async (reportId: string, userId: string, userRole: string) => {
  const report = await prisma.report.findUnique({
    where: { id: reportId },
    select: { id: true, userId: true, status: true }
  });

  if (!report) {
    const error: any = new Error('Report not found');
    error.statusCode = 404;
    throw error;
  }

  if (report.status === 'PURGED') {
    const error: any = new Error('Cannot resolve a purged report');
    error.statusCode = 400;
    throw error;
  }

  if (report.status === 'RESOLVED') {
    const error: any = new Error('Report is already marked as resolved');
    error.statusCode = 400;
    throw error;
  }

  // Authorization check
  const isAuthor = report.userId === userId;
  const isPrivileged = userRole === 'ADMIN' || userRole === 'VERIFIED_RESPONDER';

  if (!isAuthor && !isPrivileged) {
    const error: any = new Error('You do not have permission to resolve this report');
    error.statusCode = 403;
    throw error;
  }

  const updated = await prisma.report.update({
    where: { id: reportId },
    data: { status: 'RESOLVED' }
  });

  emitReportResolved({
    reportId: updated.id,
    status: updated.status,
    resolvedAt: new Date().toISOString()
  });

  void broadcastPlatformStats();

  const fuzzed = getFuzzedCoordinates(updated.id, updated.latitude, updated.longitude);
  const { userId: ownerId, ...safeUpdated } = updated;

  return {
    ...safeUpdated,
    latitude: fuzzed.latitude,
    longitude: fuzzed.longitude,
    fuzzedRadiusMeters: fuzzed.fuzzedRadiusMeters,
    isOwner: ownerId === userId,
  };
};
```

### What This Code Does
This service manages situational updates appended to existing active incident reports.
It validates whether the contributor is the original author or a verified responder before saving updates.
When an update is recorded, it triggers real-time WebSocket notifications to inform nearby commuters.

```typescript
import { prisma } from '../db/prisma';
import { emitNewReportUpdate } from '../sockets';

export const addReportUpdate = async (userId: string, reportId: string, content: string) => {
  const report = await prisma.report.findUnique({
    where: { id: reportId },
    select: { id: true, status: true }
  });

  if (!report) {
    const error: any = new Error('Report not found');
    error.statusCode = 404;
    throw error;
  }

  if (report.status === 'PURGED') {
    const error: any = new Error('Cannot append context updates to a purged report');
    error.statusCode = 400;
    throw error;
  }

  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: userId },
    select: { id: true, role: true, isVerified: true, anonymousId: true, isBanned: true }
  });

  if (user?.isBanned) {
    const error: any = new Error('Your account has been suspended. You cannot post context updates.');
    error.statusCode = 403;
    throw error;
  }

  const trimmedContent = content?.trim() || '';
  if (trimmedContent.length < 2) {
    const error: any = new Error('Update content must be at least 2 characters');
    error.statusCode = 400;
    throw error;
  }

  const update = await prisma.reportUpdate.create({
    data: {
      userId,
      reportId,
      content: trimmedContent,
    }
  });

  const sanitizedUpdate = {
    id: update.id,
    reportId: update.reportId,
    content: update.content,
    createdAt: update.createdAt,
    author: {
      isVerified: user?.isVerified ?? false,
      role: user?.role ?? 'USER',
      alias: user?.role === 'ADMIN' 
        ? 'Official Administrator' 
        : user?.isVerified 
          ? 'Verified Responder' 
          : `Citizen (${user?.anonymousId.slice(0, 6)}...)`
    }
  };

  // Broadcast live context update to all active map clients
  emitNewReportUpdate({
    reportId,
    update: sanitizedUpdate
  });

  return sanitizedUpdate;
};

export const getReportUpdates = async (reportId: string) => {
  const report = await prisma.report.findUnique({
    where: { id: reportId },
    select: { id: true, status: true }
  });

  if (!report || report.status === 'PURGED') {
    const error: any = new Error('Report not found or has been purged');
    error.statusCode = 404;
    throw error;
  }

  const updates = await prisma.reportUpdate.findMany({
    where: { reportId },
    orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' },
    include: {
      user: {
        select: {
          isVerified: true,
          role: true,
          anonymousId: true
        }
      }
    }
  });

  return updates.map((u) => ({
    id: u.id,
    reportId: u.reportId,
    content: u.content,
    createdAt: u.createdAt,
    author: {
      isVerified: u.user.isVerified,
      role: u.user.role,
      alias: u.user.role === 'ADMIN' 
        ? 'Official Administrator' 
        : u.user.isVerified 
          ? 'Verified Responder' 
          : `Citizen (${u.user.anonymousId.slice(0, 6)}...)`
    }
  }));
};
```

## [File 19] `apps/api/src/services/voteService.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/api/src/services/voteService.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 110  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This service handles community consensus voting (upvotes and downvotes) on active hazard reports.
It prevents duplicate votes by enforcing composite unique constraints on user ID and report ID.
Voting activity dynamically recalculates the report's community confirmation state and updates the author's trust score.

```typescript
import { prisma } from '../db/prisma';
import { emitReportVoted, emitReportPurged } from '../sockets';
import { broadcastPlatformStats } from './statsService';
import { sanitizeReportOutput } from './reportService';

export const submitVote = async (userId: string, reportId: string, voteType: 1 | -1) => {
  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: userId },
    select: { isBanned: true }
  });

  if (user?.isBanned) {
    const error: any = new Error('Your account has been suspended. You cannot vote on reports.');
    error.statusCode = 403;
    throw error;
  }

  const report = await prisma.report.findUnique({ where: { id: reportId } });
  if (!report) {
    const error: any = new Error('Report not found');
    error.statusCode = 404;
    throw error;
  }
  if (report.userId === userId) {
    throw new Error('You cannot vote on your own report');
  }
  if (report.status === 'PURGED') {
    throw new Error('Cannot vote on a purged report');
  }

  // Use a transaction to ensure vote record insertion and report aggregation happen atomically
  const result = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx: any) => {
    // 1. Check if vote already exists to prevent duplicate votes
    const existingVote = await tx.vote.findUnique({
      where: {
        userId_reportId: {
          userId,
          reportId
        }
      }
    });

    if (existingVote) {
      throw new Error('You have already voted on this report');
    }

    // 2. Insert vote
    await tx.vote.create({
      data: {
        userId,
        reportId,
        voteType
      }
    });

    // 3. Atomically increment the respective column
    const updatedReport = await tx.report.update({
      where: { id: reportId },
      data: voteType === 1 
        ? { upvotes: { increment: 1 } }
        : { downvotes: { increment: 1 } }
    });

    let finalReport = updatedReport;

    // 4. Trust Engine Rule: Community verification upvotes increment creator's trust score
    if (voteType === 1) {
      await tx.user.update({
        where: { id: report.userId },
        data: { trustScore: { increment: 1 } }
      });
    }

    // 5. Trust Engine Rule: If downvotes hit threshold, automatically purge and penalize creator
    if (updatedReport.downvotes >= 5) {
      finalReport = await tx.report.update({
        where: { id: reportId },
        data: { status: 'PURGED' }
      });
      
      // In addition, decrement the trust score of the creator by 1
      await tx.user.update({
        where: { id: report.userId },
        data: { trustScore: { decrement: 1 } }
      });
    }

    return finalReport;
  });

  // Phase 8: Emit real-time vote updates
  emitReportVoted({
    reportId: result.id,
    upvotes: result.upvotes,
    downvotes: result.downvotes,
    status: result.status
  });

  if (result.status === 'PURGED') {
    emitReportPurged({
      reportId: result.id,
      reason: 'TRUST_ENGINE_DOWNVOTE_THRESHOLD'
    });
  }

  void broadcastPlatformStats();

  return sanitizeReportOutput(result);
};
```

```typescript
import { prisma } from '../db/prisma';
import { Role, VerificationType } from '@prisma/client';
import { normalizeBangladeshPhone } from '@repo/shared';

export const getUserProfile = async (userId: string) => {
  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: userId },
    select: {
      id: true,
      email: true,
      role: true,
      isVerified: true,
      trustScore: true,
      isBanned: true,
      createdAt: true,
      _count: {
        select: {
          reports: true,
          votes: true,
          alertZones: true,
        },
      },
      verifications: {
        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
        take: 1,
        select: {
          id: true,
          type: true,
          status: true,
          phoneNumber: true,
          createdAt: true,
        },
      },
    },
  });

  if (!user) {
    throw new Error('User not found');
  }

  return user;
};

/**
 * Defense-in-depth account suspension check for service-layer entry points.
 */
export const assertUserNotSuspended = async (userId: string, actionMessage: string): Promise<void> => {
  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: userId },
    select: { isBanned: true },
  });

  if (!user) {
    throw Object.assign(new Error('User not found'), { statusCode: 404 });
  }

  if (user.isBanned) {
    throw Object.assign(new Error(actionMessage), { statusCode: 403 });
  }
};

export const submitVerification = async (
  userId: string,
  type: VerificationType,
  documentUrl?: string,
  phoneNumber?: string
) => {
  await assertUserNotSuspended(
    userId,
    'Your account has been suspended. You cannot submit verification requests.'
  );

  // Check if there's already a pending verification
  const existing = await prisma.userVerification.findFirst({
    where: { userId, status: 'PENDING' }
  });

  if (existing) {
    throw new Error('You already have a pending verification request');
  }

  const normalizedPhone =
    type === 'PHONE_OTP' && phoneNumber
      ? normalizeBangladeshPhone(phoneNumber)
      : undefined;

  const verification = await prisma.userVerification.create({
    data: {
      userId,
      type,
      documentUrl: type === 'NID_DOCUMENT' ? documentUrl?.trim() : undefined,
      phoneNumber: normalizedPhone,
      status: 'PENDING'
    }
  });

  return verification;
};

export const getPendingVerifications = async () => {
  return prisma.userVerification.findMany({
    where: { status: 'PENDING' },
    include: {
      user: {
        select: {
          id: true,
          email: true,
          phoneNumber: true,
          role: true,
          trustScore: true,
          createdAt: true
        }
      }
    },
    orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' }
  });
};

export const approveVerification = async (adminId: string, verificationId: string) => {
  const verification = await prisma.userVerification.findUnique({
    where: { id: verificationId },
    include: {
      user: {
        select: {
          id: true,
          role: true,
        }
      }
    }
  });

  if (!verification) {
    const error: any = new Error('Verification request not found');
    error.statusCode = 404;
    throw error;
  }

  if (verification.status !== 'PENDING') {
    const error: any = new Error(`Verification is already ${verification.status}`);
    error.statusCode = 400;
    throw error;
  }

  // Never downgrade an existing ADMIN account to VERIFIED_RESPONDER on KYC approval
  const nextRole =
    verification.user.role === Role.ADMIN ? Role.ADMIN : Role.VERIFIED_RESPONDER;

  // Use a transaction to approve verification, update user role, and log the action
  const [updatedUser] = await prisma.$transaction([
    prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: verification.userId },
      data: {
        isVerified: true,
        role: nextRole,
      },
      select: {
        id: true,
        anonymousId: true,
        email: true,
        role: true,
        isVerified: true,
        trustScore: true,
        isBanned: true,
        createdAt: true,
        updatedAt: true,
      }
    }),
    prisma.userVerification.update({
      where: { id: verificationId },
      data: { status: 'APPROVED' }
    }),
    prisma.moderationLog.create({
      data: {
        adminId,
        targetUserId: verification.userId,
        action: 'VERIFY_USER',
        reason: 'Manually approved KYC verification',
      }
    })
  ]);

  return updatedUser;
};

export const rejectVerification = async (adminId: string, verificationId: string, reason?: string) => {
  const verification = await prisma.userVerification.findUnique({
    where: { id: verificationId }
  });

  if (!verification) {
    const error: any = new Error('Verification request not found');
    error.statusCode = 404;
    throw error;
  }

  if (verification.status !== 'PENDING') {
    const error: any = new Error(`Verification is already ${verification.status}`);
    error.statusCode = 400;
    throw error;
  }

  const [rejected] = await prisma.$transaction([
    prisma.userVerification.update({
      where: { id: verificationId },
      data: { status: 'REJECTED' }
    }),
    prisma.moderationLog.create({
      data: {
        adminId,
        targetUserId: verification.userId,
        action: 'REJECT_VERIFICATION',
        reason: reason || 'Rejected KYC verification request',
      }
    })
  ]);

  return rejected;
};
```

```typescript
).map((s) => ({
  name: `${s.station_name_en}, ${s.district}`,
  type: 'POLICE_BOX' as SafeZoneType,
  latitude: s.location.latitude,
  longitude: s.location.longitude,
}));

/**
 * Reconciled 103 prominent safe havens across Bangladesh:
 * 5 hospitals + 2 pharmacies + 2 outposts + 94 verified police stations = 103 points
 * Note: Duplicate approximate police stations (Shahbagh & Kotwali Chittagong) are superseded
 * by their physically verified premises.
 */
export const DEFAULT_BANGLADESH_SAFE_ZONES: SafeZoneInput[] = [
  ...BASE_PROMINENT_SAFE_ZONES,
  ...VERIFIED_POLICE_SAFE_ZONES,
];

/**
 * Bengali name lookup map for verified police stations
 */
const POLICE_STATION_BN_LOOKUP = new Map<string, string>();
for (const s of ((verifiedPoliceData as any).stations || []) as Array<{
  station_name_en: string;
  station_name_bn: string;
  district: string;
}>) {
  POLICE_STATION_BN_LOOKUP.set(`${s.station_name_en}, ${s.district}`, s.station_name_bn);
  POLICE_STATION_BN_LOOKUP.set(s.station_name_en, s.station_name_bn);
}

let hasSeededSafeZones = false;
let seedSafeZonesPromise: Promise<number> | null = null;

/**
 * Automatically seeds prominent safe zones at most once per server process
 * lifecycle if missing. Uses idempotent checks so pre-existing databases receive
 * all 94 verified police stations without duplicating records.
 */
export const seedDefaultSafeZones = async (): Promise<number> => {
  if (hasSeededSafeZones) {
    return 0;
  }

  if (seedSafeZonesPromise) {
    return seedSafeZonesPromise;
  }

  seedSafeZonesPromise = (async () => {
    const count = await prisma.safeZone.count();
    if (count >= DEFAULT_BANGLADESH_SAFE_ZONES.length) {
      hasSeededSafeZones = true;
      return 0; // Already fully seeded
    }

    // Remove legacy approximate duplicate police stations if present
    await prisma.$executeRaw`
      DELETE FROM "SafeZone"
      WHERE name IN ('Shahbagh Police Station, Dhaka', 'Kotwali Police Station, Chittagong')
    `;

    // Deduplicate any exact-name duplicate rows if present
    await prisma.$executeRaw`
      DELETE FROM "SafeZone"
      WHERE id NOT IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT ON (name) id
        FROM "SafeZone"
        ORDER BY name, "createdAt" ASC
      )
    `;

    console.log('[SafeZoneService] Seeding reconciled Bangladesh safe havens (103 verified shelters)...');
    let inserted = 0;

    for (const zone of DEFAULT_BANGLADESH_SAFE_ZONES) {
      const res = await prisma.$executeRaw`
        INSERT INTO "SafeZone" (id, type, name, latitude, longitude, location, "createdAt", "updatedAt")
        SELECT
          gen_random_uuid(),
          ${zone.type}::"SafeZoneType",
          ${zone.name},
          ${zone.latitude},
          ${zone.longitude},
          ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(${zone.longitude}, ${zone.latitude}), 4326)::geography,
          NOW(),
          NOW()
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM "SafeZone"
          WHERE name = ${zone.name}
        )
      `;
      inserted += res;
    }

    hasSeededSafeZones = true;
    console.log(`[SafeZoneService] Successfully seeded ${inserted} safe zones.`);
    return inserted;
  })();

  try {
    return await seedSafeZonesPromise;
  } finally {
    seedSafeZonesPromise = null;
  }
};

/**
 * Fetches safe zones inside map bounding box with optional SafeZoneType filtering.
 */
export const fetchSafeZonesInBounds = async (
  bounds: BoundingBox,
  type?: SafeZoneType
) => {
  // Ensure default safe zones are seeded
  await seedDefaultSafeZones();

  const whereConditions: Prisma.Sql[] = [
    Prisma.sql`location && ST_MakeEnvelope(
      ${bounds.minLng}, ${bounds.minLat},
      ${bounds.maxLng}, ${bounds.maxLat},
      4326
    )`
  ];

  if (type) {
    whereConditions.push(Prisma.sql`type = ${type}::"SafeZoneType"`);
  }

  const whereClause = Prisma.join(whereConditions, ' AND ');

  const safeZones: any = await prisma.$queryRaw`
    SELECT id, type, name, latitude, longitude, "createdAt"
    FROM "SafeZone"
    WHERE ${whereClause}
    ORDER BY name ASC
  `;

  return safeZones.map((zone: any) => {
    const nameBn = POLICE_STATION_BN_LOOKUP.get(zone.name);
    return {
      ...zone,
      ...(nameBn ? { nameBn } : {}),
    };
  });
};

/**
 * Fetches nearest safe zones within a radial distance from user's coordinates.
 */
export const fetchNearbySafeZones = async (
  lat: number,
  lng: number,
  radiusMeters: number = 5000,
  type?: SafeZoneType
) => {
  await seedDefaultSafeZones();

  const whereConditions: Prisma.Sql[] = [
    Prisma.sql`ST_DWithin(
      location,
      ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(${lng}, ${lat}), 4326)::geography,
      ${radiusMeters}
    )`
  ];

  if (type) {
    whereConditions.push(Prisma.sql`type = ${type}::"SafeZoneType"`);
  }

  const whereClause = Prisma.join(whereConditions, ' AND ');

  const safeZones: any[] = await prisma.$queryRaw`
    SELECT 
      id, type, name, latitude, longitude,
      ROUND(ST_Distance(
        location,
        ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(${lng}, ${lat}), 4326)::geography
      )::numeric, 1)::double precision as "distanceMeters"
    FROM "SafeZone"
    WHERE ${whereClause}
    ORDER BY "distanceMeters" ASC
    LIMIT 20
  `;

  return safeZones.map((zone) => {
    const nameBn = POLICE_STATION_BN_LOOKUP.get(zone.name);
    return {
      ...zone,
      ...(nameBn ? { nameBn } : {}),
      distanceMeters:
        zone.distanceMeters !== null && zone.distanceMeters !== undefined
          ? Number(zone.distanceMeters)
          : zone.distanceMeters,
    };
  });
};

/**
 * Creates and persists a new verified safe haven (Admin only).
 */
export const createSafeZone = async (input: SafeZoneInput) => {
  const inserted: any[] = await prisma.$queryRaw`
    INSERT INTO "SafeZone" (id, type, name, latitude, longitude, location, "createdAt", "updatedAt")
    VALUES (
      gen_random_uuid(),
      ${input.type}::"SafeZoneType",
      ${input.name},
      ${input.latitude},
      ${input.longitude},
      ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(${input.longitude}, ${input.latitude}), 4326)::geography,
      NOW(),
      NOW()
    )
    RETURNING id, type, name, latitude, longitude, "createdAt"
  `;

  return inserted[0];
};

/**
 * Deletes an existing verified safe haven (Admin only).
 */
export const deleteSafeZone = async (id: string) => {
  const existing = await prisma.safeZone.findUnique({ where: { id } });
  if (!existing) {
    const error: any = new Error('Safe zone not found');
    error.statusCode = 404;
    throw error;
  }

  await prisma.safeZone.delete({ where: { id } });
  return { id, deleted: true, name: existing.name };
};
```
