### What This Code Does
This service integrates with the Open Source Routing Machine (OSRM) to calculate safety-aware transit paths.
It generates multi-modal route waypoints and spatial bounding envelopes between departure and destination coordinates.
It evaluates route geometry against active danger buffers to alert travelers to hazards intersecting their path.

```typescript
import { prisma } from '../db/prisma';
import { env } from '../config/env';
import type {
  SafeRouteOutput,
  RouteAlternative,
  LocalizedHazard,
  NavigationStep,
  TransportMode,
  RouteSafetyRating,
  OverallRouteSafetyRating,
} from '@repo/shared';

export interface RoutePoint {
  latitude: number;
  longitude: number;
}

// Backward compatibility alias
export type BypassedHazard = LocalizedHazard;

export interface SafeRouteOptions {
  injectedHazards?: any[];
  osrmBaseUrl?: string;
}

/**
 * Calculates great-circle distance between two coordinates in meters (Haversine formula)
 */
export const haversineDistanceMeters = (
  lat1: number,
  lng1: number,
  lat2: number,
  lng2: number
): number => {
  const R = 6371000; // Earth radius in meters
  const toRad = (deg: number) => (deg * Math.PI) / 180;

  const dLat = toRad(lat2 - lat1);
  const dLng = toRad(lng2 - lng1);

  const a =
    Math.sin(dLat / 2) * Math.sin(dLat / 2) +
    Math.cos(toRad(lat1)) * Math.cos(toRad(lat2)) * Math.sin(dLng / 2) * Math.sin(dLng / 2);

  const c = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
  return R * c;
};

/**
 * Calculates perpendicular distance from a hazard point to a line segment in meters
 */
export const distanceToSegmentMeters = (
  pointLat: number,
  pointLng: number,
  segStartLat: number,
  segStartLng: number,
  segEndLat: number,
  segEndLng: number
): { distanceMeters: number; projectionFactor: number } => {
  const dx = segEndLng - segStartLng;
  const dy = segEndLat - segStartLat;

  if (dx === 0 && dy === 0) {
    return {
      distanceMeters: haversineDistanceMeters(pointLat, pointLng, segStartLat, segStartLng),
      projectionFactor: 0,
    };
  }

  let t = ((pointLng - segStartLng) * dx + (pointLat - segStartLat) * dy) / (dx * dx + dy * dy);
  t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));

  const projLat = segStartLat + t * dy;
  const projLng = segStartLng + t * dx;

  return {
    distanceMeters: haversineDistanceMeters(pointLat, pointLng, projLat, projLng),
    projectionFactor: t,
  };
};

/**
 * Finds the minimum distance from a coordinate point to a polyline in meters
 */
export const distancePointToPolylineMeters = (
  point: [number, number],
  polyline: [number, number][]
): number => {
  if (!polyline || polyline.length === 0) return Infinity;
  if (polyline.length === 1) {
    return haversineDistanceMeters(point[0], point[1], polyline[0][0], polyline[0][1]);
  }

  let minDistance = Infinity;
  for (let i = 0; i < polyline.length - 1; i++) {
    const { distanceMeters } = distanceToSegmentMeters(
      point[0],
      point[1],
      polyline[i][0],
      polyline[i][1],
      polyline[i + 1][0],
      polyline[i + 1][1]
    );
    if (distanceMeters < minDistance) {
      minDistance = distanceMeters;
    }
  }
  return minDistance;
};

/**
 * Calculates total cumulative distance along a polyline in meters
 */
export const polylineDistanceMeters = (coords: [number, number][]): number => {
  if (!coords || coords.length < 2) return 0;
  let total = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < coords.length - 1; i++) {
    total += haversineDistanceMeters(
      coords[i][0],
      coords[i][1],
      coords[i + 1][0],
      coords[i + 1][1]
    );
  }
  return total;
};

/**
 * Validates coordinate point against Bangladesh geographic envelope
 */
export const validateBangladeshBounds = (
  lat: number,
  lng: number,
  label: string = 'Coordinate'
) => {
  if (lat < 20.3 || lat > 26.8 || lng < 87.8 || lng > 92.9) {
    const err: any = new Error(
      `${label} (${lat.toFixed(4)}, ${lng.toFixed(4)}) is outside Bangladesh territory boundaries.`
    );
    err.statusCode = 400;
    throw err;
  }
};

/**
 * Derives categorical safety rating from continuous safety score [15.0, 95.0]
 */
export const deriveSafetyRating = (score: number): RouteSafetyRating => {
  if (score >= 80.0) return 'LOW_HAZARD_EXPOSURE';
  if (score >= 50.0) return 'MODERATE_HAZARD_EXPOSURE';
  return 'HIGH_HAZARD_EXPOSURE';
};

/**
 * Formats a navigation step maneuver into a descriptive natural language instruction
 */
export const formatManeuverInstruction = (st: any): string => {
  if (st.instruction) return st.instruction;

  const streetName = st.name ? st.name.trim() : '';
  const type = st.maneuver?.type || 'turn';
  const modifier = st.maneuver?.modifier ? st.maneuver.modifier.replace(/_/g, ' ') : '';

  switch (type) {
    case 'depart':
      return streetName ? `Depart onto ${streetName}` : 'Depart from origin';
    case 'arrive':
      return modifier ? `Arrive at destination on the ${modifier}` : 'Arrive at destination';
    case 'turn':
      return modifier
        ? `Turn ${modifier}${streetName ? ` onto ${streetName}` : ''}`
        : `Turn${streetName ? ` onto ${streetName}` : ''}`;
    case 'new name':
    case 'continue':
      return streetName ? `Continue onto ${streetName}` : 'Continue straight';
    case 'roundabout':
    case 'rotary':
      return modifier
        ? `At the roundabout, exit ${modifier}${streetName ? ` onto ${streetName}` : ''}`
        : `Enter roundabout${streetName ? ` toward ${streetName}` : ''}`;
    case 'merge':
      return modifier
        ? `Merge ${modifier}${streetName ? ` onto ${streetName}` : ''}`
        : `Merge${streetName ? ` onto ${streetName}` : ''}`;
    case 'fork':
      return modifier
        ? `Take the fork ${modifier}${streetName ? ` onto ${streetName}` : ''}`
        : `Keep ${modifier || 'straight'}${streetName ? ` onto ${streetName}` : ''}`;
    case 'on ramp':
      return `Take on-ramp${streetName ? ` onto ${streetName}` : ''}`;
    case 'off ramp':
      return `Take exit ramp${streetName ? ` toward ${streetName}` : ''}`;
    case 'end of road':
      return modifier
        ? `Turn ${modifier} at end of road${streetName ? ` onto ${streetName}` : ''}`
        : `Turn at end of road${streetName ? ` onto ${streetName}` : ''}`;
    default:
      return streetName ? `Head along ${streetName}` : 'Continue along route';
  }
};

/**
 * Calculates explainable safety score reflecting estimated hazard exposure
 */
export const calculateSafetyScore = (
  distanceMeters: number,
  interceptedHazards: LocalizedHazard[],
  rawHazardsMap?: Map<string, { createdAt?: Date | string; isVerified?: boolean; upvotes?: number }>
): { safetyScore: number; safetyRating: RouteSafetyRating } => {
  const now = Date.now();
  let penalty = 0;

  for (const h of interceptedHazards) {
    const rawH = rawHazardsMap?.get(h.id);
    const baseWeight = h.severity === 'HIGH' ? 25 : h.severity === 'MEDIUM' ? 15 : 8;
    const buffer = h.severity === 'HIGH' ? 250 : h.severity === 'MEDIUM' ? 150 : 80;

    // Quadratic proximity falloff: ((buffer - dist) / buffer)^2
    const proximityRatio = Math.max(0, 1 - h.distanceFromRouteMeters / buffer);
    const proximityFalloff = proximityRatio * proximityRatio;

    // Recency decay: e^(-0.05 * ageHours)
    const createdAt = rawH?.createdAt ? new Date(rawH.createdAt).getTime() : now;
    const ageHours = Math.max(0, (now - createdAt) / (1000 * 3600));
    const recencyDecay = Math.exp(-0.05 * ageHours);

    // Verification multiplier: verified = 1.0, upvotes >= 3 = 0.9, unverified = 0.6
    const verificationMultiplier = rawH?.isVerified ? 1.0 : (rawH?.upvotes || 0) >= 3 ? 0.9 : 0.6;

    penalty += baseWeight * proximityFalloff * recencyDecay * verificationMultiplier;
  }

  // Distance penalty for long exposure
  const distPenalty = (distanceMeters / 1000) * 0.005;
  const rawScore = 95.0 - penalty - distPenalty;

  // Clamped continuously between 15.0 and 95.0
  const safetyScore = Math.min(95.0, Math.max(15.0, parseFloat(rawScore.toFixed(1))));
  const safetyRating = deriveSafetyRating(safetyScore);

  return { safetyScore, safetyRating };
};

/**
 * Calculates an optimal safe route between two points using genuine road network
 * geometry from OSRM and PostGIS spatial hazard corridor analysis.
 */
export const calculateSafeRoute = async (
  start: RoutePoint,
  end: RoutePoint,
  mode: TransportMode = 'driving',
  options?: SafeRouteOptions
): Promise<SafeRouteOutput> => {
  validateBangladeshBounds(start.latitude, start.longitude, 'Starting point');
  validateBangladeshBounds(end.latitude, end.longitude, 'Destination');

  const directDistance = Math.round(
    haversineDistanceMeters(start.latitude, start.longitude, end.latitude, end.longitude)
  );

  // Micro-route: start equals end (< ~0.01m)
  if (
    Math.abs(start.latitude - end.latitude) < 1e-7 &&
    Math.abs(start.longitude - end.longitude) < 1e-7
  ) {
    const singleCoord: [number, number] = [start.latitude, start.longitude];
    const zeroRoute: RouteAlternative = {
      id: 'fastest',
      title: 'Fastest Route',
      isRecommended: true,
      distanceMeters: 0,
      durationSeconds: 0,
      safetyScore: 95.0,
      safetyRating: 'LOW_HAZARD_EXPOSURE',
      hazardCount: 0,
      hazards: [],
      geometry: [singleCoord],
      steps: [
        {
          instruction: 'You have arrived at your destination.',
          distanceMeters: 0,
          durationSeconds: 0,
          maneuverType: 'arrive',
          location: singleCoord,
        },
      ],
    };

    return {
      origin: singleCoord,
      destination: singleCoord,
      directDistanceMeters: 0,
      safeDistanceMeters: 0,
      safetyRating: 'CLEAR',
      bypassedHazardsCount: 0,
      bypassedHazards: [],
      waypoints: [singleCoord],
      mode,
      routes: [zeroRoute],
    };
  }

  // Fetch routing geometry from OSRM
  const osrmProfile = mode === 'walking' ? 'walking' : 'driving';
  const osrmBaseUrl =
    options?.osrmBaseUrl ||
    process.env.OSRM_BASE_URL ||
    env.OSRM_BASE_URL ||
    'https://router.project-osrm.org';
  const osrmUrl = `${osrmBaseUrl}/route/v1/${osrmProfile}/${start.longitude},${start.latitude};${end.longitude},${end.latitude}?overview=full&geometries=geojson&steps=true&alternatives=true`;

  let osrmResponse: Response;
  const abortCtrl = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => abortCtrl.abort(), 5000);

  try {
    osrmResponse = await fetch(osrmUrl, { signal: abortCtrl.signal });
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err.name === 'AbortError') {
      const timeoutErr: any = new Error('Routing provider request timed out (>5000ms)');
      timeoutErr.statusCode = 504;
      throw timeoutErr;
    }
    const unavailErr: any = new Error('Routing provider unavailable');
    unavailErr.statusCode = 503;
    throw unavailErr;
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }

  if (osrmResponse.status === 503) {
    const err503: any = new Error('OSRM service unavailable (503)');
    err503.statusCode = 503;
    throw err503;
  }

  if (!osrmResponse.ok) {
    const err: any = new Error(`Routing provider returned status ${osrmResponse.status}`);
    err.statusCode = osrmResponse.status >= 500 ? 503 : 400;
    throw err;
  }

  const osrmData: any = await osrmResponse.json();
  if (!osrmData.routes || osrmData.routes.length === 0 || osrmData.code === 'NoRoute') {
    const noRouteErr: any = new Error('No route found between points (disconnected network)');
    noRouteErr.statusCode = 422;
    throw noRouteErr;
  }

  // Calculate spatial search envelope encompassing ALL route vertices across all alternatives + padding
  const allLats: number[] = [start.latitude, end.latitude];
  const allLngs: number[] = [start.longitude, end.longitude];

  for (const r of osrmData.routes) {
    if (r.geometry?.coordinates) {
      for (const [lng, lat] of r.geometry.coordinates) {
        allLats.push(lat);
        allLngs.push(lng);
      }
    }
  }

  const minLng = Math.min(...allLngs) - 0.015;
  const maxLng = Math.max(...allLngs) + 0.015;
  const minLat = Math.min(...allLats) - 0.015;
  const maxLat = Math.max(...allLats) + 0.015;

  let activeCorridorReports: any[] = [];
  const now = Date.now();

  if (options?.injectedHazards) {
    activeCorridorReports = options.injectedHazards.filter((h) => {
      const status = h.status || 'ACTIVE';
      if (status !== 'ACTIVE') return false;
      if (h.expiresAt) {
        const exp = new Date(h.expiresAt).getTime();
        if (exp <= now) return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
  } else {
    try {
      activeCorridorReports = await prisma.$queryRaw`
        SELECT r.id, r.category, r.severity, r.latitude, r.longitude, r.description, r."createdAt", r.upvotes, u."isVerified"
        FROM "Report" r
        LEFT JOIN "User" u ON r."userId" = u.id
        WHERE r.status = 'ACTIVE'
          AND r."expiresAt" > NOW()
          AND (
            r.location && ST_MakeEnvelope(${minLng}, ${minLat}, ${maxLng}, ${maxLat}, 4326)
            OR (r.latitude BETWEEN ${minLat} AND ${maxLat} AND r.longitude BETWEEN ${minLng} AND ${maxLng})
          )
      `;
    } catch {
      try {
        activeCorridorReports = await prisma.report.findMany({
          where: {
            status: 'ACTIVE',
            expiresAt: { gt: new Date() },
            latitude: { gte: minLat, lte: maxLat },
            longitude: { gte: minLng, lte: maxLng },
          },
          include: {
            user: { select: { isVerified: true } },
          },
        });
      } catch {
        activeCorridorReports = [];
      }
    }
  }

  const rawHazardsMap = new Map<
    string,
    { createdAt?: Date | string; isVerified?: boolean; upvotes?: number }
  >();

  for (const rep of activeCorridorReports) {
    rawHazardsMap.set(rep.id, {
      createdAt: rep.createdAt,
      isVerified: Boolean(rep.isVerified ?? rep.user?.isVerified),
      upvotes: rep.upvotes || 0,
    });
  }

  // Process all route alternatives from OSRM
  const routeAlternatives: RouteAlternative[] = osrmData.routes.map(
    (r: any, idx: number): RouteAlternative => {
      // Convert OSRM [lng, lat] to Leaflet [lat, lng]
      const geometry: [number, number][] = r.geometry.coordinates.map(
        ([lng, lat]: [number, number]) => [lat, lng]
      );

      // Corridor proximity buffer thresholds: HIGH: 250m, MEDIUM: 150m, LOW: 80m
      const interceptedHazards: LocalizedHazard[] = [];
      const seenHazardIds = new Set<string>();

      for (const h of activeCorridorReports) {
        if (seenHazardIds.has(h.id)) continue;

        const bufferLimit = h.severity === 'HIGH' ? 250 : h.severity === 'MEDIUM' ? 150 : 80;
        const dist = distancePointToPolylineMeters([h.latitude, h.longitude], geometry);

        if (dist <= bufferLimit) {
          seenHazardIds.add(h.id);
          interceptedHazards.push({
            id: h.id,
            category: h.category,
            severity: h.severity,
            distanceFromRouteMeters: Math.round(dist),
            latitude: h.latitude,
            longitude: h.longitude,
            description: h.description || null,
            approxStreetName: h.approxStreetName,
          });
        }
      }

      // Safety scoring
      const { safetyScore, safetyRating } = calculateSafetyScore(
        r.distance,
        interceptedHazards,
        rawHazardsMap
      );

      // Normalize pedestrian walking duration if OSRM returned vehicular speeds (> 2.0 m/s = > 7.2 km/h)
      let durationSeconds = Math.round(r.duration);
      if (mode === 'walking') {
        const rawSpeedMps = r.duration > 0 ? r.distance / r.duration : 0;
        if (rawSpeedMps > 2.0 || r.duration === 0) {
          // Normalize to realistic human walking speed of 1.25 m/s (~4.5 km/h)
          durationSeconds = Math.round(r.distance / 1.25);
        }
      }

      // Navigation steps paired with localized hazard warnings
      const rawSteps: any[] = r.legs?.[0]?.steps || [];
      const seenWarningHazardIds = new Set<string>();

      let steps: NavigationStep[] = rawSteps.map((st: any) => {
        const stepLoc: [number, number] = [st.maneuver.location[1], st.maneuver.location[0]];
        let warning: string | undefined = undefined;

        for (const h of interceptedHazards) {
          const stepDist = haversineDistanceMeters(stepLoc[0], stepLoc[1], h.latitude, h.longitude);
          if (stepDist <= 180 && !seenWarningHazardIds.has(h.id)) {
            seenWarningHazardIds.add(h.id);
            warning = `Caution: Active ${h.severity} hazard (${h.category}) reported within ${Math.round(stepDist)}m`;
            break;
          }
        }

        let stepDuration = Math.round(st.duration);
        if (mode === 'walking' && (st.duration === 0 || (st.distance / st.duration > 2.0))) {
          stepDuration = Math.round(st.distance / 1.25);
        }

        return {
          instruction: formatManeuverInstruction(st),
          distanceMeters: Math.round(st.distance),
          durationSeconds: stepDuration,
          maneuverType: st.maneuver?.type || 'turn',
          location: stepLoc,
          hazardWarning: warning,
        };
      });

      // Ensure minimum turn-by-turn guidance steps exist
      if (steps.length === 0) {
        steps = [
          {
            instruction: 'Depart from origin toward destination',
            distanceMeters: Math.round(r.distance),
            durationSeconds,
            maneuverType: 'depart',
            location: geometry[0] || [start.latitude, start.longitude],
          },
          {
            instruction: 'Arrive at destination',
            distanceMeters: 0,
            durationSeconds: 0,
            maneuverType: 'arrive',
            location: geometry[geometry.length - 1] || [end.latitude, end.longitude],
          },
        ];
      }

      const id = idx === 0 ? 'fastest' : idx === 1 ? 'safest' : 'alternative';
      const title = idx === 0 ? 'Fastest Route' : idx === 1 ? 'Alternative Route' : 'Scenic Route';

      return {
        id: id as any,
        title,
        isRecommended: false,
        distanceMeters: Math.round(r.distance),
        durationSeconds,
        safetyScore,
        safetyRating,
        hazardCount: interceptedHazards.length,
        hazards: interceptedHazards,
        geometry,
        steps,
      };
    }
  );

  // Classify and recommend routes with transparent, explainable trade-offs:
  // 1. Identify index with minimum duration (fastest)
  let fastestIdx = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < routeAlternatives.length; i++) {
    if (routeAlternatives[i].durationSeconds < routeAlternatives[fastestIdx].durationSeconds) {
      fastestIdx = i;
    }
  }

  // 2. Identify index with maximum safety score (safest). Tie breaker: shorter duration.
  let safestIdx = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < routeAlternatives.length; i++) {
    if (routeAlternatives[i].safetyScore > routeAlternatives[safestIdx].safetyScore) {
      safestIdx = i;
    } else if (
      routeAlternatives[i].safetyScore === routeAlternatives[safestIdx].safetyScore &&
      routeAlternatives[i].durationSeconds < routeAlternatives[safestIdx].durationSeconds
    ) {
      safestIdx = i;
    }
  }

  // 3. Assign IDs, titles, and recommendation based on actual metrics
  const hasSafetyAdvantage =
    routeAlternatives[safestIdx].safetyScore > routeAlternatives[fastestIdx].safetyScore;

  let recommendedIdx: number;

  if (hasSafetyAdvantage) {
    // There is a safer route that detours around hazards! Recommend it.
    recommendedIdx = safestIdx;
    routeAlternatives[safestIdx].id = 'safest';
    routeAlternatives[safestIdx].title = 'Safest Alternative';

    routeAlternatives[fastestIdx].id = 'fastest';
    routeAlternatives[fastestIdx].title = 'Fastest Route';

    // Label remaining alternatives
    for (let i = 0; i < routeAlternatives.length; i++) {
      if (i !== safestIdx && i !== fastestIdx) {
        routeAlternatives[i].id = 'alternative';
        routeAlternatives[i].title = 'Alternative Route';
      }
    }
  } else {
    // Fastest route is already the safest or tied with highest score.
    recommendedIdx = fastestIdx;
    routeAlternatives[fastestIdx].id = 'fastest';
    routeAlternatives[fastestIdx].title =
      routeAlternatives[fastestIdx].hazardCount === 0 ? 'Fastest Route' : 'Fastest Route';

    for (let i = 0; i < routeAlternatives.length; i++) {
      if (i !== fastestIdx) {
        routeAlternatives[i].id = 'alternative';
        routeAlternatives[i].title = 'Alternative Route';
      }
    }
  }

  routeAlternatives[recommendedIdx].isRecommended = true;
  const recommended = routeAlternatives[recommendedIdx];

  // Trade-off summary formulation
  let tradeOffSummary: string | undefined = undefined;
  if (routeAlternatives.length > 1) {
    if (hasSafetyAdvantage) {
      const fastest = routeAlternatives[fastestIdx];
      const deltaT = Math.round(
        Math.abs(recommended.durationSeconds - fastest.durationSeconds) / 60
      );
      const deltaD = Math.round(Math.abs(recommended.distanceMeters - fastest.distanceMeters));
      const deltaH = Math.abs(fastest.hazardCount - recommended.hazardCount);

      tradeOffSummary = `Recommended route reduces hazard exposure by ${deltaH} incidents (safety score ${recommended.safetyScore} vs ${fastest.safetyScore}) with a trade-off of +${deltaD}m (+${deltaT} mins).`;
    } else {
      tradeOffSummary = `Fastest route is recommended with duration of ${Math.round(
        recommended.durationSeconds / 60
      )} mins with comparable safety score (${recommended.safetyScore}).`;
    }
  }

  // Top-level legacy safetyRating for backward compatibility
  const legacySafetyRating: OverallRouteSafetyRating =
    recommended.hazardCount === 0 ? 'CLEAR' : 'HIGH_SAFETY';

  return {
    origin: [start.latitude, start.longitude],
    destination: [end.latitude, end.longitude],
    directDistanceMeters: directDistance,
    safeDistanceMeters: recommended.distanceMeters,
    safetyRating: legacySafetyRating,
    bypassedHazardsCount: recommended.hazardCount,
    bypassedHazards: recommended.hazards,
    waypoints: recommended.geometry,
    mode,
    routes: routeAlternatives,
    tradeOffSummary,
  };
};
```

### What This Code Does
This service manages user-defined polygonal geofences for personalized danger alerts.
It stores custom geographic areas as PostGIS polygons linked to the user's account.
When new incidents are reported inside a user's active geofence, it triggers automated push notifications.

```typescript
import { prisma } from '../db/prisma';
import { assertUserNotSuspended } from './userService';

export const MAX_ZONE_AREA_SQ_METERS = 25_000_000; // 25 square kilometers
export const MAX_ZONES_PER_USER = 5;

export interface AlertZoneOutput {
  id: string;
  userId: string;
  name: string;
  isActive: boolean;
  createdAt: Date;
  updatedAt: Date;
  area: any; // Parsed GeoJSON geometry
}

/**
 * Validates polygon coordinates ring structure and bounding values
 */
export const validatePolygonCoordinates = (coordinates: [number, number][]): void => {
  if (!Array.isArray(coordinates) || coordinates.length < 4) {
    throw new Error('Polygon must contain at least 4 coordinate pairs (3 vertices + 1 closing vertex).');
  }

  // Ring closure check: first point must equal last point
  const first = coordinates[0];
  const last = coordinates[coordinates.length - 1];
  if (first[0] !== last[0] || first[1] !== last[1]) {
    throw new Error('Polygon ring must be closed: the first and last coordinates must be identical.');
  }

  // Bounds check: WGS84 range [longitude, latitude]
  for (const [lng, lat] of coordinates) {
    if (typeof lng !== 'number' || typeof lat !== 'number' || isNaN(lng) || isNaN(lat)) {
      throw new Error('All coordinates must be valid numbers.');
    }
    if (lng < -180 || lng > 180) {
      throw new Error(`Longitude ${lng} is out of bounds (-180 to 180).`);
    }
    if (lat < -90 || lat > 90) {
      throw new Error(`Latitude ${lat} is out of bounds (-90 to 90).`);
    }
  }
};

/**
 * Creates and persists a PostGIS geofence polygon for a user
 */
export const createAlertZone = async (
  userId: string,
  name: string,
  coordinates: [number, number][]
): Promise<AlertZoneOutput> => {
  await assertUserNotSuspended(userId, 'Your account has been suspended. You cannot manage alert zones.');
  validatePolygonCoordinates(coordinates);

  // 1. Quota Check: Max active zones per user
  const countResult: any[] = await prisma.$queryRaw`
    SELECT COUNT(*)::int as count 
    FROM "UserAlertZone" 
    WHERE "userId" = ${userId} AND "isActive" = true
  `;
  const currentCount = countResult[0]?.count ?? 0;
  if (currentCount >= MAX_ZONES_PER_USER) {
    throw new Error(`You have reached the maximum allowed active alert zones (${MAX_ZONES_PER_USER}).`);
  }

  // 2. Format GeoJSON Polygon
  const geoJson = {
    type: 'Polygon',
    coordinates: [coordinates]
  };
  const geoJsonStr = JSON.stringify(geoJson);

  // 3. PostGIS Topological Validity Check (ST_IsValid)
  const validityResult: any[] = await prisma.$queryRaw`
    SELECT ST_IsValid(ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(${geoJsonStr}), 4326)) as "isValid",
           ST_IsValidReason(ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(${geoJsonStr}), 4326)) as "reason"
  `;
  if (!validityResult[0]?.isValid) {
    const error: any = new Error(
      `Invalid polygon topology: ${validityResult[0]?.reason || 'Polygon is self-intersecting or non-simple'}`
    );
    error.statusCode = 400;
    throw error;
  }

  // 4. PostGIS Geodesic Area Calculation & Anti-Abuse Cap (25 km²)
  const areaResult: any[] = await prisma.$queryRaw`
    SELECT ST_Area(ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(${geoJsonStr}), 4326)::geography) as "sqMeters"
  `;
  const sqMeters = parseFloat(areaResult[0]?.sqMeters ?? '0');

  if (sqMeters > MAX_ZONE_AREA_SQ_METERS) {
    throw new Error(
      `Zone area of ${(sqMeters / 1_000_000).toFixed(2)} km² exceeds the maximum limit of 25 km² (anti-abuse cap).`
    );
  }

  // 4. Insert into database using native PostGIS conversion
  const inserted: any[] = await prisma.$queryRaw`
    INSERT INTO "UserAlertZone" (id, "userId", name, area, "isActive", "createdAt", "updatedAt")
    VALUES (
      gen_random_uuid(),
      ${userId},
      ${name},
      ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(${geoJsonStr}), 4326)::geography,
      true,
      NOW(),
      NOW()
    )
    RETURNING id, "userId", name, "isActive", "createdAt", "updatedAt", ST_AsGeoJSON(area) as area
  `;

  const zone = inserted[0];
  return {
    ...zone,
    area: JSON.parse(zone.area)
  };
};

/**
 * Fetches all active alert zones for a user with parsed GeoJSON boundaries
 */
export const getUserAlertZones = async (userId: string): Promise<AlertZoneOutput[]> => {
  await assertUserNotSuspended(userId, 'Your account has been suspended. You cannot manage alert zones.');
  const zones: any[] = await prisma.$queryRaw`
    SELECT 
      id, "userId", name, "isActive", "createdAt", "updatedAt",
      ST_AsGeoJSON(area) as area
    FROM "UserAlertZone"
    WHERE "userId" = ${userId} AND "isActive" = true
    ORDER BY "createdAt" DESC
  `;

  return zones.map((z) => ({
    ...z,
    area: JSON.parse(z.area)
  }));
};

/**
 * Deletes an alert zone verifying ownership
 */
export const deleteAlertZone = async (userId: string, zoneId: string): Promise<boolean> => {
  await assertUserNotSuspended(userId, 'Your account has been suspended. You cannot manage alert zones.');
  // Check if zone exists first
  const existing: any[] = await prisma.$queryRaw`
    SELECT id, "userId" FROM "UserAlertZone" WHERE id = ${zoneId}
  `;

  if (existing.length === 0) {
    const error: any = new Error('Alert zone not found');
    error.statusCode = 404;
    throw error;
  }

  if (existing[0].userId !== userId) {
    const error: any = new Error('You do not have permission to delete this alert zone');
    error.statusCode = 403;
    throw error;
  }

  await prisma.$executeRaw`
    DELETE FROM "UserAlertZone" WHERE id = ${zoneId} AND "userId" = ${userId}
  `;

  return true;
};

/**
 * Finds all active user alert zones intersecting with a given coordinate point.
 * Leverages the GiST index on UserAlertZone.area for fast spatial lookups.
 */
export const findIntersectingAlertZones = async (
  latitude: number,
  longitude: number
): Promise<{ zoneId: string; userId: string; zoneName: string }[]> => {
  const matches: any[] = await prisma.$queryRaw`
    SELECT 
      z.id as "zoneId",
      z."userId",
      z.name as "zoneName"
    FROM "UserAlertZone" z
    WHERE z."isActive" = true
      AND ST_Intersects(
        z.area,
        ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(${longitude}, ${latitude}), 4326)::geography
      )
  `;

  return matches;
};
```

### What This Code Does
This service handles reverse geocoding between geographic coordinates and administrative boundaries in Bangladesh.
It resolves latitude and longitude coordinates to their corresponding division, district, and upazila.
This ensures news reports and citizen submissions are correctly indexed for administrative search filtering.

```typescript
import { isForeignIncident } from './internationalIncidentFilter';
import upazilasData from '../data/bangladesh_upazilas.json';

export interface UpazilaRecord {
  id: string;

  nameBn: string;
  districtEn: string;
  districtBn: string;
  divisionEn: string;
  divisionBn: string;
  latitude: number;
  longitude: number;
  aliasesEn?: string[];
  aliasesBn?: string[];
}

// Bounding box for Bangladesh: Latitude: 20.5 to 26.7, Longitude: 88.0 to 92.7

/**
 * Normalizes Bengali text to eliminate decomposed nukta mismatches (e.g. য+় vs য়, ড+় vs ড়)
 */
export function normalizeBengali(text: string): string {
  if (!text) return '';
  return text
    .normalize('NFC')
    .replace(/\u09af\u09bc/g, '\u09df') // য + ় -> য়
    .replace(/\u09a1\u09bc/g, '\u09dc') // ড + ় -> ড়
    .replace(/\u09a2\u09bc/g, '\u09dd'); // ঢ + ় -> ঢ়
}

export const BD_BOUNDS = {
  MIN_LAT: 20.5,
  MAX_LAT: 26.7,
  MIN_LNG: 88.0,
  MAX_LNG: 92.7,
};

  locationName: string;
  latitude: number;
  longitude: number;
  district?: string;
  upazila?: string;
  division?: string;
  locationPrecision: 'EXACT' | 'UPAZILA' | 'DISTRICT';
  source: 'DICTIONARY' | 'NOMINATIM';
}

export const isWithinBangladesh = (lat: number, lng: number): boolean => {
  return (
    lat >= BD_BOUNDS.MIN_LAT &&
    lat <= BD_BOUNDS.MAX_LAT &&
    lng >= BD_BOUNDS.MIN_LNG &&
    lng <= BD_BOUNDS.MAX_LNG

};

// Augment LOCAL_LANDMARK_MAP with authoritative statutory police stations across all 64 districts
try {
  const fs = require('fs');
  const path = require('path');
  const possiblePaths = [
    path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'bangladesh_police_stations.json'),
    path.resolve(__dirname, '../../../../bangladesh_police_stations.json'),
    path.resolve(__dirname, '../../../bangladesh_police_stations.json'),
    path.resolve(__dirname, '../../bangladesh_police_stations.json'),
  ];
  for (const p of possiblePaths) {
    if (fs.existsSync(p)) {
      const content = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf-8'));
      if (Array.isArray(content.stations)) {
        for (const st of content.stations) {
          if (!st.location?.latitude || !st.location?.longitude) continue;
          const lat = st.location.latitude;
          const lng = st.location.longitude;
          const standardName = `${st.station_name_en.replace(/\s+(?:Thana|Model Thana|Police Station)$/i, '')}, ${st.district}`;

          const enBase = st.station_name_en.toLowerCase().trim();
          const enShort = enBase.replace(/\s+(?:thana|model thana|police station)$/i, '').trim();
          if (enBase && !LOCAL_LANDMARK_MAP[enBase]) {
            LOCAL_LANDMARK_MAP[enBase] = { lat, lng, standardName, adminLevel: 'THANA' };
          }
          if (enShort && !LOCAL_LANDMARK_MAP[enShort]) {
            LOCAL_LANDMARK_MAP[enShort] = { lat, lng, standardName, adminLevel: 'THANA' };
          }

          if (st.station_name_bn) {
            const bnNorm = normalizeBengali(st.station_name_bn).toLowerCase().trim();
            const bnShort = bnNorm.replace(/\s+(?:থানা|মডেল থানা|পুলিশ ফাঁড়ি|পুলিশ স্টেশন)$/, '').trim();
            if (bnNorm && !LOCAL_LANDMARK_MAP[bnNorm]) {
              LOCAL_LANDMARK_MAP[bnNorm] = { lat, lng, standardName, adminLevel: 'THANA' };
            }
            if (bnShort && !LOCAL_LANDMARK_MAP[bnShort]) {
              LOCAL_LANDMARK_MAP[bnShort] = { lat, lng, standardName, adminLevel: 'THANA' };
            }
          }
        }
      }
      break;
    }
  }
} catch {
  // Graceful fallback to static dictionary
}

for (const u of ALL_UPAZILAS) {
  const normEn = u.nameEn.toLowerCase();
  const normBn = normalizeBengali(u.nameBn).toLowerCase();
  if (!LOCAL_LANDMARK_MAP[normEn] && !DISTRICT_NAMES.has(normEn)) {
    LOCAL_LANDMARK_MAP[normEn] = {
      lat: u.latitude,
      lng: u.longitude,
      standardName: u.nameEn,
      adminLevel: 'THANA',
    };
  }
  if (!LOCAL_LANDMARK_MAP[normBn] && !DISTRICT_NAMES.has(normBn)) {
    LOCAL_LANDMARK_MAP[normBn] = {
      lat: u.latitude,
      lng: u.longitude,
      standardName: u.nameEn,
      adminLevel: 'THANA',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Returns administrative priority weight:
 * - 100: Specific locality, neighborhood, thana, police station (e.g. Mirpur, Tongi, Chauddagram)
 * - 50: Broad district centroid (e.g. Dhaka, Chittagong, Gazipur)
 * - 10: Secondary place / hospital venue (e.g. DMCH, CMCH)
 */
export function getAdminPriority(key: string): number {
  const normKey = normalizeBengali(key).toLowerCase().trim();
  const entry = LOCAL_LANDMARK_MAP[normKey] || LOCAL_LANDMARK_MAP[key];
  if (entry?.adminLevel === 'HOSPITAL') return 10;
  if (DISTRICT_NAMES.has(normKey) || entry?.adminLevel === 'DISTRICT') return 50;
  return 100;
}

// Rate limiter for OpenStreetMap Nominatim (strictly max 1 request per second)
let lastNominatimCallTime = 0;
const NOMINATIM_DELAY_MS = 1100;

const throttleNominatim = async () => {
  const now = Date.now();
  const timeSinceLast = now - lastNominatimCallTime;
  if (timeSinceLast < NOMINATIM_DELAY_MS) {
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, NOMINATIM_DELAY_MS - timeSinceLast));
  }
  lastNominatimCallTime = Date.now();
};

/**
 * Searches the input text for any known Bangladesh landmark or thana name.
 * Ranks by administrative hierarchy: locality/thana (100) > district centroid (50) > hospital (10),
 * then descending by length within the same administrative tier.
 */
export const findLandmarkInText = (text: string): GeocodeResult | null => {
  const cleanInput = normalizeBengali(text).toLowerCase();

  // Sort keys by administrative hierarchy, then length
  const keys = Object.keys(LOCAL_LANDMARK_MAP).sort((a, b) => {
    const prioDiff = getAdminPriority(b) - getAdminPriority(a);
    if (prioDiff !== 0) return prioDiff;
    return b.length - a.length;
  });

  for (const key of keys) {
    const cleanKey = normalizeBengali(key).toLowerCase();

    let isMatch = false;

    // For English keys (letters, digits, spaces, hyphens, apostrophes), require word boundaries
    if (/^[a-z0-9\s'-]+$/.test(cleanKey)) {
      const escaped = cleanKey.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
      const regex = new RegExp(`(?:^|[^a-z0-9])${escaped}(?:$|[^a-z0-9])`, 'i');
      if (regex.test(cleanInput)) {
        isMatch = true;
      }
    } else {
      const escaped = cleanKey.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
      const regex = new RegExp(`(?:^|[^\\u0980-\\u09FF])${escaped}(?:ের|ে|তে|য়|য়ে|র|এর|এ)?(?:$|[^\\u0980-\\u09FF])`);
      if (regex.test(cleanInput)) {
        isMatch = true;
      }
    }

    if (!isMatch) {
      continue;
    }

    // Check for homonym disambiguation with candidate district
    if (HOMONYM_CANDIDATE_DISTRICTS[cleanKey]) {
      const candidates = HOMONYM_CANDIDATE_DISTRICTS[cleanKey];
      for (const candDist of candidates) {
        const normCand = candDist.toLowerCase();
        const bnNames = (DISTRICT_BN_MAP[candDist] || []).map((b) => normalizeBengali(b).toLowerCase());
        const hasMention =
          cleanInput.includes(normCand) ||
          bnNames.some((bn) => cleanInput.includes(bn));

        if (hasMention) {
          const uRec = ALL_UPAZILAS.find(
            (u) =>
              u.districtEn.toLowerCase() === candDist.toLowerCase() &&
              (u.nameEn.toLowerCase() === cleanKey || normalizeBengali(u.nameBn).toLowerCase() === cleanKey)
          );
          if (uRec) {
            return {
              locationName: uRec.nameEn,
              latitude: uRec.latitude,
              longitude: uRec.longitude,
              district: uRec.districtEn,
              upazila: uRec.nameEn,
              division: uRec.divisionEn,
              locationPrecision: 'UPAZILA',
              source: 'DICTIONARY',
            };
          }
        }
      }
    }

    if (isMatch) {
      const match = LOCAL_LANDMARK_MAP[key];
      const isDist = DISTRICT_NAMES.has(cleanKey) || match.adminLevel === 'DISTRICT';
      const isThana = match.adminLevel === 'THANA';
      const precision: 'EXACT' | 'UPAZILA' | 'DISTRICT' = isDist
        ? 'DISTRICT'
        : (isThana ? 'UPAZILA' : 'EXACT');

      let district = isDist ? match.standardName : undefined;
      let upazila = isThana ? match.standardName : undefined;
      let division = DISTRICT_TO_DIV_MAP[match.standardName];

      if (!district) {
        const matchedUpazila = ALL_UPAZILAS.find(
          (u) =>
            u.nameEn.toLowerCase() === match.standardName.toLowerCase() ||
            normalizeBengali(u.nameBn).toLowerCase() === cleanKey
        );
        if (matchedUpazila) {
          district = matchedUpazila.districtEn;
          upazila = matchedUpazila.nameEn;
          division = matchedUpazila.divisionEn;
        }
      }

      return {
        locationName: match.standardName,
        latitude: match.lat,
        longitude: match.lng,
        district,
        upazila,
        division,
        locationPrecision: precision,
        source: 'DICTIONARY',
      };
    }
  }

  // Check 495 Upazilas directly for places not in landmark map
  for (const u of ALL_UPAZILAS) {
    const normEn = u.nameEn.toLowerCase();
    const normBn = normalizeBengali(u.nameBn).toLowerCase();

    // Check English with word boundary
    const enRegex = new RegExp(`(?:^|[^a-z0-9])${normEn.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')}(?:$|[^a-z0-9])`, 'i');
    const bnRegex = new RegExp(`(?:^|[^\\u0980-\\u09FF])${normBn.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')}(?:ের|ে|তে|য়|য়ে|র|এর|এ)?(?:$|[^\\u0980-\\u09FF])`);
    if (enRegex.test(cleanInput) || bnRegex.test(cleanInput)) {
      return {
        locationName: u.nameEn,
        latitude: u.latitude,
        longitude: u.longitude,
        district: u.districtEn,
        upazila: u.nameEn,
        division: u.divisionEn,
        locationPrecision: 'UPAZILA',
        source: 'DICTIONARY',
      };
    }
  }

  // Check dynamic memory cache
  for (const [key, match] of dynamicCache.entries()) {
    const cleanKey = normalizeBengali(key).toLowerCase();
    if (cleanInput.includes(cleanKey)) {
      return {
        locationName: match.standardName,
        latitude: match.lat,
        longitude: match.lng,
        locationPrecision: 'EXACT',
        source: 'DICTIONARY',
      };
    }
  }

  return null;
};

/**
 * Fallback to OpenStreetMap Nominatim with rate limiting (1 req/sec) and countrycodes=bd
 */
export const geocodeWithNominatim = async (query: string): Promise<GeocodeResult | null> => {
  const cached = dynamicCache.get(query.toLowerCase());
  if (cached) {
    return {
      locationName: cached.standardName,
      latitude: cached.lat,
      longitude: cached.lng,
      locationPrecision: 'EXACT',
      source: 'NOMINATIM',
    };
  }

  try {
    await throttleNominatim();

    const encoded = encodeURIComponent(`${query}, Bangladesh`);
    const url = `https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q=${encoded}&countrycodes=bd&format=json&limit=1`;

    const res = await fetch(url, {
      headers: {
        'User-Agent': 'DangerZoneBD-PublicSafetyMap/1.0 (contact@dangerzonebd.org)',
      },
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      console.warn(`[Nominatim] Request failed with status ${res.status}`);
      return null;
    }

    const data = await res.json();
    if (!Array.isArray(data) || data.length === 0) {
      return null;
    }

    const first = data[0];
    const lat = parseFloat(first.lat);
    const lng = parseFloat(first.lon);

    // Validate that coordinates lie within Bangladesh bounds
    if (!isWithinBangladesh(lat, lng)) {
      console.warn(`[Nominatim] Returned coordinates (${lat}, ${lng}) outside Bangladesh bounds.`);
      return null;
    }

    const resultObj = {
      lat,
      lng,
      standardName: first.display_name.split(',').slice(0, 2).join(', ').trim(),
    };

    dynamicCache.set(query.toLowerCase(), resultObj);

    return {
      locationName: resultObj.standardName,
      latitude: lat,
      longitude: lng,
      locationPrecision: 'EXACT',
      source: 'NOMINATIM',
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`[Nominatim] Error geocoding query "${query}":`, error);
    return null;
  }
};

/**
 * Strips dateline bureau tokens from the beginning of news snippet text.
 * e.g. "Dhaka, Nov 19 (UNB) - " or "ঢাকা, ১৯ নভেম্বর - " or "স্টাফ রিপোর্টার, ঢাকা: "
 */
export function stripDateline(text: string): string {
  if (!text) return '';
  return text
    // "Dhaka, Nov 19 (UNB) - " or "Dhaka, Nov 19: " or "Dhaka — "
    .replace(
      /^(?:Dhaka|Chittagong|Chattogram|Sylhet|Rajshahi|Khulna|Barisal|Barishal|Rangpur|Mymensingh|Comilla|Cumilla)(?:,\s*|\s+)(?:[A-Za-z0-9\s,().—–:-]+?)(?:[-—–:]\s*|\s{2,})/i,
      ''
    )
    // "ঢাকা, ১৯ নভেম্বর (বাসস) - " or "ঢাকা, ১৯ নভেম্বর:"
    .replace(
      /^(?:ঢাকা|চট্টগ্রাম|রাজশাহী|সিলেট|খুলনা|বরিশাল|রংপুর|ময়মনসিংহ|ময়মনসিংহ|কুমিল্লা)(?:,\s*|\s+)(?:[\u0980-\u09FF0-9\s,().—–:-]+?)(?:[-—–:]\s*|\s{2,})/i,
      ''
    )
    // "নিজস্ব প্রতিবেদক, ঢাকা:" or "স্টাফ রিপোর্টার, ঢাকা -" or "অনলাইন ডেস্ক -"
    .replace(
      /^(?:নিজস্ব প্রতিবেদক|স্টাফ রিপোর্টার|অনলাইন ডেস্ক|Staff Reporter|Special Correspondent|News Desk)[^:—–-]+[:—–-]\s*/i,
      ''
    )
    .trim();
}

/**
 * Neutralizes transit departure and destination points in text so that a vehicle's origin
 * (e.g. "ঢাকা থেকে ছেড়ে আসা", "coming from Chittagong") or transit destination
 * (e.g. "চট্টগ্রামগামী", "ঢাকামুখী", "bound for Chittagong") does not override the actual crash scene.
 */
export function maskTransitDepartures(text: string): string {
  if (!text) return '';
  return text
    // Multi-city routes: "ঢাকা থেকে কক্সবাজারগামী", "Dhaka to Cox's Bazar bound"
    .replace(
      /(?:^|[\s,।–—])([^\s,।–—]+)\s*(?:থেকে|হতে)\s*([^\s,।–—]+)(?:গামী|মুখী|অভিমুখী)/gi,
      ' '
    )
    // Bengali destination suffixes: "ঢাকাগামী", "চট্টগ্রামগামী", "কক্সবাজারগামী", "ঢাকামুখী", "চট্টগ্রাম অভিমুখী"
    .replace(
      /(?:^|[\s,।–—])([^\s,।–—]+)(?:গামী|মুখী|অভিমুখী)/gi,
      ' '
    )
    // Bengali departure origins: "ঢাকা থেকে ছেড়ে আসা", "চট্টগ্রাম থেকে আসা", "সিলেট হতে ছেড়ে আসা", "খুলনা থেকে রওনা"
    .replace(
      /(?:^|[\s,।–—])(কক্স\s*বাজার|saint\s*martin|[^\s,।–—]+)\s*(?:থেকে|হতে)\s*(?:ছেড়ে\s*আসা|ছেড়ে\s*যাওয়া|ছেড়ে|ছেড়ে\s*আসা|ছেড়ে|আসা|রওনা|যাত্রা|ছেড়েছিল|আসছিল)/gi,
      ' '
    )
    // English destination phrases: "bound for Chittagong", "heading to Dhaka", "en route to Rajshahi", "destined for Sylhet"
    .replace(
      /(?:bound for|heading to|heading towards|heading toward|headed for|headed to|en route to|destined for|on its way to|way to)\s+([^\s,;]+)/gi,
      ' '
    )
    // English departure origins: "coming from Chittagong", "departed from Dhaka", "traveling from Rajshahi", "left Sylhet"
    .replace(
      /(?:coming from|departed from|departing from|traveling from|travelling from|en route from|bound from|bus from|truck from|left|originating from)\s+([^\s,;]+)/gi,
      ' '
    );
}

/**
 * Neutralizes inter-district connecting highway and expressway corridor names
 * (e.g. "ঢাকা-চট্টগ্রাম মহাসড়কে", "Dhaka-Chittagong highway") so that the corridor endpoints
 * do not hijack incidents occurring in intermediate districts (e.g. Feni, Cumilla, Narayanganj).
 */
export function maskHighwayCorridors(text: string): string {
  if (!text) return '';
  return text
    // Bengali: "ঢাকা-চট্টগ্রাম মহাসড়কে", "ঢাকা-সিলেট মহাসড়কে", "ঢাকা-মাওয়া এক্সপ্রেসওয়েতে"
    .replace(
      /[^\s,।–—]+-[^\s,।–—]+\s*(?:মহাসড়কে|মহাসড়ক|এক্সপ্রেসওয়েতে|এক্সপ্রেসওয়ে|সড়কে|সড়ক)/gi,
      ' '
    )
    // English: "Dhaka-Chittagong highway", "Dhaka-Sylhet expressway"
    .replace(
      /[A-Za-z]+-[A-Za-z]+\s+(?:highway|expressway|corridor|road)/gi,
      ' '
    );
}

/**
 * Masks secondary medical / hospital venues in text so that the hospital where victims were rushed
 * (e.g. "ঢামেক হাসপাতালে নেওয়া হলে", "Dhaka Medical College Hospital", "কুমিল্লা মেডিকেল কলেজ হাসপাতালে")
 * does not override the actual accident / crime scene.
 */
export function maskHospitalPhrases(text: string): string {
  if (!text) return '';
  return text
    // Bengali medical colleges & hospitals: Any district/place preceding hospital
    // e.g. "ঢাকা মেডিকেল কলেজ হাসপাতাল", "কুমিল্লা মেডিকেল কলেজ হাসপাতাল", "ফেনী সদর হাসপাতাল", "কেরানীগঞ্জ উপজেলা স্বাস্থ্য কমপ্লেক্স"
    .replace(
      /(?:^|[\s,।–—])(?:[^\s,।–—]+\s+)?(?:মেডিকেল\s*কলেজ\s*(?:হাসপাতাল|এ)?|মেডিকেলে|মেডিকেল|সদর\s*হাসপাতাল|জেনারেল\s*হাসপাতাল|উপজেলা\s*স্বাস্থ্য\s*কমপ্লেক্স|স্বাস্থ্য\s*কমপ্লেক্স|হাসপাতালে|হাসপাতাল)/gi,
      ' '
    )
    // English medical colleges & hospitals: "Dhaka Medical College Hospital", "Cumilla Medical College", "Feni Sadar Hospital"
    .replace(
      /(?:[A-Za-z]+\s+)?(?:Medical\s+College\s+(?:Hospital)?|Medical|Sadar\s+Hospital|General\s+Hospital|District\s+Hospital|Health\s+Complex)/gi,
      ' '
    )
    // Referral phrases in English: "rushed to Dhaka Medical", "admitted to Chittagong Hospital"
    .replace(
      /(?:rushed to|admitted to|taken to|referred to)\s+[^,;]+(?:\s+Hospital)?/gi,
      ' '
    )
    // Known medical centers and acronyms: "ঢামেক", "চমেক", "রামেক", "কুমেক", "পঙ্গু হাসপাতাল", "DMCH", "CMCH", "NITOR"
    .replace(
      /\b(?:ঢামেক|চমেক|রামেক|সিমেক|শমেক|কুমেক|শজিমেক|মিটফোর্ড|পঙ্গু\s*হাসপাতাল|সোহরাওয়ার্দী\s*হাসপাতাল|DMCH|CMCH|RMCH|SOMCH|NITOR|BSMMU)\b/gi,
      ' '
    );
}

/**
 * Masks secondary administrative filing places (e.g. police stations where a report/GD was filed later)
 * to prevent them from overriding the actual physical crime/accident scene.
 */
export function maskSecondaryPlaces(text: string): string {
  if (!text) return '';
  return text
    // Secondary filing police stations: "শাহবাগ থানায় মামলা", "কোতোয়ালী থানায় সাধারণ ডায়েরি"
    .replace(
      /[^\s,।–—]+\s*(?:থানায়\s*(?:মামলা|অভিযোগ|সাধারণ\s*ডায়েরি|জিডি|হস্তান্তর|সোপর্দ))/gi,
      ' '
    )
    // English: "case filed with Kotwali police station"
    .replace(
      /(?:case filed with|complaint lodged at|handed over to)\s+([^\s,;]+)\s+(?:police station|thana)/gi,
      ' '
    );
}

/**
 * Neutralizes common non-geographic homonym words that coincide with upazila names
 * (e.g. "তালা ভেঙে" = breaking lock, not Tala Upazila in Satkhira).
 */
export function maskFalsePositivePhrases(text: string): string {
  if (!text) return '';
  return text
    .replace(/(?:দোকানের|ঘরের|গেটের|বাড়ির|আলমারির)\s+তালা/gi, ' ')
    .replace(/তালা\s+(?:ভেঙে|ভেঙ্গে|কেটে|মেরে|খুলে|ঝুলিয়ে|ভেঙেছে)/gi, ' ');
}

function maskAllSecondaryNoise(text: string): string {
  if (!text) return '';
  return maskFalsePositivePhrases(
    maskSecondaryPlaces(
      maskHighwayCorridors(
        maskTransitDepartures(
          maskHospitalPhrases(text)
        )
      )
    )
  );
}

/**
 * Determines if a matched location in the text refers merely to a casualty's origin/residence
 * (e.g. "নিহতদের বাড়ি কক্সবাজারে", "গ্রামের বাড়ি চকরিয়ায়") rather than the actual incident scene.
 */
export function isVictimOriginContext(text: string, locationName: string): boolean {
  if (!text) return false;
  const normText = text.normalize('NFC').toLowerCase();
  const lowerLoc = locationName.toLowerCase();

  const originTerms = [
    'বাড়ি',
    'বাড়ি',
    'গ্রামের বাড়ি',
    'গ্রামের বাড়ি',
    'বাসিন্দা',
    'নিবাসী',
    'পৈতৃক',
    'স্বজন',
    'পরিবার',
    'লাশ',
    'মরদেহ',
    'দাফন',
  ];

  for (const term of originTerms) {
    const patternBefore = new RegExp(`(?:${term})[\\s\\S]{0,35}?(?:${lowerLoc})`, 'i');
    const patternAfter = new RegExp(`(?:${lowerLoc})[\\s\\S]{0,35}?(?:${term})`, 'i');
    if (patternBefore.test(normText) || patternAfter.test(normText)) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  return false;
}

/**
 * High-level domestic geocode resolver:
 * 1. Rejects international/foreign events (USA, Saudi, UK, Canada, India, etc.) -> returns null (pins nothing).
 * 2. Matches the headline first (highest confidence incident location).
 * 3. Applies administrative hierarchy: Locality / Thana > District Centroid.
 * 4. Neutralizes transit departure origins and secondary hospital/court venues.
 * 5. Strips datelines from news snippets.
 */
export const resolveLocationFromText = async (
  titleOrCombined: string,
  snippet?: string
): Promise<GeocodeResult | null> => {
  const title = titleOrCombined || '';
  const body = snippet || '';

  // 1. Universal Global Foreign Incident Filter:
  // If an incident happened in USA, Saudi Arabia, UK, Canada, India, etc., pin NOTHING in Bangladesh!
  const foreignCheck = isForeignIncident(title, body);
  if (foreignCheck.isForeign) {
    return null;
  }

  // Dateline bureau stripping
  const cleanBody = stripDateline(body);

  // 2. Headline Priority Match with transit, highway, hospital, and secondary place masking:
  // Incident scenes almost always appear in the headline without departure/destination/hospital noise
  const maskedTitle = maskAllSecondaryNoise(title);
  const headlineMatch = findLandmarkInText(maskedTitle);
  if (headlineMatch) {
    if (!isVictimOriginContext(title, headlineMatch.locationName)) {
      return headlineMatch;
    }
  }

  // 3. Snippet inspection with masking:
  // If body snippet is provided, check if masked body reveals the incident scene
  if (cleanBody) {
    const maskedBody = maskAllSecondaryNoise(cleanBody);
    const bodySceneMatch = findLandmarkInText(maskedBody);
    if (bodySceneMatch && !isVictimOriginContext(cleanBody, bodySceneMatch.locationName)) {
      return bodySceneMatch;
    }
  }

  // 4. Fallback to raw unmasked headline (e.g. story purely about "Dhaka-Chittagong highway" or hospital venue)
  const rawHeadlineMatch = findLandmarkInText(title);
  if (rawHeadlineMatch && !isVictimOriginContext(title, rawHeadlineMatch.locationName)) {
    return rawHeadlineMatch;
  }

  // 5. Fallback to raw clean body
  if (cleanBody) {
    const rawBodyMatch = findLandmarkInText(cleanBody);
    if (rawBodyMatch && !isVictimOriginContext(cleanBody, rawBodyMatch.locationName)) {
      return rawBodyMatch;
    }
  } else if (!snippet) {
    const maskedCombined = maskAllSecondaryNoise(titleOrCombined);
    const combinedMatch = findLandmarkInText(maskedCombined);
    if (combinedMatch && !isVictimOriginContext(titleOrCombined, combinedMatch.locationName)) {
      return combinedMatch;
    }

    const rawMatch = findLandmarkInText(titleOrCombined);
    if (rawMatch && !isVictimOriginContext(titleOrCombined, rawMatch.locationName)) {
      return rawMatch;
    }
  }

  return null;
};
```

### What This Code Does
This utility service applies automated visual privacy protections to user-uploaded incident media.
It detects and blurs sensitive regions, personal faces, and vehicle license plates before public distribution.
This protects eyewitnesses and bystanders from retaliation while preserving visual evidence of the hazard.

```typescript
import { prisma } from '../db/prisma';

/**
 * Processes privacy auto-blurring on uploaded evidence photos.
 * Until an active blurring pipeline (e.g., Sharp, Lambda, or Cloudinary) writes a blurred
 * derivative object to storage, persists the verified storage URL so evidence does not 404.
 */
export const processPrivacyBlur = async (mediaId: string, verifiedUrl: string): Promise<string> => {
  try {
    const blurredUrl = verifiedUrl;

    // Update ReportMedia table with the accessible storage URL
    await prisma.reportMedia.update({
      where: { id: mediaId },
      data: {
        blurredUrl,
      },
    });

    return blurredUrl;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`❌ [PrivacyBlurService] Failed to process privacy blur for media ${mediaId}:`, error);
    throw error;
  }
};
```

### What This Code Does
This service manages object storage interactions with AWS S3 or Supabase Storage buckets.
It generates pre-signed upload URLs allowing clients to securely upload incident photographs directly.
It validates file mime types, enforces file size ceilings, and constructs immutable CDN media URLs.

```typescript
import { S3Client, PutObjectCommand } from '@aws-sdk/client-s3';
import { getSignedUrl } from '@aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner';
import { randomUUID } from 'crypto';
import { env } from '../config/env';

export const ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'] as const;
export type AllowedMimeType = (typeof ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES)[number];
export const MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024; // 5MB
export const MAX_INLINE_MOCK_IMAGE_BYTES = 512 * 1024; // 512KB max decoded inline mock evidence

const UUID_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
const SAFE_MEDIA_FILENAME_REGEX = /^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp)$/i;
const INLINE_IMAGE_DATA_URL_REGEX = /^data:(image\/(?:jpeg|png|webp));base64,([A-Za-z0-9+/=]+)$/i;

export interface PresignedUploadResult {
  uploadUrl: string;
  fileKey: string;
  publicUrl: string;
  expiresInSeconds: number;
  isMock: boolean;
}

export interface ResolveConfirmedMediaInput {
  reportId: string;
  originalUrl?: string;
  fileKey?: string;
}

const MIME_EXTENSION_MAP: Record<AllowedMimeType, string> = {
  'image/jpeg': 'jpg',
  'image/png': 'png',
  'image/webp': 'webp',
};

const readRuntimeSetting = (key: keyof typeof env): string | undefined => {
  const raw = key in process.env ? process.env[key] : (env[key] as string | undefined);
  const trimmed = raw?.trim();
  return trimmed ? trimmed : undefined;
};

const getStorageConfig = () => ({
  bucket: readRuntimeSetting('S3_BUCKET') || env.S3_BUCKET,
  region: readRuntimeSetting('S3_REGION') || env.S3_REGION,
  s3PublicDomain: readRuntimeSetting('S3_PUBLIC_DOMAIN'),
  storageCdnUrl: readRuntimeSetting('STORAGE_CDN_URL'),
  s3Endpoint: readRuntimeSetting('S3_ENDPOINT'),
});

const parseHttpUrl = (rawUrl: string): URL | null => {
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(rawUrl.trim());
    if (parsed.protocol !== 'http:' && parsed.protocol !== 'https:') {
      return null;
    }
    if (parsed.username || parsed.password || parsed.search || parsed.hash) {
      return null;
    }
    return parsed;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

// Initialize S3 client if credentials exist
let s3Client: S3Client | null = null;
if (env.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID && env.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY) {
  s3Client = new S3Client({
    region: env.S3_REGION,
    endpoint: env.S3_ENDPOINT,
    credentials: {
      accessKeyId: env.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID,
      secretAccessKey: env.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY,
    },
    forcePathStyle: Boolean(env.S3_ENDPOINT),
  });
}

/**
 * Safely URL-decodes a storage object key.
 */
export const decodeStorageKey = (rawKey: string): string | null => {
  try {
    return decodeURIComponent(rawKey.replace(/\+/g, ' '));
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

/**
 * Validates and parses a report media key matching `reports/{reportId}/{filename}`.
 */
export const parseReportMediaKey = (
  rawKey: string,
  expectedReportId?: string
): { reportId: string; fileKey: string } | null => {
  const decoded = decodeStorageKey(rawKey.trim());
  if (!decoded || decoded.startsWith('/') || decoded.includes('\\') || decoded.includes('..')) {
    return null;
  }

  const parts = decoded.split('/');
  if (parts.length !== 3 || parts[0] !== 'reports') {
    return null;
  }

  const [, reportId, filename] = parts;
  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(reportId)) {
    return null;
  }

  if (expectedReportId && reportId.toLowerCase() !== expectedReportId.toLowerCase()) {
    return null;
  }

  // Skip derivative blurred assets and enforce safe image extensions
  if (filename.startsWith('blurred-') || !SAFE_MEDIA_FILENAME_REGEX.test(filename)) {
    return null;
  }

  return { reportId, fileKey: decoded };
};

/**
 * Resolves the trusted storage base URLs configured for this deployment.
 */
export const getTrustedStorageBaseUrls = (): URL[] => {
  const { bucket, region, s3PublicDomain, storageCdnUrl, s3Endpoint } = getStorageConfig();
  const hasExplicitOverride = Boolean(s3PublicDomain || storageCdnUrl || s3Endpoint);
  const explicitBases: URL[] = [];

  for (const candidate of [
    s3PublicDomain,
    storageCdnUrl,
    s3Endpoint ? `${s3Endpoint.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/${bucket}` : undefined,
  ]) {
    if (!candidate) continue;
    const parsed = parseHttpUrl(candidate);
    if (parsed) {
      explicitBases.push(parsed);
    }
  }

  if (hasExplicitOverride) {
    return explicitBases;
  }

  return [new URL(`https://${bucket}.s3.${region}.amazonaws.com`)];
};

/**
 * Returns public CDN or bucket URL for a given file key
 */
export const getPublicUrl = (fileKey: string): string => {
  const { bucket, region, s3PublicDomain, storageCdnUrl, s3Endpoint } = getStorageConfig();
  const publicBase = s3PublicDomain || storageCdnUrl;
  if (publicBase) {
    return `${publicBase.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/${fileKey}`;
  }
  if (s3Endpoint) {
    return `${s3Endpoint.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/${bucket}/${fileKey}`;
  }
  return `https://${bucket}.s3.${region}.amazonaws.com/${fileKey}`;
};

/**
 * Validates `fileKey` and/or `originalUrl` for `/media/confirm`, ensuring trusted origin and report ownership path.
 */
export const resolveTrustedReportMedia = (
  input: ResolveConfirmedMediaInput
): { fileKey: string; originalUrl: string } => {
  const { reportId, originalUrl, fileKey } = input;
  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(reportId)) {
    throw Object.assign(new Error('reportId must be a valid UUID'), { statusCode: 400 });
  }

  if (!originalUrl && !fileKey) {
    throw Object.assign(new Error('Either originalUrl or fileKey must be provided'), { statusCode: 400 });
  }

  let parsedFromKey: { reportId: string; fileKey: string } | null = null;
  if (fileKey) {
    parsedFromKey = parseReportMediaKey(fileKey, reportId);
    if (!parsedFromKey) {
      throw Object.assign(
        new Error(`fileKey must match reports/${reportId}/<valid-image-filename>`),
        { statusCode: 400 }
      );
    }
  }

  let parsedFromUrl: { fileKey: string; normalizedUrl: string; isEndpointOnly: boolean } | null = null;
  if (originalUrl) {
    if (originalUrl.includes('\\')) {
      throw Object.assign(new Error('originalUrl contains invalid path characters'), { statusCode: 400 });
    }

    const candidateUrl = parseHttpUrl(originalUrl);
    if (!candidateUrl) {
      throw Object.assign(
        new Error('originalUrl must be an http/https URL without credentials, query parameters, or fragments'),
        { statusCode: 400 }
      );
    }

    const { bucket, s3PublicDomain, storageCdnUrl, s3Endpoint } = getStorageConfig();
    const endpointBase = s3Endpoint
      ? parseHttpUrl(`${s3Endpoint.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/${bucket}`)
      : null;
    const endpointNormalizedBase = endpointBase
      ? `${endpointBase.origin}${endpointBase.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '')}`
      : undefined;
    const publicOverrideConfigured = Boolean(s3PublicDomain || storageCdnUrl);

    for (const base of getTrustedStorageBaseUrls()) {
      if (candidateUrl.origin !== base.origin) {
        continue;
      }

      const basePath = base.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '');
      const expectedPrefix = `${basePath}/`;
      if (!candidateUrl.pathname.startsWith(expectedPrefix)) {
        continue;
      }

      const relativePath = candidateUrl.pathname.slice(expectedPrefix.length);
      const parsedKey = parseReportMediaKey(relativePath, reportId);
      if (parsedKey) {
        const matchedBase = `${base.origin}${basePath}`;
        parsedFromUrl = {
          fileKey: parsedKey.fileKey,
          normalizedUrl: `${matchedBase}/${parsedKey.fileKey}`,
          isEndpointOnly: Boolean(
            endpointNormalizedBase && matchedBase === endpointNormalizedBase && publicOverrideConfigured
          ),
        };
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!parsedFromUrl) {
      throw Object.assign(
        new Error(`originalUrl must start with a trusted storage prefix under reports/${reportId}/`),
        { statusCode: 400 }
      );
    }
  }

  if (parsedFromKey && parsedFromUrl && parsedFromKey.fileKey !== parsedFromUrl.fileKey) {
    throw Object.assign(
      new Error('fileKey and originalUrl refer to different storage objects'),
      { statusCode: 400 }
    );
  }

  const resolvedFileKey = parsedFromUrl?.fileKey || parsedFromKey!.fileKey;
  const resolvedUrl =
    parsedFromUrl && !parsedFromUrl.isEndpointOnly
      ? parsedFromUrl.normalizedUrl
      : getPublicUrl(resolvedFileKey);

  return {
    fileKey: resolvedFileKey,
    originalUrl: resolvedUrl,
  };
};

/**
 * Generates a short-lived presigned upload URL for direct client-to-storage upload
 */
export const generatePresignedUploadUrl = async (
  reportId: string,
  fileType: AllowedMimeType,
  fileSizeBytes: number
): Promise<PresignedUploadResult> => {
  if (!ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES.includes(fileType)) {
    throw new Error(`Unsupported MIME type: ${fileType}. Allowed: ${ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES.join(', ')}`);
  }

  if (fileSizeBytes > MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES) {
    throw new Error(`File size (${fileSizeBytes} bytes) exceeds 5MB limit (${MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES} bytes).`);
  }

  const extension = MIME_EXTENSION_MAP[fileType];
  const fileKey = `reports/${reportId}/${randomUUID()}.${extension}`;
  const expiresInSeconds = 600; // 10 minutes
  const publicUrl = getPublicUrl(fileKey);

  // If S3 client is configured with real credentials, generate real signed URL
  if (s3Client) {
    const command = new PutObjectCommand({
      Bucket: env.S3_BUCKET,
      Key: fileKey,
      ContentType: fileType,
      ContentLength: fileSizeBytes,
    });

    const uploadUrl = await getSignedUrl(s3Client, command, { expiresIn: expiresInSeconds });

    return {
      uploadUrl,
      fileKey,
      publicUrl,
      expiresInSeconds,
      isMock: false,
    };
  }

  // Graceful Fallback / Mock Storage Provider for dev and automated tests
  const mockUploadUrl = `https://${env.S3_BUCKET}.s3.${env.S3_REGION}.amazonaws.com/${fileKey}?X-Amz-Algorithm=AWS4-HMAC-SHA256&X-Amz-Credential=mock&X-Amz-Expires=${expiresInSeconds}&X-Amz-Signature=mock-valid-sig`;

  return {
    uploadUrl: mockUploadUrl,
    fileKey,
    publicUrl,
    expiresInSeconds,
    isMock: true,
  };
};

export const isS3Configured = (): boolean => Boolean(s3Client);

/**
 * Validates and normalizes compressed base64 image data URLs for S3-less mock fallback mode.
 * Verifies exact MIME header, base64 integrity, decoded byte limit (<= 512KB), and binary magic bytes.
 */
export const validateCompressedInlineImage = (
  rawDataUrl: string
): { mimeType: AllowedMimeType; normalizedDataUrl: string } => {
  const trimmed = rawDataUrl.trim();
  const match = trimmed.match(INLINE_IMAGE_DATA_URL_REGEX);
  if (!match) {
    throw Object.assign(
      new Error('Invalid imageDataUrl: must be a base64 data URI for image/jpeg, image/png, or image/webp'),
      { statusCode: 400 }
    );
  }

  const mimeType = match[1].toLowerCase() as AllowedMimeType;
  const base64Payload = match[2];
  const buffer = Buffer.from(base64Payload, 'base64');

  if (buffer.length === 0 || buffer.length > MAX_INLINE_MOCK_IMAGE_BYTES) {
    throw Object.assign(
      new Error(`Compressed mock image must be between 1 byte and ${MAX_INLINE_MOCK_IMAGE_BYTES} bytes (512KB)`),
      { statusCode: 400 }
    );
  }

  const hasValidMagicBytes =
    (mimeType === 'image/jpeg' &&
      buffer.length >= 3 &&
      buffer[0] === 0xff &&
      buffer[1] === 0xd8 &&
      buffer[2] === 0xff) ||
    (mimeType === 'image/png' &&
      buffer.length >= 8 &&
      buffer[0] === 0x89 &&
      buffer[1] === 0x50 &&
      buffer[2] === 0x4e &&
      buffer[3] === 0x47 &&
      buffer[4] === 0x0d &&
      buffer[5] === 0x0a &&
      buffer[6] === 0x1a &&
      buffer[7] === 0x0a) ||
    (mimeType === 'image/webp' &&
      buffer.length >= 12 &&
      buffer.subarray(0, 4).toString('ascii') === 'RIFF' &&
      buffer.subarray(8, 12).toString('ascii') === 'WEBP');

  if (!hasValidMagicBytes) {
    throw Object.assign(
      new Error(`Invalid image signature: payload bytes do not match declared ${mimeType}`),
      { statusCode: 400 }
    );
  }

  return {
    mimeType,
    normalizedDataUrl: `data:${mimeType};base64,${buffer.toString('base64')}`,
  };
};
```

### What This Code Does
This service implements a bilingual (Bangla and English) NLP classifier for scraped crime and safety news.
It analyzes article titles and summaries using contextual keyword dictionaries and regex patterns for 64 districts.
It assigns standardized threat categories (e.g., THEFT, ROBBERY, ARMED_ASSAULT) and severity ratings automatically.

```typescript
const isEnglishKeyword = (kw: string) => /^[a-zA-Z0-9\s-]+$/.test(kw);
const escapeRegex = (str: string) => str.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');

export const getKeywordWeight = (kw: string): number => {
  const norm = kw.normalize('NFC').trim();
  if (norm.includes(' ') || norm.includes('-') || COMPOUND_SAFETY_PHRASES.has(norm)) {
    return 5;
  }
  if (MEDIUM_SPECIFICITY_TERMS.has(norm)) {
    return 3;
  }
  return 1;
};

const matchesKeyword = (text: string, kw: string): boolean => {
  const normKw = kw.normalize('NFC').toLowerCase();
  if (isEnglishKeyword(normKw)) {
    const regex = new RegExp(`\\b${escapeRegex(normKw)}\\b`, 'i');
    return regex.test(text);
  }
  // For short Bengali keywords (length <= 3, e.g. "আইস"), enforce boundary checks so "আইস" does not match "আইসিজে"
  if (normKw.length <= 3) {
    const regex = new RegExp(`(?:^|[\\s,।–—"\'‘“\\(\\)\\[\\]\/-])${escapeRegex(normKw)}(?:$|[\\s,।–—"\'’”\\(\\)\\[\\]\/-])`, 'u');
    return regex.test(text);
  }
  return text.includes(normKw);
};

const RETROSPECTIVE_JUDICIAL_PATTERNS = [
  // Bengali: case trials, chargesheets, remands, verdicts, life sentences, death sentences, hearings
  /(?:মামলায়|মামলার|মামলা|বিচার)[\s\S]{0,40}?(?:চার্জশিট|অভিযোগপত্র|রিমান্ড|রায়|সাজা|কারাদণ্ড|যাবজ্জীবন|মৃত্যুদণ্ড|জামিন|শুনানি|বিচার|খালাস|আদেশ|দণ্ড)/i,
  /(?:চার্জশিট|অভিযোগপত্র|রিমান্ড|রায়|সাজা|কারাদণ্ড|যাবজ্জীবন|মৃত্যুদণ্ড|জামিন|শুনানি|বিচার|খালাস)[\s\S]{0,35}?(?:মঞ্জুর|দাখিল|ঘোষণা|নামঞ্জুর|স্থগিত|শুরু|পেলেন|দিলেন|প্রদান|বহাল|দণ্ড|হাজিরা|কার্যকর)/i,
  /(?:আদালতের|বিচারিক|বিচারকের|ট্রাইব্যুনালের|আদালত|ট্রাইব্যুনাল)\s*(?:আদেশ|নির্দেশ|রায়|সাজা|দণ্ড|হাজিরা|বিচার)/i,

  // English: sentences, indictments, chargesheets, remands, verdicts, trials
  /(?:sentences|sentenced|sentencing|convicted|conviction|convicts|acquitted|acquittal|acquits)[\s\S]{0,40}?(?:imprisonment|jail|term|death|in|to|for|penalty)/i,
  /(?:chargesheet|charge sheet|indictment|remand|remanded|verdict|bail|hearing|trial)[\s\S]{0,35}?(?:in|upheld|deferred|rejected|denied|granted|issued|passed|announced|delivered|begins|set|ordered)/i,
  /(?:sentenced\s+to|life\s+term|death\s+sentence|placed\s+on\s+remand|remanded\s+to|sent\s+to\s+jail|ordered\s+to\s+jail|judicial\s+custody)/i,
  /(?:court|tribunal|judge|magistrate)\s+(?:sentences|sentenced|convicts|convicted|orders|ordered|delivered\s+verdict|announced\s+verdict)/i,

  // Historical / past time allegations
  /(?:বছরের\s+পুরোনো|বছর\s+আগের|দশক\s+আগের|১৯৭১\s*সালের|১৯৭১|decades-old|years-old|years\s+ago)/i,
];

// Patterns identifying active physical attacks directed AT court venues or political gatherings
const COURT_VENUE_PATTERNS = [
  /(?:আদালত\s*(?:চত্বরে|চত্বর|প্রাঙ্গণে|প্রাঙ্গণ|ভবনে|ভবন|গেটে|গেট|এলাকায়|এলাকা|কক্ষে|কক্ষ|সামনে)|court\s+(?:premises|building|compound|gate|complex|entrance)|courthouse)/i,
];

const POLITICAL_VENUE_PATTERNS = [

];

const IMMEDIATE_VIOLENT_ATTACK_PATTERNS = [
  /(?:ককটেল\s*বিস্ফোরণ|বোমা\s*হামলা|বোমা\s*বিস্ফোরণ|গুলি\s*বর্ষণ|গুলি\s*ছুড়ে|ককটেল\s*হামলা|রণক্ষেত্র|ককটেল\s*ছোড়া|অস্ত্রধারীদের\s*গুলি|cocktail\s*blast|cocktail\s*explosion|bomb\s*attack|bomb\s*blast|gunfire|shooting|bombed|explosive\s*device)/i,
];

const FOLLOW_UP_MOURNING_PATTERNS = [
  'জানাজা সম্পন্ন',
  'দাফন সম্পন্ন',
  'কবরস্থ',
  'শোকের ছায়া',
  'শোকের ছায়া',
  'জানাজা শেষে',
  'দাফন শেষে',
  'শেষকৃত্য সম্পন্ন',
  'memorial service',
  'burial held',
  'funeral prayer',
  'funeral held',
  'laid to rest',
];

function checkGroundRealityDisqualification(
  combinedText: string
): { isDisqualified: boolean; reason?: string } {
  // Retrospective legal / trial detection
  const isJudicialRetrospective = RETROSPECTIVE_JUDICIAL_PATTERNS.some((pat) =>
    pat.test(combinedText)
  );

  // Active physical attack directed at venue (not a past trial/verdict)
  const isCourtVenueAttack =
    COURT_VENUE_PATTERNS.some((p) => p.test(combinedText)) &&
    IMMEDIATE_VIOLENT_ATTACK_PATTERNS.some((p) => p.test(combinedText)) &&
    !isJudicialRetrospective;

  const isPoliticalVenueAttack =
    POLITICAL_VENUE_PATTERNS.some((p) => p.test(combinedText)) &&
    IMMEDIATE_VIOLENT_ATTACK_PATTERNS.some((p) => p.test(combinedText)) &&
    !isJudicialRetrospective;

  // 1. Bail Hearing Disqualification (Bail hearings are strictly legal proceedings)
  if (BAIL_KEYWORDS.some((kw) => matchesKeyword(combinedText, kw))) {
    return { isDisqualified: true, reason: 'BAIL_HEARING' };
  }

  // 2. Corruption Probe Disqualification (ACC investigations are strictly non-physical financial/graft inquiries)
  if (CORRUPTION_KEYWORDS.some((kw) => matchesKeyword(combinedText, kw))) {
    return { isDisqualified: true, reason: 'CORRUPTION_PROBE' };
  }

  // 3. Historical Allegation Disqualification (1971 war crimes, decades-old allegations)
  if (HISTORICAL_ALLEGATION_KEYWORDS.some((kw) => matchesKeyword(combinedText, kw))) {
    return { isDisqualified: true, reason: 'HISTORICAL_ALLEGATION' };
  }

  // 4. Court Proceeding Disqualification (unless an active bomb/gunfire attack is taking place at the court venue itself)
  if (COURT_KEYWORDS.some((kw) => matchesKeyword(combinedText, kw))) {
    if (!isCourtVenueAttack) {
      return { isDisqualified: true, reason: 'COURT_PROCEEDING' };
    }
  }

  // 5. Political Statement Disqualification (unless an active violent attack is taking place at the political gathering)
  if (POLITICAL_STATEMENT_KEYWORDS.some((kw) => matchesKeyword(combinedText, kw))) {
    if (!isPoliticalVenueAttack) {
      return { isDisqualified: true, reason: 'POLITICAL_STATEMENT' };
    }
  }

  // 6. Administrative Dispute Disqualification
  if (ADMINISTRATIVE_DISPUTE_KEYWORDS.some((kw) => matchesKeyword(combinedText, kw))) {
    return { isDisqualified: true, reason: 'ADMINISTRATIVE_DISPUTE' };
  }

  // 7. Mourning and Funeral Follow-Up Disqualification (retrospective burial/prayer ceremonies)
  if (FOLLOW_UP_MOURNING_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => combinedText.includes(pattern))) {
    return { isDisqualified: true, reason: 'MOURNING_FOLLOWUP' };
  }

  return { isDisqualified: false };
}

/**
 * Classifies an article's headline and summary into a public safety category and severity level.
 * Supports both Bangla and English news content with smart combination resolution.
 */
export const classifyNewsText = (title: string, summary: string = ''): ClassifiedNews => {
  // Normalize Unicode (NFC) to handle decomposed nuktas (e.g. ড+় vs ড়) across different Bengali news sources
  const combinedText = `${title} ${summary}`.normalize('NFC').toLowerCase();
  const matchedKeywords: string[] = [];

  const categoryScores: Partial<Record<ReportCategory, number>> = {};

  for (const [category, keywords] of Object.entries(CATEGORY_KEYWORDS) as [ReportCategory, string[]][]) {
    let score = 0;
    for (const kw of keywords) {
      if (matchesKeyword(combinedText, kw)) {
        const weight = getKeywordWeight(kw);
        score += weight;
        matchedKeywords.push(kw);
      }
    }
    if (score > 0) {
      categoryScores[category] = score;
    }
  }

  // Distinguish vehicular collisions from violent armed/political clashes:
  // In Bengali, vehicular crashes are often titled "মুখোমুখি সংঘর্ষ" or "বাস-ট্রাক সংঘর্ষ".
  // If the story involves vehicles and NO human violent faction/weapon/protest terms, it must resolve to ROAD_ACCIDENT.
  const hasVehicle = VEHICLE_KEYWORDS.some((vk) => matchesKeyword(combinedText, vk));
  const hasViolentFaction = VIOLENT_FACTION_KEYWORDS.some((fk) => matchesKeyword(combinedText, fk));
  const hasRoadCollisionTerms =
    combinedText.includes('সংঘর্ষ') ||
    combinedText.includes('দুর্ঘটনা') ||
    combinedText.includes('দুর্ঘটনায়') ||
    combinedText.includes('ধাক্কা') ||
    combinedText.includes('ধাক্কায়') ||
    combinedText.includes('চাপা') ||
    combinedText.includes('চাপায়') ||
    combinedText.includes('উল্টে') ||
    combinedText.includes('খাদে') ||
    combinedText.includes('নিয়ন্ত্রণ হারিয়ে') ||
    combinedText.includes('নিয়ন্ত্রণ হারিয়ে') ||
    combinedText.includes('মুখোমুখি সংঘর্ষ') ||
    combinedText.includes('সড়ক দুর্ঘটনা') ||
    combinedText.includes('গাড়ি দুর্ঘটনা') ||
    combinedText.includes('collision') ||
    combinedText.includes('traffic accident') ||
    combinedText.includes('head-on collision') ||
    combinedText.includes('road crash') ||
    combinedText.includes('crash') ||
    combinedText.includes('crashed');

  if (hasVehicle && !hasViolentFaction && hasRoadCollisionTerms) {
    categoryScores['ROAD_ACCIDENT'] = (categoryScores['ROAD_ACCIDENT'] || 0) + 15;
    categoryScores['ARMED_ASSAULT'] = 0; // Clear collision with generic "সংঘর্ষ" keyword
    if (!matchedKeywords.includes('road accident')) {
      matchedKeywords.push('road accident');
    }
  }

  // Detect Smart Combinations
  const hasTheft = (categoryScores['THEFT'] || 0) > 0;
  const hasRobbery = (categoryScores['ROBBERY'] || 0) > 0 || (categoryScores['DACOITY'] || 0) > 0;
  const hasSnatching = (categoryScores['SNATCHING'] || 0) > 0 || (categoryScores['MUGGING'] || 0) > 0;
  const hasArmedAssault = (categoryScores['ARMED_ASSAULT'] || 0) > 0;

  let resolvedCategory: ReportCategory | null = null;

  if (hasTheft && hasRobbery) {
    resolvedCategory = 'THEFT_ROBBERY';
  } else if (hasSnatching && hasArmedAssault) {
    resolvedCategory = 'SNATCHING_ARMED_ASSAULT';
  } else if (hasArmedAssault && (categoryScores['ROAD_ACCIDENT'] || 0) > 0) {
    // A road accident strictly requires vehicular involvement and collision context.
    // If genuine violent human/faction/clash terms are present, ARMED_ASSAULT takes precedence.
    if (hasVehicle && hasRoadCollisionTerms && !hasViolentFaction) {
      resolvedCategory = 'ROAD_ACCIDENT';
    } else {
      resolvedCategory = 'ARMED_ASSAULT';
    }
  } else if (hasArmedAssault && hasTheft) {
    // When a theft-related dispute, background cause, or trigger leads to an active physical clash,
    // assault, or injuries (e.g. "হবিগঞ্জে চুরির ঘটনাকে কেন্দ্র করে দুই গ্রামের সংঘর্ষে আহত অর্ধশত"),
    // the active physical safety hazard on the ground is ARMED_ASSAULT.
    resolvedCategory = 'ARMED_ASSAULT';
  } else {
    // Pick category with highest score (prefer primary forms over legacy aliases)
    let maxScore = 0;
    for (const [cat, score] of Object.entries(categoryScores) as [ReportCategory, number][]) {
      if (score > maxScore) {
        maxScore = score;
        resolvedCategory = cat;
      }
    }
  }

  // Map legacy aliases to primary forms
  if (resolvedCategory === 'MUGGING') resolvedCategory = 'SNATCHING';
  if (resolvedCategory === 'DACOITY') resolvedCategory = 'ROBBERY';
  if (resolvedCategory === 'THEFT_DACOITY') resolvedCategory = 'THEFT_ROBBERY';
  if (resolvedCategory === 'TEEN_GANG') resolvedCategory = 'YOUTH_GANG_ACTIVITY';
  if (resolvedCategory === 'DRUG_ACTIVITY') resolvedCategory = 'DRUG_RELATED_CRIME';

  // Evaluate ground-reality physical safety disqualification
  const disqualification = checkGroundRealityDisqualification(combinedText);
  if (disqualification.isDisqualified) {
    return {
      isSafetyRelated: false,
      category: resolvedCategory || 'ROAD_ACCIDENT',
      severity: 'LOW',
      confidence: 0.0,
      matchedKeywords,
      disqualifiedReason: disqualification.reason,
    };
  }

  if (!resolvedCategory) {
    return {
      isSafetyRelated: false,
      category: 'ROAD_ACCIDENT',
      severity: 'LOW',
      confidence: 0.0,
      matchedKeywords: [],
    };
  }

  // Determine Severity
  let severity: ReportSeverity = 'LOW';
  for (const kw of HIGH_SEVERITY_KEYWORDS) {
    if (matchesKeyword(combinedText, kw)) {
      severity = 'HIGH';
      break;
    }
  }

  if (severity !== 'HIGH') {
    for (const kw of MEDIUM_SEVERITY_KEYWORDS) {
      if (matchesKeyword(combinedText, kw)) {
        severity = 'MEDIUM';
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // Calculate probabilistic confidence score (0.0 - 1.0)
  let confidence = 0.0;
  const rawScore = categoryScores[resolvedCategory] || 0;
  if (rawScore >= 15) {
    confidence = 0.95;
  } else if (rawScore >= 10) {
    confidence = 0.88;
  } else if (rawScore >= 5) {
    confidence = 0.78;
  } else if (rawScore >= 3) {
    confidence = 0.70;
  } else {
    confidence = 0.60;
  }

  return {
    isSafetyRelated: true,
    category: resolvedCategory,
    severity,
    confidence,
    matchedKeywords,
  };
};
```

### What This Code Does
This module maintains an authoritative registry of trusted Bangladeshi news publishers and RSS feed configurations.
It defines source names, base domains, regional focus areas, and RSS feed endpoints for major national dailies.
The crawler service references this registry to ingest verified, high-credibility press reports.

```typescript

  domain: string;

  isWireAgency: boolean; // true for BSS, UNB
  feedUrl?: string;
  requiresXmlSanitization?: boolean;
}
```
