```typescript
/**
 * Resolves publisher entry from a URL hostname or outlet name
 */
export function getPublisherMetadata(urlOrDomain: string): PublisherEntry | null {
  if (!urlOrDomain) return null;

  try {
    let hostname = urlOrDomain.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (hostname.includes('://')) {
      const parsed = new URL(hostname);
      hostname = parsed.hostname;
    }
    hostname = hostname.replace(/^www\./, '');

    // Check exact domain match
    if (PUBLISHER_REGISTRY[hostname]) {
      return PUBLISHER_REGISTRY[hostname];
    }

    // Check subdomain match (e.g. en.prothomalo.com -> prothomalo.com)
    for (const [domain, entry] of Object.entries(PUBLISHER_REGISTRY)) {
      if (hostname.endsWith(`.${domain}`) || hostname === domain) {
        return entry;
      }
    }

    // Check name match
    for (const entry of Object.values(PUBLISHER_REGISTRY)) {
      if (entry.name.toLowerCase() === urlOrDomain.toLowerCase().trim()) {
        return entry;
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Fallback on name match
    for (const entry of Object.values(PUBLISHER_REGISTRY)) {
      if (entry.name.toLowerCase() === urlOrDomain.toLowerCase().trim()) {
        return entry;
      }
    }
  }

  return null;
}

/**
 * Detects if a story originates from a wire agency (BSS, UNB) based on URL, source name, or title/body dispatches
 */
export function isWireSyndicatedStory(
  sourceUrl?: string,
  sourceName?: string,
  content?: string
): { isWire: boolean; agency?: 'BSS' | 'UNB' } {
  const normUrl = (sourceUrl || '').toLowerCase();
  const normName = (sourceName || '').toLowerCase();
  const normContent = (content || '').toLowerCase();

  if (normUrl.includes('bssnews.net') || normName.includes('bss') || normName.includes('বাসস')) {
    return { isWire: true, agency: 'BSS' };
  }
  if (normUrl.includes('unb.com.bd') || normName.includes('unb') || normName.includes('ইউএনবি')) {
    return { isWire: true, agency: 'UNB' };
  }

  // Check content wire dispatches (e.g. "(BSS) -", "— বাসস", "UNB -")
  if (/\b(?:bss|বাসস)\b/i.test(normContent)) {
    return { isWire: true, agency: 'BSS' };
  }
  if (/\b(?:unb|ইউএনবি)\b/i.test(normContent)) {
    return { isWire: true, agency: 'UNB' };
  }

  return { isWire: false };
}

  name: string;
  url: string;
  domain: string;
  requiresXmlSanitization?: boolean;
}

export function resolvePublisherDomain(sourceUrl?: string, sourceName?: string): string {
  if (sourceUrl) {
    try {
      const parsed = new URL(sourceUrl.startsWith('http') ? sourceUrl : `https://${sourceUrl}`);
      const host = parsed.hostname.replace(/^www\./, '').toLowerCase();
      if (host) return host;
    } catch {
      // Ignore
    }
  }
  if (sourceName) {
    const meta = getPublisherMetadata(sourceName);
    if (meta) return meta.domain;
    return sourceName.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
  }
  return 'unknown';
}
```

### What This Code Does
This service executes automated RSS crawling across registered national news feeds.
It parses recent news items, deduplicates them against stored article GUIDs, and classifies geographic coordinates.
Matched incidents are ingested as "Press Confirmed" hazard reports or linked to existing citizen reports.

```typescript
export const buildGoogleNewsRssUrl = (query: string, lang: 'bn' | 'en' = 'en'): string => {
  const encodedQuery = encodeURIComponent(query);
  if (lang === 'bn') {
    return `https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=${encodedQuery}&hl=bn&gl=BD&ceid=BD:bn`;
  }
  return `https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=${encodedQuery}&hl=en-BD&gl=BD&ceid=BD:en`;
};

let clusterRotationIndex = 0;
export const getNextClusterPair = (): [string, string] => {
  const pair = CLUSTER_ROTATION_SCHEDULE[clusterRotationIndex % CLUSTER_ROTATION_SCHEDULE.length];
  clusterRotationIndex = (clusterRotationIndex + 1) % CLUSTER_ROTATION_SCHEDULE.length;
  return pair;
};
export const getClusterRotationIndex = (): number => clusterRotationIndex;
export const resetClusterRotationIndex = (): void => {
  clusterRotationIndex = 0;
};

export const buildClusterFeeds = (clusterId: string): FeedConfig[] => {
  const cluster = NATIONWIDE_CLUSTERS.find((c) => c.id === clusterId);
  if (!cluster) return [];

  const enDistricts = cluster.districtsEn.join(' OR ');
  const bnDistricts = cluster.districtsBn.map((d) => `"${d}"`).join(' OR ');

  const enQuery = `(${enDistricts}) (accident OR collision OR killed OR injured OR assault OR robbery OR theft OR violence OR "youth gang" OR extortion) bangladesh -court -bail -verdict -remand -corruption -politics when:2d`;
  const bnQuery = `(${bnDistricts}) (দুর্ঘটনা OR সংঘর্ষ OR নিহত OR আহত OR ছিনতাই OR ডাকাতি OR চুরি OR হামলা OR "কিশোর গ্যাং" OR চাঁদাবাজি) বাংলাদেশ -আদালত -জামিন -রিমান্ড -দুদক -দুর্নীতি when:2d`;

  return [
    {
      name: `Google News BD ${cluster.name} (EN)`,
      category: 'ROAD_ACCIDENT' as ReportCategory,
      categoryHint: 'ROAD_ACCIDENT' as ReportCategory,
      url: buildGoogleNewsRssUrl(enQuery, 'en'),
      timeoutMs: 10000,
    },
    {
      name: `Google News BD ${cluster.name} (BN)`,
      category: 'ROAD_ACCIDENT' as ReportCategory,
      categoryHint: 'ROAD_ACCIDENT' as ReportCategory,
      url: buildGoogleNewsRssUrl(bnQuery, 'bn'),
      timeoutMs: 10000,
    },
  ];
};

export interface CircuitBreakerState {
  state: 'CLOSED' | 'OPEN' | 'HALF_OPEN';
  openUntil: number;
  consecutiveFailures: number;
}

export const circuitBreaker: CircuitBreakerState = {
  state: 'CLOSED',
  openUntil: 0,
  consecutiveFailures: 0,
};

export const checkGoogleNewsCircuit = (): boolean => {
  const now = Date.now();
  if (circuitBreaker.state === 'OPEN') {
    if (now >= circuitBreaker.openUntil) {
      circuitBreaker.state = 'HALF_OPEN';
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  return true;
};

export const recordGoogleNewsSuccess = (): void => {
  if (circuitBreaker.state === 'OPEN') {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now < circuitBreaker.openUntil) {
      // Cooldown in progress, do not reset early
      return;
    }
  }
  circuitBreaker.state = 'CLOSED';
  circuitBreaker.consecutiveFailures = 0;
};

export const recordGoogleNewsFailure = (isRateLimit: boolean): void => {
  circuitBreaker.consecutiveFailures++;
  if (isRateLimit || circuitBreaker.consecutiveFailures >= 3) {
    circuitBreaker.state = 'OPEN';
    circuitBreaker.openUntil = Date.now() + 30 * 60 * 1000; // 30 minutes cooldown
    console.warn(
      `[News Crawler] ⚠️ Google News circuit breaker OPEN until ${new Date(circuitBreaker.openUntil).toISOString()} (RateLimit: ${isRateLimit})`
    );
  }
};

export const sleepJitter = async (minMs = 1500, maxMs = 2500): Promise<void> => {
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test' || process.env.HERMETIC_TEST_MODE === 'true' || process.env.NODE_TEST_CONTEXT) {
    return;
  }
  const delay = Math.floor(minMs + Math.random() * (maxMs - minMs));
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, delay));
};

export const sanitizeXmlString = (xml: string): string => {
  if (!xml) return '';
  return xml
    .replace(/[\x00-\x08\x0B\x0C\x0E-\x1F\x7F]/g, '')
    .trim();
};

const NEWS_BOT_EMAIL = 'news-crawler-bot@safety.bd';
let cachedBotUserId: string | null = null;

/**
 * Ensures system news-crawler bot user exists with VERIFIED_RESPONDER privileges
 */
export const getOrCreateNewsBotUser = async (): Promise<string> => {
  if (cachedBotUserId) {
    return cachedBotUserId;
  }

  try {
    let bot = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { email: NEWS_BOT_EMAIL },
    });

    if (!bot) {
      bot = await prisma.user.create({
        data: {
          email: NEWS_BOT_EMAIL,
          anonymousId: 'news-crawler-bot-system-v1',
          role: 'VERIFIED_RESPONDER',
          isVerified: true,
          trustScore: 100,
        },
      });
    }

    cachedBotUserId = bot.id;
    return bot.id;
  } catch {
    cachedBotUserId = 'news-crawler-bot-system-v1';
    return cachedBotUserId;
  }
};

export interface RawNewsItem {
  guid: string;
  title: string;
  link: string;
  pubDate?: string | Date;
  contentSnippet?: string;
  sourceName: string;
  categoryHint?: ReportCategory;
}

/**
 * Returns the active map lifespan (in hours) based on incident category.
 * - Acute traffic incidents: 48 hours
 * - Acute violent / property crimes: 72 hours (3 days)
 * - Recurring social / syndicate hazards: 7 days (168 hours)
 * - Infrastructure hazards: 14 days (336 hours)
 */
export const getNewsCategoryLifespanHours = (category: ReportCategory): number => {
  switch (category) {
    case 'ROAD_ACCIDENT':
      return 48; // 48 hours (2 days)
    case 'SNATCHING':
    case 'ROBBERY':
    case 'THEFT_ROBBERY':
    case 'ARMED_ASSAULT':
    case 'SNATCHING_ARMED_ASSAULT':
    case 'THEFT':
    case 'EXTORTION':
    case 'MUGGING':
    case 'DACOITY':
    case 'THEFT_DACOITY':
      return 72; // 72 hours (3 days)
    case 'YOUTH_GANG_ACTIVITY':
    case 'DRUG_RELATED_CRIME':
    case 'TEEN_GANG':
    case 'TEEN_GANG_ARMED_ASSAULT':
    case 'DRUG_ACTIVITY':
      return 168; // 7 days (168 hours)
    case 'UNLIT_ROAD':
      return 336; // 14 days (336 hours)
    default:
      return 72;
  }
};

/**
 * Computes the expiration date for a news-originated incident report.
 * Guarantees at least 24 hours of visibility from time of ingestion even if
 * the article publication date was several days in the past.
 */
export const calculateNewsReportExpiry = (
  category: ReportCategory,
  publishedAt: Date = new Date(),
  now: Date = new Date()
): Date => {
  const lifespanHours = getNewsCategoryLifespanHours(category);
  const lifespanMs = lifespanHours * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  const candidateExpiry = new Date(publishedAt.getTime() + lifespanMs);

  // Grant at least 24 hours of live map presence from current ingestion time
  const minFutureExpiry = new Date(now.getTime() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  if (candidateExpiry.getTime() < minFutureExpiry.getTime()) {
    return minFutureExpiry;
  }

  return candidateExpiry;
};

/**
 * Ingests and processes an array of news items:
 * 1. Batch deduplicates against NewsArticle.guid to eliminate DB round-trip overhead.
 * 2. Filters out articles older than 7 days.
 * 3. Classifies category and severity via bilingual classifier.
 * 4. Resolves Bangladesh coordinates via landmark dictionary / Nominatim.
 * 5. Saves Report and NewsArticle in database.
 * 6. Executes cross-verification against active citizen reports.
 * 7. Broadcasts real-time NEW_REPORT event.
 */
export const processAndIngestNewsItems = async (
  items: RawNewsItem[],
  runRecorder?: CrawlRunRecorder
): Promise<{ ingested: number; skipped: number; verifiedMatches: number }> => {
  const botUserId = await getOrCreateNewsBotUser();
  const sevenDaysAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

  let ingested = 0;
  let skipped = 0;
  let verifiedMatches = 0;

  if (runRecorder) {
    runRecorder.recordDiscoveredArticles(items.length);
  }

  // Batch deduplication check in a single query
  const allGuids = items.map((i) => i.guid || normalizeCanonicalUrl(i.link)).filter(Boolean);
  const allUrls = items.map((i) => normalizeCanonicalUrl(i.link)).filter(Boolean);
  let existingGuidSet = new Set<string>();
  let existingUrlSet = new Set<string>();
  try {
    const existingArticles = await prisma.newsArticle.findMany({
      where: {
        OR: [
          { guid: { in: allGuids } },
          { sourceUrl: { in: allUrls } },
        ],
      },
      select: { guid: true, sourceUrl: true },
    });
    existingGuidSet = new Set(existingArticles.map((a) => a.guid));
    existingUrlSet = new Set(existingArticles.map((a) => a.sourceUrl).filter(Boolean));
  } catch {
    // In hermetic test mode or without live DB, proceed with empty set
  }

  for (const item of items) {
    const canonicalUrl = normalizeCanonicalUrl(item.link);
    const guid = item.guid || canonicalUrl;
    if (!guid || !item.title) {
      skipped++;
      if (runRecorder) runRecorder.recordDuplicateRejection();
      continue;
    }

    // 1. Deduplication check (check both GUID and normalized canonical URL)
    if (existingGuidSet.has(guid) || existingUrlSet.has(canonicalUrl)) {
      skipped++;
      if (runRecorder) runRecorder.recordDuplicateRejection();
      continue;
    }

    // 2. Date check: max 7 days old
    const publishedAt = item.pubDate ? new Date(item.pubDate) : new Date();
    if (publishedAt < sevenDaysAgo) {
      skipped++;
      continue;
    }

    // 3. Domestic Incident Boundary Check (Strictly exclude overseas/expatriate news)
    const foreignCheck = isForeignIncident(item.title, item.contentSnippet || '');
    if (foreignCheck.isForeign) {
      console.log(
        `[News Crawler] 🌍 Skipping overseas incident: "${item.title.substring(0, 65)}..." (Matched: ${foreignCheck.matchedTerm})`
      );
      skipped++;
      continue;
    }

    // 4. Content-Based Bilingual Classification (Strict Decoupling from Feed categoryHint)
    const classification = classifyNewsText(item.title, item.contentSnippet || '');
    if (!classification.isSafetyRelated) {
      skipped++;
      continue;
    }
    const finalCategory = classification.category;

    // 5. Domestic Geocoding resolution (Headline priority + victim residence exclusion)
    const geocode = await resolveLocationFromText(item.title, item.contentSnippet || '');
    const wireInfo = isWireSyndicatedStory(canonicalUrl, item.sourceName, item.contentSnippet || item.title);
    const isWire = wireInfo.isWire;
    const wireAgency = wireInfo.agency || null;
    const initialVerificationStage: any = isWire ? 'WIRE_SYNDICATED' : 'SINGLE_SOURCE_PRESS';

    if (!geocode) {
      if (runRecorder) runRecorder.recordGeocodingFailure();
      // Stage unresolvable article without creating Report pin
      try {
        await prisma.newsArticle.create({
          data: {
            guid,
            title: item.title,
            sourceUrl: canonicalUrl,
            sourceName: item.sourceName,
            publishedAt,
            category: finalCategory,
            severity: classification.severity,
            latitude: 0,
            longitude: 0,
            reportId: null,
            isWireSyndicated: isWire,
            wireAgency,
          },
        });
        existingGuidSet.add(guid);
        existingUrlSet.add(canonicalUrl);
      } catch {
        // Skip on error
      }
      skipped++;
      continue;
    }

    if (runRecorder) runRecorder.recordGeocodingSuccess();

    // 5. Expiration: Category-specific active lifecycle
    const expiresAt = calculateNewsReportExpiry(finalCategory, publishedAt);

    // 6. Clean headline and content
    const cleanTitle = cleanIncidentTitle(item.title);
    const cleanDesc = cleanIncidentTitle(item.contentSnippet || item.title);

    // 7. Cross-Outlet Semantic Deduplication:
    // If another news agency already reported on this exact same accident/crime in this area,
    // consolidate under the existing report instead of scattering duplicate pins across the map.
    const duplicateMatch = await findDuplicateActiveReport({
      title: cleanTitle,
      category: finalCategory,
      latitude: geocode.latitude,
      longitude: geocode.longitude,
      district: geocode.district,
      upazila: geocode.upazila,
      locationPrecision: geocode.locationPrecision,
    });

    if (duplicateMatch) {
      const { existingReport, sharedTokens } = duplicateMatch;
      console.log(
        `[News Crawler] 🔄 Consolidated duplicate story from "${item.sourceName}": "${cleanTitle.substring(0, 60)}..." -> Merged with Report ${existingReport.id} (Shared: ${sharedTokens.join(', ')})`
      );

      // Create NewsArticle record linked to existingReport.id (multi-source consolidation)
      await prisma.newsArticle.create({
        data: {
          guid,
          title: item.title,
          sourceUrl: canonicalUrl,
          sourceName: item.sourceName,
          publishedAt,
          category: finalCategory,
          severity: classification.severity,
          latitude: geocode.latitude,
          longitude: geocode.longitude,
          reportId: existingReport.id,
          isWireSyndicated: isWire,
          wireAgency,
        },
      });

      // Format source names to credit multiple outlets
      const currentSources = existingReport.sourceName || '';
      const cleanOutlet = item.sourceName.replace(/^Google News BD[^:]*:\s*/i, '').trim();
      let updatedSources = currentSources;
      if (cleanOutlet && !currentSources.includes(cleanOutlet)) {
        updatedSources = `${currentSources}, ${cleanOutlet}`.replace(/^,\s*/, '');
      }

      // Preserve structured citations array
      const existingCitations: any[] = Array.isArray(existingReport.citations)
        ? (existingReport.citations as any[])
        : existingReport.sourceUrl
          ? [
              {
                sourceName: (existingReport.sourceName || 'Press').replace(/^Google News BD[^:]*:\s*/i, '').trim(),
                sourceUrl: existingReport.sourceUrl,
                title: cleanIncidentTitle(existingReport.description?.split('\n')[0] || ''),
              },
            ]
          : [];

      const newCitation = {
        sourceName: cleanOutlet || item.sourceName,
        sourceUrl: canonicalUrl,
        title: cleanTitle,
        publishedAt: publishedAt.toISOString(),
      };

      const incomingDomain = resolvePublisherDomain(canonicalUrl, item.sourceName);
      const priorDomains = existingCitations.map((c) => resolvePublisherDomain(c.sourceUrl, c.sourceName));
      const isDifferentPublisher = incomingDomain !== 'unknown' && !priorDomains.includes(incomingDomain);

      if (!existingCitations.some((c) => c.sourceUrl === canonicalUrl)) {
        existingCitations.push(newCitation);
      }

      // Stage promotion logic:
      let nextStage: any = existingReport.verificationStage;
      if (existingReport.verificationStage === 'ADMIN_VERIFIED') {
        nextStage = 'ADMIN_VERIFIED';
      } else if (isWire) {
        // Wire stories never advance to corroborated stage
        nextStage = existingReport.verificationStage;
      } else {
        if (isDifferentPublisher) {
          nextStage = 'PRESS_CORROBORATED';
        } else if (existingReport.verificationStage === 'CLASSIFIED') {
          nextStage = 'CORROBORATED';
        }
      }

      // If existing report was misclassified as ROAD_ACCIDENT, but a corroborating outlet confirms
      // a specific crime or violent clash (ARMED_ASSAULT, THEFT, ROBBERY, etc.), elevate to specific category:
      const updatedCategory =
        existingReport.category === 'ROAD_ACCIDENT' && finalCategory !== 'ROAD_ACCIDENT'
          ? finalCategory
          : existingReport.category;

      // Coordinate upgrade logic:
      let newLat = existingReport.latitude;
      let newLng = existingReport.longitude;
      let newPrecision = existingReport.locationPrecision || 'UPAZILA';
      let newDistrict = existingReport.district;
      let newUpazila = existingReport.upazila;

      if (duplicateMatch.shouldUpgradeCoords && duplicateMatch.newCoords) {
        newLat = duplicateMatch.newCoords.latitude;
        newLng = duplicateMatch.newCoords.longitude;
        newPrecision = 'UPAZILA';
        if (duplicateMatch.newCoords.district) newDistrict = duplicateMatch.newCoords.district;
        if (duplicateMatch.newCoords.upazila) newUpazila = duplicateMatch.newCoords.upazila;
        await setReportLocation(prisma, existingReport.id, newLat, newLng);
      }

      await prisma.report.update({
        where: { id: existingReport.id },
        data: {
          category: updatedCategory,
          sourceName: updatedSources,
          upvotes: { increment: 2 }, // Multi-press verification confidence boost
          verificationStage: nextStage,
          citations: existingCitations,
          latitude: newLat,
          longitude: newLng,
          locationPrecision: newPrecision,
          district: newDistrict,
          upazila: newUpazila,
        },
      });

      // Add a context update linking the confirming news outlet
      await prisma.reportUpdate.create({
        data: {
          reportId: existingReport.id,
          userId: botUserId,
          content: `অতিরিক্ত প্রেস নিশ্চিতকরণ (${cleanOutlet || item.sourceName}): "${cleanTitle}"`,
        },
      });

      // Emit real-time REPORT_ENRICHED event
      emitReportEnriched({
        id: existingReport.id,
        category: updatedCategory,
        severity: existingReport.severity,
        latitude: newLat,
        longitude: newLng,
        description: existingReport.description,
        upvotes: (existingReport.upvotes || 0) + 2,
        downvotes: existingReport.downvotes || 0,
        status: existingReport.status,
        expiresAt: existingReport.expiresAt,
        createdAt: existingReport.createdAt,
        sourceUrl: existingReport.sourceUrl,
        sourceName: updatedSources,
        isGpsVerified: existingReport.isGpsVerified,
        verificationStage: nextStage,
        citations: existingCitations,
        locationPrecision: newPrecision,
        district: newDistrict,
        upazila: newUpazila,
        threatStatus: existingReport.threatStatus || 'ACTIVE',
      });

      existingGuidSet.add(guid);
      existingUrlSet.add(canonicalUrl);
      skipped++;
      if (runRecorder) runRecorder.recordDuplicateRejection();
      continue;
    }

    const initialCitations = [
      {
        sourceName: item.sourceName.replace(/^Google News BD[^:]*:\s*/i, '').trim() || item.sourceName,
        sourceUrl: canonicalUrl,
        title: cleanTitle,
        publishedAt: publishedAt.toISOString(),
      },
    ];

    // Atomically create report, populate PostGIS location, and persist news article metadata
    const report = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const createdReport = await tx.report.create({
        data: {
          userId: botUserId,
          category: finalCategory,
          severity: classification.severity,
          latitude: geocode.latitude,
          longitude: geocode.longitude,
          description: cleanDesc,
          sourceUrl: canonicalUrl,
          sourceName: item.sourceName,
          verificationStage: initialVerificationStage,
          citations: initialCitations,
          expiresAt,
          locationPrecision: geocode.locationPrecision || 'UPAZILA',
          district: geocode.district,
          upazila: geocode.upazila,
          threatStatus: 'ACTIVE',
        },
      });

      await setReportLocation(tx, createdReport.id, geocode.latitude, geocode.longitude);

      await tx.newsArticle.create({
        data: {
          guid,
          title: item.title,
          sourceUrl: canonicalUrl,
          sourceName: item.sourceName,
          publishedAt,
          category: finalCategory,
          severity: classification.severity,
          latitude: geocode.latitude,
          longitude: geocode.longitude,
          reportId: createdReport.id,
          isWireSyndicated: isWire,
          wireAgency,
        },
      });

      return createdReport;
    });

    existingGuidSet.add(guid);
    existingUrlSet.add(canonicalUrl);
    ingested++;
    if (runRecorder) runRecorder.recordNewIncident();

    // 7. Cross-Verification with active citizen reports
    const verifyResult = await crossVerifyCitizenReports({
      id: report.id,
      category: report.category,
      latitude: report.latitude,
      longitude: report.longitude,
      sourceName: item.sourceName,
      sourceUrl: canonicalUrl,
      title: item.title,
    });
    verifiedMatches += verifyResult.matchedCount;
    if (runRecorder && verifyResult.matchedCount > 0) {
      runRecorder.recordVerifiedMatches(verifyResult.matchedCount);
      // Automatically advance verificationStage to COMMUNITY_CONFIRMED when citizen report matches
      await prisma.report.update({
        where: { id: report.id },
        data: { verificationStage: 'COMMUNITY_CONFIRMED' },
      });
      if (verifyResult.verifiedReportIds.length > 0) {
        await prisma.report.updateMany({
          where: { id: { in: verifyResult.verifiedReportIds } },
          data: { verificationStage: 'COMMUNITY_CONFIRMED' },
        });
      }
    }

    // 8. Real-time broadcast
    emitNewReport({
      id: report.id,
      category: report.category,
      severity: report.severity,
      latitude: report.latitude,
      longitude: report.longitude,
      description: report.description,
      upvotes: report.upvotes,
      downvotes: report.downvotes,
      status: report.status,
      expiresAt: report.expiresAt,
      createdAt: report.createdAt,
      sourceUrl: report.sourceUrl,
      sourceName: report.sourceName,
      isGpsVerified: report.isGpsVerified,
      verificationStage: report.verificationStage,
      citations: report.citations,
      locationPrecision: report.locationPrecision,
      district: report.district,
      upazila: report.upazila,
      threatStatus: report.threatStatus,
    });
  }

  if (ingested > 0) {
    void broadcastPlatformStats();
  }

  return { ingested, skipped, verifiedMatches };
};

/**
 * Crawls all configured public RSS feeds across Bangladesh and ingests verified incident stories
 */
const safeString = (val: any): string => {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return '';
  if (typeof val === 'string') return val.trim();
  if (typeof val === 'object') {
    if (typeof val._ === 'string') return val._.trim();
    if (typeof val.value === 'string') return val.value.trim();
    if (typeof val.$t === 'string') return val.$t.trim();
    try {
      return JSON.stringify(val);
    } catch {
      return '';
    }
  }
  return String(val).trim();
};

export const crawlAllNewsFeeds = async (
  feeds: FeedConfig[] = PUBLIC_NEWS_FEEDS
): Promise<{
  feedsChecked: number;
  totalIngested: number;
  totalSkipped: number;
  totalVerifiedMatches: number;
  runId: string;
  durationMs: number;
}> => {
  const runRecorder = newsObservabilityService.startRun();
  let totalIngested = 0;
  let totalSkipped = 0;
  let totalVerifiedMatches = 0;
  let feedsChecked = 0;

  const fetchAndProcessSingleFeed = async (feedConfig: FeedConfig) => {
    feedsChecked++;
    const feedStartTime = Date.now();
    const timeoutMs = feedConfig.timeoutMs || 10000;

    try {
      const parsePromise = (async () => {
        // Try fetching raw text first to sanitize XML (handles The Daily Star encoding artifacts)
        try {
          const controller = new AbortController();
          const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
          const resp = await fetch(feedConfig.url, {
            signal: controller.signal,
            headers: {
              'User-Agent': 'DangerZoneBD-PublicSafetyNewsCrawler/1.0 (contact@dangerzonebd.org)',
            },
          });
          clearTimeout(timeoutId);

          if (resp.status === 429) {
            if (feedConfig.url.includes('news.google.com')) {
              recordGoogleNewsFailure(true);
            }
            throw new Error(`HTTP 429 Too Many Requests from ${feedConfig.url}`);
          }
          if (!resp.ok) {
            throw new Error(`HTTP ${resp.status} ${resp.statusText}`);
          }
          const rawText = await resp.text();
          const cleanXml = sanitizeXmlString(rawText);
          return await parser.parseString(cleanXml);
        } catch (fetchErr: any) {
          if (fetchErr.name === 'AbortError') {
            throw new Error(`Feed fetch timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms`);
          }
          if (fetchErr.message?.includes('429')) {
            throw fetchErr;
          }
          // Fallback to parser.parseURL in environments or mocks that mock parser directly
          return await parser.parseURL(feedConfig.url);
        }
      })();

      const timeoutPromise = new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
        setTimeout(() => reject(new Error(`Feed fetch timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms`)), timeoutMs);
      });

      const feed = await Promise.race([parsePromise, timeoutPromise]);
      const latencyMs = Date.now() - feedStartTime;

      const items: RawNewsItem[] = (feed.items || []).map((item: any) => {
        const rawLink = safeString(item.link);
        const canonicalLink = normalizeCanonicalUrl(rawLink);
        return {
          guid: safeString(item.guid || canonicalLink || item.title),
          title: safeString(item.title),
          link: canonicalLink,
          pubDate: item.pubDate ? new Date(item.pubDate) : new Date(),
          contentSnippet: safeString(item.contentSnippet || item.content),
          sourceName: feedConfig.name,
          categoryHint: feedConfig.categoryHint || feedConfig.category,
        };
      });

      const result = await processAndIngestNewsItems(items, runRecorder);
      totalIngested += result.ingested;
      totalSkipped += result.skipped;
      totalVerifiedMatches += result.verifiedMatches;

      runRecorder.recordFeedExecution({
        feedName: feedConfig.name,
        category: feedConfig.category,
        url: feedConfig.url,
        status: 'SUCCESS',
        latencyMs,
        itemsFetched: items.length,
      });

      if (feedConfig.url.includes('news.google.com')) {
        recordGoogleNewsSuccess();
      }
    } catch (feedErr: any) {
      if (feedConfig.url.includes('news.google.com')) {
        recordGoogleNewsFailure(false);
      }
      const latencyMs = Date.now() - feedStartTime;
      const isTimeout = feedErr?.message?.includes('timed out');
      console.warn(`[News Crawler] Failed to fetch feed "${feedConfig.name}":`, feedErr?.message || feedErr);

      runRecorder.recordFeedExecution({
        feedName: feedConfig.name,
        category: feedConfig.category,
        url: feedConfig.url,
        status: isTimeout ? 'TIMEOUT' : 'FAILED',
        latencyMs,
        itemsFetched: 0,
        errorMessage: feedErr?.message || String(feedErr),
      });
      // Isolated failure handling: continuing crawl loop without aborting
    }
  };

  if (feeds !== PUBLIC_NEWS_FEEDS) {
    // Custom/targeted feeds (e.g. hermetic test mode)
    for (const feedConfig of feeds) {
      await fetchAndProcessSingleFeed(feedConfig);
    }
  } else {
    // Production scheduled crawl:
    // 1. Direct Publisher RSS Feeds (Dhaka Tribune, Dainik Azadi, Jagonews24, Prothom Alo, Daily Star)
    console.log('[News Crawler] 📰 Ingesting direct publisher feeds in parallel...');
    const directFeedConfigs: FeedConfig[] = DIRECT_PUBLISHER_FEEDS.map((df: DirectFeedDefinition) => ({
      name: df.name,
      category: 'ROAD_ACCIDENT' as ReportCategory,
      categoryHint: 'ROAD_ACCIDENT' as ReportCategory,
      url: df.url,
      timeoutMs: 12000,
    }));

    await Promise.allSettled(directFeedConfigs.map((df) => fetchAndProcessSingleFeed(df)));

    // 2. Google News Regional Discovery with Circuit Breaker and 10-Cluster Rotation
    if (checkGoogleNewsCircuit()) {
      const [clusterA, clusterB] = getNextClusterPair();
      console.log(`[News Crawler] 🌐 Executing Google News Regional Discovery for clusters: ${clusterA} + ${clusterB}`);
      const clusterFeeds = [...buildClusterFeeds(clusterA), ...buildClusterFeeds(clusterB)];

      for (const cFeed of clusterFeeds) {
        await sleepJitter(1500, 2500);
        await fetchAndProcessSingleFeed(cFeed);
      }
    } else {
      console.log(
        `[News Crawler] 🔌 Google News Circuit Breaker is OPEN (cooldown until ${new Date(circuitBreaker.openUntil).toISOString()}). Direct publisher feeds completed successfully.`
      );
    }
  }

  const completedRun = runRecorder.complete();

  return {
    feedsChecked,
    totalIngested,
    totalSkipped,
    totalVerifiedMatches,
    runId: completedRun.runId,
    durationMs: completedRun.durationMs,
  };
};
```

## [File 30] `apps/api/src/services/newsVerificationService.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/api/src/services/newsVerificationService.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 99  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This service cross-references crowdsourced citizen reports with scraped news media articles.
It performs spatial-temporal correlation checks (matching reports within 500 meters and 24 hours).
When a match is confirmed, it upgrades the report's verification stage from unverified to press-corroborated.

```typescript
import { prisma } from '../db/prisma';
import { emitReportVerified } from '../sockets';

export interface NewsIncidentCrossVerifyInput {
  id: string;
  category: string;
  latitude: number;
  longitude: number;
  sourceName: string;
  sourceUrl: string;
  title: string;
}

export interface CrossVerifyResult {
  matchedCount: number;
  verifiedReportIds: string[];
}

/**
 * Cross-references a newly ingested news incident against active crowdsourced citizen reports
 * within a 500-meter radius submitted within the last 24 hours.
 * Automatically marks matching reports as "Verified by Press" and awards +5 trustScore to the citizen reporter.
 */
export const crossVerifyCitizenReports = async (
  news: NewsIncidentCrossVerifyInput
): Promise<CrossVerifyResult> => {
  try {
    // 1. PostGIS spatial query checking for citizen reports within 500m in the last 24h
    // Uses COALESCE to gracefully handle both populated geography locations and fallback lat/lng points
    const matchedReports: any[] = await prisma.$queryRaw`
      SELECT id, "userId", description
      FROM "Report"
      WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
        AND id != ${news.id}
        AND "sourceUrl" IS NULL
        AND ST_DWithin(
          COALESCE(location, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(longitude, latitude), 4326)::geography),
          ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(${news.longitude}, ${news.latitude}), 4326)::geography,
          500
        )
        AND "createdAt" >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    `;

    if (!matchedReports || matchedReports.length === 0) {
      return { matchedCount: 0, verifiedReportIds: [] };
    }

    const verifiedIds: string[] = [];

    // 2. Elevate matched reports & award trust score bonus
    for (const report of matchedReports) {
      const verificationTag = `[Verified by Press: ${news.sourceName}]`;

      // Avoid double-tagging
      if (report.description?.includes(verificationTag)) {
        continue;
      }

      const updatedDescription = report.description
        ? `${report.description} ${verificationTag}`
        : verificationTag;

      await prisma.$transaction([
        // Update report with verified tag
        prisma.report.update({
          where: { id: report.id },
          data: { description: updatedDescription },
        }),
        // Award citizen +5 Trust Score reputation points
        prisma.user.update({
          where: { id: report.userId },
          data: { trustScore: { increment: 5 } },
        }),
      ]);

      // Broadcast real-time verification event to connected clients
      emitReportVerified({
        reportId: report.id,
        verifiedBy: news.sourceName,
        sourceUrl: news.sourceUrl,
        articleTitle: news.title,
      });

      verifiedIds.push(report.id);
      console.log(
        `[News Cross-Verification] 📰 Citizen report ${report.id} confirmed by press story "${news.title}". +5 TrustScore awarded to user ${report.userId}.`
      );
    }

    return {
      matchedCount: verifiedIds.length,
      verifiedReportIds: verifiedIds,
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[News Cross-Verification] Error checking citizen matches:', error);
    return { matchedCount: 0, verifiedReportIds: [] };
  }
};
```

### What This Code Does
This service provides telemetry and metric tracking for automated news crawler executions.
It records run durations, total feeds checked, articles ingested, duplicates rejected, and classification failure rates.
Administrators can inspect these metrics through the admin portal to monitor crawler health and feed reliability.

```typescript
import { ReportCategory } from '@prisma/client';

export interface FeedExecutionMetric {
  feedName: string;
  category: ReportCategory;
  url: string;
  status: 'SUCCESS' | 'FAILED' | 'TIMEOUT';
  latencyMs: number;
  itemsFetched: number;
  errorMessage?: string;
}

export interface CrawlRunMetric {
  runId: string;
  startTime: string;
  endTime?: string;
  durationMs: number;
  status: 'SUCCESS' | 'PARTIAL' | 'FAILED' | 'IN_PROGRESS';
  feedsChecked: number;
  feedsSuccess: number;
  feedsFailed: number;
  articlesDiscovered: number;
  duplicateRejections: number;
  newIncidentsCreated: number;
  geocodingSuccessCount: number;
  geocodingFailureCount: number;
  verifiedMatchesCount: number;
  feedDetails: FeedExecutionMetric[];
}

export interface FeedHealthSummary {
  feedName: string;
  category: ReportCategory;
  totalChecks: number;
  successes: number;
  failures: number;
  successRate: number;
  avgLatencyMs: number;
  lastChecked?: string;
  lastStatus?: 'SUCCESS' | 'FAILED' | 'TIMEOUT';
}

export interface CrawlerTelemetrySummary {
  totalRuns: number;
  lastRun?: CrawlRunMetric;
  totalArticlesDiscovered: number;
  totalDuplicateRejections: number;
  totalNewIncidentsCreated: number;
  totalGeocodingSuccess: number;
  totalGeocodingFailure: number;
  overallGeocodingSuccessRate: number;
  feedHealth: Record<string, FeedHealthSummary>;
  recentRuns: CrawlRunMetric[];
}

export class NewsObservabilityService {
  private runs: CrawlRunMetric[] = [];
  private readonly maxStoredRuns = 50;

  // Cumulative counters
  private totalRuns = 0;
  private totalArticlesDiscovered = 0;
  private totalDuplicateRejections = 0;
  private totalNewIncidentsCreated = 0;
  private totalGeocodingSuccess = 0;
  private totalGeocodingFailure = 0;
  private feedStatsMap = new Map<string, {
    category: ReportCategory;
    totalChecks: number;
    successes: number;
    failures: number;
    totalLatencyMs: number;
    lastChecked?: string;
    lastStatus?: 'SUCCESS' | 'FAILED' | 'TIMEOUT';
  }>();

  /**
   * Starts tracking a new crawl execution run.
   */
  public startRun(runId?: string): CrawlRunRecorder {
    const id = runId || `crawl_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8)}`;
    const startIso = new Date().toISOString();

    const currentRun: CrawlRunMetric = {
      runId: id,
      startTime: startIso,
      durationMs: 0,
      status: 'IN_PROGRESS',
      feedsChecked: 0,
      feedsSuccess: 0,
      feedsFailed: 0,
      articlesDiscovered: 0,
      duplicateRejections: 0,
      newIncidentsCreated: 0,
      geocodingSuccessCount: 0,
      geocodingFailureCount: 0,
      verifiedMatchesCount: 0,
      feedDetails: [],
    };

    this.runs.unshift(currentRun);
    if (this.runs.length > this.maxStoredRuns) {
      this.runs.pop();
    }
    this.totalRuns++;

    return new CrawlRunRecorder(this, currentRun);
  }

  /**
   * Internal recording helper called by CrawlRunRecorder.
   */
  public recordRunCompletion(run: CrawlRunMetric) {
    // Accumulate aggregate metrics
    this.totalArticlesDiscovered += run.articlesDiscovered;
    this.totalDuplicateRejections += run.duplicateRejections;
    this.totalNewIncidentsCreated += run.newIncidentsCreated;
    this.totalGeocodingSuccess += run.geocodingSuccessCount;
    this.totalGeocodingFailure += run.geocodingFailureCount;

    // Accumulate per-feed health stats
    for (const feed of run.feedDetails) {
      let stats = this.feedStatsMap.get(feed.feedName);
      if (!stats) {
        stats = {
          category: feed.category,
          totalChecks: 0,
          successes: 0,
          failures: 0,
          totalLatencyMs: 0,
        };
        this.feedStatsMap.set(feed.feedName, stats);
      }

      stats.totalChecks++;
      if (feed.status === 'SUCCESS') {
        stats.successes++;
      } else {
        stats.failures++;
      }
      stats.totalLatencyMs += feed.latencyMs;
      stats.lastChecked = run.endTime || new Date().toISOString();
      stats.lastStatus = feed.status;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Returns a comprehensive telemetry summary of crawler activity.
   */
  public getTelemetrySummary(): CrawlerTelemetrySummary {
    const totalGeo = this.totalGeocodingSuccess + this.totalGeocodingFailure;
    const overallGeocodingSuccessRate = totalGeo > 0
      ? Number(((this.totalGeocodingSuccess / totalGeo) * 100).toFixed(2))
      : 0;

    const feedHealth: Record<string, FeedHealthSummary> = {};
    for (const [name, stats] of this.feedStatsMap.entries()) {
      feedHealth[name] = {
        feedName: name,
        category: stats.category,
        totalChecks: stats.totalChecks,
        successes: stats.successes,
        failures: stats.failures,
        successRate: stats.totalChecks > 0
          ? Number(((stats.successes / stats.totalChecks) * 100).toFixed(2))
          : 0,
        avgLatencyMs: stats.totalChecks > 0
          ? Math.round(stats.totalLatencyMs / stats.totalChecks)
          : 0,
        lastChecked: stats.lastChecked,
        lastStatus: stats.lastStatus,
      };
    }

    return {
      totalRuns: this.totalRuns,
      lastRun: this.runs[0],
      totalArticlesDiscovered: this.totalArticlesDiscovered,
      totalDuplicateRejections: this.totalDuplicateRejections,
      totalNewIncidentsCreated: this.totalNewIncidentsCreated,
      totalGeocodingSuccess: this.totalGeocodingSuccess,
      totalGeocodingFailure: this.totalGeocodingFailure,
      overallGeocodingSuccessRate,
      feedHealth,
      recentRuns: [...this.runs],
    };
  }

  /**
   * Returns recent runs up to limit.
   */
  public getRecentRuns(limit: number = 10): CrawlRunMetric[] {
    return this.runs.slice(0, limit);
  }

  /**
   * Resets all metrics (primarily for test isolation).
   */
  public resetMetricsForTesting() {
    this.runs = [];
    this.totalRuns = 0;
    this.totalArticlesDiscovered = 0;
    this.totalDuplicateRejections = 0;
    this.totalNewIncidentsCreated = 0;
    this.totalGeocodingSuccess = 0;
    this.totalGeocodingFailure = 0;
    this.feedStatsMap.clear();
  }
}

/**
 * Helper class to record metrics during a single crawl run.
 */
export class CrawlRunRecorder {
  private startTimeMs: number;

  constructor(
    private service: NewsObservabilityService,
    public readonly run: CrawlRunMetric
  ) {
    this.startTimeMs = Date.now();
  }

  public recordFeedExecution(feedMetric: FeedExecutionMetric) {
    this.run.feedsChecked++;
    if (feedMetric.status === 'SUCCESS') {
      this.run.feedsSuccess++;
    } else {
      this.run.feedsFailed++;
    }
    this.run.feedDetails.push(feedMetric);
  }

  public recordDiscoveredArticles(count: number = 1) {
    this.run.articlesDiscovered += count;
  }

  public recordDuplicateRejection(count: number = 1) {
    this.run.duplicateRejections += count;
  }

  public recordNewIncident(count: number = 1) {
    this.run.newIncidentsCreated += count;
  }

  public recordGeocodingSuccess(count: number = 1) {
    this.run.geocodingSuccessCount += count;
  }

  public recordGeocodingFailure(count: number = 1) {
    this.run.geocodingFailureCount += count;
  }

  public recordVerifiedMatches(count: number = 1) {
    this.run.verifiedMatchesCount += count;
  }

  public complete(statusOverride?: 'SUCCESS' | 'PARTIAL' | 'FAILED'): CrawlRunMetric {
    this.run.endTime = new Date().toISOString();
    this.run.durationMs = Date.now() - this.startTimeMs;

    if (statusOverride) {
      this.run.status = statusOverride;
    } else if (this.run.feedsFailed === 0 && this.run.feedsSuccess > 0) {
      this.run.status = 'SUCCESS';
    } else if (this.run.feedsSuccess > 0 && this.run.feedsFailed > 0) {
      this.run.status = 'PARTIAL';
    } else {
      this.run.status = 'FAILED';
    }

    this.service.recordRunCompletion(this.run);
    return this.run;
  }
}

export const newsObservabilityService = new NewsObservabilityService();
```

### What This Code Does
This service identifies and clusters duplicate or overlapping incident reports submitted by different users.
It evaluates geographic proximity, temporal alignment, and category matching to detect redundant reports.
This prevents map clutter and coordinates clustering while consolidating community confirmations.

```typescript
import { prisma } from '../db/prisma';
import { Report, ReportCategory } from '@prisma/client';
import { LOCAL_LANDMARK_MAP, findLandmarkInText } from './geocodingService';

const TRACKING_PARAMS = new Set([
  'utm_source',
  'utm_medium',
  'utm_campaign',
  'utm_term',
  'utm_content',
  'fbclid',
  'gclid',
  'ref',
  'ocid',
  'ved',
  'source',
]);

/**
 * Normalizes raw news URLs by stripping tracking parameters, standardizing protocol to HTTPS,
 * removing www. subdomain, lowercasing domain, and trimming trailing slashes while preserving root /.
 */
export function normalizeCanonicalUrl(rawUrl: string): string {
  if (!rawUrl || typeof rawUrl !== 'string') return '';
  const trimmed = rawUrl.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return '';

  try {
    let urlToParse = trimmed;
    if (!/^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z\d+\-.]*:\/\//.test(urlToParse)) {
      urlToParse = `https://${urlToParse}`;
    }

    const parsed = new URL(urlToParse);
    parsed.protocol = 'https:';
    parsed.hostname = parsed.hostname.toLowerCase().replace(/^www\./, '');

    const keysToDelete: string[] = [];
    parsed.searchParams.forEach((_, key) => {
      const lower = key.toLowerCase();
      if (TRACKING_PARAMS.has(lower) || lower.startsWith('utm_')) {
        keysToDelete.push(key);
      }
    });
    for (const k of keysToDelete) {
      parsed.searchParams.delete(k);
    }

    let pathname = parsed.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '');
    if (pathname.length === 0) {
      pathname = '/';
    }
    parsed.pathname = pathname;

    const qs = parsed.searchParams.toString();
    const hash = parsed.hash || '';
    return `${parsed.protocol}//${parsed.hostname}${parsed.pathname}${qs ? '?' + qs : ''}${hash}`;
  } catch {
    return trimmed;
  }
}

const OUTLET_SUFFIX_PATTERN =
  /\s*[-–—|]\s*(?:the daily star|daily star|prothom alo|প্রথম আলো|dhaka post|ঢাকা পোস্ট|সমকাল|samakal|কালের কণ্ঠ|kalerkantho|যুগান্তর|jugantor|ইত্তেফাক|ittefaq|bdnews24|banglanews24|jagonews24|bangladesh pratidin|বাংলাদেশ প্রতিদিন|মানবজমিন|ইনকিলাব|বণিক বার্তা|সারাবাংলা|বাংলা ট্রিবিউন|bangla tribune|সময় টিভি|somoy tv|যমুনা টিভি|jamuna tv|ডিবিসি নিউজ|dbc news|চ্যানেল ২৪|channel 24|bd bulletin|cvoice24|daily observer|ajker patrika|the business standard|risingbd)[^$]*$/i;

/**
 * Cleans raw news headlines by stripping feed aggregator prefixes, trailing outlet credits,
 * and punctuation markers (Bengali Double Dari, Dari, En-dash, Em-dash).
 */
export function cleanIncidentTitle(rawTitle: string): string {
  if (!rawTitle || typeof rawTitle !== 'string') return '';
  let title = rawTitle.trim();
  if (!title) return '';

  // 1. Strip leading feed aggregator prefixes: [Google News ...], [The Daily Star], [Press: ...]
  title = title.replace(/^\[(?:google news[^\]]*|the daily star[^\]]*|press:[^\]]*)\]\s*/i, '');

  // 2. Strip trailing publisher credits like "- The Daily Star", "| প্রথম আলো"
  title = title.replace(OUTLET_SUFFIX_PATTERN, '');

  // 3. Strip Bengali Double Dari (॥, \u0965), Dari (।, \u0964), En-dash (–, \u2013), Em-dash (—, \u2014), pipes (|), dashes
  title = title.replace(/[॥।–—|]/g, ' ');

  // 4. Collapse consecutive whitespace
  title = title.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();

  // 5. If title consists only of punctuation/symbols/dashes after cleaning, return empty string
  if (!/[a-zA-Z0-9\u0980-\u09FF]/.test(title)) {
    return '';
  }

  return title;
}

const YYA_PATTERN = '(?:\u09df|\u09af\u09bc)';
const PLURAL_PATTERN = new RegExp(`(?:গুলোর|গুলোতে|গুলো${YYA_PATTERN}|গুলো|দের|খানা|খানি|টুকু)$`);
const CASE_PATTERN = /(?:ের|কে|তে|ে)$/;
const YYA_INFLECTION = new RegExp(`(?:${YYA_PATTERN}ে|${YYA_PATTERN})$`);

/**
 * Normalizes root words / synonyms in Bengali
 */
function stemBengaliToken(token: string): string {
  let word = token.normalize('NFC').toLowerCase();

  // Strip known trailing plural/case inflections while preserving base vowel 'া'
  word = word
    .replace(PLURAL_PATTERN, '')
    .replace(CASE_PATTERN, '')
    .replace(YYA_INFLECTION, '');

  const normGari = 'গাড়ি'.normalize('NFC');
  const normGariOld = 'গাড়ী'.normalize('NFC');
  if (word.startsWith(normGari) || word.startsWith(normGariOld)) return normGari;

  const normDhakka = 'ধাক্কা'.normalize('NFC');
  if (word.startsWith(normDhakka)) return normDhakka;

  const normChintay = 'ছিনতাই'.normalize('NFC');
  if (word.startsWith(normChintay)) return normChintay;

  if (word.startsWith('গ্রেপ্তা') || word.startsWith('গ্রেফতা') || word === 'আটক') return 'গ্রেপ্তার'.normalize('NFC');
  if (word.startsWith('পিকআপ')) return 'পিকআপ';
  if (word.startsWith('ট্রাক')) return 'ট্রাক';
  if (word.startsWith('বাস')) return 'বাস';
  if (word.startsWith('লরি')) return 'লরি';
  if (word.startsWith('ডাকাতি')) return 'ডাকাতি';
  if (word.startsWith('লুণ্ঠ')) return 'লুণ্ঠন';
  if (word.startsWith('টাকা')) return 'টাকা';
  if (word.startsWith('মামলা')) return 'মামলা';
  if (word.startsWith('ঘটনা')) return 'ঘটনা';

  return word;
}

/**
 * Extracts normalized, stemmed, cross-lingual significant entity/event tokens from a news title
 */
export function extractSignificantTokens(rawTitle: string): Set<string> {
  const cleanedTitle = cleanIncidentTitle(rawTitle);
  const normDigits = normalizeDigits(cleanedTitle);
  let text = normDigits.normalize('NFC').toLowerCase();

  // Strip zero-width non-joiner and zero-width joiner
  text = text.replace(/[\u200C\u200D]/g, '');

  // Strip [Google News ...] prefixes
  text = text.replace(/^\[(?:google news[^\]]*|the daily star[^\]]*)\]\s*/i, '');

  // Strip media outlet brand signatures
  for (const outlet of OUTLET_NAMES) {
    text = text.split(outlet).join(' ');
  }

  const significant = new Set<string>();

  // Extract identified landmark entity tokens (e.g. Uttara, Mirpur, Patenga)
  const landmarkMatch = findLandmarkInText(rawTitle);
  if (landmarkMatch) {
    const locLower = landmarkMatch.locationName.toLowerCase();
    significant.add(locLower);
    const shortLoc = locLower.split(',')[0].trim();
    significant.add(shortLoc);
  }

  // Extract standalone digits (e.g. casualty counts: '2', '3', '8')
  const digitMatches = normDigits.match(/\b\d+\b/g);
  if (digitMatches) {
    digitMatches.forEach((d) => significant.add(d));
  }

  // Strip punctuation and special characters including Double Dari, En-dash, and guillemets
  text = text.replace(/[!"#$%&'()*+,\-./:;<=>?@[\\\]^_`{|}~‘’“”।॥|—–«»‹›]/gu, ' ');

  const rawWords = text.split(/\s+/).map((w) => w.trim()).filter(Boolean);

  for (const w of rawWords) {
    if (BENGALI_STOPWORDS.has(w)) continue;

    // Check cross-lingual concept dictionary
    const canonicalConcept = BILINGUAL_CONCEPT_MAP[w];
    if (canonicalConcept) {
      significant.add(canonicalConcept);
    }

    const stemmed = stemBengaliToken(w);
    if (stemmed.length >= 1 && !BENGALI_STOPWORDS.has(stemmed)) {
      significant.add(stemmed);
      const conceptFromStemmed = BILINGUAL_CONCEPT_MAP[stemmed];
      if (conceptFromStemmed) {
        significant.add(conceptFromStemmed);
      }
    }
  }

  return significant;
}

/**
 * Identifies major location names mentioned in title
 */
function extractLocations(tokens: Set<string>): string[] {
  const locs: string[] = [];
  for (const t of tokens) {
    if (
      LOCAL_LANDMARK_MAP[t] ||
      LOCAL_LANDMARK_MAP[t + 'ে'] ||
      LOCAL_LANDMARK_MAP[t + 'ের'] ||
      Object.values(LOCAL_LANDMARK_MAP).some((m) => m.standardName.toLowerCase() === t)
    ) {
      locs.push(t);
    }
  }
  return locs;
}

const VEHICLE_CANONICAL_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
  bus: 'BUS', buses: 'BUS', 'বাস': 'BUS', 'বাসের': 'BUS',
  truck: 'TRUCK', trucks: 'TRUCK', 'ট্রাক': 'TRUCK', 'ট্রাকের': 'TRUCK', lorry: 'TRUCK', 'লরি': 'TRUCK', 'লরির': 'TRUCK',
  pickup: 'PICKUP', 'পিকআপ': 'PICKUP', 'পিকআপের': 'PICKUP',
  van: 'COVERED_VAN', 'covered van': 'COVERED_VAN', 'covered-van': 'COVERED_VAN', 'কাভার্ডভ্যান': 'COVERED_VAN', 'কাভার্ডভ্যানের': 'COVERED_VAN', 'ভ্যান': 'COVERED_VAN',
  motorcycle: 'MOTORCYCLE', motorbike: 'MOTORCYCLE', bike: 'MOTORCYCLE', 'মোটরসাইকেল': 'MOTORCYCLE', 'মোটরসাইকেলের': 'MOTORCYCLE', 'বাইক': 'MOTORCYCLE', 'বাইকের': 'MOTORCYCLE',
  cng: 'CNG', 'auto-rickshaw': 'CNG', autorickshaw: 'CNG', easybike: 'CNG', 'সিএনজি': 'CNG', 'সিএনজির': 'CNG', 'অটোরিকশা': 'CNG', 'ইজিবাইক': 'CNG', 'টমটম': 'CNG',
  microbus: 'MICROBUS', 'মাইক্রোবাস': 'MICROBUS', 'মাইক্রোবাসের': 'MICROBUS', car: 'CAR', 'প্রাইভেটকার': 'CAR', 'কার': 'CAR',
  train: 'TRAIN', 'ট্রেন': 'TRAIN', 'ট্রেনের': 'TRAIN',
  nosimon: 'NOSIMON', 'নসিমন': 'NOSIMON', 'নসিমনের': 'NOSIMON', 'নছিমন': 'NOSIMON',
  korimon: 'KORIMON', 'করিমন': 'KORIMON', 'করিমনের': 'KORIMON',
  bhotbhoti: 'BHOTBHOTI', 'ভটভটি': 'BHOTBHOTI', 'ভটভটির': 'BHOTBHOTI',
  leguna: 'LEGUNA', 'লেগুনা': 'LEGUNA', 'লেগুনার': 'LEGUNA',
  mahindra: 'MAHINDRA', 'মাহিন্দ্রা': 'MAHINDRA', 'মাহিন্দ্রার': 'MAHINDRA',
  tractor: 'TRACTOR', 'ট্রাক্টর': 'TRACTOR', 'ট্রাক্টরের': 'TRACTOR',
  ambulance: 'AMBULANCE', 'অ্যাম্বুলেন্স': 'AMBULANCE', 'অ্যাম্বুলেন্সের': 'AMBULANCE',
};

export function extractVehicles(tokensOrText: Set<string> | string[] | string): Set<string> {
  const vehicles = new Set<string>();
  const tokenList: string[] = typeof tokensOrText === 'string'
    ? Array.from(extractSignificantTokens(tokensOrText))
    : Array.isArray(tokensOrText) ? tokensOrText : Array.from(tokensOrText);

  for (const token of tokenList) {
    const norm = token.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (VEHICLE_CANONICAL_MAP[norm]) {
      vehicles.add(VEHICLE_CANONICAL_MAP[norm]);
    }
  }
  return vehicles;
}

/**
 * Calculates token overlap similarity between two titles.
 * Fully supports bilingual matching (English <-> Bangla) and applies vehicle conflict penalty.
 */
export function calculateStorySimilarity(
  title1: string,
  title2: string
): { isDuplicate: boolean; score: number; sharedTokens: string[] } {
  const set1 = extractSignificantTokens(title1);
  const set2 = extractSignificantTokens(title2);

  if (set1.size === 0 || set2.size === 0) {
    return { isDuplicate: false, score: 0, sharedTokens: [] };
  }

  // If both titles explicitly mention conflicting districts (e.g. Mymensingh vs Sylhet), reject duplicate
  const locs1 = extractLocations(set1);
  const locs2 = extractLocations(set2);
  if (locs1.length > 0 && locs2.length > 0) {
    const hasSharedLoc = locs1.some((l1) =>
      locs2.some((l2) => {
        if (l1 === l2) return true;
        const s1 = LOCAL_LANDMARK_MAP[l1]?.standardName || l1;
        const s2 = LOCAL_LANDMARK_MAP[l2]?.standardName || l2;
        return s1.toLowerCase() === s2.toLowerCase();
      })
    );
    if (!hasSharedLoc) {
      return { isDuplicate: false, score: 0, sharedTokens: [] };
    }
  }

  // Vehicle Conflict Penalty:
  // If both stories mention vehicle entities, but have completely disjoint sets of vehicles
  // (e.g. Bus-Truck collision at 8 AM vs Covered Van-Motorcycle crash at 2 PM on the same highway)
  const vehicles1 = extractVehicles(set1);
  const vehicles2 = extractVehicles(set2);
  let vehicleConflict = false;
  if (vehicles1.size > 0 && vehicles2.size > 0) {
    const hasSharedVehicle = Array.from(vehicles1).some((v) => vehicles2.has(v));
    if (!hasSharedVehicle) {
      vehicleConflict = true;
    }
  }

  const sharedTokens: string[] = [];
  for (const t of set1) {
    if (set2.has(t)) {
      sharedTokens.push(t);
    }
  }

  const unionSize = new Set([...set1, ...set2]).size;
  const jaccard = unionSize > 0 ? sharedTokens.length / unionSize : 0;
  const overlapRatio = sharedTokens.length / Math.min(set1.size, set2.size);

  // Core anchor entities that strongly indicate identical incidents
  const highValueEntities = [
    'truck',
    'pickup',
    'bus',
    'microbus',
    'cng',
    'motorcycle',
    'nosimon',
    'korimon',
    'bhotbhoti',
    'leguna',
    'mahindra',
    'tractor',
    'ambulance',
    'collision',
    'accident',
    'killed',
    'injured',
    'robbery',
    'theft',
    'snatching',
    'arrest',
    'murder',
    'stabbing',
    'gunfire',
    'arson',
    'teengang',
    'extortion',
    'yaba',
    'drug',
    'মাদক',
    'ইয়াবা',
    'ইয়াবা'.normalize('NFC'),
    'ট্রাক',
    'পিকআপ',
    'বাস',
    'সংঘর্ষ',
    'ডাকাতি',
    'ছিনতাই',
    'গ্রেপ্তার',
    'খুন',
  ];

  const sharedHighValue = sharedTokens.filter((st) => highValueEntities.includes(st));

  let finalScore = Math.max(jaccard, overlapRatio);
  if (vehicleConflict) {
    finalScore = Math.max(0, finalScore - 0.40);
  }

  // Incident Duplicate Criteria:
  // 1. 3 or more shared tokens and Jaccard >= 0.25
  // 2. OR 2 or more shared high-value entities (e.g. [truck, pickup] or [robbery, arrest]) and overlapRatio >= 0.35
  // 3. OR high overall overlap (>= 0.50)
  // Strictly disallowed if vehicleConflict is true
  const isDuplicate = !vehicleConflict && (
    (sharedTokens.length >= 3 && jaccard >= 0.25) ||
    (sharedHighValue.length >= 2 && overlapRatio >= 0.35) ||
    overlapRatio >= 0.5
  );

  return {
    isDuplicate,
    score: finalScore,
    sharedTokens,
  };
}

/**
 * Searches the database for an existing active report representing the same incident.
 * Checks spatial proximity (approx 3.5km, expanding to 35km for parent district centroid matches),
 * category match, and title token similarity.
 */
export async function findDuplicateActiveReport(params: {
  title: string;
  category: ReportCategory;
  latitude: number;
  longitude: number;
  district?: string;
  upazila?: string;
  locationPrecision?: string;
  maxDistanceDegrees?: number;
  lookbackHours?: number;
}): Promise<{
  existingReport: Report;
  sharedTokens: string[];
  shouldUpgradeCoords?: boolean;
  newCoords?: { latitude: number; longitude: number; district?: string; upazila?: string };
} | null> {
  const { title, category, latitude, longitude, district, upazila, locationPrecision } = params;
  let maxDelta = params.maxDistanceDegrees ?? 0.035; // ~3.5 km
  const lookbackHours = params.lookbackHours ?? 48; // 48 hours
  const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - lookbackHours * 60 * 60 * 1000);

  if (locationPrecision === 'DISTRICT' && district) {
    maxDelta = 0.35;
  }

  // Categories that can be considered compatible when matching duplicate press coverage
  const compatibleCategories: Record<string, ReportCategory[]> = {
    ROAD_ACCIDENT: ['ROAD_ACCIDENT', 'ARMED_ASSAULT'],
    ROBBERY: ['ROBBERY', 'DACOITY', 'THEFT_ROBBERY', 'THEFT'],
    THEFT: ['THEFT', 'THEFT_ROBBERY', 'ROBBERY'],
    THEFT_ROBBERY: ['THEFT_ROBBERY', 'ROBBERY', 'THEFT', 'DACOITY', 'THEFT_DACOITY'],
    SNATCHING: ['SNATCHING', 'MUGGING', 'SNATCHING_ARMED_ASSAULT'],
    SNATCHING_ARMED_ASSAULT: ['SNATCHING_ARMED_ASSAULT', 'SNATCHING', 'ARMED_ASSAULT', 'MUGGING'],
    ARMED_ASSAULT: ['ARMED_ASSAULT', 'SNATCHING_ARMED_ASSAULT', 'ROAD_ACCIDENT'],
    EXTORTION: ['EXTORTION', 'YOUTH_GANG_ACTIVITY'],
    YOUTH_GANG_ACTIVITY: ['YOUTH_GANG_ACTIVITY', 'TEEN_GANG', 'TEEN_GANG_ARMED_ASSAULT', 'EXTORTION', 'ARMED_ASSAULT'],
    DRUG_RELATED_CRIME: ['DRUG_RELATED_CRIME', 'DRUG_ACTIVITY'],
    UNLIT_ROAD: ['UNLIT_ROAD'],
    // Legacy aliases
    MUGGING: ['MUGGING', 'SNATCHING', 'SNATCHING_ARMED_ASSAULT'],
    DACOITY: ['DACOITY', 'ROBBERY', 'THEFT_ROBBERY', 'THEFT'],
    THEFT_DACOITY: ['THEFT_DACOITY', 'THEFT_ROBBERY', 'ROBBERY', 'THEFT'],
    TEEN_GANG: ['TEEN_GANG', 'YOUTH_GANG_ACTIVITY', 'TEEN_GANG_ARMED_ASSAULT'],
    TEEN_GANG_ARMED_ASSAULT: ['TEEN_GANG_ARMED_ASSAULT', 'YOUTH_GANG_ACTIVITY', 'ARMED_ASSAULT'],
    DRUG_ACTIVITY: ['DRUG_ACTIVITY', 'DRUG_RELATED_CRIME'],
  };

  const allowedCategories = compatibleCategories[category] || [category];

  const whereConditions: any = {
    status: 'ACTIVE',
    createdAt: { gte: cutoff },
    category: { in: allowedCategories },
  };

  if (district) {
    whereConditions.OR = [
      {
        latitude: { gte: latitude - maxDelta, lte: latitude + maxDelta },
        longitude: { gte: longitude - maxDelta, lte: longitude + maxDelta },
      },
      {
        district: district,
        latitude: { gte: latitude - 0.35, lte: latitude + 0.35 },
        longitude: { gte: longitude - 0.35, lte: longitude + 0.35 },
      },
    ];
  } else {
    whereConditions.latitude = { gte: latitude - maxDelta, lte: latitude + maxDelta };
    whereConditions.longitude = { gte: longitude - maxDelta, lte: longitude + maxDelta };
  }

  const candidates = await prisma.report.findMany({
    where: whereConditions,
    include: {
      newsArticles: {
        select: { title: true },
        take: 1,
      },
    },
    orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    take: 25,
  });

  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    const candidateTitle =
      candidate.newsArticles?.[0]?.title ||
      (candidate.description ? cleanIncidentTitle(candidate.description.split('\n')[0]) : '');
    const sim = calculateStorySimilarity(title, candidateTitle);

    if (sim.isDuplicate) {
      const candidatePrecision = (candidate as any).locationPrecision || 'EXACT';
      let shouldUpgradeCoords = false;
      let newCoords: { latitude: number; longitude: number; district?: string; upazila?: string } | undefined = undefined;

      if (candidatePrecision === 'DISTRICT' && (locationPrecision === 'UPAZILA' || locationPrecision === 'EXACT')) {
        shouldUpgradeCoords = true;
        newCoords = { latitude, longitude, district, upazila };
      }

      return {
        existingReport: candidate,
        sharedTokens: sim.sharedTokens,
        shouldUpgradeCoords,
        newCoords,
      };
    }
  }

  return null;
}
```

## [File 33] `apps/api/src/services/internationalIncidentFilter.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/api/src/services/internationalIncidentFilter.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 468  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This service filters out international, foreign, and non-local news reports ingested from general news feeds.
It cross-references article text against a comprehensive database of Bangladeshi place names, divisions, and districts.
Articles referencing foreign conflicts or overseas crimes are rejected to maintain strict focus on Bangladesh safety.

```typescript
 * be injected or pinned on the Bangladesh map—even if the victims or casualties

 */

export interface ForeignCheckResult {
  isForeign: boolean;
  matchedTerm?: string;
  reason?: string;
}

/**
 * Universal evaluator for international/foreign incidents.
 * Analyzes both headline and article lead context.
 */
export function isForeignIncident(title: string, snippet: string = ''): ForeignCheckResult {
  if (!title && !snippet) {
    return { isForeign: false };
  }

  // Normalize Unicode (NFC) for robust Bengali script matching
  const normTitle = (title || '').normalize('NFC').toLowerCase();
  const normSnippet = (snippet || '').normalize('NFC').toLowerCase();
  const combined = `${normTitle} ${normSnippet}`;

  for (const keyword of GLOBAL_FOREIGN_TERMS) {
    const normKeyword = keyword.normalize('NFC').toLowerCase();

    // Prevent false positive on Bengali 'আসামি' (accused/convict, NOT Assam state)
    if (keyword.startsWith('আসাম')) {
      const isAccusedWord = /(?:আসামি|আসামির|আসামিদের|আসামিরা|আসামীর)/i.test(normTitle);
      const isAssamState = /(?:আসামে|আসাম\s+রাজ্য|আসামের)/i.test(normTitle);
      if (isAccusedWord && !isAssamState) {
        continue;
      }
    }

    const isEnglish = /^[a-zA-Z0-9\s'-]+$/.test(normKeyword);
    const escapedKw = normKeyword.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');

    // 1. Primary check: Headline explicitly mentions a foreign country, territory or city
    const titleMatched = isEnglish
      ? new RegExp(`\\b${escapedKw}\\b`, 'i').test(normTitle)
      : (normKeyword.length <= 3
          ? new RegExp(`(?:^|[\\s,।–—"\'‘“\\(\\)\\[\\]\\/-])${escapedKw}(?:$|[\\s,।–—"\'’”\\(\\)\\[\\]\\/-])`, 'u').test(normTitle)
          : normTitle.includes(normKeyword));

    if (titleMatched) {
      return {
        isForeign: true,
        matchedTerm: keyword,
        reason: `Headline explicitly references overseas country/city "${keyword}"`,
      };
    }

    // 2. Incident-association check in lead snippet:
    // Matches if the foreign term appears in close proximity to incident verbs
    const incidentActionRegex = isEnglish
      ? new RegExp(
          `\\b${escapedKw}\\b[\\s\\S]{0,35}(?:সড়ক দুর্ঘটনা|সড়ক দুর্ঘটনায়|সড়কে নিহত|দুর্ঘটনা|নিহত|আহত|হামলা|ছিনতাই|আগুনে|দাফন|লাশ|গুলি|গুলিবিদ্ধ|dead|killed|crash|accident|shot|injured)`,
          'i'
        )
      : new RegExp(
          `(?:${escapedKw})[\\s\\S]{0,35}(?:সড়ক দুর্ঘটনা|সড়ক দুর্ঘটনায়|সড়কে নিহত|দুর্ঘটনা|নিহত|আহত|হামলা|ছিনতাই|আগুনে|দাফন|লাশ|গুলি|গুলিবিদ্ধ|dead|killed|crash|accident|shot|injured)`,
          'i'
        );

    if (incidentActionRegex.test(combined)) {
      return {
        isForeign: true,
        matchedTerm: keyword,
        reason: `Article associates incident with overseas location "${keyword}"`,
      };
    }
  }

  return { isForeign: false };
}
```

> **Path:** `apps/api/src/services/statsService.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 115  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This service aggregates platform-wide incident counts, severity distributions, and community reporting metrics.
It computes active hazard counts, resolved incidents, and district-level threat heat rankings.
It also broadcasts updated summary statistics over WebSockets when incidents are created or resolved.

```typescript
import { prisma } from '../db/prisma';
import { emitStatsUpdated, hasInitializedIO } from '../sockets';

export interface PlatformStats {
  totalReports: number;
  activeReports: number;
  resolvedReports: number;
  criticalThreats: number;
  totalCitizens: number;
  verifiedCitizens: number;
  safeHavens: number;
  totalVotes: number;
  lastActiveAt: string;
  timestamp: string;
}

/**
 * Aggregates live, database-backed platform metrics directly from Supabase PostgreSQL.
 * Strict Single Source of Truth: Never returns mock or hardcoded statistics.
 */
export const getPlatformStats = async (): Promise<PlatformStats> => {
  const now = new Date();

  const [
    reportStatsRows,
    totalCitizens,
    verifiedCitizens,
    safeHavens,
    totalVotes,
  ] = await prisma.$transaction([
    prisma.$queryRaw<
      Array<{
        totalReports: number;
        activeReports: number;
        resolvedReports: number;
        criticalThreats: number;
        latestCreatedAt: Date | null;
      }>
    >`
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)::int AS "totalReports",
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND "expiresAt" > NOW())::int AS "activeReports",
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'RESOLVED')::int AS "resolvedReports",
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND severity = 'HIGH' AND "expiresAt" > NOW())::int AS "criticalThreats",
        MAX("createdAt") AS "latestCreatedAt"
      FROM "Report"
      WHERE location IS NOT NULL
    `,
    prisma.user.count({
      where: {
        isBanned: false,
      },
    }),
    prisma.user.count({
      where: {
        isVerified: true,
        isBanned: false,
      },
    }),
    prisma.safeZone.count(),
    prisma.vote.count(),
  ]);

  const reportStats = reportStatsRows[0] ?? {
    totalReports: 0,
    activeReports: 0,
    resolvedReports: 0,
    criticalThreats: 0,
    latestCreatedAt: null,
  };

  return {
    totalReports: reportStats.totalReports,
    activeReports: reportStats.activeReports,
    resolvedReports: reportStats.resolvedReports,
    criticalThreats: reportStats.criticalThreats,
    totalCitizens,
    verifiedCitizens,
    safeHavens,
    totalVotes,
    lastActiveAt: reportStats.latestCreatedAt
      ? new Date(reportStats.latestCreatedAt).toISOString()
      : now.toISOString(),
    timestamp: now.toISOString(),
  };
};

let isBroadcastingStats = false;
let hasPendingStatsBroadcast = false;

/**
 * Coalesces concurrent stats recalculations so rapid mutations (e.g. RSS batch ingestion)
 * run at most one active query plus one trailing refresh and never block or fail callers.
 */
export const broadcastPlatformStats = async (): Promise<void> => {
  if (!hasInitializedIO()) return;
  if (isBroadcastingStats) {
    hasPendingStatsBroadcast = true;
    return;
  }

  isBroadcastingStats = true;
  try {
    do {
      hasPendingStatsBroadcast = false;
      const stats = await getPlatformStats();
      emitStatsUpdated(stats);
    } while (hasPendingStatsBroadcast && hasInitializedIO());
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[Stats Broadcaster] Failed to broadcast STATS_UPDATED:', err);
  } finally {
    isBroadcastingStats = false;
  }
};
```
