### What This Code Does
This service implements privileged administrative moderation capabilities.
It handles manual incident verification, threat reclassification, report purging with recorded reasons, and user banning.
All administrative modifications execute within atomic database transactions that write immutable records to ModerationLog.

```typescript
import { ModerationAction, ReportCategory, ReportSeverity, ReportStatus, Role } from '@prisma/client';
import { prisma } from '../db/prisma';
import { emitReportPurged } from '../sockets';
import { broadcastPlatformStats } from './statsService';

const UUID_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

export const findUserByIdentifier = async (identifier: string) => {
  const trimmed = identifier.trim();
  if (UUID_REGEX.test(trimmed)) {
    const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: trimmed } });
    if (user) return user;
  }
  return prisma.user.findFirst({
    where: {
      OR: [
        { email: { equals: trimmed.toLowerCase(), mode: 'insensitive' } },
        { anonymousId: trimmed },
        { phoneNumber: trimmed },
      ],
    },
  });
};

export interface ModerationLogOutput {
  id: string;
  adminId: string;
  targetUserId?: string | null;
  targetReportId?: string | null;
  action: ModerationAction;
  reason: string;
  createdAt: Date;
}

const SAFE_ADMIN_USER_SELECT = {
  id: true,
  email: true,
  phoneNumber: true,
  anonymousId: true,
  role: true,
  isVerified: true,
  trustScore: true,
  isBanned: true,
  lastReportAt: true,
  createdAt: true,
} as const;

/**
 * Bans a user account, revokes all active refresh tokens, and records an immutable entry in ModerationLog.
 * Accepts either UUID, email, phone number, or anonymousId.
 */
export const banUser = async (
  adminId: string,
  targetIdentifier: string,
  reason: string
) => {
  const targetUser = await findUserByIdentifier(targetIdentifier);

  if (!targetUser) {
    const error: any = new Error('User not found');
    error.statusCode = 404;
    throw error;
  }

  const targetUserId = targetUser.id;

  if (targetUser.id === adminId) {
    const error: any = new Error('Administrators cannot ban their own account');
    error.statusCode = 403;
    throw error;
  }

  if (targetUser.role === 'ADMIN') {
    const error: any = new Error('Administrators cannot ban another administrator account');
    error.statusCode = 403;
    throw error;
  }

  if (targetUser.isBanned) {
    const error: any = new Error('User is already banned');
    error.statusCode = 400;
    throw error;
  }

  // Atomic transaction: suspend user, globally revoke all active sessions, and record immutable moderation log
  const [updatedUser, , log] = await prisma.$transaction([
    prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: targetUserId },
      data: { isBanned: true },
      select: SAFE_ADMIN_USER_SELECT,
    }),
    prisma.refreshToken.updateMany({
      where: { userId: targetUserId, isRevoked: false },
      data: { isRevoked: true },
    }),
    prisma.moderationLog.create({
      data: {
        adminId,
        targetUserId,
        action: 'BAN_USER',
        reason,
      },
    }),
  ]);

  void broadcastPlatformStats();

  return { user: updatedUser, log };
};

/**
 * Unbans a user account and records an immutable entry in ModerationLog.
 * Accepts either UUID, email, phone number, or anonymousId.
 */
export const unbanUser = async (
  adminId: string,
  targetIdentifier: string,
  reason: string
) => {
  const targetUser = await findUserByIdentifier(targetIdentifier);

  if (!targetUser) {
    const error: any = new Error('User not found');
    error.statusCode = 404;
    throw error;
  }

  const targetUserId = targetUser.id;

  if (!targetUser.isBanned) {
    const error: any = new Error('User is not banned');
    error.statusCode = 400;
    throw error;
  }

  // Atomic transaction: restore user and record immutable moderation log
  const [updatedUser, log] = await prisma.$transaction([
    prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: targetUserId },
      data: { isBanned: false },
      select: SAFE_ADMIN_USER_SELECT,
    }),
    prisma.moderationLog.create({
      data: {
        adminId,
        targetUserId,
        action: 'UNBAN_USER',
        reason,
      },
    }),
  ]);

  void broadcastPlatformStats();

  return { user: updatedUser, log };
};

/**
 * Manually purges a report and records an immutable entry in ModerationLog.
 * Emits real-time REPORT_PURGED event to active map clients.
 */
export const purgeReport = async (
  adminId: string,
  targetReportId: string,
  reason: string
) => {
  const targetReport = await prisma.report.findUnique({
    where: { id: targetReportId },
  });

  if (!targetReport) {
    const error: any = new Error('Report not found');
    error.statusCode = 404;
    throw error;
  }

  if (targetReport.status === 'PURGED') {
    const error: any = new Error('Report is already purged');
    error.statusCode = 400;
    throw error;
  }

  // Atomic transaction: purge report and record immutable moderation log
  const [updatedReport, log] = await prisma.$transaction([
    prisma.report.update({
      where: { id: targetReportId },
      data: { status: 'PURGED' },
    }),
    prisma.moderationLog.create({
      data: {
        adminId,
        targetReportId,
        action: 'PURGE_REPORT',
        reason,
      },
    }),
  ]);

  // Broadcast real-time PURGED event to all active clients
  emitReportPurged({
    reportId: targetReportId,
    reason: `ADMIN_PURGED: ${reason}`,
  });

  void broadcastPlatformStats();

  return { report: updatedReport, log };
};

/**
 * Retrieves paginated audit logs of all administrative actions.
 * Strictly read-only; no endpoints exist to update or delete moderation logs.
 */
export const getModerationLogs = async (
  page: number = 1,
  limit: number = 20,
  action?: ModerationAction
) => {
  if (!Number.isInteger(page) || page < 1) {
    const error: any = new Error('page must be a positive integer');
    error.statusCode = 400;
    throw error;
  }
  if (!Number.isInteger(limit) || limit < 1 || limit > 100) {
    const error: any = new Error('limit must be an integer between 1 and 100');
    error.statusCode = 400;
    throw error;
  }

  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
  const where = action ? { action } : undefined;

  const [total, logs] = await prisma.$transaction([
    prisma.moderationLog.count({ where }),
    prisma.moderationLog.findMany({
      where,
      skip,
      take: limit,
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
      include: {
        admin: {
          select: { id: true, email: true, role: true },
        },
        targetUser: {
          select: { id: true, email: true, role: true, isBanned: true },
        },
        targetReport: {
          select: { id: true, category: true, severity: true, status: true },
        },
      },
    }),
  ]);

  return {
    logs,
    pagination: {
      total,
      page,
      limit,
      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit),
    },
  };
};

/**
 * Calculates 30-day incident trends, frequency breakdown by category and severity,
 * night-time proportions, and daily timeline distribution for administrative analytics.
 */
export const getHazardTrends = async () => {
  const thirtyDaysAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

  const [
    totalReports,
    byCategory,
    bySeverity,
    byStatus,
    nightReportsCount,
    dailyTimeline
  ] = await prisma.$transaction([
    // Total reports in last 30 days
    prisma.report.count({
      where: { createdAt: { gte: thirtyDaysAgo } }
    }),
    // Breakdown by category
    prisma.report.groupBy({
      by: ['category'],
      where: { createdAt: { gte: thirtyDaysAgo } },
      _count: { _all: true },
      orderBy: { category: 'asc' }
    }),
    // Breakdown by severity
    prisma.report.groupBy({
      by: ['severity'],
      where: { createdAt: { gte: thirtyDaysAgo } },
      _count: { _all: true },
      orderBy: { severity: 'asc' }
    }),
    // Breakdown by status
    prisma.report.groupBy({
      by: ['status'],
      where: { createdAt: { gte: thirtyDaysAgo } },
      _count: { _all: true },
      orderBy: { status: 'asc' }
    }),
    // Total night-time reports
    prisma.report.count({
      where: { createdAt: { gte: thirtyDaysAgo }, isNightReport: true }
    }),
    // Daily incident timeline
    prisma.$queryRaw<Array<{ day: string; count: bigint }>>`
      SELECT 
        TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('day', "createdAt"), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as day,
        COUNT(*)::bigint as count
      FROM "Report"
      WHERE "createdAt" >= ${thirtyDaysAgo}
      GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', "createdAt")
      ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('day', "createdAt") ASC
    `
  ]);

  const categoryMap: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const item of byCategory) {
    categoryMap[item.category] = (item as any)._count?._all ?? 0;
  }

  const severityMap: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const item of bySeverity) {
    severityMap[item.severity] = (item as any)._count?._all ?? 0;
  }

  const statusMap: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const item of byStatus) {
    statusMap[item.status] = (item as any)._count?._all ?? 0;
  }

  const timelineFormatted = dailyTimeline.map((row) => ({
    date: row.day,
    count: Number(row.count)
  }));

  return {
    timeframe: '30_DAYS',
    startDate: thirtyDaysAgo.toISOString(),
    totalReports,
    nightReportsCount,
    nightReportPercentage: totalReports > 0 ? Number(((nightReportsCount / totalReports) * 100).toFixed(1)) : 0,
    breakdown: {
      byCategory: categoryMap,
      bySeverity: severityMap,
      byStatus: statusMap
    },
    timeline: timelineFormatted
  };
};

/**
 * Promotes a report to ADMIN_VERIFIED stage and records an immutable entry in ModerationLog.
 */
export const verifyReport = async (
  adminId: string,
  targetReportId: string,
  reason: string = 'Incident verified by administrator'
) => {
  const targetReport = await prisma.report.findUnique({
    where: { id: targetReportId },
  });

  if (!targetReport) {
    const error: any = new Error('Report not found');
    error.statusCode = 404;
    throw error;
  }

  if (targetReport.status === 'PURGED') {
    const error: any = new Error('Cannot verify a purged report');
    error.statusCode = 400;
    throw error;
  }

  const [updatedReport, log] = await prisma.$transaction([
    prisma.report.update({
      where: { id: targetReportId },
      data: { verificationStage: 'ADMIN_VERIFIED' },
    }),
    prisma.moderationLog.create({
      data: {
        adminId,
        targetReportId,
        action: 'VERIFY_INCIDENT',
        reason,
      },
    }),
  ]);

  return { report: updatedReport, log };
};

/**
 * Reclassifies a report's category and/or severity with an immutable audit log entry.
 */
export const reclassifyReport = async (
  adminId: string,
  targetReportId: string,
  params: {
    category?: ReportCategory;
    severity?: ReportSeverity;
    reason?: string;
  }
) => {
  const targetReport = await prisma.report.findUnique({
    where: { id: targetReportId },
  });

  if (!targetReport) {
    const error: any = new Error('Report not found');
    error.statusCode = 404;
    throw error;
  }

  if (targetReport.status === 'PURGED') {
    const error: any = new Error('Cannot reclassify a purged report');
    error.statusCode = 400;
    throw error;
  }

  if (!params.category && !params.severity) {
    const error: any = new Error('At least one of category or severity must be provided');
    error.statusCode = 400;
    throw error;
  }

  const dataToUpdate: any = {};
  if (params.category) dataToUpdate.category = params.category;
  if (params.severity) dataToUpdate.severity = params.severity;

  const reason = params.reason || `Report reclassified: ${JSON.stringify(dataToUpdate)}`;

  const [updatedReport, log] = await prisma.$transaction([
    prisma.report.update({
      where: { id: targetReportId },
      data: dataToUpdate,
    }),
    prisma.moderationLog.create({
      data: {
        adminId,
        targetReportId,
        action: 'RECLASSIFY_REPORT',
        reason,
      },
    }),
  ]);

  return { report: updatedReport, log };
};

export interface GetAdminUsersParams {
  search?: string;
  role?: Role;
  isBanned?: boolean;
  isVerified?: boolean;
  page?: number;
  limit?: number;
  sortBy?: 'createdAt' | 'trustScore' | 'lastReportAt';
  sortOrder?: 'asc' | 'desc';
}

/**
 * Retrieves paginated users list with search by email, phone, anonymousId, or UUID,
 * with role/status filters and aggregated activity metrics.
 */
export const getAdminUsers = async (params: GetAdminUsersParams = {}) => {
  const page = Math.max(1, params.page || 1);
  const limit = Math.min(100, Math.max(1, params.limit || 20));
  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

  const whereConditions: any[] = [];

  if (params.search && params.search.trim()) {
    const term = params.search.trim();
    const isUuid = UUID_REGEX.test(term);
    const searchConditions: any[] = [
      { email: { contains: term, mode: 'insensitive' } },
      { anonymousId: { contains: term, mode: 'insensitive' } },
      { phoneNumber: { contains: term } },
    ];
    if (isUuid) {
      searchConditions.push({ id: term });
    }
    whereConditions.push({ OR: searchConditions });
  }

  if (params.role) {
    whereConditions.push({ role: params.role });
  }

  if (typeof params.isBanned === 'boolean') {
    whereConditions.push({ isBanned: params.isBanned });
  }

  if (typeof params.isVerified === 'boolean') {
    whereConditions.push({ isVerified: params.isVerified });
  }

  const where = whereConditions.length > 0 ? { AND: whereConditions } : {};

  const validSortFields = ['createdAt', 'trustScore', 'lastReportAt'] as const;
  const sortField = validSortFields.includes(params.sortBy as any) ? params.sortBy! : 'createdAt';
  const sortOrder = params.sortOrder === 'asc' ? 'asc' : 'desc';

  const [total, users] = await prisma.$transaction([
    prisma.user.count({ where }),
    prisma.user.findMany({
      where,
      skip,
      take: limit,
      orderBy: { [sortField]: sortOrder },
      select: {
        id: true,
        email: true,
        phoneNumber: true,
        anonymousId: true,
        role: true,
        isVerified: true,
        trustScore: true,
        isBanned: true,
        lastReportAt: true,
        createdAt: true,
        updatedAt: true,
        _count: {
          select: {
            reports: true,
            votes: true,
            verifications: true,
          },
        },
      },
    }),
  ]);

  return {
    users,
    pagination: {
      total,
      page,
      limit,
      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit),
    },
  };
};

export interface GetAdminReportsParams {
  search?: string;
  category?: ReportCategory;
  severity?: ReportSeverity;
  status?: ReportStatus;
  userId?: string;
  page?: number;
  limit?: number;
}

/**
 * Retrieves paginated reports for moderation with rich metadata, including
 * reporter account details, verification status, and attached evidence.
 */
export const getAdminReports = async (params: GetAdminReportsParams = {}) => {
  const page = Math.max(1, params.page || 1);
  const limit = Math.min(100, Math.max(1, params.limit || 20));
  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

  const whereConditions: any[] = [];

  if (params.category) {
    whereConditions.push({ category: params.category });
  }
  if (params.severity) {
    whereConditions.push({ severity: params.severity });
  }
  if (params.status) {
    whereConditions.push({ status: params.status });
  }
  if (params.userId) {
    whereConditions.push({ userId: params.userId });
  }
  if (params.search && params.search.trim()) {
    whereConditions.push({
      description: { contains: params.search.trim(), mode: 'insensitive' },
    });
  }

  const where = whereConditions.length > 0 ? { AND: whereConditions } : {};

  const [total, reports] = await prisma.$transaction([
    prisma.report.count({ where }),
    prisma.report.findMany({
      where,
      skip,
      take: limit,
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
      select: {
        id: true,
        category: true,
        severity: true,
        status: true,
        verificationStage: true,
        description: true,
        latitude: true,
        longitude: true,
        upvotes: true,
        downvotes: true,
        isNightReport: true,
        isGpsVerified: true,
        sourceName: true,
        sourceUrl: true,
        createdAt: true,
        expiresAt: true,
        userId: true,
        user: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            email: true,
            phoneNumber: true,
            anonymousId: true,
            role: true,
            trustScore: true,
            isBanned: true,
            isVerified: true,
          },
        },
        media: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            blurredUrl: true,
            createdAt: true,
          },
        },
      },
    }),
  ]);

  return {
    reports,
    pagination: {
      total,
      page,
      limit,
      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit),
    },
  };
};
```

## [File 36] `apps/api/src/controllers/authController.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/api/src/controllers/authController.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 136  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This controller handles HTTP endpoints for device registration, administrator login, and session token refreshing.
It reads request credentials, invokes authService methods, and sets secure HTTP-only cookies on responses.
It also manages user logout by clearing session cookies and revoking active refresh tokens in the database.

```typescript
import { Request, Response } from 'express';
import * as authService from '../services/authService';
import { verifyRefreshToken } from '../utils/jwt';
import { extractAccessToken, verifyActiveAccessToken } from '../middleware/requireAuth';
import { env } from '../config/env';
import { successResponse, errorResponse } from '../utils/responseFormatter';

const ACCESS_TOKEN_MAX_AGE_MS = 15 * 60 * 1000;
const REFRESH_TOKEN_MAX_AGE_MS = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

const getBaseCookieOptions = () => ({
  httpOnly: true,
  secure: env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
  sameSite: 'lax' as const,
});

const setAuthCookies = (res: Response, accessToken: string, refreshToken: string) => {
  const base = getBaseCookieOptions();
  res.cookie('accessToken', accessToken, { ...base, maxAge: ACCESS_TOKEN_MAX_AGE_MS });
  res.cookie('refreshToken', refreshToken, { ...base, maxAge: REFRESH_TOKEN_MAX_AGE_MS });
};

const clearAuthCookies = (res: Response) => {
  const base = getBaseCookieOptions();
  res.clearCookie('accessToken', base);
  res.clearCookie('refreshToken', base);
};

export const loginDevice = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { anonymousId, email } = req.body;
    const { user, accessToken, refreshToken, socketToken, isNewUser } =
      await authService.loginOrRegisterDevice(anonymousId, email);

    setAuthCookies(res, accessToken, refreshToken);

    return successResponse(
      res,
      { user: { id: user.id, role: user.role }, socketToken },
      isNewUser ? 201 : 200
    );
  } catch (error: any) {
    if (error?.statusCode === 403 && error?.message === 'Account is suspended') {
      clearAuthCookies(res);
    }
    return errorResponse(res, error.message, error.statusCode || 400);
  }
};

export const loginPassword = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { email, password } = req.body;
    const { user, accessToken, refreshToken, socketToken } = await authService.loginWithPassword(email, password);

    setAuthCookies(res, accessToken, refreshToken);

    return successResponse(
      res,
      {
        user: {
          id: user.id,
          email: user.email,
          role: user.role,
          isVerified: user.isVerified,
          trustScore: user.trustScore,
        },
        socketToken,
      },
      200
    );
  } catch (error: any) {
    return errorResponse(res, error.message, 401);
  }
};

export const refresh = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const refreshToken = req.cookies.refreshToken;
    if (!refreshToken) throw new Error('No refresh token provided');

    const decoded = verifyRefreshToken(refreshToken);
    const {
      accessToken,
      refreshToken: rotatedRefreshToken,
      socketToken,
    } = await authService.refreshSession(refreshToken, decoded.id);

    setAuthCookies(res, accessToken, rotatedRefreshToken);

    return successResponse(res, { socketToken }, 200);
  } catch (error: any) {
    clearAuthCookies(res);
    return errorResponse(res, 'Unauthorized', 401);
  }
};

export const logout = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const accessToken = extractAccessToken(req);
    const refreshToken = req.cookies?.refreshToken as string | undefined;

    let hasValidSession = false;

    if (accessToken) {
      try {
        await verifyActiveAccessToken(accessToken);
        hasValidSession = true;
      } catch {
        // Fall through to refreshToken verification so expired access tokens can still log out cleanly
      }
    }

    if (!hasValidSession && refreshToken) {
      try {
        verifyRefreshToken(refreshToken);
        hasValidSession = true;
      } catch {
        // Invalid or expired refresh token
      }
    }

    if (!hasValidSession) {
      return errorResponse(res, 'Unauthorized: No valid session token provided', 401);
    }

    if (refreshToken) {
      await authService.logout(refreshToken);
    }

    clearAuthCookies(res);
    return successResponse(res, {}, 200);
  } catch (error: any) {
    return errorResponse(res, 'Internal server error', 500);
  }
};
```

### What This Code Does
This controller manages REST endpoints for fetching, creating, and resolving hazard reports.
It handles PostGIS bounding-box viewport queries, validates incident submission payloads, and triggers real-time socket events.
It guarantees that public responses omit sensitive reporter identifiers and return fuzzed coordinates.

```typescript
import { Request, Response } from 'express';
import * as reportService from '../services/reportService';
import { successResponse, errorResponse } from '../utils/responseFormatter';
import { ReportCategory, ReportSeverity } from '@prisma/client';

export const createReport = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const userId = req.user!.id;
    const payload = req.body;
    
    const rawLat = req.headers['x-device-lat'] as string | undefined;
    const rawLng = req.headers['x-device-lng'] as string | undefined;
    const rawAccuracy = req.headers['x-device-accuracy'] as string | undefined;
    const gpsSource = req.headers['x-gps-source'] as 'hardware' | 'manual' | undefined;

    const deviceGps =
      rawLat !== undefined && rawLng !== undefined
        ? {
            latitude: Number(rawLat.trim()),
            longitude: Number(rawLng.trim()),
            accuracy: rawAccuracy !== undefined ? Number(rawAccuracy.trim()) : undefined,
            source: gpsSource,
          }
        : undefined;

    const report = await reportService.createReport(userId, payload as any, deviceGps);
    return successResponse(res, report, 201);
  } catch (error: any) {
    const statusCode = error.statusCode || 400;
    return errorResponse(res, error.message, statusCode);
  }
};

export const getReports = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const bounds = {
      minLng: parseFloat(req.query.minLng as string),
      minLat: parseFloat(req.query.minLat as string),
      maxLng: parseFloat(req.query.maxLng as string),
      maxLat: parseFloat(req.query.maxLat as string)
    };

    const filters = {
      category: req.query.category as ReportCategory | undefined,
      severity: req.query.severity as ReportSeverity | undefined,
      isNightReport: req.query.isNightReport !== undefined 
        ? req.query.isNightReport === 'true' 
        : undefined
    };

    const reports = await reportService.fetchReportsInBounds(bounds, filters);
    return successResponse(res, reports, 200);
  } catch (error: any) {
    const statusCode = error.statusCode || 400;
    return errorResponse(res, error.message, statusCode);
  }
};

  try {
    const { id } = req.params;
    const report = await reportService.fetchReportById(id, req.user?.id);
    return successResponse(res, report, 200);
  } catch (error: any) {
    const statusCode = error.statusCode || 400;
    return errorResponse(res, error.message, statusCode);
  }
};

    const { id } = req.params;

  }
```

## [File 39] `apps/api/src/controllers/safeZoneController.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/api/src/controllers/safeZoneController.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 99  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This controller serves endpoints for querying emergency safe-haven facilities (police stations and hospitals).
It accepts geographic bounding box and coordinate filters to return nearby shelters sorted by proximity.
It formats location names, categories, and verified phone numbers for emergency dialer integration.

```typescript
import { Request, Response } from 'express';
import * as safeZoneService from '../services/safeZoneService';
import { successResponse, errorResponse } from '../utils/responseFormatter';
import { SafeZoneType } from '@prisma/client';

export const getSafeZonesHandler = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { minLng, minLat, maxLng, maxLat, lat, lng, radius, type } = req.query;

    const safeZoneType = type as SafeZoneType | undefined;

    // Viewport Bounding Box query
    if (minLng && minLat && maxLng && maxLat) {
      const minLngNum = parseFloat(minLng as string);
      const minLatNum = parseFloat(minLat as string);
      const maxLngNum = parseFloat(maxLng as string);
      const maxLatNum = parseFloat(maxLat as string);
      if (
        !Number.isFinite(minLngNum) ||
        !Number.isFinite(minLatNum) ||
        !Number.isFinite(maxLngNum) ||
        !Number.isFinite(maxLatNum)
      ) {
        const error: any = new Error('Invalid bounding box coordinates');
        error.statusCode = 400;
        throw error;
      }
      const bounds = {
        minLng: minLngNum,
        minLat: minLatNum,
        maxLng: maxLngNum,
        maxLat: maxLatNum,
      };
      const zones = await safeZoneService.fetchSafeZonesInBounds(bounds, safeZoneType);
      return successResponse(res, zones, 200);
    }

    // Nearby Radius Proximity query
    if (lat || lng) {
      if (!lat || !lng) {
        const error: any = new Error('Both lat and lng must be provided together for proximity queries');
        error.statusCode = 400;
        throw error;
      }
      const latitude = parseFloat(lat as string);
      const longitude = parseFloat(lng as string);
      const radiusMeters = radius ? parseFloat(radius as string) : 5000;
      if (!Number.isFinite(latitude) || !Number.isFinite(longitude) || !Number.isFinite(radiusMeters)) {
        const error: any = new Error('Invalid latitude, longitude, or radius');
        error.statusCode = 400;
        throw error;
      }

      const zones = await safeZoneService.fetchNearbySafeZones(latitude, longitude, radiusMeters, safeZoneType);
      return successResponse(res, zones, 200);
    }

    // Default: fetch all prominent safe zones in Bangladesh bounds
    const defaultBounds = {
      minLng: 88.0,
      minLat: 20.5,
      maxLng: 93.0,
      maxLat: 27.0,
    };
    const zones = await safeZoneService.fetchSafeZonesInBounds(defaultBounds, safeZoneType);
    return successResponse(res, zones, 200);
  } catch (error: any) {
    const statusCode = error.statusCode || 400;
    return errorResponse(res, error.message || 'Failed to fetch safe zones', statusCode);
  }
};

export const createSafeZoneHandler = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { name, type, latitude, longitude } = req.body;
    const newZone = await safeZoneService.createSafeZone({
      name,
      type,
      latitude,
      longitude,
    });
    return successResponse(res, newZone, 201);
  } catch (error: any) {
    const statusCode = error.statusCode || 400;
    return errorResponse(res, error.message || 'Failed to create safe zone', statusCode);
  }
};

  try {

  }
};
```

## [File 44] `apps/api/src/controllers/mediaController.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/api/src/controllers/mediaController.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 259  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This controller provides endpoints for uploading incident evidence photographs and obtaining pre-signed URLs.
It validates file sizes and extensions to ensure only safe image formats are stored in the media bucket.
It returns uploaded image metadata to attach to incident report submissions.

```typescript
import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import { prisma } from '../db/prisma';
import { env } from '../config/env';
import {
  generatePresignedUploadUrl,
  getPublicUrl,
  AllowedMimeType,
  isS3Configured,
  parseReportMediaKey,
  resolveTrustedReportMedia,
  validateCompressedInlineImage,
} from '../services/storageService';
import { processPrivacyBlur } from '../services/privacyBlurService';
import { successResponse, errorResponse } from '../utils/responseFormatter';

const findAuthorizedReportForMedia = async (
  reportId: string,
  user: { id: string; role: string },
  forbiddenMessage: string
) => {
  const report = await prisma.report.findUnique({
    where: { id: reportId },
  });

  if (!report) {
    throw Object.assign(new Error('Report not found'), { statusCode: 404 });
  }

  if (report.userId !== user.id && user.role !== 'ADMIN' && user.role !== 'VERIFIED_RESPONDER') {
    throw Object.assign(new Error(forbiddenMessage), { statusCode: 403 });
  }

  return report;
};

const persistConfirmedReportMedia = async (reportId: string, resolvedUrl: string) => {
  const existingMedia = await prisma.reportMedia.findFirst({
    where: { reportId, originalUrl: resolvedUrl },
  });

  let mediaId: string;
  let statusCode = 201;

  if (existingMedia) {
    mediaId = existingMedia.id;
    statusCode = 200;
    if (!existingMedia.blurredUrl) {
      await processPrivacyBlur(existingMedia.id, resolvedUrl);
    }
  } else {
    const media = await prisma.reportMedia.create({
      data: {
        reportId,
        originalUrl: resolvedUrl,
      },
    });
    mediaId = media.id;
    await processPrivacyBlur(media.id, resolvedUrl);
  }

  // Return sanitized media metadata without exposing originalUrl
  const updatedMedia = await prisma.reportMedia.findUnique({
    where: { id: mediaId },
    select: {
      id: true,
      reportId: true,
      blurredUrl: true,
      createdAt: true,
    },
  });

  return { updatedMedia, statusCode };
};

export const getPresignedUrlHandler = async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
  try {
    const user = (req as any).user;
    if (!user) {
      return errorResponse(res, 'Unauthorized', 401);
    }

    const { reportId, fileType, fileSize } = req.query;

    try {
      await findAuthorizedReportForMedia(
        String(reportId),
        user,
        'You are not authorized to attach media to this report'
      );
    } catch (authError: any) {
      return errorResponse(res, authError.message, authError.statusCode || 403);
    }

    const presignedData = await generatePresignedUploadUrl(
      String(reportId),
      fileType as AllowedMimeType,
      Number(fileSize)
    );

    return successResponse(res, presignedData, 200);
  } catch (error: any) {
    next(error);
  }
};

export const confirmMediaUploadHandler = async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
  try {
    const user = (req as any).user;
    if (!user) {
      return errorResponse(res, 'Unauthorized', 401);
    }

    const { reportId, originalUrl, fileKey } = req.body;

    try {
      await findAuthorizedReportForMedia(
        reportId,
        user,
        'You are not authorized to confirm media for this report'
      );
    } catch (authError: any) {
      return errorResponse(res, authError.message, authError.statusCode || 403);
    }

    let resolvedUrl: string;
    try {
      resolvedUrl = resolveTrustedReportMedia({ reportId, originalUrl, fileKey }).originalUrl;
    } catch (validationError: any) {
      return errorResponse(res, validationError.message, validationError.statusCode || 400);
    }

    const { updatedMedia, statusCode } = await persistConfirmedReportMedia(reportId, resolvedUrl);

    return successResponse(res, updatedMedia, statusCode);
  } catch (error: any) {
    next(error);
  }
};

/**
 * Authenticated fallback for environments where cloud S3 credentials are not configured (`isMock: true`).
 * Accepts a client-compressed JPEG/PNG/WebP base64 data URI (<= 512KB), verifies binary magic bytes,
 * and stores sanitized ReportMedia so evidence previews remain viewable in S3-less deployments.
 */
export const mockUploadMediaHandler = async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
  try {
    const user = (req as any).user;
    if (!user) {
      return errorResponse(res, 'Unauthorized', 401);
    }

    if (isS3Configured()) {
      return errorResponse(
        res,
        'Mock media upload is disabled when cloud S3 storage is configured. Upload directly via presigned URL.',
        409
      );
    }

    const { reportId, imageDataUrl } = req.body;

    try {
      await findAuthorizedReportForMedia(
        reportId,
        user,
        'You are not authorized to attach media to this report'
      );
    } catch (authError: any) {
      return errorResponse(res, authError.message, authError.statusCode || 403);
    }

    let normalizedDataUrl: string;
    try {
      normalizedDataUrl = validateCompressedInlineImage(imageDataUrl).normalizedDataUrl;
    } catch (validationError: any) {
      return errorResponse(res, validationError.message, validationError.statusCode || 400);
    }

    const { updatedMedia, statusCode } = await persistConfirmedReportMedia(reportId, normalizedDataUrl);

    return successResponse(res, updatedMedia, statusCode);
  } catch (error: any) {
    next(error);
  }
};

export const handleStorageWebhook = async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
  try {
    const payload = req.body;
    const expectedBucket = (
      'STORAGE_WEBHOOK_BUCKET' in process.env
        ? process.env.STORAGE_WEBHOOK_BUCKET
        : env.STORAGE_WEBHOOK_BUCKET
    )?.trim();

    // Handle standard S3 ObjectCreated arrays or Supabase Storage webhook INSERT payloads
    const isS3Batch = Array.isArray(payload?.Records);
    if (!isS3Batch && typeof payload?.type === 'string' && payload.type.toUpperCase() !== 'INSERT') {
      return successResponse(res, { received: true }, 200);
    }

    const records = isS3Batch
      ? payload.Records
      : payload?.record
        ? [payload.record]
        : typeof payload?.key === 'string'
          ? [{ name: payload.key }]
          : [];

    for (const record of records) {
      if (
        isS3Batch &&
        typeof record?.eventName === 'string' &&
        !record.eventName.toLowerCase().includes('objectcreated')
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      if (expectedBucket) {
        const eventBucket = record?.s3?.bucket?.name || record?.bucket_id;
        if (eventBucket !== expectedBucket) {
          continue;
        }
      }

      const rawKey = record?.s3?.object?.key || record?.name;
      if (typeof rawKey !== 'string') continue;

      const parsed = parseReportMediaKey(rawKey);
      if (!parsed) continue;

      const { reportId, fileKey } = parsed;
      const report = await prisma.report.findUnique({
        where: { id: reportId },
      });
      if (!report) continue;

      const publicUrl = getPublicUrl(fileKey);
      const existingMedia = await prisma.reportMedia.findFirst({
        where: { reportId, originalUrl: publicUrl },
      });
      if (existingMedia) continue;

      const media = await prisma.reportMedia.create({
        data: {
          reportId,
          originalUrl: publicUrl,
        },
      });

      await processPrivacyBlur(media.id, publicUrl);
    }

    return successResponse(res, { received: true }, 200);
  } catch (error: any) {
    next(error);
  }
};
```

## [File 47] `apps/api/src/routes/auth.ts`

### What This Code Does
This file registers authentication HTTP routes under the /auth prefix.
It binds endpoints for anonymous device registration (/auth/device), admin login (/auth/login), and token refreshing (/auth/refresh).
It attaches request validation schemas and strict rate limiting to protect authentication gates.

```typescript
import { Router } from 'express';
import { loginDevice, loginPassword, refresh, logout } from '../controllers/authController';
import { validateRequest } from '../middleware/validateRequest';
import {
  authDeviceRateLimiter,
  authLoginRateLimiter,
  authRefreshRateLimiter,
} from '../middleware/rateLimiter';
import { z } from 'zod';

const router = Router();

const deviceLoginSchema = z.object({
  body: z.object({
    anonymousId: z.string().min(1),
    email: z.string().email().optional(),
  }).strict()
});

const passwordLoginSchema = z.object({
  body: z.object({
    email: z.string().email(),
    password: z.string().min(6),
  }).strict()
});

router.post('/device', authDeviceRateLimiter, validateRequest(deviceLoginSchema), loginDevice);
router.post('/login', authLoginRateLimiter, validateRequest(passwordLoginSchema), loginPassword);
router.post('/refresh', authRefreshRateLimiter, refresh);
router.post('/logout', logout);

export default router;
```

## [File 48] `apps/api/src/routes/reports.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/api/src/routes/reports.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 119  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This file defines the primary REST routes for incident reporting under /reports.
It configures endpoints for fetching reports in viewport bounds, retrieving report details by ID, submitting new hazards, and marking incidents resolved.
It enforces authentication, rate limiting, and request validation middleware on all mutation endpoints.

```typescript
import { Router } from 'express';
import { createReport, getReports, getReportById, resolveReportHandler } from '../controllers/reportController';
import { voteOnReport } from '../controllers/voteController';
import { addUpdateHandler, getUpdatesHandler } from '../controllers/reportUpdateController';
import { requireAuth, optionalAuth } from '../middleware/requireAuth';
import { validateRequest } from '../middleware/validateRequest';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { REPORT_CATEGORIES } from '@repo/shared';

import {
  reportCreationRateLimiter,
  reportUpdateRateLimiter,
  reportVoteRateLimiter,
} from '../middleware/rateLimiter';

const router = Router();

const parseFiniteHeaderNumber = (val: string): number => {
  const trimmed = val.trim();
  return trimmed.length === 0 ? Number.NaN : Number(trimmed);
};

const optionalCoordHeader = (min: number, max: number, label: string) =>
  z
    .string()
    .refine((val) => {
      const num = parseFiniteHeaderNumber(val);
      return Number.isFinite(num) && num >= min && num <= max;
    }, `${label} must be a valid number between ${min} and ${max}`)
    .optional();

const reportSchema = z.object({
  body: z.object({
    category: z.enum(REPORT_CATEGORIES),
    severity: z.enum(['LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH']),
    latitude: z.number().min(-90).max(90),
    longitude: z.number().min(-180).max(180),
    description: z
      .string()
      .trim()
      .min(1, 'Description cannot be empty if provided')
      .max(1000, 'Description cannot exceed 1000 characters')
      .optional(),
  }).strict(),
  headers: z.object({
    'x-device-lat': optionalCoordHeader(-90, 90, 'x-device-lat'),
    'x-device-lng': optionalCoordHeader(-180, 180, 'x-device-lng'),
    'x-device-accuracy': z
      .string()
      .refine((val) => {
        const num = parseFiniteHeaderNumber(val);
        return Number.isFinite(num) && num >= 0;
      }, 'x-device-accuracy must be a non-negative number string')
      .optional(),
    'x-gps-source': z.enum(['hardware', 'manual']).optional(),
  }).passthrough().refine(
    (headers) => (headers['x-device-lat'] === undefined) === (headers['x-device-lng'] === undefined),
    { message: 'x-device-lat and x-device-lng must both be provided together or both omitted' }
  )
});

const coordQueryParam = (min: number, max: number, label: string) =>
  z.string().trim().refine((val) => {
    if (!/^-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(val)) return false;
    const num = Number(val);
    return Number.isFinite(num) && num >= min && num <= max;
  }, `${label} must be a valid number between ${min} and ${max}`);

const boundsSchema = z.object({
  query: z.object({
    minLng: coordQueryParam(-180, 180, 'minLng'),
    minLat: coordQueryParam(-90, 90, 'minLat'),
    maxLng: coordQueryParam(-180, 180, 'maxLng'),
    maxLat: coordQueryParam(-90, 90, 'maxLat'),
    category: z.enum(REPORT_CATEGORIES).optional(),
    severity: z.enum(['LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH']).optional(),
    isNightReport: z.enum(['true', 'false']).optional(),
  }).passthrough().refine(
    (q) => Number(q.minLng) < Number(q.maxLng) && Number(q.minLat) < Number(q.maxLat),
    { message: 'Inverted bounding box: minLng must be less than maxLng and minLat must be less than maxLat' }
  )
});

const reportIdSchema = z.object({
  params: z.object({
    id: z.string().uuid({ message: 'Valid report UUID is required' })
  }).passthrough()
});

const voteSchema = z.object({
  body: z.object({
    voteType: z.literal(1).or(z.literal(-1))
  }).strict(),
  params: z.object({
    id: z.string().uuid()
  }).passthrough()
});

const addUpdateSchema = z.object({
  body: z.object({
    content: z.string().trim().min(2, 'Update must be at least 2 characters').max(500, 'Update cannot exceed 500 characters')
  }).strict(),
  params: z.object({
    id: z.string().uuid({ message: 'Valid report UUID is required' })
  }).passthrough()
});

router.post('/', requireAuth, reportCreationRateLimiter, validateRequest(reportSchema), createReport);
router.get('/', validateRequest(boundsSchema), getReports);
router.get('/:id', optionalAuth, validateRequest(reportIdSchema), getReportById);
router.patch('/:id/resolve', requireAuth, validateRequest(reportIdSchema), resolveReportHandler);
router.post('/:id/vote', requireAuth, reportVoteRateLimiter, validateRequest(voteSchema), voteOnReport);

// Threaded Context Updates for active incidents
router.post('/:id/updates', requireAuth, reportUpdateRateLimiter, validateRequest(addUpdateSchema), addUpdateHandler);
router.get('/:id/updates', validateRequest(reportIdSchema), getUpdatesHandler);

export default router;
```

> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This file declares the routing endpoints for the safe-haven directory under /safe-zones.
It exposes public GET endpoints to query police stations, medical clinics, and 24/7 pharmacies across Bangladesh.
It applies query caching headers and spatial parameter validation to ensure responsive map layer rendering.

```typescript
import { Router } from 'express';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { SAFE_ZONE_TYPES } from '@repo/shared';
import {
  getSafeZonesHandler,
  createSafeZoneHandler,
  deleteSafeZoneHandler,
} from '../controllers/safeZoneController';
import { requireAuth } from '../middleware/requireAuth';
import { requireRole } from '../middleware/requireRole';
import { validateRequest } from '../middleware/validateRequest';

const router = Router();

const coordParam = (min: number, max: number, label: string) =>
  z.string().trim().refine((val) => {
    if (!/^-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(val)) return false;
    const num = Number(val);
    return Number.isFinite(num) && num >= min && num <= max;
  }, `${label} must be a valid number between ${min} and ${max}`);

const radiusParam = z.string().trim().refine((val) => {
  if (!/^\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(val)) return false;
  const num = Number(val);
  return Number.isFinite(num) && num > 0 && num <= 500000;
}, 'radius must be a positive number up to 500000 meters');

const safeZoneQuerySchema = z.object({
  query: z.object({
    minLng: coordParam(-180, 180, 'minLng').optional(),
    minLat: coordParam(-90, 90, 'minLat').optional(),
    maxLng: coordParam(-180, 180, 'maxLng').optional(),
    maxLat: coordParam(-90, 90, 'maxLat').optional(),
    lat: coordParam(-90, 90, 'lat').optional(),
    lng: coordParam(-180, 180, 'lng').optional(),
    radius: radiusParam.optional(),
    type: z.enum(SAFE_ZONE_TYPES).optional(),
  }).passthrough().superRefine((q, ctx) => {
    const hasBboxAny = q.minLng !== undefined || q.minLat !== undefined || q.maxLng !== undefined || q.maxLat !== undefined;
    const hasBboxAll = q.minLng !== undefined && q.minLat !== undefined && q.maxLng !== undefined && q.maxLat !== undefined;
    if (hasBboxAny && !hasBboxAll) {
      ctx.addIssue({
        code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
        message: 'All bounding box coordinates (minLng, minLat, maxLng, maxLat) must be provided together',
      });
    }
    if (hasBboxAll && (Number(q.minLng) >= Number(q.maxLng) || Number(q.minLat) >= Number(q.maxLat))) {
      ctx.addIssue({
        code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
        message: 'Inverted bounding box: minLng must be less than maxLng and minLat must be less than maxLat',
      });
    }
    const hasPointAny = q.lat !== undefined || q.lng !== undefined;
    const hasPointAll = q.lat !== undefined && q.lng !== undefined;
    if (hasPointAny && !hasPointAll) {
      ctx.addIssue({
        code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
        message: 'Both lat and lng must be provided together for proximity queries',
      });
    }
  }),
});

const createSafeZoneSchema = z.object({
  body: z.object({
    name: z.string().min(2).max(150),
    type: z.enum(SAFE_ZONE_TYPES),
    latitude: z.number().min(-90).max(90),
    longitude: z.number().min(-180).max(180),
  }).strict(),
});

const safeZoneIdSchema = z.object({
  params: z.object({
    id: z.string().uuid({ message: 'Valid UUID is required' }),
  }).passthrough(),
});

// Public safe zones lookup
router.get('/', validateRequest(safeZoneQuerySchema), getSafeZonesHandler);

// Admin-only safe zone creation
router.post('/', requireAuth, requireRole(['ADMIN']), validateRequest(createSafeZoneSchema), createSafeZoneHandler);

// Admin-only safe zone deletion
router.delete('/:id', requireAuth, requireRole(['ADMIN']), validateRequest(safeZoneIdSchema), deleteSafeZoneHandler);

export default router;
```

```typescript
import { Router } from 'express';

});
```

```typescript
import { Router } from 'express';
import { BD_MOBILE_REGEX } from '@repo/shared';
import { getMe, submitVerify, approveVerify } from '../controllers/userController';
import { requireAuth } from '../middleware/requireAuth';
import { requireRole } from '../middleware/requireRole';
import { validateRequest } from '../middleware/validateRequest';
import { userVerifyRateLimiter } from '../middleware/rateLimiter';
import { z } from 'zod';

const router = Router();

const verifySchema = z.object({
  body: z.object({
    type: z.enum(['PHONE_OTP', 'NID_DOCUMENT']),
    documentUrl: z.string().trim().url('Please provide a valid document URL').optional(),
    phoneNumber: z
      .string()
      .trim()
      .regex(
        BD_MOBILE_REGEX,
        'Please provide a valid Bangladeshi mobile number (e.g. +8801XXXXXXXXX or 01XXXXXXXXX)'
      )
      .optional(),
  }).strict().superRefine((data, ctx) => {
    if (data.type === 'PHONE_OTP' && !data.phoneNumber) {
      ctx.addIssue({
        code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
        path: ['phoneNumber'],
        message: 'Bangladeshi mobile number is required for PHONE_OTP verification',
      });
    }
    if (data.type === 'NID_DOCUMENT' && !data.documentUrl) {
      ctx.addIssue({
        code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
        path: ['documentUrl'],
        message: 'Document URL is required for NID_DOCUMENT verification',
      });
    }
  })
});

const verifyIdParamSchema = z.object({
  params: z.object({
    id: z.string().uuid('Invalid verification ID format'),
  }),
});

router.get('/me', requireAuth, getMe);
router.post('/verify', requireAuth, userVerifyRateLimiter, validateRequest(verifySchema), submitVerify);
// Legacy alias for POST /api/v1/admin/verifications/:id/approve (kept for backwards compatibility)
router.post(
  '/verify/:id/approve',
  requireAuth,
  requireRole(['ADMIN']),
  validateRequest(verifyIdParamSchema),
  approveVerify
);

export default router;
```

```typescript
  }).strict(),

  }).passthrough(),
});

const userBanReasonSchema = z.object({

    reason: z
      .string()
      .min(3, { message: 'Reason must be at least 3 characters' })
      .max(500, { message: 'Reason cannot exceed 500 characters' }),
  }).strict(),
  params: z.object({
    id: z.string().min(1, { message: 'User identifier is required' }).max(120),
  }).passthrough(),
});

const approveSchema = z.object({
  params: z.object({
    id: z.string().uuid({ message: 'Valid UUID is required' }),
  }).passthrough(),
});

const usersQuerySchema = z.object({
  query: z.object({
    search: z.string().trim().max(100).optional(),
    role: z.nativeEnum(Role).optional(),
    isBanned: z.enum(['true', 'false']).optional(),
    isVerified: z.enum(['true', 'false']).optional(),
    page: z
      .string()
      .trim()
      .regex(/^[1-9]\d*$/, 'page must be a positive integer')
      .optional(),
    limit: z
      .string()
      .trim()
      .regex(/^[1-9]\d*$/, 'limit must be a positive integer between 1 and 100')
      .refine((val) => Number(val) >= 1 && Number(val) <= 100, 'limit must be between 1 and 100')
      .optional(),
    sortBy: z.enum(['createdAt', 'trustScore', 'lastReportAt']).optional(),
    sortOrder: z.enum(['asc', 'desc']).optional(),
  }).strict(),
});

const adminReportsQuerySchema = z.object({
  query: z.object({

    category: z.nativeEnum(ReportCategory).optional(),
    severity: z.nativeEnum(ReportSeverity).optional(),
    status: z.nativeEnum(ReportStatus).optional(),
    userId: z.string().uuid().optional(),
    page: z
      .string()
      .trim()
      .regex(/^[1-9]\d*$/, 'page must be a positive integer')
      .optional(),
    limit: z
      .string()
      .trim()
      .regex(/^[1-9]\d*$/, 'limit must be a positive integer between 1 and 100')
      .refine((val) => Number(val) >= 1 && Number(val) <= 100, 'limit must be between 1 and 100')
      .optional(),
  }).strict(),
});

const logsQuerySchema = z.object({
  query: z.object({

      .string()
      .trim()
      .regex(/^[1-9]\d*$/, 'page must be a positive integer')
      .optional(),
    limit: z
      .string()
      .trim()
      .regex(/^[1-9]\d*$/, 'limit must be a positive integer between 1 and 100')
      .refine((val) => Number(val) >= 1 && Number(val) <= 100, 'limit must be between 1 and 100')
      .optional(),
    action: z.nativeEnum(ModerationAction).optional(),
  }).strict(),
});

const trendsQuerySchema = z.object({
  query: z.object({}).strict(),
});

const verifyReportSchema = z.object({
  params: z.object({
    id: z.string().uuid({ message: 'Valid UUID is required' }),
  }).passthrough(),
  body: z.object({
    reason: z

      .min(3, { message: 'Reason must be at least 3 characters' })
      .max(500, { message: 'Reason cannot exceed 500 characters' })
      .optional(),
  }).strict().optional(),
});

const reclassifyReportSchema = z.object({
  params: z.object({
    id: z.string().uuid({ message: 'Valid UUID is required' }),
  }).passthrough(),
  body: z
    .object({
      category: z.nativeEnum(ReportCategory).optional(),
      severity: z.nativeEnum(ReportSeverity).optional(),
      reason: z.string().max(500).optional(),

      message: 'At least one of category or severity must be provided',
    }),
});

// All routes require authentication and ADMIN role
router.use(requireAuth, requireRole(['ADMIN']));

router.get('/users', validateRequest(usersQuerySchema), getUsersHandler);
router.post('/users/:id/ban', validateRequest(userBanReasonSchema), banUserHandler);
router.post('/users/:id/unban', validateRequest(userBanReasonSchema), unbanUserHandler);

router.post('/reports/:id/purge', validateRequest(reasonSchema), purgeReportHandler);
router.patch('/reports/:id/verify', validateRequest(verifyReportSchema), async (req: Request, res: Response, next) => {

  } catch (err) {
    next(err);

});

router.get('/verifications', getVerificationsHandler);
router.post('/verifications/:id/approve', validateRequest(approveSchema), approveVerificationHandler);
router.post('/verifications/:id/reject', validateRequest(reasonSchema), rejectVerificationHandler);
router.post('/news/crawl', triggerNewsCrawlHandler);
router.get('/crawler-metrics', (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  const telemetry = newsObservabilityService.getTelemetrySummary();
  return successResponse(res, telemetry, 200);
});

export default router;
```

### What This Code Does
This file declares media upload endpoints under /media.
It binds routes to request pre-signed upload URLs and upload incident evidence attachments.
It applies rate limits and file size validation to prevent storage resource abuse.

```typescript
import { Router, Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { requireAuth } from '../middleware/requireAuth';
import { validateRequest } from '../middleware/validateRequest';
import { verifyStorageWebhookSecret } from '../middleware/verifyWebhookSecret';
import {
  getPresignedUrlHandler,
  confirmMediaUploadHandler,
  mockUploadMediaHandler,
  handleStorageWebhook,
} from '../controllers/mediaController';
import {
  ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES,
  MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES,
  resolveTrustedReportMedia,
} from '../services/storageService';

const router = Router();

// Middleware to explicitly reject raw multipart/form-data uploads
const rejectMultipart = (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
  const contentType = req.headers['content-type'] || '';
  if (contentType.includes('multipart/form-data')) {
    return res.status(415).json({
      success: false,
      error: {
        code: 'UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE',
        message:
          'Direct multipart/form-data uploads are strictly disallowed on this server to preserve memory. Request a presigned URL via GET /api/v1/media/presigned-url and upload directly to cloud storage.',
      },
    });
  }
  next();
};

router.use(rejectMultipart);

// Validation Schemas
const presignedUrlSchema = z.object({
  query: z.object({
    reportId: z.string().uuid(),
    fileType: z.enum(ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES),
    fileSize: z.string().refine((val) => {
      const num = Number(val);
      return !isNaN(num) && num > 0 && num <= MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES;
    }, `fileSize must be a positive integer up to ${MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES} bytes (5MB)`),
  }).passthrough(),
});

const confirmMediaSchema = z.object({
  body: z
    .object({
      reportId: z.string().uuid(),
      originalUrl: z.string().url().optional(),
      fileKey: z.string().min(1).optional(),
    })
    .superRefine((data, ctx) => {
      if (!data.originalUrl && !data.fileKey) {
        ctx.addIssue({
          code: 'custom',
          message: 'Either originalUrl or fileKey must be provided',
        });
        return;
      }

      if (!z.string().uuid().safeParse(data.reportId).success) {
        return;
      }

      try {
        resolveTrustedReportMedia(data);
      } catch (err: any) {
        ctx.addIssue({
          code: 'custom',
          path: data.originalUrl ? ['originalUrl'] : ['fileKey'],
          message: err?.message || 'Untrusted or invalid media storage location',
        });
      }
    }),
});

const webhookRecordSchema = z.object({
  eventName: z.string().optional(),
  bucket_id: z.string().optional(),
  name: z.string().optional(),
  s3: z.object({
    bucket: z.object({
      name: z.string().optional(),
    }).passthrough().optional(),
    object: z.object({
      key: z.string().optional(),
    }).passthrough().optional(),
  }).passthrough().optional(),
}).passthrough();

const storageWebhookSchema = z.object({
  body: z.object({
    type: z.string().optional(),
    key: z.string().min(1).optional(),
    Records: z.array(webhookRecordSchema).optional(),
    record: webhookRecordSchema.optional(),
  }).passthrough().refine(
    (data) => Array.isArray(data.Records) || Boolean(data.record) || typeof data.key === 'string',
    { message: 'Webhook payload must include Records, record, or key' }
  ),
});

const mockUploadSchema = z.object({
  body: z
    .object({
      reportId: z.string().uuid(),
      imageDataUrl: z.string().min(1),
    })
    .strict(),
});

// Endpoints
router.get('/presigned-url', requireAuth, validateRequest(presignedUrlSchema), getPresignedUrlHandler);
router.post('/confirm', requireAuth, validateRequest(confirmMediaSchema), confirmMediaUploadHandler);
router.post('/mock-upload', requireAuth, validateRequest(mockUploadSchema), mockUploadMediaHandler);
router.post('/webhook', verifyStorageWebhookSecret, validateRequest(storageWebhookSchema), handleStorageWebhook);

export default router;
```

```typescript
import { Router, Request, Response } from 'express';
import { triggerNewsCrawler } from '../jobs/newsCrawlerJob';
import { cronNewsCrawlRateLimiter } from '../middleware/rateLimiter';
import { verifyCronSecret } from '../middleware/verifyWebhookSecret';
import { successResponse, errorResponse } from '../utils/responseFormatter';
import { newsObservabilityService } from '../services/newsObservabilityService';

const router = Router();

/**
 * Endpoint called by Vercel Cron, external monitoring heartbeats, or admin triggers
 * to run the news crawler on-demand.
 * Wakes up sleeping server instances and executes fresh news ingestion.
 */
const handleNewsCrawl = async (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    console.log('[Cron Route] 🌐 Received automated news crawl request...');
    const result = await triggerNewsCrawler();

    return successResponse(
      res,
      {
        message: 'News crawler executed successfully',
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        ...result,
      },
      200
    );
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('[Cron Route] ❌ News crawl execution failed:', error);
    return errorResponse(res, error.message || 'News crawler failed', 500);
  }
};

router
  .route('/news-crawl')
  .get(verifyCronSecret, cronNewsCrawlRateLimiter, handleNewsCrawl)
  .post(verifyCronSecret, cronNewsCrawlRateLimiter, handleNewsCrawl);

/**
 * Observability endpoint to inspect crawler telemetry and feed health metrics.
 */
router.get('/crawler-metrics', verifyCronSecret, (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  const telemetry = newsObservabilityService.getTelemetrySummary();
  return successResponse(res, telemetry, 200);
});

export default router;
```

```typescript
      message: 'Database connection successful',

        status: 'UP',
        database: 'connected',
```

## [File 60] `apps/api/src/jobs/newsCrawlerJob.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/api/src/jobs/newsCrawlerJob.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 86  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This background job executes automated news crawling on a recurring schedule (default every 10 minutes).
It uses a mutex lock to prevent overlapping runs and ingests recent public safety news across Bangladesh.
It also schedules a cold-start crawl shortly after server boot to ensure fresh news upon container wake.

```typescript
import cron from 'node-cron';
import { crawlAllNewsFeeds, FeedConfig, PUBLIC_NEWS_FEEDS } from '../services/newsCrawlerService';

let isCrawling = false;
let customFeeds: FeedConfig[] | null = null;

export const isCrawlerBusy = (): boolean => isCrawling;
export const resetCrawlerMutex = (): void => {
  isCrawling = false;
};
export const setCustomCrawlerFeeds = (feeds: FeedConfig[] | null): void => {
  customFeeds = feeds;
};

/**
 * Triggers the news crawler process with concurrency mutex protection.
 */
export const triggerNewsCrawler = async (feeds?: FeedConfig[]) => {
  if (isCrawling) {
    console.warn('[News Crawler Job] Crawler already in progress. Skipping duplicate run.');
    return { status: 'in_progress', ingested: 0 };
  }

  isCrawling = true;
  console.log('\n[News Crawler Job] 🌐 Starting automated RSS news crawl for Bangladesh public safety...');

  try {
    const targetFeeds = feeds || customFeeds || PUBLIC_NEWS_FEEDS;
    const result = await crawlAllNewsFeeds(targetFeeds);
    console.log(
      `[News Crawler Job] ✅ Ingestion complete: ${result.totalIngested} new incidents added, ${result.totalVerifiedMatches} citizen reports cross-verified, ${result.totalSkipped} skipped across ${result.feedsChecked} feeds.\n`
    );
    return { status: 'success', ...result };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[News Crawler Job] ❌ News crawler failed with error:', error);
    throw error;
  } finally {
    isCrawling = false;
  }
};

/**
 * Executes a cold-start background crawl 10 seconds after server boot.
 * This recovers immediately from Render container sleep / spin-downs so
 * incoming traffic always sees fresh news without waiting for the next cron tick.
 */
export const scheduleStartupCrawl = () => {
  setTimeout(async () => {
    try {
      console.log('[News Crawler] 🚀 Executing initial startup news crawl check...');
      await triggerNewsCrawler();
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.warn('[News Crawler] Startup crawl warning:', err.message);
    }
  }, 10000);
};

export const DEFAULT_CRAWLER_SCHEDULE = '*/10 * * * *';

/**
 * Initializes the automated news crawler cron job.
 * Default schedule: Every 10 minutes (e.g. 'star/10 * * * *').
 */
export const initNewsCrawlerCron = (scheduleExpression: string = DEFAULT_CRAWLER_SCHEDULE) => {
  const task = cron.schedule(scheduleExpression, async () => {
    try {
      await triggerNewsCrawler();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[News Crawler Cron] Unhandled error during scheduled crawl:', err);
    }
  });

  console.log(`[News Crawler Cron] Scheduled automatically with expression: "${scheduleExpression}"`);

  // Run initial crawl on server boot/wake
  scheduleStartupCrawl();

  return {
    task,
    stop: () => {
      console.log('[News Crawler Cron] Stopping cron task...');
      task.stop();
    },
  };
};
```

> **Path:** `apps/api/src/jobs/notificationWorker.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 101

### What This Code Does
This worker processes and dispatches queued push notifications for active hazard alerts.
It queries users whose registered geofence polygons intersect newly reported incident coordinates.
It formats Web Push payloads and delivers notifications to subscribers via the Web Push Protocol.

```typescript
import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { findIntersectingAlertZones } from '../services/alertZoneService';
import { emitUserAlert } from '../sockets';

export const notificationEvents = new EventEmitter();

export interface ReportAlertInput {
  id: string;
  category: string;
  severity: string;
  latitude: number;
  longitude: number;
  description?: string | null;
}

export interface GeofenceAlertPayload {
  type: 'GEOFENCE_ALERT';
  title: string;
  body: string;
  data: {
    reportId: string;
    category: string;
    severity: string;
    latitude: number;
    longitude: number;
    zones: string[];
  };
  timestamp: string;
}

/**
 * Process geofenced notification matching for a newly created report.
 * Finds all active UserAlertZone polygons intersecting with the report's coordinates.
 */
export const processReportNotification = async (
  report: ReportAlertInput
): Promise<{ matchedUsers: number; alerts: Record<string, GeofenceAlertPayload> }> => {
  // 1. PostGIS ST_Intersects spatial check
  const matchingZones = await findIntersectingAlertZones(report.latitude, report.longitude);

  if (!matchingZones || matchingZones.length === 0) {
    return { matchedUsers: 0, alerts: {} };
  }

  // 2. Group intersecting zones by userId to avoid multiple alerts for overlapping zones
  const userZoneMap = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const match of matchingZones) {
    const zones = userZoneMap.get(match.userId) || [];
    zones.push(match.zoneName);
    userZoneMap.set(match.userId, zones);
  }

  const alerts: Record<string, GeofenceAlertPayload> = {};

  // 3. Dispatch targeted alerts
  for (const [userId, zoneNames] of userZoneMap.entries()) {
    const alertPayload: GeofenceAlertPayload = {
      type: 'GEOFENCE_ALERT',
      title: '🚨 Urgent Safety Alert: Hazard in Your Monitored Zone',
      body: `A ${report.severity} severity ${report.category} was reported inside "${zoneNames.join(', ')}". Stay vigilant.`,
      data: {
        reportId: report.id,
        category: report.category,
        severity: report.severity,
        latitude: report.latitude,
        longitude: report.longitude,
        zones: zoneNames,
      },
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    alerts[userId] = alertPayload;

    // A. Targeted real-time WebSocket alert to user's room
    emitUserAlert(userId, alertPayload);

    // B. Mock Web Push Notification payload
    console.log(
      `[Notification Worker] 📲 Web Push dispatched to user ${userId} for zones: [${zoneNames.join(', ')}]`
    );

    // Emit internal event for test assertion hooks
    notificationEvents.emit('alert_dispatched', { userId, payload: alertPayload });
  }

  return { matchedUsers: userZoneMap.size, alerts };
};

/**
 * Enqueue an asynchronous notification check without blocking the calling HTTP request loop.
 */
export const enqueueReportNotification = (report: ReportAlertInput): void => {
  setImmediate(async () => {
    try {
      await processReportNotification(report);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Notification Worker] Error executing asynchronous alert check:', error);
    }
  });
};
```

## [File 62] `apps/api/src/jobs/timeDecayJob.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/api/src/jobs/timeDecayJob.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 255  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This background worker enforces the temporal decay lifecycle of active incident reports.
It runs periodically to identify reports whose expiresAt timestamp has passed and marks them inactive.
This automated pruning ensures that outdated, temporary hazards do not linger on the live radar.

```typescript
import cron from 'node-cron';
import { prisma } from '../db/prisma';
import { emitReportExpired } from '../sockets';
import { broadcastPlatformStats } from '../services/statsService';

let isPurging = false;

/**
 * Isolated service function to purge expired reports.
 * Employs a mutex lock to avoid overlapping runs.
 */
export const purgeExpiredReports = async (now: Date = new Date()): Promise<number> => {
  if (isPurging) {
    console.warn('[Time-Decay Job] Previous purge still in progress. Skipping tick.');
    return 0;
  }

  isPurging = true;
  try {
    // 1. Query active reports whose expiration has passed
    const expiredReports = await prisma.report.findMany({
      where: {
        status: 'ACTIVE',
        expiresAt: { lt: now }
      },
      select: { id: true }
    });

    if (expiredReports.length === 0) {
      return 0;
    }

    const expiredIds = expiredReports.map((r) => r.id);

    // 2. Atomically flip status to PURGED
    await prisma.report.updateMany({
      where: {
        id: { in: expiredIds }
      },
      data: {
        status: 'PURGED'
      }
    });

    // 3. Emit real-time event to connected map clients
    emitReportExpired({
      reportIds: expiredIds,
      reason: 'TIME_DECAY_EXPIRED'
    });

    void broadcastPlatformStats();

    return expiredIds.length;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[Time-Decay Job] Database error during purge:', error);
    throw error;
  } finally {
    isPurging = false;
  }
};

let isHardCleaning = false;

export interface RetentionCleanupResult {
  deletedReports: number;
  deletedVotes: number;
  deletedUpdates: number;
  deletedMedia: number;
  updatedModerationLogs: number;
  deletedNews: number;
  deletedTokens: number;
}

/**
 * Permanently removes stale PURGED reports, orphan news articles, and expired auth tokens
 * older than retentionDays (default: 30 days) to enforce Supabase free tier (500 MB) quota protection.
 * Cascades foreign key dependencies safely inside an isolated transaction.
 */
export const hardDeleteStaleRetentionData = async (
  retentionDays: number = 30,
  now: Date = new Date()
): Promise<RetentionCleanupResult> => {
  if (isHardCleaning) {
    console.warn('[Retention Cleanup] Previous hard-delete cleanup still running. Skipping tick.');
    return {
      deletedReports: 0,
      deletedVotes: 0,
      deletedUpdates: 0,
      deletedMedia: 0,
      updatedModerationLogs: 0,
      deletedNews: 0,
      deletedTokens: 0,
    };
  }

  isHardCleaning = true;
  try {
    const thresholdDate = new Date(now.getTime() - retentionDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

    // 1. Identify PURGED reports older than the retention threshold
    const staleReports = await prisma.report.findMany({
      where: {
        status: 'PURGED',
        createdAt: { lt: thresholdDate },
      },
      select: { id: true },
      take: 500, // Batch limit to keep transaction lock window small
    });

    const staleReportIds = staleReports.map((r) => r.id);

    let deletedVotes = 0;
    let deletedUpdates = 0;
    let deletedMedia = 0;
    let updatedModerationLogs = 0;
    let deletedNews = 0;
    let deletedReports = 0;

    if (staleReportIds.length > 0) {
      // Execute cascading foreign-key deletion in a transaction
      await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
        // Child 1: Votes
        const vRes = await tx.vote.deleteMany({
          where: { reportId: { in: staleReportIds } },
        });
        deletedVotes = vRes.count;

        // Child 2: Report Updates
        const uRes = await tx.reportUpdate.deleteMany({
          where: { reportId: { in: staleReportIds } },
        });
        deletedUpdates = uRes.count;

        // Child 3: Report Media
        const mRes = await tx.reportMedia.deleteMany({
          where: { reportId: { in: staleReportIds } },
        });
        deletedMedia = mRes.count;

        // Child 4: Moderation Logs referencing these reports
        const mlRes = await tx.moderationLog.updateMany({
          where: { targetReportId: { in: staleReportIds } },
          data: { targetReportId: null },
        });
        updatedModerationLogs = mlRes.count;

        // Child 5: Linked NewsArticles
        const nRes = await tx.newsArticle.deleteMany({
          where: { reportId: { in: staleReportIds } },
        });
        deletedNews = nRes.count;

        // Parent: Delete stale Reports
        const rRes = await tx.report.deleteMany({
          where: { id: { in: staleReportIds } },
        });
        deletedReports = rRes.count;
      });
    }

    // 2. Delete any unlinked/orphan NewsArticles published prior to threshold
    const orphanNewsRes = await prisma.newsArticle.deleteMany({
      where: {
        publishedAt: { lt: thresholdDate },
      },
    });
    deletedNews += orphanNewsRes.count;

    // 3. Clean up expired or revoked refresh tokens (prevents auth table bloat)
    const tokenRes = await prisma.refreshToken.deleteMany({
      where: {
        OR: [
          { expiresAt: { lt: now } },
          { isRevoked: true },
        ],
      },
    });

    const result: RetentionCleanupResult = {
      deletedReports,
      deletedVotes,
      deletedUpdates,
      deletedMedia,
      updatedModerationLogs,
      deletedNews,
      deletedTokens: tokenRes.count,
    };

    if (deletedReports > 0 || deletedNews > 0 || tokenRes.count > 0) {
      console.log(
        `[Retention Cleanup] 🧹 Reclaimed database storage: ` +
        `Deleted ${deletedReports} stale reports (with ${deletedVotes} votes, ${deletedUpdates} updates, ${deletedMedia} media, ${updatedModerationLogs} logs unlinked), ` +
        `${deletedNews} old news articles, and ${tokenRes.count} expired refresh tokens.`
      );
    }

    return result;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[Retention Cleanup] Database error during hard-delete cleanup:', error);
    throw error;
  } finally {
    isHardCleaning = false;
  }
};

/**
 * Initialize time-decay cron schedule (default: every 5 minutes)
 */
export const initTimeDecayCron = (cronExpression = '*/5 * * * *') => {
  console.log(`[Time-Decay Job] Scheduled with expression: "${cronExpression}"`);

  const task = cron.schedule(cronExpression, async () => {
    try {
      const count = await purgeExpiredReports();
      if (count > 0) {
        console.log(`[Time-Decay Job] Successfully purged ${count} expired report(s).`);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[Time-Decay Job] Unhandled error during scheduled run:', err);
    }
  });

  return {
    task,
    stop: () => {
      console.log('[Time-Decay Job] Stopping cron task...');
      task.stop();
    }
  };
};

/**
 * Initializes the daily retention cleanup cron job.
 * Default schedule: Daily at 3:00 AM UTC+6 ('0 3 * * *')
 */
export const initDailyRetentionCron = (cronExpression = '0 3 * * *') => {
  console.log(`[Retention Job] Scheduled daily rolling cleanup with expression: "${cronExpression}"`);

  const task = cron.schedule(cronExpression, async () => {
    try {
      await hardDeleteStaleRetentionData(30);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[Retention Job] Unhandled error during scheduled retention cleanup:', err);
    }
  });

  return {
    task,
    stop: () => {
      console.log('[Retention Job] Stopping daily retention cleanup cron task...');
      task.stop();
    },
  };
};
```

## [File 63] `apps/api/src/scripts/seedAdmin.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/api/src/scripts/seedAdmin.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 109  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This database script provisions and seeds the initial administrator account in PostgreSQL.
It reads ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD from environment variables and generates secure bcrypt password hashes.
It guarantees that at least one verified administrator exists for moderation and dashboard access.

```typescript
import dotenv from 'dotenv';
dotenv.config();

import bcrypt from 'bcrypt';
import { prisma } from '../db/prisma';

async function seedAdmin() {
  const adminEmail = process.env.ADMIN_EMAIL?.trim().toLowerCase();
  const envPasswordHash = process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH?.trim();
  const envPassword = process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD;

  if (!adminEmail) {
    throw new Error('[Seed Admin] ADMIN_EMAIL environment variable is required.');
  }

  let passwordHash: string;
  if (envPasswordHash) {
    if (!envPasswordHash.startsWith('$2')) {
      throw new Error('[Seed Admin] ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH must be a valid bcrypt hash.');
    }
    passwordHash = envPasswordHash;
  } else {
    if (!envPassword || envPassword.length < 8) {
      throw new Error(
        '[Seed Admin] Provide ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH or an explicit ADMIN_PASSWORD of at least 8 characters.'
      );
    }
    if (envPassword === 'AdminSafety@2026') {
      throw new Error('[Seed Admin] Refusing to seed the insecure legacy default password.');
    }
    passwordHash = await bcrypt.hash(envPassword, 12);
  }

  console.log(`[Seed Admin] Starting administrator account setup for: ${adminEmail}`);

  const existingByEmail = await prisma.user.findFirst({
    where: {
      email: {
        equals: adminEmail,
        mode: 'insensitive',
      },
    },
  });

  if (existingByEmail) {
    const updated = await prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: existingByEmail.id },
      data: {
        role: 'ADMIN',
        passwordHash,
        isVerified: true,
        trustScore: 100,
        isBanned: false,
      },
    });
    console.log(`[Seed Admin] Successfully updated existing user (${updated.id}) to ADMIN with password credentials.`);
  } else {
    const defaultAnonId = `admin-master-${Date.now().toString(36)}`;
    const created = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        email: adminEmail,
        anonymousId: defaultAnonId,
        passwordHash,
        role: 'ADMIN',
        isVerified: true,
        trustScore: 100,
      },
    });
    console.log(`[Seed Admin] Successfully created new administrator account (${created.id}) with email: ${adminEmail}`);
  }

  // Double check credentials
  const verifiedUser = await prisma.user.findFirst({
    where: {
      email: {
        equals: adminEmail,
        mode: 'insensitive',
      },
    },
  });

  if (!verifiedUser || !verifiedUser.passwordHash) {
    throw new Error('Failed to verify seeded administrator in database.');
  }

  if (envPasswordHash) {
    if (verifiedUser.passwordHash !== passwordHash || verifiedUser.role !== 'ADMIN') {
      throw new Error('Seeded password hash verification failed!');
    }
  } else if (envPassword) {
    const isValid = await bcrypt.compare(envPassword, verifiedUser.passwordHash);
    if (!isValid) {
      throw new Error('Password hash verification failed!');
    }
  }

  console.log(`[Seed Admin] Verification complete: Role=${verifiedUser.role}, Email=${verifiedUser.email}, isVerified=${verifiedUser.isVerified}`);
}

seedAdmin()
  .catch((err) => {
    console.error('[Seed Admin] Error seeding administrator:', err);
    process.exit(1);
  })
  .finally(async () => {
    await prisma.$disconnect();
    console.log('[Seed Admin] Database connection closed.');
  });
```
