## [File 65] `apps/web/store/useAuthStore.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/web/store/useAuthStore.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 190  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This Zustand store manages client-side authentication state, user identity, and session tokens.
It coordinates silent anonymous device authentication on initial visit and administrator credential login.
It synchronizes authentication cookies, stores user trust metrics, and manages WebSocket authentication tokens.

```typescript
import { create } from "zustand";
import { apiFetch, ApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import { getSocket, setSocketAuthToken } from "@/lib/socket";

export interface AuthUser {
  id: string;
  email?: string;
  role: "USER" | "VERIFIED_RESPONDER" | "ADMIN";
  trustScore: number;
  isVerified: boolean;
  isBanned?: boolean;
  createdAt?: string;
  _count?: {
    reports: number;
    votes: number;
    alertZones: number;
  };
  verifications?: {
    id: string;
    type: 'PHONE_OTP' | 'NID_DOCUMENT';
    status: 'PENDING' | 'APPROVED' | 'REJECTED';
    createdAt: string;
  }[];
}

interface AuthState {
  user: AuthUser | null;
  deviceId: string | null;
  isLoading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  initAuth: () => Promise<AuthUser | null>;
  loginAdminWithPassword: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<AuthUser>;
  logout: () => Promise<void>;
  resetAnonymousIdentity: () => Promise<AuthUser | null>;
  refreshProfile: () => Promise<void>;
}

const DEVICE_ID_KEY = "bd_safety_device_id";
let initAuthPromise: Promise<AuthUser | null> | null = null;

function getOrCreateDeviceId(): string {
  let deviceId = localStorage.getItem(DEVICE_ID_KEY);
  if (!deviceId) {
    deviceId =
      typeof crypto !== "undefined" && crypto.randomUUID
        ? crypto.randomUUID()
        : `anon-dev-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9)}`;
    localStorage.setItem(DEVICE_ID_KEY, deviceId);
  }
  return deviceId;
}

export const useAuthStore = create<AuthState>((set, get) => ({
  user: null,
  deviceId: null,
  isLoading: true,
  error: null,

  initAuth: async () => {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;

    if (!initAuthPromise) {
      initAuthPromise = (async () => {
        set({ isLoading: true, error: null });

        try {
          const existingDeviceId = localStorage.getItem(DEVICE_ID_KEY);

          // Probe existing session first so ADMIN, VERIFIED_RESPONDER, and USER cookies are preserved
          try {
            const existingProfile = await apiFetch<AuthUser>("/users/me");
            set({
              user: existingProfile,
              deviceId: existingDeviceId,
              isLoading: false,
            });
            getSocket();
            return existingProfile;
          } catch (probeErr: any) {
            // Only mint/re-auth anonymous device identity when session is unauthenticated (401)
            if (!(probeErr instanceof ApiError && probeErr.statusCode === 401)) {
              throw probeErr;
            }
          }

          const deviceId = getOrCreateDeviceId();
          set({ deviceId });

          // Silent device authentication for unauthenticated guests
          const deviceAuth = await apiFetch<{
            user?: { id: string; role: string };
            socketToken?: string;
          }>("/auth/device", {
            method: "POST",
            body: JSON.stringify({ anonymousId: deviceId }),
          });

          if (deviceAuth?.socketToken) {
            setSocketAuthToken(deviceAuth.socketToken);
          }

          // Retrieve full user profile
          const profile = await apiFetch<AuthUser>("/users/me");

          set({ user: profile, isLoading: false });

          // Initialize Socket connection now that cookies & scoped socketToken are set
          getSocket();

          return profile;
        } catch (err: any) {
          console.warn("[Auth] Silent device authentication fallback notice:", err.message);
          set({ user: null, isLoading: false, error: err.message });
          return null;
        } finally {
          initAuthPromise = null;
        }
      })();
    }

    return initAuthPromise;
  },

  loginAdminWithPassword: async (email: string, password: string) => {
    set({ isLoading: true, error: null });
    try {
      const loginData = await apiFetch<{ socketToken?: string }>("/auth/login", {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({ email, password }),
      });

      const profile = await apiFetch<AuthUser>("/users/me");

      if (profile.role !== "ADMIN") {
        await apiFetch("/auth/logout", {
          method: "POST",
          skipAuthRefresh: true,
        }).catch(() => {});
        getSocket()?.disconnect();
        setSocketAuthToken(null);
        set({ user: null });
        throw new Error("This account does not have administrator privileges.");
      }

      set({ user: profile, isLoading: false });

      // Refresh socket connection with admin authorization
      setSocketAuthToken(loginData?.socketToken ?? null);
      getSocket();

      return profile;
    } catch (err: any) {
      set({ isLoading: false, error: err.message });
      throw err;
    }
  },

  refreshProfile: async () => {
    try {
      const profile = await apiFetch<AuthUser>("/users/me");
      set({ user: profile });
    } catch {
      // Ignore background refresh errors
    }
  },

  logout: async () => {
    try {
      await apiFetch("/auth/logout", {
        method: "POST",
        skipAuthRefresh: true,
      });
    } catch {
      // Ignore logout errors
    }

    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      localStorage.removeItem(DEVICE_ID_KEY);
    }
    getSocket()?.disconnect();
    setSocketAuthToken(null);
    set({ user: null, deviceId: null, isLoading: false, error: null });
  },

  resetAnonymousIdentity: async () => {
    await get().logout();
    return await get().initAuth();
  },
}));
```

## [File 66] `apps/web/store/useIncidentStore.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/web/store/useIncidentStore.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 384  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This reactive Zustand store manages all incident data displayed across the frontend application.
It stores active reports, applied category and severity filters, and real-time report additions.
It listens to WebSocket events to dynamically insert new reports and remove purged hazards without page reloads.

```typescript
import { create } from "zustand";
import {
  DangerIncident,
  SOCKET_EVENTS,
  getSocketReportId,
  type SafeZoneItem,
  type ReportVotedPayload,
  type ReportPurgedPayload,
  type ReportResolvedPayload,
  type ReportExpiredPayload,
  type ReportVerifiedPayload,
} from "@repo/shared";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { getSocket, joinMapBounds } from "@/lib/socket";
import { cleanIncidentTitle } from "@/lib/incidentUtils";

export type { SafeZoneItem };

const inFlightVotes = new Set<string>();

interface IncidentState {
  incidents: DangerIncident[];
  safeZones: SafeZoneItem[];
  isLoading: boolean;
  isUpdatingBounds: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  activeBounds: { minLat: number; maxLat: number; minLng: number; maxLng: number } | null;
  setIncidents: (incidents: DangerIncident[]) => void;
  addIncident: (incident: DangerIncident) => void;
  fetchAllIncidents: () => Promise<void>;
  fetchIncidentsInBounds: (bounds: { minLat: number; maxLat: number; minLng: number; maxLng: number }) => Promise<void>;
  fetchSafeZones: () => Promise<void>;
  voteIncident: (reportId: string, voteType: 1 | -1) => Promise<{ upvotes: number; downvotes: number }>;
  addContextUpdate: (reportId: string, content: string) => Promise<any>;
  initSocketListeners: () => void;
}

const mapBackendToFrontendIncident = (r: any): DangerIncident => {
  const cleanTitle = cleanIncidentTitle(r.description ? r.description.split("\n")[0] : `${r.category} Incident`);
  const cleanDesc = r.description ? cleanIncidentTitle(r.description) : "No description provided.";

  let status: any = "unverified";
  if (r.verificationStage === 'ADMIN_VERIFIED') {
    status = "authority_verified";
  } else if (
    r.verificationStage === 'PRESS_CORROBORATED' ||
    r.verificationStage === 'CORROBORATED' ||
    r.verificationStage === 'COMMUNITY_CONFIRMED'
  ) {
    status = "community_confirmed";
  } else if (r.status === 'RESOLVED') {
    status = "resolved";
  } else {
    status = "unverified";
  }

  return {
    id: r.id,
    title: cleanTitle,
    description: cleanDesc,
    category: r.category,
    severity: r.severity,
    coordinates: {
      lat: r.latitude,
      lng: r.longitude,
    },
    locationName: r.upazila
      ? `${r.upazila}, ${r.district || ''}`.replace(/,\s*$/, '')
      : (r.district || (r.sourceName ? r.sourceName : "Reported Hazard Zone")),
    district: r.district,
    upazila: r.upazila,
    locationPrecision: r.locationPrecision || 'EXACT',
    threatStatus: r.threatStatus || 'ACTIVE',
    timestamp: r.createdAt ? new Date(r.createdAt).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),
    upvotes: r.upvotes || 0,
    downvotes: r.downvotes || 0,
    status,
    reportedBy: r.sourceName ? `Press: ${r.sourceName}` : "Citizen Report",
    verifiedCount: r.upvotes || 0,
    sourceUrl: r.sourceUrl,
    sourceName: r.sourceName,
    verificationStage: r.verificationStage || (r.sourceUrl ? "SINGLE_SOURCE_PRESS" : "INGESTED"),
    citations: Array.isArray(r.citations)
      ? r.citations
      : r.sourceUrl
        ? [{ sourceName: r.sourceName || 'Press', sourceUrl: r.sourceUrl, title: cleanTitle }]
        : [],
    fuzzedRadiusMeters: r.fuzzedRadiusMeters || 150,
    isGpsVerified: Boolean(r.isGpsVerified),
  };
};

export const useIncidentStore = create<IncidentState>((set, get) => ({
  incidents: [],
  safeZones: [],
  isLoading: true,
  isUpdatingBounds: false,
  error: null,
  activeBounds: null,

  setIncidents: (incidents) => set({ incidents }),

  addIncident: (incident) =>
    set((state) => ({
      incidents: [incident, ...state.incidents.filter((i) => i.id !== incident.id)],
    })),

  fetchAllIncidents: async () => {
    try {
      set({ isLoading: true, error: null });
      // Fetch nationwide incidents across Bangladesh
      const query = new URLSearchParams({
        minLat: "20.0",
        maxLat: "27.5",
        minLng: "88.0",
        maxLng: "93.5",
      });
      const reports = await apiFetch<any[]>(`/reports?${query.toString()}`);
      if (Array.isArray(reports)) {
        const mapped = reports.map(mapBackendToFrontendIncident);
        const existingMap = new Map(get().incidents.map((i) => [i.id, i]));
        mapped.forEach((inc) => existingMap.set(inc.id, inc));
        set({ incidents: Array.from(existingMap.values()), isLoading: false, error: null });
      } else {
        set({ isLoading: false, error: null });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("[Incidents] Nationwide fetch failed:", err.message);
      set({ isLoading: false });
    }
  },

  fetchIncidentsInBounds: async (bounds) => {
    const hasExistingData = get().incidents.length > 0;
    if (hasExistingData) {
      set({ isUpdatingBounds: true, error: null, activeBounds: bounds });
    } else {
      set({ isLoading: true, isUpdatingBounds: true, error: null, activeBounds: bounds });
    }

    try {
      // Update viewport on server for targeted Socket.IO emissions
      joinMapBounds({
        minLat: bounds.minLat,
        maxLat: bounds.maxLat,
        minLng: bounds.minLng,
        maxLng: bounds.maxLng,
      });

      const query = new URLSearchParams({
        minLat: bounds.minLat.toString(),
        maxLat: bounds.maxLat.toString(),
        minLng: bounds.minLng.toString(),
        maxLng: bounds.maxLng.toString(),
      });

      const reports = await apiFetch<any[]>(`/reports?${query.toString()}`);
      if (Array.isArray(reports)) {
        const mapped = reports.map(mapBackendToFrontendIncident);
        // Merge with existing incidents so navigating to one local sector never deletes pins in other districts
        const existingMap = new Map(get().incidents.map((i) => [i.id, i]));
        mapped.forEach((inc) => existingMap.set(inc.id, inc));
        set({ incidents: Array.from(existingMap.values()), isLoading: false, isUpdatingBounds: false, error: null });
      } else {
        set({ isLoading: false, isUpdatingBounds: false, error: null });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("[Incidents] Fetch failed from live database:", err.message);
      // Preserve existing incidents during map movements if background refresh fails
      set({
        isLoading: false,
        isUpdatingBounds: false,
        error: hasExistingData
          ? null
          : (err.message || "Unable to connect to live public safety network."),
      });
    }
  },

  fetchSafeZones: async () => {
    try {
      const zones = await apiFetch<SafeZoneItem[]>("/safe-zones");
      if (Array.isArray(zones)) {
        set({ safeZones: zones });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("[SafeZones] Fetch failed from live database:", err.message);
    }
  },

  voteIncident: async (reportId: string, voteType: 1 | -1) => {
    const existing = get().incidents.find((inc) => inc.id === reportId);
    if (inFlightVotes.has(reportId)) {
      return {
        upvotes: existing?.upvotes ?? 0,
        downvotes: existing?.downvotes ?? 0,
      };
    }

    const previousCounts = existing
      ? {
          upvotes: existing.upvotes,
          downvotes: existing.downvotes,
          verifiedCount: existing.verifiedCount,
        }
      : null;

    inFlightVotes.add(reportId);

    // Optimistic vote tally update
    set((state) => ({
      incidents: state.incidents.map((inc) => {
        if (inc.id === reportId) {
          return {
            ...inc,
            upvotes: voteType === 1 ? inc.upvotes + 1 : inc.upvotes,
            downvotes: voteType === -1 ? inc.downvotes + 1 : inc.downvotes,
            verifiedCount:
              voteType === 1 ? (inc.verifiedCount ?? inc.upvotes) + 1 : inc.verifiedCount,
          };
        }
        return inc;
      }),
    }));

    try {
      const result = await apiFetch<{ upvotes: number; downvotes: number; status: string }>(
        `/reports/${reportId}/vote`,
        {
          method: "POST",
          body: JSON.stringify({ voteType }),
        }
      );

      // Reconcile with exact server vote totals (or remove if threshold purge triggered)
      set((state) => ({
        incidents:
          result.status === "PURGED"
            ? state.incidents.filter((inc) => inc.id !== reportId)
            : state.incidents.map((inc) =>
                inc.id === reportId
                  ? {
                      ...inc,
                      upvotes: result.upvotes,
                      downvotes: result.downvotes,
                      verifiedCount: result.upvotes,
                    }
                  : inc
              ),
      }));

      return result;
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (previousCounts) {
        set((state) => ({
          incidents: state.incidents.map((inc) =>
            inc.id === reportId
              ? {
                  ...inc,
                  upvotes: previousCounts.upvotes,
                  downvotes: previousCounts.downvotes,
                  verifiedCount: previousCounts.verifiedCount,
                }
              : inc
          ),
        }));
      }
      console.error("[Vote] Failed:", err.message);
      throw err;
    } finally {
      inFlightVotes.delete(reportId);
    }
  },

  addContextUpdate: async (reportId: string, content: string) => {
    try {
      const result = await apiFetch(`/reports/${reportId}/updates`, {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({ content }),
      });
      return result;
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("[ContextUpdate] Failed:", err.message);
      throw err;
    }
  },

  initSocketListeners: () => {
    const socket = getSocket();
    if (!socket) return;

    // Listen for new incoming incidents in bounds
    socket.off(SOCKET_EVENTS.NEW_REPORT);
    socket.on(SOCKET_EVENTS.NEW_REPORT, (data: any) => {
      console.log("[Socket.IO] Real-time NEW_REPORT received:", data);
      const newInc = mapBackendToFrontendIncident(data);
      get().addIncident(newInc);
    });

    // Listen for enriched / corroborated incidents (multi-press or coordinate upgrades)
    socket.off(SOCKET_EVENTS.REPORT_ENRICHED);
    socket.on(SOCKET_EVENTS.REPORT_ENRICHED, (data: any) => {
      console.log("[Socket.IO] Real-time REPORT_ENRICHED received:", data);
      const enrichedInc = mapBackendToFrontendIncident(data);
      set((state) => ({
        incidents: state.incidents.some((i) => i.id === enrichedInc.id)
          ? state.incidents.map((i) => (i.id === enrichedInc.id ? enrichedInc : i))
          : [enrichedInc, ...state.incidents],
      }));
    });

    // Listen for real-time vote updates
    socket.off(SOCKET_EVENTS.REPORT_VOTED);
    socket.on(SOCKET_EVENTS.REPORT_VOTED, (data: ReportVotedPayload) => {
      const targetId = getSocketReportId(data);
      if (!targetId) return;
      set((state) => ({
        incidents: state.incidents.map((inc) =>
          inc.id === targetId
            ? { ...inc, upvotes: data.upvotes, downvotes: data.downvotes }
            : inc
        ),
      }));
    });

    // Listen for purged reports (trust engine 5-downvote or admin purge)
    socket.off(SOCKET_EVENTS.REPORT_PURGED);
    socket.on(SOCKET_EVENTS.REPORT_PURGED, (data: ReportPurgedPayload) => {
      const targetId = getSocketReportId(data);
      if (!targetId) return;
      console.log("[Socket.IO] Real-time REPORT_PURGED received:", targetId);
      set((state) => ({
        incidents: state.incidents.filter((inc) => inc.id !== targetId),
      }));
    });

    // Listen for resolved reports (author / responder / admin clearance)
    socket.off(SOCKET_EVENTS.REPORT_RESOLVED);
    socket.on(SOCKET_EVENTS.REPORT_RESOLVED, (data: ReportResolvedPayload) => {
      const resolvedId = getSocketReportId(data);
      if (!resolvedId) return;
      console.log("[Socket.IO] Real-time REPORT_RESOLVED received:", resolvedId);
      set((state) => ({
        incidents: state.incidents.filter((inc) => inc.id !== resolvedId),
      }));
    });

    // Listen for expired reports (time-decay worker)
    socket.off(SOCKET_EVENTS.REPORT_EXPIRED);
    socket.on(SOCKET_EVENTS.REPORT_EXPIRED, (data: ReportExpiredPayload) => {
      const expiredSet = new Set(data.reportIds || []);
      set((state) => ({
        incidents: state.incidents.filter((inc) => !expiredSet.has(inc.id)),
      }));
    });

    // Listen for press cross-verification updates
    socket.off(SOCKET_EVENTS.REPORT_VERIFIED);
    socket.on(SOCKET_EVENTS.REPORT_VERIFIED, (data: ReportVerifiedPayload) => {
      const targetId = getSocketReportId(data);
      if (!targetId) return;
      console.log("[Socket.IO] Real-time REPORT_VERIFIED received:", targetId);
      set((state) => ({
        incidents: state.incidents.map((inc) => {
          if (inc.id === targetId) {
            const pressTag = `[Verified by Press: ${data.verifiedBy}]`;
            const updatedDesc = inc.description.includes(pressTag)
              ? inc.description
              : `${inc.description} ${pressTag}`;
            return {
              ...inc,
              description: updatedDesc,
              status: "authority_verified",
              sourceName: data.verifiedBy,
              sourceUrl: data.sourceUrl || inc.sourceUrl,
            };
          }
          return inc;
        }),
      }));
    });
  },
}));
```

## [File 67] `apps/web/store/useMapStore.ts`

### What This Code Does
This Zustand store coordinates map viewport state, user coordinates, active zoom level, and selected tile layers.
It manages GPS tracking accuracy markers, calibration modal visibility, and active search target coordinates.
It ensures synchronized map navigation between search bars, location buttons, and interactive pins.

```typescript
export interface TargetCommand {
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
  zoom?: number;
  id: number;
}

import { create } from 'zustand';
import {
  MapMode,
  Coordinates,
  GeolocationAccuracyTier,
  classifyGeolocationAccuracy,
  sanitizeAccuracy,
  formatCoordinate,
  isWithinBangladesh,
  isFreshPosition,
} from '@repo/shared';

export type TrackingStatus = 'active' | 'paused' | 'unavailable' | 'stopped';

export interface LiveTrackingState {
  isLiveTracking: boolean;
  trackingStatus: TrackingStatus;
  isFollowingUser: boolean;
  liveWatchId: number | null;
  startLiveTracking: () => Promise<boolean>;
  stopLiveTracking: () => void;
  setIsFollowingUser: (follow: boolean) => void;
  recenterOnUser: () => void;
  setTrackingStatus: (status: TrackingStatus) => void;
  setLiveWatchId: (id: number | null) => void;
}

export type MapTileLayer = 'google_streets' | 'google_hybrid' | 'osm';
export type LocationSource = 'gps' | 'calibrated';
export type AcquisitionStage =
  | 'idle'
  | 'acquiring'
  | 'refining'
  | 'success'
  | 'timeout'
  | 'error';

export interface SavedUserLocation {
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
  accuracy?: number;
  source: LocationSource;
  label?: string;
  updatedAt: number;
}

export interface MapLayerConfig {
  id: MapTileLayer;
  nameEn: string;
  nameBn: string;
  url: string;
  maxZoom: number;
  subdomains: string[];
  attribution: string;
}

export const MAP_LAYERS: Record<MapTileLayer, MapLayerConfig> = {
  google_streets: {
    id: 'google_streets',
    nameEn: 'Google Streets',
    nameBn: 'গুগল স্ট্রিট ম্যাপ',
    url: 'https://mt{s}.google.com/vt/lyrs=m&x={x}&y={y}&z={z}',
    maxZoom: 20,
    subdomains: ['0', '1', '2', '3'],
    attribution: '&copy; Google Maps',
  },
  google_hybrid: {
    id: 'google_hybrid',
    nameEn: 'Satellite Hybrid',
    nameBn: 'স্যাটেলাইট হাইব্রিড',
    url: 'https://mt{s}.google.com/vt/lyrs=y&x={x}&y={y}&z={z}',
    maxZoom: 20,
    subdomains: ['0', '1', '2', '3'],
    attribution: '&copy; Google Maps Satellite',
  },
  osm: {
    id: 'osm',
    nameEn: 'OpenStreetMap',
    nameBn: 'ওপেন-স্ট্রিট-ম্যাপ',
    url: 'https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png',
    maxZoom: 19,
    subdomains: ['a', 'b', 'c'],
    attribution: '&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors',
  },
};

export const STORAGE_KEY_USER_LOCATION = 'danger_zone_user_location';

const defaultLayerEnv =
  (typeof process !== 'undefined' && process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_MAP_DEFAULT_LAYER as MapTileLayer) ||
  'google_streets';

export interface MapState extends LiveTrackingState {
  mode: MapMode;
  center: Coordinates;
  zoom: number;
  activeTileLayer: MapTileLayer;
  userLocation: { lat: number; lng: number } | null;
  userAccuracy: number | null;
  locationSource: LocationSource | null;
  locationLabel: string | null;
  isCalibrationModalOpen: boolean;
  isLowAccuracy: boolean;
  dismissedCalibrationBanner: boolean;
  isSosModalOpen: boolean;
  targetCommand: TargetCommand | null;

  // Progressive Refinement & Accuracy States
  isLocating: boolean;
  acquisitionStage: AcquisitionStage;
  userAccuracyTier: GeolocationAccuracyTier | null;
  locationTimestamp: number | null;
  activeRequestId: number;
  activeWatchId: number | null;
  hasAutoLocated: boolean;

  setMode: (mode: MapMode) => void;
  setCenter: (center: Coordinates, zoom?: number) => void;
  setZoom: (zoom: number) => void;
  flyTo: (coords: Coordinates, zoom?: number) => void;
  setActiveTileLayer: (layer: MapTileLayer) => void;
  setIsLocating: (isLocating: boolean) => void;
  setAcquisitionStage: (stage: AcquisitionStage) => void;
  setActiveWatchId: (id: number | null) => void;
  setHasAutoLocated: (hasAutoLocated: boolean) => void;
  incrementRequestId: () => number;
  setUserLocation: (
    coords: { lat: number; lng: number } | null,
    accuracy?: number | null,
    source?: LocationSource,
    label?: string,
    timestamp?: number | null
  ) => void;
  calibrateUserLocation: (coords: { lat: number; lng: number }, label?: string) => void;
  centerOnUserLocation: (zoom?: number) => boolean;
  resetToBrowserGps: () => void;
  loadSavedLocation: () => SavedUserLocation | null;
  openCalibrationModal: () => void;
  closeCalibrationModal: () => void;
  openSosModal: () => void;
  closeSosModal: () => void;
  setIsLowAccuracy: (isLow: boolean) => void;
  setDismissedCalibrationBanner: (dismissed: boolean) => void;
}

export const useMapStore = create<MapState>((set, get) => ({
  mode: 'basic',
  center: { lat: 23.685, lng: 90.3563 }, // Center of Bangladesh
  zoom: 7,
  activeTileLayer: MAP_LAYERS[defaultLayerEnv] ? defaultLayerEnv : 'google_streets',
  userLocation: null,
  userAccuracy: null,
  userAccuracyTier: null,
  locationSource: null,
  locationLabel: null,
  locationTimestamp: null,
  isLocating: false,
  acquisitionStage: 'idle',
  activeRequestId: 0,
  activeWatchId: null,
  hasAutoLocated: false,
  isCalibrationModalOpen: false,
  isLowAccuracy: false,
  dismissedCalibrationBanner: false,
  isSosModalOpen: false,
  targetCommand: null,

  // Continuous Live Tracking State
  isLiveTracking: false,
  trackingStatus: 'stopped',
  isFollowingUser: false,
  liveWatchId: null,

  setMode: (mode) => set({ mode }),
  setCenter: (center, zoom) =>
    set((state) => {
      const targetZoom = zoom ?? state.zoom;
      return {
        center,
        zoom: targetZoom,
        targetCommand: {
          lat: center.lat,
          lng: center.lng,
          zoom: targetZoom,
          id: Date.now() + Math.random(),
        },
      };
    }),
  setZoom: (zoom) =>
    set((state) => ({
      zoom,
      targetCommand: {
        lat: state.center.lat,
        lng: state.center.lng,
        zoom,
        id: Date.now() + Math.random(),
      },
    })),
  flyTo: (coords, zoom) =>
    set((state) => {
      const targetZoom = zoom ?? state.zoom;
      return {
        center: coords,
        zoom: targetZoom,
        targetCommand: {
          lat: coords.lat,
          lng: coords.lng,
          zoom: targetZoom,
          id: Date.now() + Math.random(),
        },
      };
    }),
  setActiveTileLayer: (activeTileLayer) => set({ activeTileLayer }),
  setIsLocating: (isLocating) => set({ isLocating }),
  setAcquisitionStage: (acquisitionStage) => set({ acquisitionStage }),
  setActiveWatchId: (activeWatchId) => set({ activeWatchId }),
  setHasAutoLocated: (hasAutoLocated) => set({ hasAutoLocated }),
  incrementRequestId: () => {
    let nextId = 0;
    set((state) => {
      nextId = state.activeRequestId + 1;
      return { activeRequestId: nextId };
    });
    return nextId;
  },
  openCalibrationModal: () => set({ isCalibrationModalOpen: true }),
  closeCalibrationModal: () => set({ isCalibrationModalOpen: false }),
  openSosModal: () => set({ isSosModalOpen: true }),
  closeSosModal: () => set({ isSosModalOpen: false }),
  setIsLowAccuracy: (isLowAccuracy) => set({ isLowAccuracy }),
  setDismissedCalibrationBanner: (dismissedCalibrationBanner) => set({ dismissedCalibrationBanner }),
  setTrackingStatus: (trackingStatus) => set({ trackingStatus }),
  setIsFollowingUser: (isFollowingUser) => set({ isFollowingUser }),
  setLiveWatchId: (liveWatchId) => set({ liveWatchId }),

  recenterOnUser: () => {
    const loc = get().userLocation;
    set({
      isFollowingUser: true,
      ...(get().isLiveTracking ? { trackingStatus: 'active' } : {}),
    });
    if (loc && isWithinBangladesh(loc.lat, loc.lng)) {
      get().centerOnUserLocation();
    }
  },

  stopLiveTracking: () => {
    const watchId = get().liveWatchId;
    if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.geolocation && watchId !== null) {
      try {
        navigator.geolocation.clearWatch(watchId);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[useMapStore] Failed to clear live tracking watch:', err);
      }
    }
    set({
      isLiveTracking: false,
      trackingStatus: 'stopped',
      isFollowingUser: false,
      liveWatchId: null,
    });
  },

  startLiveTracking: async () => {
    if (typeof navigator === 'undefined' || !navigator.geolocation) {
      set({
        isLiveTracking: false,
        trackingStatus: 'unavailable',
        isFollowingUser: false,
        liveWatchId: null,
      });
      return false;
    }

    const prevWatchId = get().liveWatchId;
    if (prevWatchId !== null) {
      try {
        navigator.geolocation.clearWatch(prevWatchId);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[useMapStore] clearWatch error:', err);
      }
    }

    set({
      isLiveTracking: true,
      trackingStatus: 'active',
      isFollowingUser: true,
      locationSource: 'gps',
    });

    try {
      const watchId = navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(
        (pos) => {
          if (!get().isLiveTracking) return;

          // Timestamp freshness check: reject readings older than 30s or non-positive timestamp
          if (!isFreshPosition(pos.timestamp, 30000, Date.now())) {
            return;
          }

          const rawAcc = pos.coords.accuracy;
          const sanitizedAcc = sanitizeAccuracy(rawAcc);

          const coords = {
            lat: formatCoordinate(pos.coords.latitude),
            lng: formatCoordinate(pos.coords.longitude),
          };

          if (!isWithinBangladesh(coords.lat, coords.lng)) {
            return;
          }

          // Degraded accuracy does not freeze position in continuous tracking
          const tier = classifyGeolocationAccuracy(rawAcc);
          const isLow =
            tier === 'LOW' ||
            tier === 'VERY_LOW' ||
            tier === 'EXTREMELY_POOR';

          set({
            userLocation: coords,
            userAccuracy: sanitizedAcc,
            userAccuracyTier: tier,
            locationSource: 'gps',
            locationTimestamp: pos.timestamp || Date.now(),
            isLowAccuracy: isLow,
          });

          if (get().isFollowingUser) {
            get().centerOnUserLocation();
          }
        },
        (err) => {
          console.warn('[useMapStore] watchPosition error:', err);
          set({
            trackingStatus: 'unavailable',
          });
        },
        {
          enableHighAccuracy: true,
          maximumAge: 0,
        }
      );

      set({ liveWatchId: watchId });
      return true;
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[useMapStore] Exception in startLiveTracking:', err);
      set({
        isLiveTracking: false,
        trackingStatus: 'unavailable',
        isFollowingUser: false,
        liveWatchId: null,
      });
      return false;
    }
  },

  setUserLocation: (coords, accuracy = null, source = 'gps', label = undefined, timestamp = null) => {
    if (!coords) {
      set({
        userLocation: null,
        userAccuracy: null,
        userAccuracyTier: null,
        locationSource: null,
        locationLabel: null,
        locationTimestamp: null,
        isLowAccuracy: false,
      });
      return;
    }

    const currentSource = get().locationSource;
    // If locationSource === 'calibrated' and incoming source === 'gps', DO NOT overwrite unless explicit forced reset
    if (currentSource === 'calibrated' && source === 'gps') {
      return;
    }

    const tier = classifyGeolocationAccuracy(accuracy);
    const isLow =
      tier === 'LOW' ||
      tier === 'VERY_LOW' ||
      tier === 'EXTREMELY_POOR';

    set({
      userLocation: {
        lat: formatCoordinate(coords.lat),
        lng: formatCoordinate(coords.lng),
      },
      userAccuracy: sanitizeAccuracy(accuracy),
      userAccuracyTier: tier,
      locationSource: source,
      locationLabel: label || null,
      locationTimestamp: timestamp ?? Date.now(),
      isLowAccuracy: isLow,
    });
  },

  calibrateUserLocation: (coords, label = undefined) => {
    const currentWatchId = get().activeWatchId;
    if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.geolocation && currentWatchId !== null) {
      try {
        navigator.geolocation.clearWatch(currentWatchId);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[useMapStore] Failed to clear geolocation watch upon calibration:', err);
      }
    }
    const currentLiveWatchId = get().liveWatchId;
    if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.geolocation && currentLiveWatchId !== null) {
      try {
        navigator.geolocation.clearWatch(currentLiveWatchId);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[useMapStore] Failed to clear live geolocation watch upon calibration:', err);
      }
    }

    const formattedCoords = {
      lat: formatCoordinate(coords.lat),
      lng: formatCoordinate(coords.lng),
    };

    const saved: SavedUserLocation = {
      lat: formattedCoords.lat,
      lng: formattedCoords.lng,
      accuracy: 25, // Calibrated locations are pinpointed by the user
      source: 'calibrated',
      label: label || 'Calibrated Location',
      updatedAt: Date.now(),
    };

    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY_USER_LOCATION, JSON.stringify(saved));
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[useMapStore] Failed to save calibrated location to localStorage:', err);
      }
    }

    set((state) => ({
      activeRequestId: state.activeRequestId + 1,
      activeWatchId: null,
      isLocating: false,
      acquisitionStage: 'idle',
      isLiveTracking: false,
      trackingStatus: 'stopped',
      isFollowingUser: false,
      liveWatchId: null,
      userLocation: formattedCoords,
      userAccuracy: 25,
      userAccuracyTier: 'GOOD',
      locationSource: 'calibrated',
      locationLabel: saved.label || null,
      locationTimestamp: Date.now(),
      isLowAccuracy: false,
      dismissedCalibrationBanner: false,
      center: formattedCoords,
      targetCommand: {
        lat: formattedCoords.lat,
        lng: formattedCoords.lng,
        zoom: Math.max(state.zoom, 16),
        id: Date.now() + Math.random(),
      },
    }));
  },

  centerOnUserLocation: (zoom?: number) => {
    const state = get();
    const loc = state.userLocation;
    if (!loc || !isWithinBangladesh(loc.lat, loc.lng)) {
      return false;
    }
    const acc = state.userAccuracy;
    const targetZoom =
      zoom ??
      (state.locationSource === 'calibrated' || (acc !== null && acc <= 30)
        ? 17
        : acc !== null && acc <= 100
        ? 16
        : 15);
    state.flyTo(loc, targetZoom);
    return true;
  },

  resetToBrowserGps: () => {
    const currentWatchId = get().activeWatchId;
    if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.geolocation && currentWatchId !== null) {
      try {
        navigator.geolocation.clearWatch(currentWatchId);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[useMapStore] Failed to clear geolocation watch upon reset:', err);
      }
    }
    const currentLiveWatchId = get().liveWatchId;
    if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.geolocation && currentLiveWatchId !== null) {
      try {
        navigator.geolocation.clearWatch(currentLiveWatchId);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[useMapStore] Failed to clear live geolocation watch upon reset:', err);
      }
    }

    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY_USER_LOCATION);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[useMapStore] Failed to remove saved location from localStorage:', err);
      }
    }
    set((state) => ({
      activeRequestId: state.activeRequestId + 1,
      activeWatchId: null,
      isLocating: false,
      acquisitionStage: 'idle',
      isLiveTracking: false,
      trackingStatus: 'stopped',
      isFollowingUser: false,
      liveWatchId: null,
      userLocation: null,
      userAccuracy: null,
      userAccuracyTier: null,
      locationSource: null,
      locationLabel: null,
      locationTimestamp: null,
      isLowAccuracy: false,
      dismissedCalibrationBanner: false,
      hasAutoLocated: false,
    }));
  },

  loadSavedLocation: () => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY_USER_LOCATION);
      if (!raw) return null;
      const parsed: SavedUserLocation = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (parsed && typeof parsed.lat === 'number' && typeof parsed.lng === 'number') {
        return parsed;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[useMapStore] Failed to parse saved location from localStorage:', err);
    }
    return null;
  },
}));
```

## [File 68] `apps/web/store/useFilterStore.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/web/store/useFilterStore.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 61  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This store manages active search filters, category selections, and severity thresholds on the threat radar.
It provides action creators to toggle individual threat categories (e.g., snatching, extortion, accidents) or reset filters.
The active filters are referenced by map and feed components to filter displayed incidents client-side.

```typescript
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { IncidentSeverity, IncidentCategory } from '@repo/shared';

interface FilterState {
  selectedSeverity: IncidentSeverity | 'all';
  selectedCategories: IncidentCategory[];
  selectedCategory: IncidentCategory | 'all'; // Backward compatibility
  searchQuery: string;
  setSeverity: (severity: IncidentSeverity | 'all') => void;
  setCategories: (categories: IncidentCategory[]) => void;
  toggleCategory: (category: IncidentCategory) => void;
  setCategory: (category: IncidentCategory | 'all') => void;
  clearCategories: () => void;
  setSearchQuery: (query: string) => void;
  resetFilters: () => void;
}

export const useFilterStore = create<FilterState>((set) => ({
  selectedSeverity: 'all',
  selectedCategories: [],
  selectedCategory: 'all',
  searchQuery: '',
  setSeverity: (selectedSeverity) => set({ selectedSeverity }),
  setCategories: (selectedCategories) =>
    set({
      selectedCategories,
      selectedCategory:
        selectedCategories.length === 1
          ? selectedCategories[0]
          : selectedCategories.length === 0
          ? 'all'
          : selectedCategories[0],
    }),
  toggleCategory: (category) =>
    set((state) => {
      const exists = state.selectedCategories.includes(category);
      const updated = exists
        ? state.selectedCategories.filter((c) => c !== category)
        : [...state.selectedCategories, category];
      return {
        selectedCategories: updated,
        selectedCategory:
          updated.length === 1 ? updated[0] : updated.length === 0 ? 'all' : updated[0],
      };
    }),
  setCategory: (category) =>
    set({
      selectedCategory: category,
      selectedCategories: category === 'all' ? [] : [category],
    }),
  clearCategories: () => set({ selectedCategories: [], selectedCategory: 'all' }),
  setSearchQuery: (searchQuery) => set({ searchQuery }),
  resetFilters: () =>
    set({
      selectedSeverity: 'all',
      selectedCategories: [],
      selectedCategory: 'all',
      searchQuery: '',
    }),
}));
```

## [File 70] `apps/web/store/useStatsStore.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/web/store/useStatsStore.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 56  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This store holds aggregated platform safety statistics fetched from the /stats endpoint.
It tracks counts of total active incidents, resolved threats, verified safe zones, and high-risk zones.
It updates dynamically via real-time WebSocket events to reflect current safety trends across Bangladesh.

```typescript
import { create } from "zustand";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { getSocket } from "@/lib/socket";
import { SOCKET_EVENTS } from "@repo/shared";

export interface PlatformStats {
  totalReports: number;
  activeReports: number;
  resolvedReports: number;
  criticalThreats: number;
  totalCitizens: number;
  verifiedCitizens: number;
  safeHavens: number;
  totalVotes: number;
  lastActiveAt: string;
  timestamp: string;
}

interface StatsState {
  stats: PlatformStats | null;
  isLoading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  fetchStats: () => Promise<void>;
  initStatsListener: () => void;
}

export const useStatsStore = create<StatsState>((set, get) => ({
  stats: null,
  isLoading: true,
  error: null,

  fetchStats: async () => {
    try {
      set({ isLoading: true, error: null });
      const response: any = await apiFetch("/stats");
      const statsData = response?.data || response;
      if (statsData && typeof statsData.activeReports === "number") {
        set({ stats: statsData, isLoading: false, error: null });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.warn("[StatsStore] Could not fetch live platform stats:", err.message);
      set({ isLoading: false, error: err.message });
    }
  },

  initStatsListener: () => {
    const socket = getSocket();
    if (!socket) return;

    socket.off(SOCKET_EVENTS.STATS_UPDATED);
    socket.on(SOCKET_EVENTS.STATS_UPDATED, (newStats: PlatformStats) => {
      set({ stats: newStats });
    });
  },
}));
```

## [File 71] `apps/web/store/useToastStore.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/web/store/useToastStore.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 72  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This store manages the display of non-blocking toast notifications across the web interface.
It supports success, warning, and error toast variants with automated auto-dismiss timers.
Components dispatch toast messages through this store to provide immediate visual feedback for user actions.

```typescript
import { create } from "zustand";

export type ToastType = "success" | "error" | "info" | "warning";

export interface ToastItem {
  id: string;
  message: string;
  type: ToastType;
  durationMs: number;
}

interface ToastState {
  toasts: ToastItem[];
  showToast: (message: string, type?: ToastType, durationMs?: number) => string;
  dismissToast: (id: string) => void;
}

const MAX_VISIBLE_TOASTS = 4;
const DEFAULT_DURATION_MS = 4000;
const toastTimers = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>();

function clearToastTimer(id: string) {
  const existing = toastTimers.get(id);
  if (existing !== undefined) {
    clearTimeout(existing);
    toastTimers.delete(id);
  }
}

export const useToastStore = create<ToastState>((set) => ({
  toasts: [],

  showToast: (message, type = "info", durationMs = DEFAULT_DURATION_MS) => {
    const id = `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;

    set((state) => {
      const next = [...state.toasts, { id, message, type, durationMs }];
      if (next.length > MAX_VISIBLE_TOASTS) {
        const evicted = next.slice(0, next.length - MAX_VISIBLE_TOASTS);
        evicted.forEach((t) => clearToastTimer(t.id));
        return { toasts: next.slice(-MAX_VISIBLE_TOASTS) };
      }
      return { toasts: next };
    });

    if (durationMs > 0) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        clearToastTimer(id);
        set((state) => ({
          toasts: state.toasts.filter((t) => t.id !== id),
        }));
      }, durationMs);
      toastTimers.set(id, timer);
    }

    return id;
  },

  dismissToast: (id) => {
    clearToastTimer(id);
    set((state) => ({
      toasts: state.toasts.filter((t) => t.id !== id),
    }));
  },
}));

export const showToast = (
  message: string,
  type: ToastType = "info",
  durationMs?: number
) => useToastStore.getState().showToast(message, type, durationMs);
```

## [File 72] `apps/web/lib/api.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/web/lib/api.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 223  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This utility module wraps the native browser fetch API with automatic base URL injection and credential handling.
It intercepts 401 Unauthorized responses to silently attempt session refreshing via /auth/refresh before failing.
It also formats network exceptions into structured ApiError instances for consistent component-level error handling.

```typescript
import { setSocketAuthToken } from './socket';

export interface ApiFetchOptions extends RequestInit {
  skipAuthRefresh?: boolean;
  timeoutMs?: number;
}

export class ApiError extends Error {
  statusCode: number;
  data: any;

  constructor(message: string, statusCode: number, data?: any) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'ApiError';
    this.statusCode = statusCode;
    this.data = data;
  }
}

/**
 * Universal endpoint resolver:
 * - In the browser, always targets same-origin /api/v1 to leverage the Next.js reverse proxy.
 *   This ensures HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookies (accessToken, refreshToken) are stored
 *   as first-party cookies, eliminates cross-origin restrictions, and avoids CORS preflights.
 * - On the server (SSR), uses INTERNAL_API_URL or defaults to localhost.
 * - Deduplicates /api/v1 prefixing if already supplied.
 */
export function resolveApiUrl(endpoint: string): string {
  if (endpoint.startsWith('http://') || endpoint.startsWith('https://')) {
    return endpoint;
  }

  // Determine base prefix
  const isBrowser = typeof window !== 'undefined';
  const rawBase = isBrowser
    ? '/api/v1'
    : (process.env.INTERNAL_API_URL || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:5000').replace(/\/+$/, '');

  const base = isBrowser || rawBase.endsWith('/api/v1') ? rawBase : `${rawBase}/api/v1`;

  const cleanEndpoint = endpoint.startsWith('/') ? endpoint : `/${endpoint}`;

  // If endpoint already has /api/v1 prefix, don't duplicate
  if (cleanEndpoint.startsWith('/api/v1/')) {
    if (isBrowser) return cleanEndpoint;
    const origin = rawBase.replace(/\/api\/v1$/, '');
    return `${origin}${cleanEndpoint}`;
  }

  return `${base}${cleanEndpoint}`;
}

const AUTH_NO_REFRESH_PATHS = [
  '/auth/refresh',
  '/auth/device',
  '/auth/login',
  '/auth/logout',
];

let refreshPromise: Promise<boolean> | null = null;

const DEFAULT_API_TIMEOUT_MS = 25000;
const UUID_CLEANUP_TIMEOUT_MS = 15000;

function createRequestSignal(
  timeoutMs: number,
  callerSignal?: AbortSignal | null
): {
  signal: AbortSignal;
  didTimeout: () => boolean;
  cleanup: () => void;
} {
  const controller = new AbortController();
  let timedOut = false;

  const onCallerAbort = () => {
    controller.abort(callerSignal?.reason);
  };

  if (callerSignal) {
    if (callerSignal.aborted) {
      controller.abort(callerSignal.reason);
    } else {
      callerSignal.addEventListener('abort', onCallerAbort, { once: true });
    }
  }

  const timerId =
    timeoutMs > 0
      ? setTimeout(() => {
          timedOut = true;
          controller.abort(new DOMException('Request timed out', 'AbortError'));
        }, timeoutMs)
      : null;

  return {
    signal: controller.signal,
    didTimeout: () => timedOut,
    cleanup: () => {
      if (timerId !== null) clearTimeout(timerId);
      if (callerSignal) {
        callerSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onCallerAbort);
      }
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Coalesces concurrent 401 refresh attempts behind a single in-flight promise so
 * single-use rotated refresh tokens are never consumed twice simultaneously.
 */
async function refreshSessionSingleFlight(): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!refreshPromise) {
    refreshPromise = (async () => {
      const timeoutGuard = createRequestSignal(UUID_CLEANUP_TIMEOUT_MS);
      try {
        const refreshUrl = resolveApiUrl('/auth/refresh');
        const refreshRes = await fetch(refreshUrl, {
          method: 'POST',
          credentials: 'include',
          signal: timeoutGuard.signal,
        });

        if (!refreshRes.ok) {
          return false;
        }

        const refreshJson = await refreshRes.json().catch(() => null);
        if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && refreshJson?.data?.socketToken) {
          setSocketAuthToken(refreshJson.data.socketToken);
        }
        return true;
      } catch {
        return false;
      } finally {
        timeoutGuard.cleanup();
        refreshPromise = null;
      }
    })();
  }
  return refreshPromise;
}

function shouldAttemptSilentRefresh(endpoint: string, skipAuthRefresh?: boolean): boolean {
  if (skipAuthRefresh) return false;
  const endpointPath = endpoint.split('?')[0];
  return !AUTH_NO_REFRESH_PATHS.some((path) => endpointPath.includes(path));
}

/**
 * Universal typed API fetcher:
 * - Automatically handles credentials: 'include' (HttpOnly cookie propagation)
 * - Enforces default AbortController timeout (25000ms) linked with optional caller signal
 * - Intercepts 401 responses and triggers silent session refresh before retrying
 */
export async function apiFetch<T = any>(
  endpoint: string,
  options: ApiFetchOptions = {}
): Promise<T> {
  const url = resolveApiUrl(endpoint);
  const {
    skipAuthRefresh,
    timeoutMs = DEFAULT_API_TIMEOUT_MS,
    signal: callerSignal,
    ...fetchOptions
  } = options;

  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    ...(fetchOptions.body && !(fetchOptions.body instanceof FormData)
      ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
      : {}),
    ...((fetchOptions.headers as Record<string, string>) || {}),
  };

  const requestGuard = createRequestSignal(timeoutMs, callerSignal);
  let response: Response;
  try {
    response = await fetch(url, {
      ...fetchOptions,
      signal: requestGuard.signal,
      headers,
      credentials: 'include',
    });
  } catch (networkErr: any) {
    const timedOut = requestGuard.didTimeout();
    throw new ApiError(
      timedOut
        ? 'Request timed out. Please try again.'
        : networkErr?.message || 'Network connection failed. API is unreachable.',
      0,
      { isNetworkError: true, ...(timedOut ? { isTimeout: true } : {}) }
    );
  } finally {
    requestGuard.cleanup();
  }

  // Handle 401 Unauthorized with single-flight silent token refresh
  if (
    response.status === 401 &&
    shouldAttemptSilentRefresh(endpoint, skipAuthRefresh)
  ) {
    const refreshed = await refreshSessionSingleFlight();
    if (refreshed) {
      // Retry original request once
      return apiFetch<T>(endpoint, { ...options, skipAuthRefresh: true });
    }
  }

  const json = await response.json().catch(() => null);

  if (!response.ok) {
    const errorMsg =
      json?.message ||
      json?.error?.message ||
      json?.error ||
      response.statusText ||
      `API request failed with status ${response.status}`;
    throw new ApiError(errorMsg, response.status, json);
  }

  return json?.data !== undefined ? json.data : json;
}
```

## [File 73] `apps/web/lib/socket.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/web/lib/socket.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 101  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This module manages the client-side Socket.io WebSocket connection to the backend server.
It handles automatic reconnection, maintains scoped authentication tokens, and exports socket event subscription helpers.
It ensures that map markers, community vote counts, and report purges synchronize across browsers in real time.

```typescript
import { io, Socket } from "socket.io-client";
import { SOCKET_EVENTS } from "@repo/shared";

let socketInstance: Socket | null = null;
let currentSocketToken: string | null = null;

const SOCKET_URL =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SOCKET_URL ||
  (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.location.hostname !== "localhost"
    ? "https://danger-zone-bd.onrender.com"
    : "http://127.0.0.1:5000");

/**
 * Updates the in-memory Socket.IO handshake token for cross-origin auth
 * and reconnects an active or stale socket cleanly while preserving registered listeners.
 * Passing null clears credentials and disconnects without reconnecting as a guest.
 */
export const setSocketAuthToken = (token: string | null) => {
  const normalized = token && token.trim().length > 0 ? token : null;
  const tokenChanged = normalized !== currentSocketToken;
  currentSocketToken = normalized;

  if (socketInstance) {
    socketInstance.auth = normalized ? { token: normalized } : {};
    if (normalized) {
      if (tokenChanged || !socketInstance.connected) {
        socketInstance.disconnect().connect();
      }
    } else if (socketInstance.connected) {
      socketInstance.disconnect();
    }
  }
};

export const setSocketToken = setSocketAuthToken;

/**
 * Access or create the singleton Socket.IO instance.
 * Strictly browser-only (`typeof window !== 'undefined'`).
 * Implements reconnection: true, reconnectionDelay: 1000, reconnectionAttempts: Infinity
 * as required by the Master Blueprint for Render free-tier sleep handling.
 */
export const getSocket = (): Socket | null => {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") {
    return null;
  }

  if (!socketInstance) {
    socketInstance = io(SOCKET_URL, {
      auth: currentSocketToken ? { token: currentSocketToken } : undefined,
      withCredentials: true,
      transports: ["websocket", "polling"],
      reconnection: true,
      reconnectionDelay: 1000,
      reconnectionAttempts: Infinity,
      autoConnect: true,
    });

    socketInstance.on(SOCKET_EVENTS.CONNECT, () => {
      console.log("[Socket.IO] Connected to live safety server:", socketInstance?.id);
    });

    socketInstance.on("connect_error", (err) => {
      console.warn("[Socket.IO] Connection error:", err.message);
      // If an authenticated handshake fails (e.g., expired 15m token), fall back to guest
      // read-only live_reports until apiFetch silent refresh provides a new socketToken.
      const msg = (err?.message || "").toLowerCase();
      if (
        currentSocketToken &&
        (msg.includes("token") || msg.includes("unauthorized") || msg.includes("expired") || msg.includes("authentication"))
      ) {
        currentSocketToken = null;
        if (socketInstance) {
          socketInstance.auth = {};
        }
      }
    });

    socketInstance.on(SOCKET_EVENTS.DISCONNECT, (reason) => {
      console.warn("[Socket.IO] Disconnected from safety server:", reason);
    });
  }

  return socketInstance;
};

/**
 * Emits updated map viewport coordinates to receive localized updates
 */
export const joinMapBounds = (bounds: {
  minLng: number;
  minLat: number;
  maxLng: number;
  maxLat: number;
}) => {
  const socket = getSocket();
  if (socket && socket.connected) {
    socket.emit(SOCKET_EVENTS.JOIN_MAP_BOUNDS, bounds);
  }
};
```

## [File 75] `apps/web/lib/gpsVerification.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/web/lib/gpsVerification.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 103  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This utility validates device hardware GPS coordinates against user-selected incident pin locations.
It implements the Haversine distance formula to calculate the exact spatial offset between the two points.
It alerts users if their dropped pin exceeds the permitted 200-meter anti-spoofing threshold.

```typescript
import { MAX_GPS_PROXIMITY_METERS, MAX_HARDWARE_GPS_ACCURACY_METERS } from "@repo/shared";

export interface HardwareGpsFix {
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
  accuracy: number;
}

export type GpsVerificationStatus =
  | "HARDWARE_VERIFIED"
  | "OUT_OF_RANGE"
  | "LOW_ACCURACY"
  | "UNAVAILABLE";

export interface HardwareGpsEvaluation {
  status: GpsVerificationStatus;
  isEligibleHardwareGps: boolean;
  isVerified: boolean;
  distanceMeters: number | null;
}

/** Calculates Haversine distance in meters between two WGS-84 coordinates. */
export function calculateDistanceMeters(
  lat1: number,
  lon1: number,
  lat2: number,
  lon2: number
): number {
  const R = 6371e3;
  const toRad = (v: number) => (v * Math.PI) / 180;
  const dLat = toRad(lat2 - lat1);
  const dLon = toRad(lon2 - lon1);
  const a =
    Math.sin(dLat / 2) * Math.sin(dLat / 2) +
    Math.cos(toRad(lat1)) * Math.cos(toRad(lat2)) * Math.sin(dLon / 2) * Math.sin(dLon / 2);
  const c = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
  return Math.round(R * c);
}

/** Evaluates whether an unmodified hardware geolocation fix supports <=200m proximity verification. */
export function evaluateHardwareGpsProximity(
  hardwareGps: HardwareGpsFix | null,
  pinLat: number,
  pinLng: number
): HardwareGpsEvaluation {
  if (!hardwareGps) {
    return {
      status: "UNAVAILABLE",
      isEligibleHardwareGps: false,
      isVerified: false,
      distanceMeters: null,
    };
  }

  const distanceMeters = calculateDistanceMeters(hardwareGps.lat, hardwareGps.lng, pinLat, pinLng);
  const isAccuracyValid =
    Number.isFinite(hardwareGps.accuracy) &&
    hardwareGps.accuracy >= 0 &&
    hardwareGps.accuracy <= MAX_HARDWARE_GPS_ACCURACY_METERS;

  if (!isAccuracyValid) {
    return {
      status: "LOW_ACCURACY",
      isEligibleHardwareGps: false,
      isVerified: false,
      distanceMeters,
    };
  }

  if (distanceMeters > MAX_GPS_PROXIMITY_METERS) {
    return {
      status: "OUT_OF_RANGE",
      isEligibleHardwareGps: true,
      isVerified: false,
      distanceMeters,
    };
  }

  return {
    status: "HARDWARE_VERIFIED",
    isEligibleHardwareGps: true,
    isVerified: true,
    distanceMeters,
  };
}

/** Builds device GPS telemetry headers only for verified, unmodified hardware fixes. */
export function buildHardwareGpsHeaders(
  hardwareGps: HardwareGpsFix | null,
  evaluation: HardwareGpsEvaluation
): Record<string, string> {
  if (!hardwareGps || !evaluation.isVerified) {
    return {};
  }

  return {
    "x-device-lat": hardwareGps.lat.toString(),
    "x-device-lng": hardwareGps.lng.toString(),
    "x-device-accuracy": Math.round(hardwareGps.accuracy).toString(),
    "x-gps-source": "hardware",
  };
}
```

## [File 76] `apps/web/lib/proximityEngine.ts`

### What This Code Does
This module calculates real-time proximity between the user's live GPS position and surrounding hazard reports.
It identifies nearby high-severity incidents within danger thresholds (e.g., 500m or 1km) and calculates distance deltas.
It powers the warning banners that alert commuters when they are approaching an active danger zone.

```typescript
import {
  DangerIncident,
  MAX_GPS_PROXIMITY_METERS,
  MAX_HARDWARE_GPS_ACCURACY_METERS,
  isWithinBangladesh,
} from '@repo/shared';
import { calculateDistanceMeters } from './gpsVerification';

export { calculateDistanceMeters };

export interface ProximityAlertItem {
  hazard: DangerIncident;
  distanceMeters: number;
  enteredAt: number;
}

export interface ProximityTrackerEntry {
  hazardId: string;
  isInside: boolean;
  enteredAt: number;
  lastAlertTimestamp: number;
  lastDistanceMeters: number;
}

export interface EvaluateHazardProximityOptions {
  thresholdMeters?: number;          // Default: 200 (MAX_GPS_PROXIMITY_METERS)
  cooldownMs?: number;               // Default: 600,000 (10 minutes)
  hysteresisMeters?: number;         // Default: 20 (exit boundary = threshold + 20)
  maxAccuracyMeters?: number;        // Default: 250 (MAX_HARDWARE_GPS_ACCURACY_METERS)
  currentTime?: number;              // Default: Date.now()
  checkBangladeshBounds?: boolean;   // Default: true
  enabled?: boolean;                 // Default: true
}

export interface ProximityEvaluationResult {
  newAlerts: ProximityAlertItem[];
  exitedHazardIds: string[];
  activeAlerts: ProximityAlertItem[];
  closestAlert: ProximityAlertItem | null;
  updatedTrackerState: Map<string, ProximityTrackerEntry>;
}

export type CoordinateLike =
  | { lat: number; lng: number }
  | { latitude: number; longitude: number };

const ELIGIBLE_STATUSES = new Set([
  'unverified',
  'community_confirmed',
  'authority_verified',
  'disputed',
  'active',
]);

const EXCLUDED_STATUSES = new Set([
  'resolved',
  'purged',
  'deleted',
  'archived',
  'rejected',
  'inactive',
  'expired',
]);

/**
 * Validates whether a hazard incident is eligible for proximity evaluation.
 * Defense-in-depth: status normalization, boundary checking, and timestamp validation.
 */
export function isHazardEligible(
  hazard: DangerIncident | null | undefined,
  options?: { currentTime?: number; checkBangladeshBounds?: boolean }
): boolean {
  if (!hazard || typeof hazard !== 'object') return false;
  if (typeof hazard.id !== 'string' || hazard.id.trim() === '') return false;

  // Status check (case-insensitive normalization)
  const normStatus = String(hazard.status || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  if (EXCLUDED_STATUSES.has(normStatus)) return false;
  if (!ELIGIBLE_STATUSES.has(normStatus)) return false;

  // Coordinates check
  if (!hazard.coordinates || typeof hazard.coordinates !== 'object') return false;
  const { lat, lng } = hazard.coordinates;
  if (typeof lat !== 'number' || typeof lng !== 'number') return false;
  if (!Number.isFinite(lat) || !Number.isFinite(lng)) return false;
  if (lat < -90 || lat > 90 || lng < -180 || lng > 180) return false;

  if (options?.checkBangladeshBounds !== false) {
    if (!isWithinBangladesh(lat, lng)) return false;
  }

  // Timestamp check
  if (!hazard.timestamp || typeof hazard.timestamp !== 'string') return false;
  const createdAtMs = Date.parse(hazard.timestamp);
  if (!Number.isFinite(createdAtMs) || createdAtMs <= 0) return false;

  // Expiration check (expiresAt field if present)
  const expiresAt = (hazard as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).expiresAt;
  if (expiresAt) {
    const expiresAtMs = Date.parse(String(expiresAt));
    const now = options?.currentTime ?? Date.now();
    if (Number.isFinite(expiresAtMs) && expiresAtMs <= now) return false;
  }

  return true;
}

/** Backward-compatible alias for isHazardEligible */
export const isEligibleHazard = isHazardEligible;

/**
 * Pure evaluation function computing proximity transitions, entry/exit events,
 * and deduplication against tracking state at $0 budget.
 */
export function evaluateHazardProximity(
  userCoords: CoordinateLike | null | undefined,
  userAccuracy: number | null | undefined,
  hazards: DangerIncident[] | null | undefined,
  trackerState: Map<string, ProximityTrackerEntry> = new Map(),
  options: EvaluateHazardProximityOptions = {}
): ProximityEvaluationResult {
  const thresholdMeters = options.thresholdMeters ?? MAX_GPS_PROXIMITY_METERS;
  const cooldownMs = options.cooldownMs ?? 600_000;
  const hysteresisMeters = options.hysteresisMeters ?? 20;
  const maxAccuracyMeters = options.maxAccuracyMeters ?? MAX_HARDWARE_GPS_ACCURACY_METERS;
  const currentTime = options.currentTime ?? Date.now();
  const checkBangladeshBounds = options.checkBangladeshBounds ?? true;
  const enabled = options.enabled ?? true;
  const exitThresholdMeters = thresholdMeters + hysteresisMeters;

  // Return empty result while preserving state
  const emptyResult = (state: Map<string, ProximityTrackerEntry>): ProximityEvaluationResult => ({
    newAlerts: [],
    exitedHazardIds: [],
    activeAlerts: [],
    closestAlert: null,
    updatedTrackerState: state,
  });

  if (!enabled) {
    // If disabled, transition all currently inside hazards to exited
    const disabledState = new Map<string, ProximityTrackerEntry>(trackerState);
    const exited: string[] = [];
    disabledState.forEach((entry, id) => {
      if (entry.isInside) {
        exited.push(id);
        disabledState.set(id, { ...entry, isInside: false });
      }
    });
    return {
      newAlerts: [],
      exitedHazardIds: exited,
      activeAlerts: [],
      closestAlert: null,
      updatedTrackerState: disabledState,
    };
  }

  // 1. User coordinates check
  if (!userCoords || typeof userCoords !== 'object') {
    return emptyResult(trackerState);
  }

  const rawLat = (userCoords as { lat?: unknown; latitude?: unknown }).lat ??
    (userCoords as { lat?: unknown; latitude?: unknown }).latitude;
  const rawLng = (userCoords as { lng?: unknown; longitude?: unknown }).lng ??
    (userCoords as { lng?: unknown; longitude?: unknown }).longitude;

  if (
    typeof rawLat !== 'number' ||
    typeof rawLng !== 'number' ||
    !Number.isFinite(rawLat) ||
    !Number.isFinite(rawLng) ||
    rawLat < -90 ||
    rawLat > 90 ||
    rawLng < -180 ||
    rawLng > 180
  ) {
    return emptyResult(trackerState);
  }

  const userLat = rawLat;
  const userLng = rawLng;

  if (checkBangladeshBounds && !isWithinBangladesh(userLat, userLng)) {
    return emptyResult(trackerState);
  }

  // 2. Hardware GPS accuracy guard: discard evaluation if accuracy degraded beyond threshold or negative/invalid
  if (userAccuracy !== null && userAccuracy !== undefined) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(userAccuracy) || userAccuracy < 0 || userAccuracy > maxAccuracyMeters) {
      return emptyResult(trackerState);
    }
  }

  // Clone tracker state for immutability
  const updatedTrackerState = new Map<string, ProximityTrackerEntry>(trackerState);
  const safeHazards = Array.isArray(hazards) ? hazards : [];
  const eligibleHazards = safeHazards.filter((h) =>
    isHazardEligible(h, { currentTime, checkBangladeshBounds })
  );
  const eligibleMap = new Map<string, DangerIncident>(eligibleHazards.map((h) => [h.id, h]));

  const newAlerts: ProximityAlertItem[] = [];
  const exitedHazardIds: string[] = [];
  const activeAlerts: ProximityAlertItem[] = [];

  // 3. Clear hazards in tracker that became ineligible or were removed in real time
  updatedTrackerState.forEach((entry, hazardId) => {
    if (entry.isInside && !eligibleMap.has(hazardId)) {
      exitedHazardIds.push(hazardId);
      updatedTrackerState.set(hazardId, {
        ...entry,
        isInside: false,
      });
    }
  });

  // 4. Evaluate all eligible hazards
  for (const hazard of eligibleHazards) {
    const distance = calculateDistanceMeters(
      userLat,
      userLng,
      hazard.coordinates.lat,
      hazard.coordinates.lng
    );

    const prevEntry = updatedTrackerState.get(hazard.id);
    const wasInside = prevEntry ? prevEntry.isInside : false;
    const lastAlertTime = prevEntry ? prevEntry.lastAlertTimestamp : 0;
    const enteredAtTime = prevEntry && wasInside ? prevEntry.enteredAt : currentTime;

    if (distance <= thresholdMeters) {
      // User is within entry threshold (e.g. <= 200m)
      if (!wasInside) {
        // Transition: ENTRY
        const isCooldownElapsed = lastAlertTime === 0 || currentTime - lastAlertTime >= cooldownMs;
        const newAlertTime = isCooldownElapsed ? currentTime : lastAlertTime;

        if (isCooldownElapsed) {
          newAlerts.push({
            hazard,
            distanceMeters: distance,
            enteredAt: currentTime,
          });
        }

        updatedTrackerState.set(hazard.id, {
          hazardId: hazard.id,
          isInside: true,
          enteredAt: currentTime,
          lastAlertTimestamp: newAlertTime,
          lastDistanceMeters: distance,
        });

        activeAlerts.push({
          hazard,
          distanceMeters: distance,
          enteredAt: currentTime,
        });
      } else {
        // Remaining inside: update distance, deduplicate alert
        updatedTrackerState.set(hazard.id, {
          ...prevEntry!,
          lastDistanceMeters: distance,
        });

        activeAlerts.push({
          hazard,
          distanceMeters: distance,
          enteredAt: enteredAtTime,
        });
      }
    } else if (distance <= exitThresholdMeters) {
      // Within hysteresis zone (e.g. 200m < d <= 220m)
      if (wasInside) {
        // Hysteresis preserves inside state
        updatedTrackerState.set(hazard.id, {
          ...prevEntry!,
          lastDistanceMeters: distance,
        });

        activeAlerts.push({
          hazard,
          distanceMeters: distance,
          enteredAt: enteredAtTime,
        });
      } else {
        // Still outside
        if (prevEntry) {
          updatedTrackerState.set(hazard.id, {
            ...prevEntry,
            lastDistanceMeters: distance,
          });
        }
      }
    } else {
      // Outside exit threshold (d > 220m)
      if (wasInside) {
        // Transition: EXIT
        exitedHazardIds.push(hazard.id);
        updatedTrackerState.set(hazard.id, {
          ...prevEntry!,
          isInside: false,
          lastDistanceMeters: distance,
        });
      } else {
        if (prevEntry) {
          updatedTrackerState.set(hazard.id, {
            ...prevEntry,
            lastDistanceMeters: distance,
          });
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // 5. Sort active alerts by distance ascending (closest first)
  activeAlerts.sort((a, b) => a.distanceMeters - b.distanceMeters);
  const closestAlert = activeAlerts.length > 0 ? activeAlerts[0] : null;

  return {
    newAlerts,
    exitedHazardIds,
    activeAlerts,
    closestAlert,
    updatedTrackerState,
  };
}

/**
 * Stateful class tracker wrapping evaluateHazardProximity for object-oriented consumers.
 */
export class ProximityAlertTracker {
  private trackerState = new Map<string, ProximityTrackerEntry>();
  private dismissedHazardIds = new Set<string>();
  private options: EvaluateHazardProximityOptions;
  private onAlertCallback?: (item: ProximityAlertItem) => void;
  private onExitCallback?: (hazardId: string) => void;
  private alertCounts = new Map<string, number>();
  private latestActiveAlerts: ProximityAlertItem[] = [];

  constructor(
    options: EvaluateHazardProximityOptions & {
      onAlert?: (item: ProximityAlertItem) => void;
      onExit?: (hazardId: string) => void;
    } = {}
  ) {
    this.options = { ...options };
    this.onAlertCallback = options.onAlert;
    this.onExitCallback = options.onExit;
  }

  public updateOptions(
    options: Partial<
      EvaluateHazardProximityOptions & {
        onAlert?: (item: ProximityAlertItem) => void;
        onExit?: (hazardId: string) => void;
      }
    >
  ): void {
    this.options = { ...this.options, ...options };
    if (options.onAlert !== undefined) this.onAlertCallback = options.onAlert;
    if (options.onExit !== undefined) this.onExitCallback = options.onExit;
  }

  public evaluate(
    userLocation: CoordinateLike | null | undefined,
    incidents: DangerIncident[] | null | undefined,
    opts?: { userAccuracy?: number | null; currentTime?: number }
  ): {
    activeAlerts: ProximityAlertItem[];
    closestAlert: ProximityAlertItem | null;
    isInsideDangerZone: boolean;
    dismissAlert: (hazardId: string) => void;
    resetAllAlerts: () => void;
  } {
    const userAccuracy = opts?.userAccuracy ?? null;
    const currentTime = opts?.currentTime ?? this.options.currentTime ?? Date.now();

    const result = evaluateHazardProximity(
      userLocation,
      userAccuracy,
      incidents,
      this.trackerState,
      {
        ...this.options,
        currentTime,
      }
    );

    this.trackerState = result.updatedTrackerState;
    this.latestActiveAlerts = result.activeAlerts;

    // Trigger onExit for exited hazards and remove from dismissed set
    for (const exitedId of result.exitedHazardIds) {
      this.dismissedHazardIds.delete(exitedId);
      this.onExitCallback?.(exitedId);
    }

    // Trigger onAlert for newly detected entries (if not dismissed)
    for (const newAlert of result.newAlerts) {
      const prevCount = this.alertCounts.get(newAlert.hazard.id) ?? 0;
      this.alertCounts.set(newAlert.hazard.id, prevCount + 1);
      if (!this.dismissedHazardIds.has(newAlert.hazard.id)) {
        this.onAlertCallback?.(newAlert);
      }
    }

    return this.getState();
  }

  public dismissAlert(hazardId: string): void {
    this.dismissedHazardIds.add(hazardId);
  }

  public resetAllAlerts(): void {
    this.trackerState.forEach((entry, id) => {
      if (entry.isInside) {
        this.onExitCallback?.(id);
      }
    });
    this.trackerState.clear();
    this.dismissedHazardIds.clear();
    this.alertCounts.clear();
    this.latestActiveAlerts = [];
  }

  public isDismissed(hazardId: string): boolean {
    return this.dismissedHazardIds.has(hazardId);
  }

  public getAlertCount(hazardId: string): number {
    return this.alertCounts.get(hazardId) ?? 0;
  }

  public getLastAlertTime(hazardId: string): number | undefined {
    return this.trackerState.get(hazardId)?.lastAlertTimestamp;
  }

  public getState(): {
    activeAlerts: ProximityAlertItem[];
    closestAlert: ProximityAlertItem | null;
    isInsideDangerZone: boolean;
    dismissAlert: (hazardId: string) => void;
    resetAllAlerts: () => void;
  } {
    const activeAlerts = this.latestActiveAlerts.filter(
      (a) => !this.dismissedHazardIds.has(a.hazard.id)
    );

    const closestAlert = activeAlerts.length > 0 ? activeAlerts[0] : null;

    return {
      activeAlerts,
      closestAlert,
      isInsideDangerZone: activeAlerts.length > 0,
      dismissAlert: (id: string) => this.dismissAlert(id),
      resetAllAlerts: () => this.resetAllAlerts(),
    };
  }
}
```

## [File 77] `apps/web/lib/audioAlert.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/web/lib/audioAlert.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 161  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This utility generates browser audio alerts using the Web Audio API without requiring external audio assets.
It synthesizes multi-tone audible chimes for imminent hazard warnings, emergency SOS triggers, and high-priority alerts.
It respects user sound preferences and browser autoplay permission policies.

```typescript
/**
 * Web Audio API Danger Alert Synthesizer
 *
 * Synthesizes a dual-pulse 800 Hz alert chime (120ms beep, 60ms silence, 120ms beep)
 * with smooth exponential decay curves entirely client-side using browser-native
 * Web Audio API (AudioContext / webkitAudioContext) at strictly $0 cost with ZERO
 * external sound assets or network requests.
 *
 * Designed to handle browser autoplay policies safely via gesture unlocking,
 * debounce siren spam with a 10s cooldown, and respect user mute preferences.
 */

export interface AudioAlertOptions {
  /** Override mute state for this specific chime call. */
  isMuted?: boolean;
  /** Oscillator base frequency in Hertz. Defaults to 800 Hz. */
  frequency?: number;
  /** Minimum interval in milliseconds between consecutive chimes. Defaults to 10,000 ms. */
  cooldownMs?: number;
  /** Simulated current timestamp in milliseconds (for deterministic testing). */
  currentTime?: number;
}

let sharedAudioContext: AudioContext | null = null;
let isMutedState = false;
let lastChimeTimestamp = 0;

function getAudioContextConstructor(): typeof AudioContext | null {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    const w = window as unknown as { AudioContext?: typeof AudioContext; webkitAudioContext?: typeof AudioContext };
    return w.AudioContext || w.webkitAudioContext || null;
  }
  if (typeof globalThis !== 'undefined') {
    const g = globalThis as unknown as { AudioContext?: typeof AudioContext; webkitAudioContext?: typeof AudioContext };
    return g.AudioContext || g.webkitAudioContext || null;
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * Returns true if the Web Audio context has been created and transitioned to 'running'.
 */
export function isAudioUnlocked(): boolean {
  return sharedAudioContext !== null && sharedAudioContext.state === 'running';
}

/**
 * Updates the global audio alert mute state.
 */
export function setAudioMuted(muted: boolean): void {
  isMutedState = Boolean(muted);
}

/**
 * Returns current global audio alert mute state.
 */
export function isAudioMuted(): boolean {
  return isMutedState;
}

/**
 * Unlocks or resumes the shared AudioContext in response to a user interaction gesture
 * (click, touchstart, keydown, or Live Tracking toggle) to satisfy browser autoplay policies.
 */
export async function unlockAudioContext(): Promise<void> {
  const AudioContextClass = getAudioContextConstructor();
  if (!AudioContextClass) return;

  try {
    if (!sharedAudioContext || sharedAudioContext.state === 'closed') {
      sharedAudioContext = new AudioContextClass();
    }
    if (sharedAudioContext.state === 'suspended' && typeof sharedAudioContext.resume === 'function') {
      await sharedAudioContext.resume();
    }
  } catch {
    // Autoplay or initialization error silently absorbed to prevent breaking gesture handlers
  }
}

/**
 * Synthesizes and plays a dual-pulse 800 Hz chime.
 * Returns true if the chime was successfully scheduled, false if muted, in cooldown,
 * or blocked by browser autoplay/unsupported audio context.
 */
export async function playDangerAlertSound(options?: AudioAlertOptions): Promise<boolean> {
  const muted = options?.isMuted ?? isMutedState;
  if (muted) {
    return false;
  }

  const now = options?.currentTime ?? Date.now();
  const cooldownMs = options?.cooldownMs ?? 10_000;

  if (lastChimeTimestamp > 0 && now - lastChimeTimestamp < cooldownMs) {
    return false;
  }

  const AudioContextClass = getAudioContextConstructor();
  if (!AudioContextClass) {
    return false;
  }

  try {
    if (!sharedAudioContext || sharedAudioContext.state === 'closed') {
      sharedAudioContext = new AudioContextClass();
    }

    if (sharedAudioContext.state === 'suspended' && typeof sharedAudioContext.resume === 'function') {
      await sharedAudioContext.resume();
    }

    if (sharedAudioContext.state !== 'running') {
      return false;
    }

    const ctx = sharedAudioContext;
    const frequency = options?.frequency ?? 800;
    const t0 = ctx.currentTime;

    // Pulse 1: 120ms beep with exponential decay
    const osc1 = ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain1 = ctx.createGain();
    osc1.type = 'sine';
    osc1.frequency.setValueAtTime(frequency, t0);
    gain1.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, t0);
    gain1.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t0 + 0.12);
    osc1.connect(gain1);
    gain1.connect(ctx.destination);
    osc1.start(t0);
    osc1.stop(t0 + 0.12);

    // Pulse 2: 120ms beep after 60ms silence (starts at t0 + 0.18s)
    const t1 = t0 + 0.18;
    const osc2 = ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain2 = ctx.createGain();
    osc2.type = 'sine';
    osc2.frequency.setValueAtTime(frequency, t1);
    gain2.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, t1);
    gain2.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t1 + 0.12);
    osc2.connect(gain2);
    gain2.connect(ctx.destination);
    osc2.start(t1);
    osc2.stop(t1 + 0.12);

    lastChimeTimestamp = now;
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Test helper to reset internal singleton state between isolated test runs.
 */
export function _resetAudioStateForTesting(): void {
  isMutedState = false;
  lastChimeTimestamp = 0;
  sharedAudioContext = null;
}
```
