### What This Code Does
This helper triggers physical haptic vibration patterns on supported mobile devices using navigator.vibrate.
It provides distinct vibration cadences for standard notifications, nearby hazard warnings, and emergency SOS alerts.
This provides tactile warnings to users walking or commuting in noisy urban environments.

```typescript
/**
 * Mobile Vibration Wrapper for Danger Zone Proximity Alerts
 *
 * Implements haptic feedback using browser-standard navigator.vibrate([300, 150, 300])
 * (300ms vibration, 150ms pause, 300ms vibration).
 *
 * Features defensive feature checks for platforms that lack the Vibration API
 * (such as iOS Safari and desktop browsers), failing safely and returning false
 * without throwing runtime exceptions.
 */

export const DEFAULT_VIBRATION_PATTERN = [300, 150, 300];

/**
 * Checks if the current environment supports the W3C Vibration API.
 */
export function isVibrationSupported(): boolean {
  return (
    typeof navigator !== 'undefined' &&
    'vibrate' in navigator &&
    typeof (navigator as unknown as { vibrate?: unknown }).vibrate === 'function'
  );
}

/**
 * Triggers a danger proximity vibration pattern on supported mobile devices.
 *
 * @param pattern - Millisecond vibration pattern. Defaults to [300, 150, 300].
 * @returns boolean - True if vibration was dispatched to the device, false if unsupported,
 *                   pattern was invalid, or device blocked vibration.
 */
export function triggerDangerVibration(
  pattern: number[] = DEFAULT_VIBRATION_PATTERN
): boolean {
  if (!isVibrationSupported()) {
    return false;
  }

  if (
    !Array.isArray(pattern) ||
    pattern.length === 0 ||
    pattern.every((duration) => typeof duration !== 'number' || duration <= 0)
  ) {
    return false;
  }

  try {
    return Boolean(navigator.vibrate(pattern));
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}
```

### What This Code Does
This utility interfaces with the browser Notification API to display native desktop and mobile OS notifications.
It requests user notification permissions and formats notification title, icon, and body strings.
It ensures users receive critical safety alerts even when the browser tab is minimized or in the background.

```typescript
/**
 * Browser System Notification Service for Hazard Proximity
 *
 * Dispatches high-priority visual notifications to the operating system notification
 * center using the browser's Service Worker (`registration.showNotification()`)
 * with fallback to window-level `new Notification()`.
 *
 * ============================================================================
 * ARCHITECTURAL SPECIFICATION: FOREGROUND CLIENT GPS vs. BACKEND WEB PUSH
 * ============================================================================
 *
 * 1. Client-Side Geospatial Execution Model:
 *    bd-safety-map executes all hazard proximity evaluations entirely within the
 *    client browser engine using pure Haversine spherical trigonometry. This
 *    preserves 100% user privacy (coordinates never leave the device) and incurs
 *    strictly $0 in external cloud infrastructure or mapping API costs.
 *
 * 2. Foreground vs. Background Tab Notification Delivery:
 *    - Foreground Tab: When the application is open and active, proximity alerts
 *      trigger HUD warning banners, Web Audio chimes, and haptic vibrations.
 *    - Background Tab: When the user switches tabs or minimizes the browser,
 *      modern browsers (Chrome, Edge, Firefox) maintain the active Web Worker
 *      and Geolocation watchPosition for a grace period. When an entry event occurs,
 *      `navigator.serviceWorker.ready.then(reg => reg.showNotification())` or the
 *      Notification constructor displays a native OS notification.
 *
 * 3. Mobile Device Sleep & OS Process Suspension Limitations:
 *    Both Apple iOS (WebKit) and Android (Chromium) deliberately suspend JavaScript
 *    execution and terminate `navigator.geolocation.watchPosition` timers when
 *    the device screen sleeps or the browser application is fully backgrounded.
 *    This is a hard OS-level battery conservation and privacy sandbox boundary.
 *
 * 4. Architectural Requirements for True "Device-Asleep" Background Push:
 *    To wake a locked, sleeping device when approaching a hazard, an application must
 *    employ the W3C Web Push Protocol (RFC 8030 / RFC 8291 / RFC 8292):
 *    a) User must grant Push permission, generating a `PushSubscription` endpoint.
 *    b) Client coordinates would need to be continuously streamed to a backend
 *       server (introducing privacy trade-offs and network data consumption).
 *    c) Server-side spatial geofencing algorithms (PostGIS / spatial indexing)
 *       would detect radius intersections and sign a Web Push message using VAPID
 *       (Voluntary Application Server Identification) key pairs.
 *    d) The push message is delivered through platform Push Services (Apple APNs /
 *       Google FCM) which wake the device's network radio and invoke the Service
 *       Worker `push` event handler.
 *
 *    In bd-safety-map, foreground and active background-tab tracking are fully supported
 *    without requiring continuous coordinate streaming or paid backend infrastructure.
 * ============================================================================
 */

export interface DangerZoneHazardMetadata {
  id: string;
  title?: string;
  category: string;
  locationName?: string;
  description?: string;
  coordinates?: {
    lat: number;
    lng: number;
  };
}

/**
 * Returns current Notification permission state or 'denied' if unsupported.
 */
export function getNotificationPermission(): NotificationPermission {
  if (typeof Notification === 'undefined') {
    return 'denied';
  }
  return Notification.permission;
}

/**
 * Requests system notification permission from the user.
 * Safe to call on user gestures; never throws errors on denial or unsupported platforms.
 */
export async function requestNotificationPermission(): Promise<NotificationPermission> {
  if (typeof Notification === 'undefined') {
    return 'denied';
  }

  try {
    if (typeof Notification.requestPermission === 'function') {
      return await Notification.requestPermission();
    }
    return Notification.permission;
  } catch {
    return 'denied';
  }
}

/**
 * Dispatches a native operating system notification for an entered danger zone.
 * Attempts ServiceWorker registration first, then falls back to window Notification.
 *
 * @param hazard - Hazard metadata (id, title, category, etc.)
 * @param distanceMeters - Geodesic distance in meters to hazard center.
 * @returns boolean - True if notification was emitted, false if denied or unsupported.
 */
export async function showDangerSystemNotification(
  hazard: DangerZoneHazardMetadata,
  distanceMeters: number
): Promise<boolean> {
  if (getNotificationPermission() !== 'granted') {
    return false;
  }

  const roundedDistance = Math.max(0, Math.round(distanceMeters));
  const categoryLabel = hazard.category || 'Hazard';
  const titleLabel = hazard.title ? `${categoryLabel} - ${hazard.title}` : categoryLabel;

  // Title: ⚠️ DANGER ZONE ALERT: [Category/Title]
  const title = `⚠️ DANGER ZONE ALERT: ${titleLabel}`;

  // Body: You are [distance]m from an active danger zone. Stay alert.
  const body = `You are ${roundedDistance}m from an active danger zone. Stay alert.`;

  const options: NotificationOptions & { renotify?: boolean } = {
    body,
    icon: '/icon-192x192.png',
    badge: '/badge-72x72.png',
    tag: `hazard-${hazard.id}`,
    renotify: false,
    data: {
      hazardId: hazard.id,
      distanceMeters: roundedDistance,
      coordinates: hazard.coordinates,
    },
  };

  // Attempt Service Worker registration first
  if (
    typeof navigator !== 'undefined' &&
    'serviceWorker' in navigator &&
    navigator.serviceWorker &&
    typeof navigator.serviceWorker.ready !== 'undefined'
  ) {
    try {
      const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.ready;
      if (registration && typeof registration.showNotification === 'function') {
        await registration.showNotification(title, options);
        return true;
      }
    } catch {
      // Graceful fallback to window-level Notification constructor
    }
  }

  // Fallback to window-level Notification API
  try {
    if (typeof Notification !== 'undefined') {
      new Notification(title, options);
      return true;
    }
  } catch {
    return false;
  }

  return false;
}
```

## [File 80] `apps/web/lib/webPush.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/web/lib/webPush.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 57  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This module handles Web Push subscription management using VAPID public keys.
It converts URL-safe base64 VAPID keys to Uint8Array format, registers PushManager subscriptions, and sends them to the API.
This enables persistent server-initiated push alerts even after the browser session closes.

```typescript
/**
 * Web Push VAPID Utilities & Standard Key Defaults
 */

/**
 * Application default VAPID public key (P-256 base64url uncompressed 65-byte EC point)
 * Used as standard Web Push applicationServerKey when NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY is not overridden.
 */
export const DEFAULT_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY =
  "BEtmSYaZLymwNuQkRyYVz9YxDEE24DnaZps-8EWvh_Q6v9Hy1kTKXUxb1WvOLieZuaPcEKLpEkBD0WBjP49bxNE";

/**
 * Convert URL-safe base64 VAPID key into bytes for PushManager.subscribe.
 * Handles both browser atob and Node.js Buffer environments safely.
 * Strips surrounding whitespace and wrapping quotes.
 */
export const urlBase64ToUint8Array = (base64String: string): Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer> => {
  if (!base64String || typeof base64String !== "string") {
    throw new Error("Invalid VAPID base64 key: value must be a non-empty string");
  }

  const clean = base64String.trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, "");
  if (!clean) {
    throw new Error("Invalid VAPID base64 key: string is empty after trimming");
  }

  const padding = "=".repeat((4 - (clean.length % 4)) % 4);
  const base64 = (clean + padding).replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/");
  const atobFn =
    typeof window !== "undefined" && typeof window.atob === "function"
      ? window.atob.bind(window)
      : typeof atob === "function"
      ? atob
      : (str: string) => Buffer.from(str, "base64").toString("binary");

  let rawData: string;
  try {
    rawData = atobFn(base64);
  } catch (err: any) {
    throw new Error(`Failed to decode base64 VAPID key: ${err?.message || "Invalid encoding"}`);
  }

  const output = new Uint8Array(new ArrayBuffer(rawData.length));
  for (let i = 0; i < rawData.length; ++i) {
    output[i] = rawData.charCodeAt(i);
  }
  return output;
};

/**
 * Resolve the active VAPID public key from environment or fallback default.
 */
export const getVapidPublicKey = (): string => {
  const envKey = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY?.trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, "");
  return envKey || DEFAULT_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY;
};
```

### What This Code Does
This utility orchestrates incident photo uploads from the browser to cloud storage buckets.

It returns uploaded image URLs to attach to the final incident submission payload.

```typescript
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";

export const ALLOWED_EVIDENCE_MIME_TYPES = [
  "image/jpeg",
  "image/png",
  "image/webp",
] as const;

export const MAX_EVIDENCE_FILE_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024; // 5MB

export interface PresignedUrlResponse {
  uploadUrl: string;
  fileKey: string;
  publicUrl: string;
  expiresInSeconds: number;
  isMock?: boolean;
}

export interface ConfirmedMediaResponse {
  id: string;
  reportId: string;
  blurredUrl: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
}

export type EvidenceValidationResult =
  | { valid: true }
  | {
      valid: false;
      code: "EMPTY_FILE" | "UNSUPPORTED_TYPE" | "FILE_TOO_LARGE";
      message: string;
    };

export function validateEvidenceFile(file: File): EvidenceValidationResult {
  if (!ALLOWED_EVIDENCE_MIME_TYPES.includes(file.type as (typeof ALLOWED_EVIDENCE_MIME_TYPES)[number])) {
    return {
      valid: false,
      code: "UNSUPPORTED_TYPE",
      message: "Unsupported image format. Please select a JPEG, PNG, or WebP photo.",
    };
  }

  if (!file.size || file.size <= 0) {
    return {
      valid: false,
      code: "EMPTY_FILE",
      message: "Selected image file is empty.",
    };
  }

  if (file.size > MAX_EVIDENCE_FILE_BYTES) {
    return {
      valid: false,
      code: "FILE_TOO_LARGE",
      message: "File size exceeds the 5MB maximum limit.",
    };
  }

  return { valid: true };
}

function estimateBase64Bytes(dataUrl: string): number {
  const commaIdx = dataUrl.indexOf(",");
  if (commaIdx === -1) return Infinity;
  const base64 = dataUrl.slice(commaIdx + 1);
  return Math.ceil((base64.length * 3) / 4);
}

/**
 * Downscales and compresses an evidence image in-browser for S3-less mock environments.
 */
export async function compressImageToDataUrl(
  file: File,
  maxDimension = 1024,
  maxBytes = 350 * 1024
): Promise<string> {
  const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
  try {
    const img = await new Promise<HTMLImageElement>((resolve, reject) => {
      const el = new Image();
      el.onload = () => resolve(el);
      el.onerror = () => reject(new Error("Could not decode selected image for upload."));
      el.src = objectUrl;
    });

    const naturalW = img.naturalWidth || img.width || maxDimension;
    const naturalH = img.naturalHeight || img.height || maxDimension;
    const initialScale = Math.min(1, maxDimension / Math.max(naturalW, naturalH));

    const preferredMime =
      file.type === "image/webp" ? "image/webp" : "image/jpeg";

    for (const scaleFactor of [1, 0.75, 0.55]) {
      const targetW = Math.max(1, Math.round(naturalW * initialScale * scaleFactor));
      const targetH = Math.max(1, Math.round(naturalH * initialScale * scaleFactor));

      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = targetW;
      canvas.height = targetH;

      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
      if (!ctx) {
        throw new Error("Browser canvas is unavailable to compress evidence photo.");
      }
      ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, targetW, targetH);

      for (const mime of [preferredMime, "image/jpeg"] as const) {
        for (const quality of [0.82, 0.7, 0.56, 0.42]) {
          const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL(mime, quality);
          if (
            (dataUrl.startsWith("data:image/jpeg;base64,") ||
              dataUrl.startsWith("data:image/webp;base64,") ||
              dataUrl.startsWith("data:image/png;base64,")) &&
            estimateBase64Bytes(dataUrl) <= maxBytes
          ) {
            return dataUrl;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    throw new Error("Compressed photo still exceeds mock upload size limit (350KB). Please choose a smaller image.");
  } finally {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
  }
}

/**
 * Full citizen photo evidence pipeline:
 * 1. Requests presigned upload metadata (`GET /media/presigned-url`).
 * 2. When S3/R2/Supabase Storage is configured (`isMock === false`):
 *    performs direct binary PUT to `uploadUrl`, then confirms via `POST /media/confirm`
 *    with `{ reportId, fileKey, originalUrl: publicUrl }`.
 * 3. When cloud S3 is unconfigured (`isMock === true`):
 *    compresses the image client-side and submits via `POST /media/mock-upload`.
 */
export async function uploadReportEvidence(
  reportId: string,
  file: File
): Promise<ConfirmedMediaResponse> {
  const validation = validateEvidenceFile(file);
  if (!validation.valid) {
    throw new Error(validation.message);
  }

  const query = new URLSearchParams({
    reportId,
    fileType: file.type,
    fileSize: String(file.size),
  });

  const presigned = await apiFetch<PresignedUrlResponse>(
    `/media/presigned-url?${query.toString()}`
  );

  if (presigned.isMock) {
    const imageDataUrl = await compressImageToDataUrl(file);
    return apiFetch<ConfirmedMediaResponse>("/media/mock-upload", {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({
        reportId,
        imageDataUrl,
      }),
    });
  }

  const putRes = await fetch(presigned.uploadUrl, {
    method: "PUT",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": file.type,
    },
    body: file,
  });

  if (!putRes.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Direct cloud storage upload failed (HTTP ${putRes.status}).`);
  }

  return apiFetch<ConfirmedMediaResponse>("/media/confirm", {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify({
      reportId,
      fileKey: presigned.fileKey,
      originalUrl: presigned.publicUrl,
    }),
  });
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * Detects mobile devices and viewports (mobile user-agent, iPadOS, coarse pointer, touch points, or compact screens).
 */
export function isMobileDevice(): boolean {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return false;
  const ua = typeof navigator !== "undefined" && navigator.userAgent ? navigator.userAgent : "";
  const isMobileUa = /Android|webOS|iPhone|iPad|iPod|BlackBerry|IEMobile|Opera Mini/i.test(ua);
  const maxTouch =
    typeof navigator !== "undefined" && navigator.maxTouchPoints != null ? navigator.maxTouchPoints : 0;
  const isTouch = "ontouchstart" in window || maxTouch > 0;
  // Modern iPadOS (iOS 13+) identifies as Macintosh with touch points
  const isIPad = maxTouch > 1 && /Macintosh/i.test(ua);
  const isCoarsePointer =
    typeof window.matchMedia === "function" && window.matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches;
  const width = typeof window.innerWidth === "number" ? window.innerWidth : 1024;
  const isSmallScreen = width <= 768;
  const isTabletTouch = isTouch && width <= 1024;

  return isMobileUa || isIPad || (isTouch && isCoarsePointer) || isTabletTouch || isSmallScreen;
}
```

### What This Code Does
This helper provides pure utility functions to filter and sort arrays of incident reports.
It applies category filtering, severity filtering, time-range slicing, and text search across reports.
It ensures fast, unlagged client-side filtering without redundant network requests.

```typescript
import { IncidentCategory } from '@repo/shared';

/**
 * Checks if an incident category matches any of the user's selected multi-select categories.
 * Handles exact matches, smart combinational crimes (e.g. THEFT_ROBBERY matches THEFT or ROBBERY),
 * and legacy aliases.
 */
export function isIncidentCategoryMatch(
  incidentCategory: string,
  selectedCategories: IncidentCategory[]
): boolean {
  if (!selectedCategories || selectedCategories.length === 0) {
    return true;
  }

  // Exact match
  if (selectedCategories.includes(incidentCategory as IncidentCategory)) {
    return true;
  }

  // Smart combination matches:
  // If incident is THEFT_ROBBERY, matches if user selected THEFT or ROBBERY
  if (incidentCategory === 'THEFT_ROBBERY') {
    if (selectedCategories.includes('THEFT') || selectedCategories.includes('ROBBERY')) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  // If incident is SNATCHING_ARMED_ASSAULT, matches if user selected SNATCHING or ARMED_ASSAULT
  if (incidentCategory === 'SNATCHING_ARMED_ASSAULT') {
    if (selectedCategories.includes('SNATCHING') || selectedCategories.includes('ARMED_ASSAULT')) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  // If incident is TEEN_GANG_ARMED_ASSAULT
  if (incidentCategory === 'TEEN_GANG_ARMED_ASSAULT') {
    if (
      selectedCategories.includes('YOUTH_GANG_ACTIVITY') ||
      selectedCategories.includes('ARMED_ASSAULT')
    ) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  // Legacy aliases
  if (incidentCategory === 'MUGGING' && selectedCategories.includes('SNATCHING')) return true;
  if (incidentCategory === 'DACOITY' && selectedCategories.includes('ROBBERY')) return true;
  if (
    incidentCategory === 'THEFT_DACOITY' &&
    (selectedCategories.includes('THEFT') || selectedCategories.includes('ROBBERY'))
  ) {
    return true;
  }
  if (incidentCategory === 'TEEN_GANG' && selectedCategories.includes('YOUTH_GANG_ACTIVITY')) {
    return true;
  }
  if (incidentCategory === 'DRUG_ACTIVITY' && selectedCategories.includes('DRUG_RELATED_CRIME')) {
    return true;
  }

  return false;
}
```

```typescript
import React from "react";

import {

  formatCategoryLabel,
  getCategoryDescription,
  getCategoryAriaLabel,

} from "./incidentCategoryVisuals";

export {

  getCategoryDescription,
  getCategoryAriaLabel,
  CATEGORY_VISUALS,
  UNKNOWN_CATEGORY_VISUAL,

/**
 * Cleans raw news headlines by stripping bracketed feed aggregator prefixes
 * (e.g. "[Google News BD Safety (Bangla)]") and trailing source suffixes
 * (e.g. " - dhakapost.com", " - প্রথম আলো", or " dbcnews.tv").
 */
export function cleanIncidentTitle(rawTitle: string): string {
  if (!rawTitle) return "";

  // 1. Strip leading [Source] or [Google News ...] tags
  let cleaned = rawTitle
    .replace(/^\[(?:Google News[^\]]*|The Daily Star[^\]]*|Press:[^\]]*)\]\s*/i, "")
    .trim();

  // 2. Strip trailing publisher credits like "- dhakapost.com", "- প্রথম আলো", or " dbcnews.tv"
  cleaned = cleaned
    .replace(
      /\s*[-–—|]\s*(?:[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+\.[a-zA-Z]{2,}|প্রথম আলো|দৈনিক ইত্তেফাক|যুগান্তর|কালের কণ্ঠ|সমকাল|ইনকিলাব|মানবজমিন|banglanews24|dhakapost|bdnews24|prothomalo|daily star|daily observer|ajker patrika|the business standard|jagonews24|bangladesh pratidin|bd bulletin|sarabangla|cvoice24|dbc news|dbcnews).*$/i,
      ""
    )
    .trim();

  // 3. Strip trailing media outlet domain or brand suffix directly attached at the end
  cleaned = cleaned
    .replace(
      /\s+(?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]+\.(?:tv|com|org|net|bd|info|xyz|me|news|live)|dbcnews\.tv|dhakapost\.com|banglanews24\.com|bdnews24\.com|prothomalo\.com|dbc news|dbcnews)\s*$/i,
      ""
    )
    .trim();

  return cleaned || rawTitle;
}
```

### What This Code Does
This configuration module maps threat categories to their visual styling attributes.
It defines color palettes (e.g., orange for snatching, red for armed assault), Lucide icon associations, and badge styles.
This ensures consistent, recognizable visual hierarchy across map markers, feeds, and detail cards.

```typescript
import React from "react";
import {
  Car,
  KeyRound,
  Skull,
  PackageX,
  Grab,
  Swords,
  Crosshair,
  Banknote,
  Users,
  UsersRound,
  Pill,
  LightbulbOff,
  ShieldBan,
  Flame,
  Zap,
  Megaphone,
  AlertTriangle,
  Siren,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Language, IncidentCategory } from "@repo/shared";
import { translations } from "@/lib/translations";

export interface IncidentCategoryVisual {
  canonicalCategory: string;
  icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>;
  getSvg: (size?: number) => string;
  labelEn: string;
  labelBn: string;
  descriptionEn: string;
  descriptionBn: string;
  badgeClass: string;
  accentColor: string;
  ariaLabelEn: string;
  ariaLabelBn: string;
}

/**
 * Universal fallback visual for unknown, missing, or unclassified categories.
 * Strict invariant: MUST NOT default to Car or any unrelated incident type.
 */
export const UNKNOWN_CATEGORY_VISUAL: IncidentCategoryVisual = {
  canonicalCategory: "UNKNOWN",
  icon: AlertTriangle,
  getSvg: (size = 14) =>
    `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${size}" height="${size}" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" style="transform: translateY(-0.5px);"><path d="m21.73 18-8-14a2 2 0 0 0-3.48 0l-8 14A2 2 0 0 0 4 21h16a2 2 0 0 0 1.73-3Z"/><line x1="12" y1="9" x2="12" y2="13"/><line x1="12" y1="17" x2="12.01" y2="17"/></svg>`,
  labelEn: "Unclassified Incident",
  labelBn: "অনির্ধারিত ঘটনা",
  descriptionEn: "Reported public safety hazard with pending classification",
  descriptionBn: "রিপোর্টকৃত নিরাপত্তা ঘটনা (শ্রেণি যাচাইকরণ প্রক্রিয়াধীন)",
  badgeClass: "bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 border-slate-200",
  accentColor: "#64748B",
  ariaLabelEn: "Unclassified public safety hazard",
  ariaLabelBn: "অনির্ধারিত সাধারণ নিরাপত্তা সতর্কতা",
};

    labelEn: "Harassment",
    labelBn: "নিপীড়ন / হয়রানি",
    descriptionEn: "Public stalking, street harassment, eve-teasing",
    descriptionBn: "পথেঘাটে হয়রানি ও উত্ত্যক্তকরণ",
    badgeClass: "bg-pink-50 text-pink-700 border-pink-200",
    accentColor: "#BE185D",
    ariaLabelEn: "Harassment hazard",
    ariaLabelBn: "হয়রানির সতর্কতা",
  },

  // 17. Violence / Riot: Emergency alarm / riot alert
  VIOLENCE_RIOT: {
    canonicalCategory: "VIOLENCE_RIOT",
    icon: Siren,
    getSvg: (size = 14) =>
      `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${size}" height="${size}" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M7 12a5 5 0 0 1 10 0v4H7v-4Z"/><path d="M5 20h14"/><path d="M12 4v2"/><path d="m4.93 7.93 1.41 1.41"/><path d="m19.07 7.93-1.41 1.41"/></svg>`,
    labelEn: "Riot / Unrest",
    labelBn: "দাঙ্গা / সংঘর্ষ",
    descriptionEn: "Civil unrest, riot, mob clashes",
    descriptionBn: "দাঙ্গা, বিশৃঙ্খলা ও গণসংঘর্ষ",
    badgeClass: "bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 border-rose-300 font-bold",
    accentColor: "#991B1B",
    ariaLabelEn: "Riot and civil unrest hazard",
    ariaLabelBn: "দাঙ্গা ও গণসংঘর্ষের সতর্কতা",
  },
};

/**
 * Backward compatibility alias mappings
 */
const CATEGORY_ALIASES: Record<string, string> = {
  MUGGING: "SNATCHING",
  DACOITY: "ROBBERY",
  THEFT_DACOITY: "THEFT_ROBBERY",
  TEEN_GANG: "YOUTH_GANG_ACTIVITY",
  DRUG_ACTIVITY: "DRUG_RELATED_CRIME",
  ACCIDENT: "ROAD_ACCIDENT",
  ROBBERY_CRIME: "ROBBERY",
  GENERAL_ALERT: "UNKNOWN",
};

/**
 * Normalizes any category string into its canonical category key.
 */
export function normalizeCategoryKey(rawCategory: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!rawCategory) return "UNKNOWN";
  const upper = rawCategory.trim().toUpperCase();
  if (CATEGORY_ALIASES[upper]) {
    return CATEGORY_ALIASES[upper];
  }
  if (CATEGORY_VISUALS[upper]) {
    return upper;
  }
  // Try case-insensitive lookup
  const found = Object.keys(CATEGORY_VISUALS).find(
    (k) => k.toLowerCase() === rawCategory.trim().toLowerCase()
  );
  return found || "UNKNOWN";
}

/**
 * Retrieves the complete IncidentCategoryVisual for any given incident category.
 * If the category is unknown or unsupported, returns UNKNOWN_CATEGORY_VISUAL and logs
 * the classification problem for diagnostic investigation.
 * Strict invariant: NEVER defaults to Car icon.
 */
export function getCategoryVisual(category: string | null | undefined): IncidentCategoryVisual {
  const normKey = normalizeCategoryKey(category);
  const visual = CATEGORY_VISUALS[normKey];

  if (!visual) {
    if (category && category !== "UNKNOWN" && category !== "general_alert") {
      console.warn(
        `[CategoryVisuals] Unknown or unclassified incident category received: "${category}". Using neutral generic alert.`
      );
    }
    return UNKNOWN_CATEGORY_VISUAL;
  }

  return visual;
}

/**
 * Returns the matching Lucide icon component for any incident category.
 */
export function getCategoryIcon(
  category: string | null | undefined
): React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }> {
  return getCategoryVisual(category).icon;
}

/**
 * Returns the vector SVG markup string for any incident category.
 */
export function getCategorySvg(category: string | null | undefined, size = 14): string {
  return getCategoryVisual(category).getSvg(size);
}

/**
 * Returns the Tailwind CSS badge class string for any incident category.
 */
export function getCategoryBadgeClass(category: string | null | undefined): string {
  return getCategoryVisual(category).badgeClass;
}

/**
 * Returns the localized human-readable category display label.
 */
export function formatCategoryLabel(
  category: string | null | undefined,
  language: Language = "en"
): string {
  if (!category) return "";
  const visual = getCategoryVisual(category);
  if (visual.canonicalCategory !== "UNKNOWN") {
    return language === "bn" ? visual.labelBn : visual.labelEn;
  }

  // If UNKNOWN/unrecognized by CATEGORY_VISUALS, check translations table first
  const categories = translations[language]?.categories as Record<string, string> | undefined;
  const fallbackCategories = translations.en.categories as Record<string, string>;
  const upper = category.toUpperCase();
  const lower = category.toLowerCase();

  const translated =
    categories?.[category] ??
    categories?.[upper] ??
    categories?.[lower] ??
    fallbackCategories?.[category] ??
    fallbackCategories?.[upper] ??
    fallbackCategories?.[lower];

  if (translated) {
    return translated;
  }

  const cleaned = category.replace(/_/g, " ").trim();
  if (cleaned && cleaned.toLowerCase() !== "unknown") {
    if (language === "bn") {
      return visual.labelBn;
    }
    return cleaned.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + cleaned.slice(1);
  }
  return language === "bn" ? visual.labelBn : visual.labelEn;
}

/**
 * Returns the localized descriptive text explaining the incident category.
 */
export function getCategoryDescription(
  category: string | null | undefined,
  language: Language = "en"
): string {
  const visual = getCategoryVisual(category);
  return language === "bn" ? visual.descriptionBn : visual.descriptionEn;
}

/**
 * Returns accessible ARIA label for screen readers.
 */
export function getCategoryAriaLabel(
  category: string | null | undefined,
  language: Language = "en"
): string {
  const visual = getCategoryVisual(category);
  return language === "bn" ? visual.ariaLabelBn : visual.ariaLabelEn;
}
```

## [File 86] `apps/web/lib/mapMarkerUtils.ts`

### What This Code Does
This utility creates customized Leaflet HTML markers and SVG icons for map rendering.
It constructs pulsating threat markers, category badges, and color-coded safe-zone pins.
It optimizes marker DOM complexity to maintain smooth 60 FPS panning and zooming on mobile browsers.

```typescript
import L from "leaflet";
import { IncidentSeverity } from "@repo/shared";
import { getCategorySvg, getCategoryVisual } from "./incidentCategoryVisuals";

export { getCategorySvg, getCategoryVisual };

export interface MarkerDimensionConfig {
  size: number;
  iconSize: number;
  borderWidth: number;
}

/**
 * Responsive sizing rules according to map zoom level:
 * - Zoom <= 11: Compact 22px beacon (avoids overlap in national/district views while skipping nothing)
 * - Zoom 12-14: Balanced 28px safety badge (optimal for city/ward level navigation)
 * - Zoom >= 15: Prominent 32px tactile badge (high-definition street level)
 */
export function getMarkerDimensions(zoom: number = 13): MarkerDimensionConfig {
  if (zoom <= 11) {
    return { size: 22, iconSize: 11, borderWidth: 1.5 };
  }
  if (zoom <= 14) {
    return { size: 28, iconSize: 14, borderWidth: 2 };
  }
  return { size: 32, iconSize: 16, borderWidth: 2.5 };
}

/**
 * Palette configuration for each incident severity.
 * Decoupled from incident category: severity dictates danger signaling (color, glow, halo),
 * while category dictates the vector icon inside the marker badge.
 */
export function getSeverityColors(severity: IncidentSeverity) {
  const norm = (severity || "").toUpperCase();

  switch (norm) {
    case "CRITICAL":
      return {
        bg: "#E11D48", // Rose-600
        border: "#FFFFFF",
        glow: "rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.45)",
        halo: "rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.55)",
      };
    case "HIGH":
      return {
        bg: "#DC2626", // Red-600
        border: "#FFFFFF",
        glow: "rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.45)",
        halo: "rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.55)",
      };
    case "MEDIUM":
      return {
        bg: "#EA580C", // Orange-600
        border: "#FFFFFF",
        glow: "rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.35)",
        halo: "rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.35)",
      };
    case "LOW":
    default:
      return {
        bg: "#D97706", // Amber-600
        border: "#FFFFFF",
        glow: "rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.3)",
        halo: "rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.3)",
      };
  }
}

/**
 * Creates a perfectly centered, responsive, category-specific Danger Marker icon.
 * Preserves category identity across zoom levels, map styles, and severities.
 */
export function createDangerMarkerIcon(
  category: string,
  severity: IncidentSeverity,
  zoom: number = 13
): L.DivIcon {
  const norm = (severity || "").toUpperCase();
  const isHigh = norm === "HIGH" || norm === "CRITICAL";
  const { size, iconSize, borderWidth } = getMarkerDimensions(zoom);
  const colors = getSeverityColors(severity);
  const svg = getCategorySvg(category, iconSize);

  return L.divIcon({
    className: "custom-danger-pin",
    html: `
      <div style="
        position: relative;
        width: ${size}px;
        height: ${size}px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
      ">
        ${
          isHigh
            ? `<span class="tactical-halo-pulse" style="
                position: absolute;
                inset: -3px;
                border-radius: 50%;
                background: radial-gradient(circle, ${colors.halo} 0%, rgba(220, 38, 38, 0) 70%);
                pointer-events: none;
              "></span>`
            : ""
        }
        <div class="danger-pin-badge" style="
          position: relative;
          background-color: ${colors.bg};
          border: ${borderWidth}px solid ${colors.border};
          width: ${size}px;
          height: ${size}px;
          border-radius: 50%;
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          color: #FFFFFF;
          box-shadow: 0 4px 12px ${colors.glow}, 0 2px 4px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.22);
          cursor: pointer;
          transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
        ">
          ${svg}
        </div>
      </div>
    `,
    iconSize: [size, size],
    iconAnchor: [size / 2, size / 2],
    popupAnchor: [0, -Math.round(size / 2 + 4)],
  });
}

/**
 * Creates a crisp Safe Haven sanctuary pin (Police, Hospital, Pharmacy, Fire Station).
 */
export function createSafeZoneIcon(
  type: string,
  isSelected: boolean = false
): L.DivIcon {
  const normType = (type || "").trim().toUpperCase();
  const isPolice = normType === "POLICE_BOX" || normType === "POLICE_STATION";
  const isHospital = normType === "HOSPITAL";
  const isPharmacy = normType === "PHARMACY";
  const isFireStation = normType === "FIRE_STATION";

  let bgColor = "#4F46E5";
  let iconSvg = "";

  if (isPolice) {
    bgColor = "#4F46E5";
    iconSvg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 22s8-4 8-10V5l-8-3-8 3v7c0 6 8 10 8 10z"/></svg>`;
  } else if (isHospital) {
    bgColor = "#2563EB";
    iconSvg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 6v12"/><path d="M6 12h12"/></svg>`;
  } else if (isPharmacy) {
    bgColor = "#059669";
    iconSvg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m10.5 20.5 10-10a4.95 4.95 0 1 0-7-7l-10 10a4.95 4.95 0 1 0 7 7Z"/><path d="m8.5 8.5 7 7"/></svg>`;
  } else if (isFireStation) {
    bgColor = "#EA580C";
    iconSvg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M8.5 14.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 0 11 12c0-1.38-.5-2-1-3-1.072-2.143-.224-4.054 2-6 .5 2.5 2 4.9 4 6.5 2 1.6 3 3.5 3 5.5a7 7 0 1 1-14 0c0-1.153.433-2.294 1-3a2.5 2.5 0 0 0 2.5 2.5z"/></svg>`;
  } else {
    bgColor = "#4F46E5";
    iconSvg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 22s8-4 8-10V5l-8-3-8 3v7c0 6 8 10 8 10z"/></svg>`;
  }

  const size = isSelected ? 38 : 32;

  return L.divIcon({
    className: "custom-safe-pin",
    html: `
      <div style="
        position: relative;
        width: ${size}px;
        height: ${size}px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
      ">
        <div style="
          background-color: ${bgColor};
          border: 2.5px solid #FFFFFF;
          width: ${size}px;
          height: ${size}px;
          border-radius: ${isPolice ? "12px" : "10px"};
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          color: #FFFFFF;
          box-shadow: 0 4px 12px ${bgColor}55, 0 2px 4px rgba(15,23,42,0.18);
          cursor: pointer;
          transform: ${isSelected ? "scale(1.15)" : "scale(1)"};
          transition: transform 0.2s ease;
        ">
          ${iconSvg}
        </div>
      </div>
    `,
    iconSize: [size, size],
    iconAnchor: [size / 2, size / 2],
    popupAnchor: [0, -Math.round(size / 2 + 4)],
  });
}
```

### What This Code Does
This helper module defines metadata, icons, and category descriptors for emergency safe-haven facilities.
It maps facility types (police stations, police boxes, hospitals, pharmacies) to distinct visual icons and colors.
It also formats emergency telephone numbers for direct click-to-call dialing.

```typescript
import type { SafeZoneType } from "@repo/shared";

export type SafeZoneIconKey = "hospital" | "police" | "pharmacy";

export interface SafeZonePresentation {
  type: SafeZoneType;
  label: string;
  shortLabel: string;
  iconKey: SafeZoneIconKey;
  badgeClass: string;
  boxClass: string;
  iconColor: string;
  accentColor: string;
  markerBgColor: string;
  markerRadius: string;
}

/**
 * Normalizes backend/legacy safe zone type strings onto canonical SafeZoneType values.
 */
export function normalizeSafeZoneType(type?: string | null): SafeZoneType {
  const normalized = (type || "").trim().toUpperCase();
  if (normalized === "POLICE_BOX" || normalized === "POLICE_STATION") {
    return "POLICE_BOX";
  }
  if (normalized === "PHARMACY") {
    return "PHARMACY";
  }
  return "HOSPITAL";
}

/**
 * Returns unified bilingual labels, icon keys, and Tailwind/marker styles per SafeZoneType.
 */
export function getSafeZonePresentation(
  type?: string | null,
  language: "en" | "bn" = "en"
): SafeZonePresentation {
  const canonical = normalizeSafeZoneType(type);
  const isBn = language === "bn";

  switch (canonical) {
    case "POLICE_BOX":
      return {
        type: "POLICE_BOX",
        label: isBn ? "পুলিশ স্টেশন / বক্স" : "Police Station / Box",
        shortLabel: isBn ? "পুলিশ স্টেশন" : "Police Station",
        iconKey: "police",
        badgeClass: "bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border-indigo-200",
        boxClass: "bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 border-indigo-200",
        iconColor: "text-indigo-600",
        accentColor: "border-indigo-500",
        markerBgColor: "#4F46E5",
        markerRadius: "12px",
      };
    case "PHARMACY":
      return {
        type: "PHARMACY",
        label: isBn ? "২৪/৭ ফার্মেসি" : "24/7 Pharmacy",
        shortLabel: isBn ? "ফার্মেসি" : "Pharmacy",
        iconKey: "pharmacy",
        badgeClass: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200",
        boxClass: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 border-emerald-200",
        iconColor: "text-emerald-600",
        accentColor: "border-emerald-500",
        markerBgColor: "#059669",
        markerRadius: "10px",
      };
    case "HOSPITAL":
    default:
      return {
        type: "HOSPITAL",
        label: isBn ? "জরুরি হাসপাতাল" : "Emergency Hospital",
        shortLabel: isBn ? "হাসপাতাল" : "Hospital",
        iconKey: "hospital",
        badgeClass: "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border-blue-200",
        boxClass: "bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 border-blue-200",
        iconColor: "text-blue-600",
        accentColor: "border-blue-500",
        markerBgColor: "#2563EB",
        markerRadius: "10px",
      };
  }
}
```

```tsx
    selectedSeverity !== "all" || selectedCategories.length > 0 || searchQuery.trim() !== "";

  const navLinks = [
    { name: isBn ? "লাইভ ম্যাপ" : "Live Map", href: "/", icon: Map },
    { name: isBn ? "ফিড" : "Feed", href: "/feed", icon: ListFilter },
    { name: isBn ? "আশ্রয়স্থল" : "Safe Shelters", href: "/safe-zones", icon: Shield },
    { name: isBn ? "নিরাপদ পথ" : "Safe Routes", href: "/routes", icon: Navigation },

  return (

        <Link href="/" className="flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2.5 shrink-0 group">

            <ShieldAlert className="w-4.5 h-4.5 sm:w-5.5 sm:h-5.5" />

              </span>
              <span className="hidden sm:inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-red-50 text-red-700 border border-red-200 shadow-2xs font-mono whitespace-nowrap">
                <span className="relative flex h-2 w-2">
                  <span className="animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full bg-red-400 opacity-75" />
                  <span className="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2 w-2 bg-red-600" />
                </span>
                <span>{totalIncidents} {isBn ? "সক্রিয়" : "Active"}</span>
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 hidden 2xl:block tracking-wide font-medium whitespace-nowrap">

            </p>

        {/* Primary Desktop Navigation Links: All 7 core views */}
        <nav className="hidden lg:flex items-center gap-0.5 xl:gap-1 bg-slate-100/90 p-0.5 xl:p-1 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 shrink-0">
```

> **Path:** `apps/web/components/layout/CategoryFilterPopover.tsx`

### What This Code Does
This component renders a floating dropdown popover allowing users to filter map incidents by threat category.
Users can toggle individual categories (e.g., theft, snatching, armed assault, road hazards) or select all.
It displays active filter count badges and updates the map radar dynamically in real time.

```tsx
"use client";

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import {
  Filter,
  ChevronDown,
  X,
  Grab,
  Swords,
  Skull,
  KeyRound,
  PackageX,
  Crosshair,
  Banknote,
  Users,
  Pill,
  LightbulbOff,
  Car,
  Check,
  Sparkles,
} from "lucide-react";
import { IncidentCategory } from "@repo/shared";
import { CATEGORY_VISUALS } from "@/lib/incidentCategoryVisuals";

interface FilterOption {
  id: IncidentCategory;
  labelEn: string;
  labelBn: string;
  icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>;
  color: string;
  badgeClass: string;
}

interface FilterGroup {
  groupEn: string;
  groupBn: string;
  icon: string;
  options: FilterOption[];
}

export const FILTER_GROUPS: FilterGroup[] = [
  {
    groupEn: "Violent & Armed Threats",
    groupBn: "সহিংস ও সশস্ত্র অপরাধ",
    icon: "🚨",
    options: [
      {
        id: "SNATCHING",
        labelEn: CATEGORY_VISUALS.SNATCHING.labelEn,

interface CategoryFilterPopoverProps {
  selectedCategories?: IncidentCategory[];
  onToggleCategory?: (category: IncidentCategory) => void;
  onClearCategories?: () => void;
  // Backward compatibility with single-category mode if needed
  selectedCategory?: IncidentCategory | "all";
  onSelectCategory?: (category: IncidentCategory | "all") => void;
  categoryCounts?: Record<string, number>;
  isBn: boolean;
}

export default function CategoryFilterPopover({
  selectedCategories,
  onToggleCategory,
  onClearCategories,
  selectedCategory,
  onSelectCategory,
  categoryCounts = {},
  isBn,
}: CategoryFilterPopoverProps) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  const buttonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const popoverRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [coords, setCoords] = useState<{ top: number; left: number; width: number } | null>(null);

  // Normalize multi-select active list from props
  const activeCategories: IncidentCategory[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (selectedCategories && Array.isArray(selectedCategories)) {
      return selectedCategories;
    }
    if (selectedCategory && selectedCategory !== "all") {
      return [selectedCategory];
    }
    return [];
  }, [selectedCategories, selectedCategory]);

  const handleToggle = (catId: IncidentCategory) => {
    if (onToggleCategory) {
      onToggleCategory(catId);
    } else if (onSelectCategory) {
      const isSelected = activeCategories.includes(catId);
      onSelectCategory(isSelected ? "all" : catId);
    }
  };

  const handleClear = () => {
    if (onClearCategories) {
      onClearCategories();
    } else if (onSelectCategory) {
      onSelectCategory("all");
    }
  };

  // Compute trigger button viewport bounding rect
  const updateCoords = useCallback(() => {
    if (!buttonRef.current) return;
    const rect = buttonRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const isMobile = window.innerWidth < 640;
    const popoverWidth = isMobile ? window.innerWidth - 24 : 480;

    let left = rect.left;
    if (left + popoverWidth > window.innerWidth - 16) {
      left = window.innerWidth - popoverWidth - 16;
    }
    if (left < 12) left = 12;

    setCoords({
      top: rect.bottom + 8,
      left,
      width: popoverWidth,
    });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
    updateCoords();
  }, [updateCoords]);

  // Re-calculate coordinates on open, window resize, or scroll
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      updateCoords();
      const handleReposition = () => updateCoords();
      window.addEventListener("resize", handleReposition);
      window.addEventListener("scroll", handleReposition, true);
      return () => {
        window.removeEventListener("resize", handleReposition);
        window.removeEventListener("scroll", handleReposition, true);
      };
    }
  }, [isOpen, updateCoords]);

  // Close on Escape or click outside
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (e: MouseEvent | TouchEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as Node;
      if (
        popoverRef.current &&
        !popoverRef.current.contains(target) &&
        buttonRef.current &&
        !buttonRef.current.contains(target)
      ) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };

    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") setIsOpen(false);
    };

    if (isOpen) {
      document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
      document.addEventListener("touchstart", handleClickOutside, { passive: true });
      document.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    }
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
      document.removeEventListener("touchstart", handleClickOutside);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [isOpen]);

  const totalCategoriesCount = useMemo(() => {
    return FILTER_GROUPS.reduce((acc, g) => acc + g.options.length, 0);
  }, []);

  const activeOptions = useMemo(() => {
    if (activeCategories.length === 0) return [];
    const list: (typeof FILTER_GROUPS)[0]["options"][0][] = [];
    for (const group of FILTER_GROUPS) {
      for (const opt of group.options) {
        if (activeCategories.includes(opt.id as IncidentCategory)) {
          list.push(opt);
        }
      }
    }
    return list;
  }, [activeCategories]);

  return (
    <div className="relative inline-block text-left shrink-0">
      {/* Trigger Button: Responsive compact sizing for mobile screens (e.g. 375px iPhone) */}
      <button
        ref={buttonRef}
        type="button"
        onClick={() => {
          updateCoords();
          setIsOpen(!isOpen);
        }}
        className={`text-xs px-2 sm:px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl font-bold border flex items-center gap-1 sm:gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs select-none shrink-0 ${
          activeCategories.length > 0
            ? "bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-600 shadow-sm shadow-blue-600/20"
            : isOpen
            ? "bg-slate-100 text-slate-900 border-slate-300 ring-2 ring-blue-500/20"
            : "bg-white text-slate-700 border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 hover:text-slate-900 hover:border-slate-300"
        }`}
        aria-expanded={isOpen}
        aria-haspopup="true"
      >
        <Filter
          className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0 ${
            activeCategories.length > 0 ? "text-white" : "text-slate-500"
          }`}
        />

        {activeOptions.length > 0 ? (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 min-w-0">
            <span className="truncate max-w-[85px] sm:max-w-[130px] text-xs">
              {activeOptions.length === 1
                ? isBn
                  ? activeOptions[0].labelBn
                  : activeOptions[0].labelEn
                : `${isBn ? activeOptions[0].labelBn : activeOptions[0].labelEn} +${
                    activeOptions.length - 1
                  }`}
            </span>
            {activeOptions.length > 1 && (
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-1 py-0.2 rounded-full bg-white/20 text-white shrink-0 hidden sm:inline">
                {activeOptions.length}
              </span>
            )}
            <span
              role="button"
              tabIndex={0}
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                handleClear();
              }}
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  handleClear();
                }
              }}
              className="p-0.5 rounded-full hover:bg-white/20 active:bg-white/30 text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0 ml-0.5"
              title={isBn ? "সব ফিল্টার মুছুন" : "Clear filters"}
            >
              <X className="w-3 h-3" />
            </span>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            <span className="whitespace-nowrap">
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">
                {isBn ? "ক্যাটাগরি ফিল্টার" : "Category Filter"}
              </span>
              <span className="sm:hidden">
                {isBn ? "ক্যাটাগরি" : "Category"}
              </span>
            </span>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full shrink-0 bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border border-slate-200">
              {totalCategoriesCount}
            </span>
          </>
        )}

        <ChevronDown
          className={`w-3 h-3 sm:w-3.5 sm:h-3.5 shrink-0 transition-transform duration-200 ${
            isOpen ? "rotate-180" : ""
          } ${activeCategories.length > 0 ? "text-white" : "text-slate-400"}`}
        />
      </button>

      {/* Floating Popover Menu via React Portal: Escapes ANY parent overflow clipping */}
      {isOpen &&
        mounted &&
        createPortal(
          <>
            {/* Backdrop for click dismissal */}
            <div
              className="fixed inset-0 z-[9998] bg-black/30 sm:bg-black/10 backdrop-blur-xs"
              onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
            />

            {/* Floating Dropdown / Mobile Sheet */}
            <div
              ref={popoverRef}
              style={
                coords && typeof window !== "undefined" && window.innerWidth >= 640
                  ? {
                      position: "fixed",
                      top: `${coords.top}px`,
                      left: `${coords.left}px`,
                      width: `${coords.width}px`,
                    }
                  : undefined
              }
              className={`z-[9999] bg-white border border-slate-200/90 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl p-3.5 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150 overflow-hidden flex flex-col ${
                // Mobile: centered bottom sheet; Desktop: fixed dropdown below button
                "fixed inset-x-3 bottom-4 sm:bottom-auto sm:inset-x-auto max-h-[84vh] sm:max-h-[78vh]"
              }`}
            >
              {/* Header */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2.5 mb-2.5 border-b border-slate-100 px-1 shrink-0">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="p-1.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 border border-blue-200 shadow-2xs">
                    <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </span>
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 leading-tight">
                      {isBn ? "ঘটনার বিভাগ ফিল্টার (মাল্টি-সিলেক্ট)" : "Filter by Incident Category"}
                    </h4>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 leading-tight mt-0.5">
                      {isBn
                        ? "এক বা একাধিক ক্যাটাগরি একসাথে নির্বাচন করুন"
                        : "Select one or multiple categories simultaneously"}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {activeCategories.length > 0 && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleClear}
                    className="text-[11px] font-bold text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800 bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    {isBn ? `সব মুছুন (${activeCategories.length})` : `Clear (${activeCategories.length})`}
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Scrollable Semantic Groups */}
              <div className="space-y-3.5 overflow-y-auto pr-1 flex-1">
                {FILTER_GROUPS.map((group, groupIdx) => (
                  <div key={groupIdx} className="space-y-1.5">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-1 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
                      <span>{group.icon}</span>
                      <span>{isBn ? group.groupBn : group.groupEn}</span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
                      {group.options.map((opt) => {
                        const Icon = opt.icon;
                        const isSelected = activeCategories.includes(opt.id as IncidentCategory);
                        const count = categoryCounts[opt.id] ?? 0;

                        return (
                          <button
                            key={opt.id}
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleToggle(opt.id as IncidentCategory)}
                            className={`w-full p-2 rounded-xl text-left border flex items-center justify-between gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                              isSelected
                                ? "bg-blue-50/90 border-blue-500 ring-1 ring-blue-500/20 shadow-xs"
                                : "bg-white border-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-50 hover:border-slate-200"
                            }`}
                          >
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                              <span
                                className={`p-1.5 rounded-lg shrink-0 ${
                                  isSelected
                                    ? "bg-blue-600 text-white"
                                    : "bg-slate-100 " + opt.color
                                }`}
                              >
                                <Icon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </span>
                              <div className="min-w-0">
                                <span
                                  className={`text-xs block font-bold truncate leading-tight ${
                                    isSelected ? "text-blue-900" : "text-slate-800"
                                  }`}
                                >
                                  {isBn ? opt.labelBn : opt.labelEn}
                                </span>
                                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block truncate leading-tight">
                                  {isBn ? opt.labelEn : opt.labelBn}
                                </span>
                              </div>
                            </div>

                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                              {count > 0 ? (
                                <span
                                  className={`text-[10px] font-bold font-mono px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full border ${
                                    isSelected
                                      ? "bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-600"
                                      : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-200"
                                  }`}
                                >
                                  {count}
                                </span>
                              ) : null}

                              {/* Multi-Select Checkbox Indicator */}
                              <div
                                className={`w-4 h-4 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center transition-colors ${
                                  isSelected
                                    ? "bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-2xs"
                                    : "border-2 border-slate-300 bg-white"
                                }`}
                              >
                                {isSelected && (
                                  <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-white stroke-[3]" />
                                )}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </button>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              {/* Bottom Action / Summary Bar */}
              <div className="pt-3 mt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 shrink-0">
                <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-600 font-medium truncate">
                  {activeCategories.length === 0
                    ? isBn
                      ? "সব ক্যাটাগরি প্রদর্শিত হচ্ছে"
                      : "Showing all categories"
                    : isBn
                    ? `${activeCategories.length}টি ক্যাটাগরি ফিল্টার সক্রিয়`
                    : `${activeCategories.length} categories active`}
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-1.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-bold text-xs rounded-xl shadow-sm transition shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {isBn ? "প্রয়োগ করুন" : "Apply Filter"}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </>,
          document.body
        )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### What This Code Does
This component renders a navigation helper bar used to test and verify application routes.
It provides quick links to all application pages during testing and development.
It adapts dynamically to screen widths and can be toggled without cluttering user interfaces.

```tsx
"use client";

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/store/useAuthStore";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import {
  Map,
  ListFilter,
  PlusCircle,
  Shield,
  Navigation,
  Bell,
  UserCheck,
  FlaskConical,
  Lock,
  Activity,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronUp,
} from "lucide-react";

interface RouteItem {
  name: string;
  href: string;
  icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>;
  description: string;
  adminOnly?: boolean;
}

const ROUTES: RouteItem[] = [
  { name: "Live Map", href: "/", icon: Map, description: "Interactive map with pins & safe zones" },
  { name: "Feed", href: "/feed", icon: ListFilter, description: "Incident feed with filtering & voting" },
  { name: "Report", href: "/report", icon: PlusCircle, description: "Submit incident & test GPS proximity" },
  { name: "Safe Shelters", href: "/safe-zones", icon: Shield, description: "Hospitals, police boxes & pharmacies" },
  { name: "Safe Routes", href: "/routes", icon: Navigation, description: "Pathfinding avoiding active hazards" },
  { name: "Alert Zones", href: "/alerts", icon: Bell, description: "Geofences (25km² max) & Push alerts" },
  { name: "Profile & KYC", href: "/profile", icon: UserCheck, description: "Trust score, device ID & verification" },
  { name: "Admin Portal", href: "/admin", icon: Lock, description: "Purge reports, ban users & news crawl", adminOnly: true },
  { name: "API Test Suite", href: "/dev-test", icon: FlaskConical, description: "Interactive 1-click backend tester" },
];

export default function RouteTestNav() {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const user = useAuthStore((state) => state.user);
  const [backendOnline, setBackendOnline] = useState<boolean | null>(null);
  const [isCollapsed, setIsCollapsed] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Check backend health
    apiFetch<{ success: boolean }>("/health")
      .then(() => setBackendOnline(true))
      .catch(() => setBackendOnline(false));
  }, []);

  if (isCollapsed) {
    return (
      <div className="bg-white/95 border-b border-slate-200 text-slate-600 text-[11px] px-3 sm:px-4 py-1 flex items-center justify-between z-40 relative backdrop-blur-md shadow-2xs">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span
            className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${
              backendOnline === true ? "bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse" : "bg-rose-500"
            }`}
          />
          <span className="font-mono text-slate-700 font-semibold">
            API: {backendOnline === true ? "Online" : backendOnline === false ? "Offline" : "Connecting..."}
          </span>
          {user && (
            <span className="hidden sm:inline text-slate-500">
              • {user.role} (Trust: {user.trustScore})
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={() => setIsCollapsed(false)}
          className="flex items-center gap-1 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 transition-colors px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md hover:bg-slate-100"
        >
          <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase">Route Explorer</span>
          <ChevronDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-500" />
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="bg-white border-b border-slate-200 text-slate-800 text-xs px-3 sm:px-4 py-2 z-40 relative shadow-sm backdrop-blur-md animate-in slide-in-from-top-1 duration-150">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-2">
        {/* Left: Backend Status and Route Guide */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between w-full md:w-auto gap-3 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold tracking-wider uppercase text-[10px] text-blue-600">
              <Activity className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 animate-pulse" />
              <span>Route Explorer</span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-slate-100 border border-slate-200 text-[10px]">
              <span
                className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${
                  backendOnline === true
                    ? "bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse"
                    : backendOnline === false
                    ? "bg-rose-500"
                    : "bg-amber-500 animate-pulse"
                }`}
              />
              <span className="font-mono text-slate-700 font-semibold">
                {backendOnline === true
                  ? "API: Online"
                  : backendOnline === false
                  ? "API: Offline"
                  : "API: Connecting..."}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={() => setIsCollapsed(true)}
            className="md:hidden flex items-center gap-1 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-100"
          >
            <span>Hide</span>
            <ChevronUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Center: Quick navigation links */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto w-full md:w-auto pb-1 md:pb-0 scrollbar-none">
          {ROUTES.map((route) => {
            const isActive = route.href === "/" ? pathname === "/" : pathname?.startsWith(route.href);
            const Icon = route.icon;

            // Only show admin route to admin
            if (route.adminOnly && user?.role !== "ADMIN") return null;

            return (
              <Link
                key={route.href}
                href={route.href}
                title={route.description}
                className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-medium transition-all whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 ${
                  isActive
                    ? "bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-xs font-semibold"
                    : "text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100"
                }`}
              >
                <Icon className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" />
                <span>{route.name}</span>
              </Link>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* Right: Collapse toggle button on desktop */}
        <button
          onClick={() => setIsCollapsed(true)}
          className="hidden md:flex items-center gap-1 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded hover:bg-slate-100 transition"
          title="Collapse Route Explorer"
        >
          <span>Hide</span>
          <ChevronUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

This is the core interactive mapping component built with React-Leaflet.

```tsx
// Map events handler: fetches viewport incidents on pan/zoom without triggering reactive setState feedback loops
function MapEventsHandler({ onUserDragStart }: { onUserDragStart?: () => void }) {
  const fetchIncidentsInBounds = useIncidentStore((state) => state.fetchIncidentsInBounds);
  const debounceRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);

  const map = useMapEvents({
    dragstart: () => {
      onUserDragStart?.();
    },
    zoomend: () => {
      const currentZoom = Math.round(map.getZoom());
      const storeZoom = useMapStore.getState().zoom;
      if (Math.abs(currentZoom - storeZoom) >= 1) {
        useMapStore.setState({ zoom: currentZoom });
      }
    },
    moveend: () => {
      // Debounce viewport bounds query to prevent re-fetching on continuous zoom or pan
      if (debounceRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
      }
      debounceRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        const b = map.getBounds();
        fetchIncidentsInBounds({
          minLat: b.getSouth(),
          maxLat: b.getNorth(),
          minLng: b.getWest(),
          maxLng: b.getEast(),
        });
      }, 350);
    },
  });

  // Cleanup on unmount
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (debounceRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, []);

  // Initial bounds load on map readiness
  useEffect(() => {
    if (map) {
      const b = map.getBounds();
      fetchIncidentsInBounds({
        minLat: b.getSouth(),
        maxLat: b.getNorth(),
        minLng: b.getWest(),
        maxLng: b.getEast(),
      });
    }
  }, [map, fetchIncidentsInBounds]);

  return null;
}

// Map center updater: listens strictly to discrete programmatic target commands
function MapViewUpdater() {
  const map = useMap();
  const targetCommand = useMapStore((state) => state.targetCommand);
  const lastExecutedId = useRef<number>(0);
  const activeFlightTargetRef = useRef<{ lat: number; lng: number; zoom: number } | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleFlightEnd = () => {
      activeFlightTargetRef.current = null;
    };
    map.on("moveend", handleFlightEnd);
    map.on("dragstart", handleFlightEnd);
    return () => {
      map.off("moveend", handleFlightEnd);
      map.off("dragstart", handleFlightEnd);
    };
  }, [map]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!targetCommand || targetCommand.id === lastExecutedId.current) return;
    lastExecutedId.current = targetCommand.id;

    const currentCenter = map.getCenter();
    const currentZoom = map.getZoom();
    const targetZoom = targetCommand.zoom ?? currentZoom;

    // Check if map is already actively flying to this identical destination
    if (
      activeFlightTargetRef.current &&
      Math.abs(activeFlightTargetRef.current.lat - targetCommand.lat) < 0.00001 &&
      Math.abs(activeFlightTargetRef.current.lng - targetCommand.lng) < 0.00001 &&
      Math.abs(activeFlightTargetRef.current.zoom - targetZoom) < 0.05
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const distLat = Math.abs(currentCenter.lat - targetCommand.lat);
    const distLng = Math.abs(currentCenter.lng - targetCommand.lng);
    const distZoom = Math.abs(currentZoom - targetZoom);

    // Only initiate flight if programmatic target actually differs from current camera
    if (distLat > 0.00001 || distLng > 0.00001 || distZoom > 0.05) {
      activeFlightTargetRef.current = { lat: targetCommand.lat, lng: targetCommand.lng, zoom: targetZoom };
      try {
        map.flyTo([targetCommand.lat, targetCommand.lng], targetZoom, {
          animate: true,
          duration: 1.0,
        });
      } catch {
        map.setView([targetCommand.lat, targetCommand.lng], targetZoom);
        activeFlightTargetRef.current = null;
      }
    }
  }, [targetCommand, map]);

  return null;
}

// Child component that captures the active Leaflet Map instance into parent mapRef

// Automatically invalidates Leaflet map size safely when structural containers change (e.g. sidebar toggle)
function MapResizeHandler() {
  const map = useMap();

  useEffect(() => {
    const container = map.getContainer();
    if (!container) return;

    let resizeTimer: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;
    let prevWidth = container.clientWidth;
    let prevHeight = container.clientHeight;

    const observer = new ResizeObserver((entries) => {
      for (const entry of entries) {
        const { width, height } = entry.contentRect;
        // Require meaningful resize (>= 15px) to prevent micro subpixel fluctuations from triggering invalidateSize loops
        if (Math.abs(width - prevWidth) >= 15 || Math.abs(height - prevHeight) >= 15) {
          prevWidth = width;
          prevHeight = height;

          if (resizeTimer) clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
          resizeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            map.invalidateSize({ pan: false });
          }, 150);
        }
      }
    });

    observer.observe(container);

    // Initial layout alignment on mount for mobile dynamic viewport heights
    const initialTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      map.invalidateSize({ pan: false });
    }, 150);

    const handleWindowResize = () => {
      map.invalidateSize({ pan: false });
    };
    window.addEventListener("resize", handleWindowResize);

    return () => {
      observer.disconnect();
      if (initialTimer) clearTimeout(initialTimer);
      if (resizeTimer) clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", handleWindowResize);
    };
  }, [map]);

  return null;
}
```
