```tsx
'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { AlertTriangle, Volume2, VolumeX, X } from 'lucide-react';

export interface HazardProximityBannerItem {
  hazard: {
    id: string;
    title?: string;
    category: string;
    description?: string;
    locationName?: string;
  };
  distanceMeters: number;
  enteredAt: number;
}

export interface HazardProximityBannerProps {
  /** List of active nearby danger zone alerts, sorted ascending by distance (closest first). */
  alerts: HazardProximityBannerItem[];
  /** Audio mute status for proximity chimes. */
  isMuted: boolean;
  /** Callback invoked when the user toggles mute. */
  onToggleMute: () => void;
  /** Callback invoked when the user dismisses the active hazard banner. */
  onDismiss: (hazardId: string) => void;
  /** Optional custom Tailwind class names. */
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Formats distance in meters for clear tactical HUD readability.
 */
export function formatBannerDistance(distanceMeters: number): string {
  if (distanceMeters <= 0) {
    return 'At hazard epicenter';
  }
  return `${Math.round(distanceMeters)}m away`;
}

/**
 * Visual HUD warning banner mounted on top of the interactive map viewport.
 * Provides real-time dynamic distance to the closest active hazard, category badge,
 * audio chime mute toggle, and manual dismissal.
 */
export default function HazardProximityBanner({
  alerts,
  isMuted,
  onToggleMute,
  onDismiss,
  className = '',
}: HazardProximityBannerProps) {
  if (!alerts || alerts.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  const closest = alerts[0];
  const moreCount = Math.max(0, alerts.length - 1);
  const formattedDist = formatBannerDistance(closest.distanceMeters);
  const title = closest.hazard.title || closest.hazard.locationName || 'Active Danger Zone';
  const category = closest.hazard.category || 'Danger';

  return (
    <div
      role="alert"
      aria-live="assertive"
      className={`absolute top-16 sm:top-20 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-[450] w-[calc(100%-1.5rem)] max-w-lg transition-all duration-300 ease-out pointer-events-auto ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-red-950/95 via-rose-950/95 to-red-900/95 border border-red-500/60 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-md p-3 sm:p-4 text-white">
        {/* Animated warning accent line at top */}
        <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 h-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-400 via-red-500 to-rose-400 animate-pulse" />

        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
          {/* Pulsing Alert Icon */}
          <div className="relative shrink-0 mt-0.5">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-red-500/20 border border-red-500/40 flex items-center justify-center text-red-400">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 animate-pulse text-amber-300" />
            </div>
            <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 flex h-3 w-3">
              <span className="animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full bg-red-400 opacity-75" />
              <span className="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-3 w-3 bg-red-500" />
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* Central Hazard Details */}
          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 pr-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider bg-red-500/30 text-red-200 border border-red-400/40">
                {category}
              </span>
              <span className="font-mono text-xs font-black text-amber-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-black/40 border border-amber-400/30">
                {formattedDist}
              </span>
              {moreCount > 0 && (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[10px] font-semibold bg-rose-950/80 text-rose-300 border border-rose-700/50">
                  +{moreCount} more nearby
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white tracking-tight truncate mt-1 leading-snug">
              {title}
            </h3>

            {closest.hazard.locationName && (
              <p className="text-[11px] text-red-200/80 truncate mt-0.5 font-medium">
                📍 {closest.hazard.locationName}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Controls: Mute Toggle and Dismiss */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0 mt-0.5">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onToggleMute}
              aria-label={isMuted ? 'Unmute hazard alert audio' : 'Mute hazard alert audio'}
              title={isMuted ? 'Unmute audio chime' : 'Mute audio chime'}
              className="p-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white/90 hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer border border-white/10"
            >
              {isMuted ? (
                <VolumeX className="w-4 h-4 text-red-300" />
              ) : (
                <Volume2 className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-300" />
              )}
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onDismiss(closest.hazard.id)}
              aria-label="Dismiss danger warning banner"
              title="Dismiss warning banner"
              className="p-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white/90 hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer border border-white/10"
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import React, { useMemo } from "react";
import { MapContainer, TileLayer, Marker, Circle, ZoomControl } from "react-leaflet";
import { useMapStore, MAP_LAYERS } from "@/store/useMapStore";
import MapLayerSwitcher from "@/components/map/MapLayerSwitcher";
import { createDangerMarkerIcon, getSeverityColors } from "@/lib/mapMarkerUtils";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ExternalLink, Navigation } from "lucide-react";

interface IncidentMiniMapProps {
  latitude: number;
  longitude: number;
  severity: "LOW" | "MEDIUM" | "HIGH";
  category: string;
  radiusMeters?: number;
}

export default function IncidentMiniMap({
  latitude,
  longitude,
  severity,
  category,
  radiusMeters = 150,
}: IncidentMiniMapProps) {
  const activeTileLayer = useMapStore((state) => state.activeTileLayer);
  const currentTileConfig = MAP_LAYERS[activeTileLayer] || MAP_LAYERS.google_streets;
  const colors = useMemo(() => getSeverityColors(severity), [severity]);

  const customIcon = useMemo(
    () => createDangerMarkerIcon(category, severity, 16),
    [category, severity]
  );

  return (
    <div className="relative w-full h-64 sm:h-72 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-200/90 shadow-xs bg-slate-100 select-none">
      <div className="absolute top-3 right-3 z-[500]">
        <MapLayerSwitcher compact />
      </div>
      <MapContainer
        center={[latitude, longitude]}
        zoom={15}
        zoomControl={false}
        scrollWheelZoom={false}
        dragging={true}
        style={{ width: "100%", height: "100%" }}
      >
        {/* Active High-Detail Tile Layer (Google Streets / Satellite Hybrid / OSM) */}
        <TileLayer
          key={activeTileLayer}
          url={currentTileConfig.url}
          attribution={currentTileConfig.attribution}
          maxZoom={currentTileConfig.maxZoom}
          subdomains={currentTileConfig.subdomains || ['0', '1', '2', '3']}
        />
        <Circle
          center={[latitude, longitude]}
          radius={radiusMeters}
          pathOptions={{
            color: colors.bg,
            fillColor: colors.bg,
            fillOpacity: 0.16,
            weight: 2,
            dashArray: "4, 6",
          }}
        />

        <Marker position={[latitude, longitude]} icon={customIcon} />

        <ZoomControl position="bottomright" />
      </MapContainer>

      {/* Floating Tactical Overlay Pill */}
      <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 z-[400] flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-200/80 shadow-2xs text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-700">
        <Navigation className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600" />
        <span>150m Privacy Fuzzed Perimeter</span>
      </div>

      {/* Link to Full Radar Map */}
      <Link
        href={`/?lat=${latitude}&lng=${longitude}&zoom=16`}
        className="absolute bottom-3 left-3 z-[400] flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white/95 hover:bg-white backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-200/80 shadow-xs hover:shadow text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 hover:text-blue-600 transition-all active:scale-95"
      >
        <span>Open in Live Radar</span>
        <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 group-hover:text-blue-600" />
      </Link>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import React, { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useIncidentStore } from "@/store/useIncidentStore";
import { useMapStore } from "@/store/useMapStore";
import { useLanguageStore } from "@/store/useLanguageStore";
import { useFilterStore } from "@/store/useFilterStore";
import { showToast } from "@/store/useToastStore";
import { getTranslation } from "@/lib/translations";
import { DangerIncident } from "@repo/shared";
import { cleanIncidentTitle, getCategoryIcon, getCategoryBadgeClass } from "@/lib/incidentUtils";
import { isIncidentCategoryMatch } from "@/lib/filterUtils";
import {
  AlertCircle,
  MapPin,
  ThumbsUp,
  ThumbsDown,
  ExternalLink,
  MessageSquare,
  ShieldCheck,
  Crosshair,
  ArrowUpRight,
  Send,
  Clock,
  Radio,
  Search,
  RotateCcw,
  PlusCircle,
  Loader2,
  ShieldAlert,
  PhoneCall,
  Flame,
} from "lucide-react";

function formatRelativeTime(dateString: string, lang: "en" | "bn"): string {
  try {
    const diffMs = Date.now() - new Date(dateString).getTime();
    const diffSec = Math.floor(diffMs / 1000);
    const diffMin = Math.floor(diffSec / 60);
    const diffHour = Math.floor(diffMin / 60);

    if (diffMin < 1) {
      return lang === "bn" ? "এইমাত্র" : "Just now";
    }
    if (diffMin < 60) {
      return lang === "bn" ? `${diffMin} মিনিট আগে` : `${diffMin}m ago`;
    }
    if (diffHour < 24) {
      return lang === "bn" ? `${diffHour} ঘণ্টা আগে` : `${diffHour}h ago`;
    }
    const days = Math.floor(diffHour / 24);
    return lang === "bn" ? `${days} দিন আগে` : `${days}d ago`;
  } catch {
    return lang === "bn" ? "সাম্প্রতিক" : "Recent";
  }
}

export default function IncidentFeed({ onIncidentSelect }: { onIncidentSelect?: () => void }) {
  const { language } = useLanguageStore();
  const incidents = useIncidentStore((state) => state.incidents);
  const isLoading = useIncidentStore((state) => state.isLoading);
  const isUpdatingBounds = useIncidentStore((state) => state.isUpdatingBounds);
  const error = useIncidentStore((state) => state.error);
  const activeBounds = useIncidentStore((state) => state.activeBounds);
  const fetchIncidentsInBounds = useIncidentStore((state) => state.fetchIncidentsInBounds);
  const voteIncident = useIncidentStore((state) => state.voteIncident);
  const addContextUpdate = useIncidentStore((state) => state.addContextUpdate);
  const { selectedSeverity, setSeverity, selectedCategories, searchQuery, resetFilters } = useFilterStore();
  const flyTo = useMapStore((state) => state.flyTo);
  const t = getTranslation(language);
  const isBn = language === "bn";

  const [activeCommentIncidentId, setActiveCommentIncidentId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [commentText, setCommentText] = useState("");
  const [isSubmittingComment, setIsSubmittingComment] = useState(false);
  const [selectedIncidentId, setSelectedIncidentId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [feedTab, setFeedTab] = useState<"all" | "critical" | "verified">("all");

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    return incidents.filter((item) => {
      // Feed-specific tab filter
      if (feedTab === "critical") {
        const isCrit = item.severity.toUpperCase() === "HIGH" || item.severity.toLowerCase() === "critical";
        if (!isCrit) return false;
      } else if (feedTab === "verified") {
        if (!item.sourceUrl) return false;
      }

      // Global store filters
      if (selectedSeverity !== "all" && item.severity.toUpperCase() !== selectedSeverity.toUpperCase()) {
        return false;
      }
      if (!isIncidentCategoryMatch(item.category, selectedCategories)) {
        return false;
      }
      if (searchQuery.trim() !== "") {
        const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
        const matchesTitle =
          item.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.titleBn && item.titleBn.toLowerCase().includes(q));
        const matchesLoc =
          item.locationName.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.locationNameBn && item.locationNameBn.toLowerCase().includes(q));
        if (!matchesTitle && !matchesLoc) return false;
      }
      return true;
    }).sort((a, b) => new Date(b.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(a.timestamp).getTime());
  }, [incidents, feedTab, selectedSeverity, selectedCategories, searchQuery]);

  const hasActiveFilters =
    selectedSeverity !== "all" || selectedCategories.length > 0 || searchQuery.trim() !== "" || feedTab !== "all";

  const handleFocusIncident = (incident: DangerIncident) => {
    setSelectedIncidentId(incident.id);
    flyTo(incident.coordinates, 16);
    if (onIncidentSelect) {

  const handlePostUpdate = async (incidentId: string) => {
    if (!commentText.trim()) return;
    setIsSubmittingComment(true);

      setActiveCommentIncidentId(null);

  return (
    <aside className="w-full bg-white text-slate-800 flex flex-col h-full z-10 shadow-sm select-text border-r border-slate-200">
      {/* Feed Header */}
      <div className="p-3.5 border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/90 shrink-0 space-y-2.5">

              </h2>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono">
                {isBn ? "পোস্টজিআইএস সরাসরি উপাত্ত" : "PostGIS Real-Time Stream"}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            {isUpdatingBounds && (
              <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 flex items-center gap-1 font-medium bg-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-slate-200 shadow-2xs">
                <Loader2 className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin text-blue-600" />
                <span className="hidden sm:inline">
                  {isBn ? "সিঙ্ক হচ্ছে..." : "Syncing..."}
                </span>
              </span>
            )}
            <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 shadow-2xs">
```

## [File 103] `apps/web/components/incidents/ReportIncidentModal.tsx`
> **Path:** `apps/web/components/incidents/ReportIncidentModal.tsx`  
> **Lines of Code:** 497  
> **Language:** `tsx`

### What This Code Does
This modal encapsulates the multi-step hazard reporting workflow for eyewitnesses.
It allows users to select threat categories, pick locations, enter descriptions, and attach photos.
It enforces hardware GPS proximity validation before submitting the report to ensure zero-spoof data integrity.

```tsx
"use client";

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from "react";
import { useLanguageStore } from "@/store/useLanguageStore";
import { getTranslation } from "@/lib/translations";
import {
  X,
  ShieldAlert,
  CheckCircle2,
  Navigation,
  AlertTriangle,
  Crosshair,
  Sparkles,
} from "lucide-react";
import { ReportCategory, ReportSeverity } from "@repo/shared";
import { useMapStore } from "@/store/useMapStore";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { getCategoryVisual, formatCategoryLabel } from "@/lib/incidentCategoryVisuals";
import {
  HardwareGpsFix,
  evaluateHardwareGpsProximity,
  buildHardwareGpsHeaders,
} from "@/lib/gpsVerification";

interface ReportModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

// Option A: Primary incident tags for reporting
interface IncidentTagDef {
  id: string;
  labelEn: string;
  labelBn: string;
  icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>;
  color: string;
  bgColor: string;
  borderColor: string;
}

const PRIMARY_TAG_IDS: ReportCategory[] = [
  "SNATCHING",
  "ARMED_ASSAULT",
  "THEFT",
  "ROBBERY",
  "YOUTH_GANG_ACTIVITY",
  "EXTORTION",
  "DRUG_RELATED_CRIME",
  "ROAD_ACCIDENT",
  "UNLIT_ROAD",
];

const PRIMARY_TAGS: IncidentTagDef[] = PRIMARY_TAG_IDS.map((id) => {
  const visual = getCategoryVisual(id);
  return {
    id,
    labelEn: visual.labelEn,
    labelBn: visual.labelBn,
    icon: visual.icon,
    color:
      id === "SNATCHING"
        ? "text-orange-700"
        : id === "ARMED_ASSAULT"
        ? "text-rose-700"
        : id === "THEFT"
        ? "text-amber-700"
        : id === "ROBBERY"
        ? "text-red-700"
        : id === "YOUTH_GANG_ACTIVITY"
        ? "text-violet-700"
        : id === "EXTORTION"
        ? "text-purple-700"
        : id === "DRUG_RELATED_CRIME"
        ? "text-blue-700"
        : id === "ROAD_ACCIDENT"
        ? "text-emerald-700"
        : "text-slate-700",
    bgColor: id === "UNLIT_ROAD" ? "bg-slate-100" : visual.badgeClass.split(" ")[0] || "bg-slate-50",
    borderColor: visual.badgeClass.split(" ")[2] || "border-slate-200",
  };
});

export default function ReportIncidentModal({ isOpen, onClose }: ReportModalProps) {
  const { language } = useLanguageStore();
  const t = getTranslation(language);
  const isBn = language === "bn";

  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [selectedTags, setSelectedTags] = useState<string[]>(["SNATCHING"]);
  const [severity, setSeverity] = useState<ReportSeverity>("HIGH");
  const [locationName, setLocationName] = useState("");
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const mapCenter = useMapStore((state) => state.center);
  const setMapCenter = useMapStore((state) => state.setCenter);
  const [hardwareGps, setHardwareGps] = useState<HardwareGpsFix | null>(null);

  // Request live browser geolocation on modal open without fabricating fallback coordinates
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;

    if (typeof window !== "undefined" && "geolocation" in navigator) {
      navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
        (pos) => {
          const coords = {
            lat: pos.coords.latitude,
            lng: pos.coords.longitude,
          };
          const accuracy = Number.isFinite(pos.coords.accuracy) ? pos.coords.accuracy : Infinity;
          setHardwareGps({ ...coords, accuracy });
          setMapCenter(coords);
        },
        (err) => {
          console.warn("[GPS Proximity Radar] Geolocation unavailable:", err.message);
          setHardwareGps(null);
        },
        { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 6000, maximumAge: 30000 }
      );
    } else {
      setHardwareGps(null);
    }
  }, [isOpen, setMapCenter]);

  const gpsEvaluation = useMemo(
    () => evaluateHardwareGpsProximity(hardwareGps, mapCenter.lat, mapCenter.lng),
    [hardwareGps, mapCenter]
  );

  // Auto-align map center with eligible hardware GPS
  const handleSyncToGps = () => {
    if (hardwareGps && gpsEvaluation.isEligibleHardwareGps) {
      setMapCenter({ lat: hardwareGps.lat, lng: hardwareGps.lng });
    }
  };

  // Option A: Smart Category Resolution
  const resolvedCategory = useMemo<ReportCategory>(() => {
    const hasTheft = selectedTags.includes("THEFT");
    const hasRobbery = selectedTags.includes("ROBBERY") || selectedTags.includes("DACOITY");
    const hasSnatching = selectedTags.includes("SNATCHING");
    const hasArmedAssault = selectedTags.includes("ARMED_ASSAULT");

    if (hasTheft && hasRobbery) return "THEFT_ROBBERY";
    if (hasSnatching && hasArmedAssault) return "SNATCHING_ARMED_ASSAULT";

    const lastTag = selectedTags[selectedTags.length - 1];
    if (lastTag) return lastTag as ReportCategory;
    return "SNATCHING";
  }, [selectedTags]);

  // Handle Tag Toggling with Smart Combination Pairing
  const handleToggleTag = (tagId: string) => {
    // If tag is already selected, unselect it (unless it's the last one)
    if (selectedTags.includes(tagId)) {
      if (selectedTags.length > 1) {
        setSelectedTags((prev) => prev.filter((id) => id !== tagId));
      }
      return;
    }

    // Pair Combinations:
    // 1. THEFT + ROBBERY
    if (tagId === "THEFT") {
      if (selectedTags.includes("ROBBERY")) {
        setSelectedTags(["ROBBERY", "THEFT"]);
      } else {
        setSelectedTags(["THEFT"]);
      }
      return;
    }

    if (tagId === "ROBBERY") {
      if (selectedTags.includes("THEFT")) {
        setSelectedTags(["THEFT", "ROBBERY"]);
      } else {
        setSelectedTags(["ROBBERY"]);
      }
      return;
    }

    // 2. SNATCHING + ARMED_ASSAULT
    if (tagId === "SNATCHING") {
      if (selectedTags.includes("ARMED_ASSAULT")) {
        setSelectedTags(["ARMED_ASSAULT", "SNATCHING"]);
      } else {
        setSelectedTags(["SNATCHING"]);
      }
      return;
    }

    if (tagId === "ARMED_ASSAULT") {
      if (selectedTags.includes("SNATCHING")) {
        setSelectedTags(["SNATCHING", "ARMED_ASSAULT"]);
      } else {
        setSelectedTags(["ARMED_ASSAULT"]);
      }
      return;
    }

    // Independent tags: EXTORTION, YOUTH_GANG_ACTIVITY, DRUG_RELATED_CRIME, ROAD_ACCIDENT, UNLIT_ROAD
    setSelectedTags([tagId]);
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMessage(null);

    if (!title.trim() || !description.trim()) {
      setErrorMessage(
        language === "en"
          ? "Please enter both an incident title and description."
          : "অনুগ্রহ করে ঘটনার শিরোনাম এবং বিস্তারিত বিবরণ উভয়ই লিখুন।"
      );
      return;
    }

    const fullDescription = `${title.trim()}${locationName.trim() ? ` [${locationName.trim()}]` : ""}: ${description.trim()}`;
    if (fullDescription.length > 1000) {
      setErrorMessage(
        language === "en"
          ? "Combined report details cannot exceed 1000 characters."
          : "মোট রিপোর্টের বিবরণ ১০০০ অক্ষরের বেশি হতে পারবে না।"
      );
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const gpsHeaders = buildHardwareGpsHeaders(hardwareGps, gpsEvaluation);

      await apiFetch("/reports", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: gpsHeaders,
        body: JSON.stringify({
          category: resolvedCategory,
          severity,
          latitude: mapCenter.lat,
          longitude: mapCenter.lng,
          description: fullDescription,
        }),
      });

      setSubmitted(true);
      setTimeout(() => {
        setSubmitted(false);
        setTitle("");
        setLocationName("");
        setDescription("");
        setSelectedTags(["SNATCHING"]);
        onClose();
      }, 2000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("[Report Submission] Error:", err.message);
      setErrorMessage(err.message || "Failed to submit report. Please try again.");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[2000] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 p-4 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl max-w-lg w-full shadow-2xl overflow-hidden max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-50/70 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <ShieldAlert className="w-5 h-5 text-red-600" />
            <h3 className="font-bold text-sm sm:text-base text-slate-900">
              {language === "en" ? "Report Public Danger / Incident" : "নতুন বিপদ সংকেত বা ঘটনা রিপোর্ট করুন"}
            </h3>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Content */}
        {submitted ? (
          <div className="p-8 text-center space-y-3">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-12 h-12 text-emerald-600 mx-auto" />
            <h4 className="font-bold text-base text-slate-900">
              {language === "en" ? "Report Broadcasted Successfully!" : "রিপোর্টটি সফলভাবে সম্প্রচারিত হয়েছে!"}
            </h4>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 max-w-xs mx-auto">
              {language === "en"
                ? "Your alert has been verified and broadcast to all live map users in real time."
                : "আপনার রিপোর্টটি সরাসরি ম্যাপ ও সতর্কবার্তা নেটওয়ার্কে যুক্ত করা হয়েছে।"}
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-5 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto">
            {/* Legal Warning Notice */}
            <div className="p-2.5 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-xl text-xs text-red-700">
              ⚠️ {language === "en"
                ? "Please only report genuine incidents. False reporting violates the Cyber Security Act."
                : "অনুগ্রহ করে কেবল সত্য ঘটনা রিপোর্ট করুন। ভিত্তিহীন তথ্য প্রদান আইনত দণ্ডনীয় অপরাধ।"}
            </div>

            {/* Error Message */}
            {errorMessage && (
              <div className="p-2.5 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-700 text-xs rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
                <span>{errorMessage}</span>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Title */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                {language === "en" ? "Incident Title *" : "ঘটনার শিরোনাম *"}
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={title}
                onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
                placeholder={language === "en" ? "e.g. Armed mugging attempt near roundabout" : "যেমন: গোলচত্বরে ছিনতাইয়ের চেষ্টা"}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-slate-900 placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:bg-white focus:border-red-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-500 transition-colors"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Option A: Smart Category Tag Chips */}
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                  {language === "en" ? "Incident Category Tags *" : "ঘটনার ক্যাটাগরি ট্যাগ *"}
                </label>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                  {isBn ? "প্রয়োজনে সমন্বিত ট্যাগ বাছাই করুন" : "Select tags (auto-combines)"}
                </span>

              {/* Tag Chips Grid */}
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 p-2 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl">

                  return (

                        isSelected
                          ? "bg-slate-900 text-white border-slate-900 shadow-xs scale-[1.02]"

                    >

              <div className="mt-2 p-2.5 rounded-xl border flex items-center justify-between gap-2 transition-all bg-blue-50/80 border-blue-200 text-blue-900">

                  <span className="text-xs font-bold">

                    <span className="underline decoration-blue-500 underline-offset-2">
                      {formatCategoryLabel(resolvedCategory, language)}
                    </span>

                </div>
                {resolvedCategory.includes("_") && (
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-2xs">

              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Severity Picker */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                {language === "en" ? "Threat Severity *" : "বিপদের মাত্রা *"}

              <select

              >
                <option value="HIGH">{language === "en" ? "High (Weapons / Severe Threat)" : "উচ্চ ঝুঁকি (অস্ত্রধারী / মারপিট)"}</option>
                <option value="MEDIUM">{language === "en" ? "Medium (Active Threat)" : "মাঝারি ঝুঁকি"}</option>
                <option value="LOW">{language === "en" ? "Low (Advisory / Hazard)" : "নিম্ন ঝুঁকি (সতর্কবার্তা)"}</option>

            {/* Specific Area / Landmark */}
            <div>

                {language === "en" ? "Landmark / Neighborhood" : "নির্দিষ্ট এলাকা বা পরিচিত স্থান"}
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={locationName}
                onChange={(e) => setLocationName(e.target.value)}
                placeholder={language === "en" ? "e.g. Dhanmondi 27 / Farmgate" : "যেমন: ধানমন্ডি ২৭ / ফার্মগেট"}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-slate-900 placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:bg-white focus:border-red-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-500 transition-colors"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Description */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                {language === "en" ? "Incident Details *" : "বিস্তারিত বিবরণ *"}
              </label>
              <textarea
                rows={3}
                required
                value={description}
                onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
                placeholder={
                  language === "en"
                    ? "Provide key details: number of suspects, weapons seen, escape route..."
                    : "প্রয়োজনীয় বিবরণ দিন: অপরাধীদের সংখ্যা, ব্যবহৃত অস্ত্র, পালানোর দিক..."
                }
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-slate-900 placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:bg-white focus:border-red-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-500 transition-colors resize-none"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Proximity GPS Radar Status Bar */}
            <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Navigation className={`w-4 h-4 ${gpsEvaluation.isVerified ? "text-emerald-600" : "text-amber-600"}`} />
                <div>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800">
                    {language === "en" ? "Incident Pin Location" : "রিপোর্টের ম্যাপ পিন"}:
                  </span>{" "}
                  <span className="font-mono text-slate-600">
                    {mapCenter.lat.toFixed(4)}, {mapCenter.lng.toFixed(4)}
                  </span>
                  <span className={`block text-[11px] ${gpsEvaluation.isVerified ? "text-emerald-700" : "text-amber-700 font-semibold"}`}>
                    {gpsEvaluation.isVerified
                      ? language === "en"
                        ? `Hardware GPS Verified (${gpsEvaluation.distanceMeters}m ≤ 200m)`
                        : `হার্ডওয়্যার জিপিএস যাচাইকৃত (${gpsEvaluation.distanceMeters}মি ≤ ২০০মি)`
                      : gpsEvaluation.status === "OUT_OF_RANGE"
                        ? language === "en"
                          ? `Manual Pin / Unverified GPS (${gpsEvaluation.distanceMeters}m away > 200m)`
                          : `ম্যানুয়াল পিন / অযাচাইকৃত জিপিএস (${gpsEvaluation.distanceMeters}মি দূরে)`
                        : language === "en"

                          : "ম্যানুয়াল পিন / অযাচাইকৃত জিপিএস"}
                  </span>

              {gpsEvaluation.isEligibleHardwareGps && (
                <button

                  className="px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 hover:bg-blue-100 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors"

                >
                  <Crosshair className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{language === "en" ? "Sync GPS" : "জিপিএস সিঙ্ক"}</span>
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Submit Action Buttons */}
            <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-end gap-2 shrink-0">
              <button

                className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-xl transition-colors"

              <button

              >

                  ? (language === "en" ? "Broadcasting..." : "সম্প্রচার হচ্ছে...")
                  : (language === "en" ? "Broadcast Alert ⚡" : "সতর্কবার্তা সম্প্রচার করুন ⚡")}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## [File 104] `apps/web/components/report/ReportPinMap.tsx`
> **Path:** `apps/web/components/report/ReportPinMap.tsx`  
> **Lines of Code:** 230  
> **Language:** `tsx`

### What This Code Does
This interactive map component is embedded inside the reporting page to allow precise pin placement.
It centers on user GPS coordinates and allows draggable pin adjustments within the 200m validation boundary.
It renders a visual geofence circle indicating the allowable reporting perimeter.

```tsx
"use client";

import React, { useEffect } from "react";
import {
  MapContainer,
  TileLayer,
  Circle,
  CircleMarker,
  useMap,
  useMapEvents,
} from "react-leaflet";
import { useMapStore, MAP_LAYERS } from "@/store/useMapStore";
import MapLayerSwitcher from "@/components/map/MapLayerSwitcher";
import "leaflet/dist/leaflet.css";
import { Crosshair, MapPin, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle } from "lucide-react";

interface ReportPinMapProps {
  proximityRadius?: number;
  incidentLat: number;
  incidentLng: number;
  deviceLat?: number | null;
  deviceLng?: number | null;
  proximityDistance?: number | null;
  onLocationChange: (lat: number, lng: number) => void;
  onSnapToDevice?: () => void;
  severity: "LOW" | "MEDIUM" | "HIGH";
  language?: "en" | "bn";
}

function ChangeView({ center }: { center: [number, number] }) {
  const map = useMap();
  useEffect(() => {
    map.setView(center, map.getZoom(), { animate: true });
  }, [center, map]);
  return null;
}

function MapClickHandler({
  onLocationChange,
}: {
  onLocationChange: (lat: number, lng: number) => void;
}) {
  useMapEvents({
    click: (e) => {
      onLocationChange(
        Number(e.latlng.lat.toFixed(6)),
        Number(e.latlng.lng.toFixed(6))
      );
    },
  });
  return null;
}

export default function ReportPinMap({
  incidentLat,
  incidentLng,
  deviceLat,
  deviceLng,
  proximityDistance,
  proximityRadius = 200,
  onLocationChange,
  onSnapToDevice,
  severity,
  language = "en",
}: ReportPinMapProps) {
  const activeTileLayer = useMapStore((state) => state.activeTileLayer);
  const currentTileConfig = MAP_LAYERS[activeTileLayer] || MAP_LAYERS.google_streets;
  const isBn = language === "bn";
  const isWithinProximity =
    proximityDistance === null ||
    proximityDistance === undefined ||
    proximityDistance <= (proximityRadius || 200);

  const severityColor =
    severity === "HIGH"
      ? "#DC2626"
      : severity === "MEDIUM"
      ? "#F59E0B"
      : "#10B981";

  const hasDeviceGps =
    typeof deviceLat === "number" &&
    typeof deviceLng === "number" &&
    !isNaN(deviceLat) &&
    !isNaN(deviceLng);

  return (
    <div className="relative w-full h-72 sm:h-80 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-200 shadow-xs z-0 select-none bg-slate-100">
      <div className="absolute top-3 right-3 z-[500]">
        <MapLayerSwitcher compact />
      </div>
      <MapContainer
        center={[incidentLat, incidentLng]}
        zoom={15}
        minZoom={6}
        maxZoom={20}
        attributionControl={false}
        className="w-full h-full"
      >
        <ChangeView center={[incidentLat, incidentLng]} />
        <MapClickHandler onLocationChange={onLocationChange} />

        {/* Active High-Detail Tile Layer (Google Streets / Satellite Hybrid / OSM) */}
        <TileLayer
          key={activeTileLayer}
          url={currentTileConfig.url}
          attribution={currentTileConfig.attribution}
          maxZoom={currentTileConfig.maxZoom}
          subdomains={currentTileConfig.subdomains || ['0', '1', '2', '3']}
        />

        {/* 200m Proximity Radar Zone around Citizen's Real Device GPS */}
        {hasDeviceGps && (
          <>
            <Circle
              center={[deviceLat!, deviceLng!]}
              radius={proximityRadius || 200}
              pathOptions={{
                color: isWithinProximity ? "#10B981" : "#EF4444",
                fillColor: isWithinProximity ? "#10B981" : "#EF4444",
                fillOpacity: 0.12,
                weight: 2,
                dashArray: "5 5",
              }}
            />

            {/* Device Marker */}
            <CircleMarker
              center={[deviceLat!, deviceLng!]}
              radius={7}
              pathOptions={{
                color: "#FFFFFF",
                fillColor: "#2563EB",
                fillOpacity: 1,
                weight: 2,
              }}
            />
          </>
        )}

        {/* Selected Incident Pin */}
        <CircleMarker
          center={[incidentLat, incidentLng]}
          radius={11}
          pathOptions={{
            color: "#FFFFFF",
            fillColor: severityColor,
            fillOpacity: 1,
            weight: 3,
          }}
        />
        <CircleMarker
          center={[incidentLat, incidentLng]}
          radius={22}
          pathOptions={{
            color: severityColor,
            fillColor: severityColor,
            fillOpacity: 0.2,
            weight: 1,
          }}
        />
      </MapContainer>

      {/* Floating Status Badge (Top-Left) */}
      <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 z-[1000] pointer-events-none">
        {hasDeviceGps && proximityDistance !== null ? (
          <div
            className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold shadow-md backdrop-blur-md border ${
              isWithinProximity
                ? "bg-emerald-50/95 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-200"
                : "bg-amber-50/95 text-amber-900 border-amber-200"
            }`}
          >
            {isWithinProximity ? (
              <>
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
                <span>
                  {isBn
                    ? `✓ হার্ডওয়্যার জিপিএস যাচাইকৃত: ${proximityDistance} মি (≤ ২০০ মি)`
                    : `✓ Hardware GPS Verified: ${proximityDistance}m (≤ 200m)`}
                </span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
                <span>
                  {isBn
                    ? `⚠️ দূরত্ব ${proximityDistance} মি (> ২০০ মি) • ম্যানুয়াল পিন`
                    : `⚠️ ${proximityDistance}m from GPS (> 200m) • Manual Pin`}
                </span>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-amber-50/95 text-amber-900 shadow-md backdrop-blur-md border border-amber-200">
            <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
            <span>
              {isBn
                ? "ম্যানুয়াল পিন / অযাচাইকৃত জিপিএস — স্থান নির্বাচন করুন"
                : "Manual Pin / Unverified GPS — Click map to place pin"}
            </span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Floating Action Controls (Bottom-Right) */}
      <div className="absolute bottom-3 right-3 z-[1000] flex items-center gap-2">
        {hasDeviceGps && onSnapToDevice && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onSnapToDevice}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white/95 hover:bg-white text-slate-800 border border-slate-200 shadow-md text-xs font-bold transition-all active:scale-95 cursor-pointer backdrop-blur-md"
            title={isBn ? "আমার বর্তমান জিপিএস স্থানে পিন বসান" : "Snap pin to current device location"}
          >
            <Crosshair className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600" />
            <span>{isBn ? "আমার জিপিএস-এ বসান" : "Snap to My GPS"}</span>
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Help text at bottom-left */}
      <div className="absolute bottom-2 left-3 z-[1000] pointer-events-none hidden sm:block">
        <span className="text-[10px] font-medium text-slate-600 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-slate-200/60 shadow-2xs">
          {hasDeviceGps ? "Blue dot = Your Device • Colored circle = 200m Radar" : "OpenStreetMap contributors"}
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### What This Code Does
This component visualizes the safe-haven directory overlay on the interactive map.
It displays color-coded markers for police stations, police outposts, and emergency hospitals.
Clicking any safe-haven marker opens a popup with facility names, distance, and one-touch phone dialer links.

```tsx
"use client";

import React, { useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import {
  MapContainer,
  TileLayer,
  Marker,
  Popup,
  Circle,
  useMap,
} from "react-leaflet";
import { useMapStore, MAP_LAYERS } from "@/store/useMapStore";
import MapLayerSwitcher from "@/components/map/MapLayerSwitcher";
import type { SafeZoneItem } from "@repo/shared";
import { getSafeZonePresentation } from "@/lib/safeZoneMeta";
import "leaflet/dist/leaflet.css";
import L from "leaflet";
import {
  Hospital,
  Shield,
  Pill,
  Navigation,
  ExternalLink,
  Crosshair,
  Maximize2,
  PhoneCall,
} from "lucide-react";

export type { SafeZoneItem };

interface SafeZonesMapProps {
  safeZones: SafeZoneItem[];
  selectedZone: SafeZoneItem | null;
  onSelectZone: (zone: SafeZoneItem) => void;
  userLocation: { lat: number; lng: number } | null;
  language?: "en" | "bn";
  onNavigateSafeRoute?: (zone: SafeZoneItem) => void;
  className?: string;
}

// Map camera controller for smooth transitions
function MapController({
  selectedZone,
  userLocation,
  safeZones,
}: {
  selectedZone: SafeZoneItem | null;
  userLocation: { lat: number; lng: number } | null;
  safeZones: SafeZoneItem[];
}) {
  const map = useMap();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedZone) {
      map.flyTo([selectedZone.latitude, selectedZone.longitude], 15, {
        duration: 1.2,
      });
    }
  }, [selectedZone, map]);

  return null;
}

// Create custom pin icons for each safe haven type
function createSafeHavenIcon(type: SafeZoneItem["type"], isSelected: boolean) {
  const presentation = getSafeZonePresentation(type);
  const bgColor = presentation.markerBgColor;
  let iconSvg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 6v12"/><path d="M6 12h12"/></svg>`;

  if (presentation.iconKey === "police") {
    iconSvg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 22s8-4 8-10V5l-8-3-8 3v7c0 6 8 10 8 10z"/></svg>`;
  } else if (presentation.iconKey === "pharmacy") {
    iconSvg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m10.5 20.5 10-10a4.95 4.95 0 1 0-7-7l-10 10a4.95 4.95 0 1 0 7 7Z"/><path d="m8.5 8.5 7 7"/></svg>`;
  }

  const size = isSelected ? 40 : 32;
  const ringSize = isSelected ? 48 : 32;

  return L.divIcon({
    className: "safe-haven-marker",
    html: `
      <div style="
        position: relative;
        width: ${ringSize}px;
        height: ${ringSize}px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
      ">
        ${
          isSelected
            ? `<div style="
                position: absolute;
                inset: 0;
                border-radius: 9999px;
                background-color: ${bgColor}33;
                animation: ping 1.5s cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite;
              "></div>`
            : ""
        }
        <div style="
          background-color: ${bgColor};
          border: 2.5px solid #FFFFFF;
          width: ${size}px;
          height: ${size}px;
          border-radius: ${presentation.markerRadius};
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          color: #FFFFFF;
          box-shadow: 0 4px 12px ${bgColor}55, 0 2px 5px rgba(15,23,42,0.15);
          cursor: pointer;
          transform: ${isSelected ? "scale(1.15)" : "scale(1)"};
          transition: transform 0.2s ease;
        ">
          ${iconSvg}
        </div>
      </div>
    `,
    iconSize: [ringSize, ringSize],
    iconAnchor: [ringSize / 2, ringSize / 2],
    popupAnchor: [0, -ringSize / 2],
  });
}

// User live location GPS marker
const userLocationIcon = L.divIcon({
  className: "user-live-gps-pin",
  html: `
    <div style="
      position: relative;
      width: 24px;
      height: 24px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    ">
      <div style="

        height: 24px;
        border-radius: 9999px;

      "></div>
      <div style="

        height: 14px;

        border: 2.5px solid #FFFFFF;
        box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.6);
      "></div>
    </div>
  `,
  iconSize: [24, 24],
  iconAnchor: [12, 12],
});

export default function SafeZonesMap({
  safeZones,
  selectedZone,
  onSelectZone,
  userLocation,
  language = "en",
  onNavigateSafeRoute,
  className = "w-full h-full min-h-[420px]",
}: SafeZonesMapProps) {
  const activeTileLayer = useMapStore((state) => state.activeTileLayer);
  const currentTileConfig = MAP_LAYERS[activeTileLayer] || MAP_LAYERS.google_streets;
  const isBn = language === "bn";

  // Center coordinate: selected zone > user location > default Dhaka center
  const defaultCenter: [number, number] = useMemo(() => {
    if (selectedZone) return [selectedZone.latitude, selectedZone.longitude];
    if (userLocation) return [userLocation.lat, userLocation.lng];
    return [23.7565, 90.3888]; // Dhaka center
  }, [selectedZone, userLocation]);

  return (
    <div className={`relative isolate rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-200 shadow-sm bg-slate-100 z-0 select-none ${className}`}>
      <div className="absolute top-2.5 right-2.5 sm:top-3 sm:right-3 z-[500]">
        <MapLayerSwitcher compact />
      </div>
      <MapContainer
        center={defaultCenter}
        zoom={13}
        minZoom={6}
        maxZoom={20}
        attributionControl={false}
        className="w-full h-full"
      >
        <MapController
          selectedZone={selectedZone}
          userLocation={userLocation}
          safeZones={safeZones}
        />

        {/* Active High-Detail Tile Layer (Google Streets / Satellite Hybrid / OSM) */}
        <TileLayer
          key={activeTileLayer}
          url={currentTileConfig.url}
          attribution={currentTileConfig.attribution}
          maxZoom={currentTileConfig.maxZoom}
          subdomains={currentTileConfig.subdomains || ['0', '1', '2', '3']}
        />

        {/* User live position circle and marker */}
        {userLocation && (
          <>
            <Circle
              center={[userLocation.lat, userLocation.lng]}
              radius={300}
              pathOptions={{
                color: "#2563EB",
                fillColor: "#3B82F6",
                fillOpacity: 0.12,
                weight: 1.5,
                dashArray: "4 4",
              }}
            />
            <Marker
              position={[userLocation.lat, userLocation.lng]}
              icon={userLocationIcon}
            >
              <Popup className="clean-white-popup">
                <div className="p-1 text-center font-sans">
                  <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-blue-700">
                    {isBn ? "আপনার বর্তমান অবস্থান" : "Your Current Location"}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono">
                    {userLocation.lat.toFixed(4)}, {userLocation.lng.toFixed(4)}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </Popup>
            </Marker>
          </>
        )}

        {/* Safe Haven Markers */}
        {safeZones.map((zone) => {
          const isSelected = selectedZone?.id === zone.id;
          const icon = createSafeHavenIcon(zone.type, isSelected);
          const meta = getSafeZonePresentation(zone.type, language);

          return (
            <Marker
              key={zone.id}
              position={[zone.latitude, zone.longitude]}
              icon={icon}
              eventHandlers={{
                click: () => onSelectZone(zone),
              }}
            >
              <Popup className="clean-white-popup">
                <div className="p-2 min-w-[220px] max-w-[280px] font-sans">
                  {/* Type badge */}
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
                    <span
                      className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border ${meta.badgeClass}`}
                    >
                      {meta.label}
                    </span>

                    {zone.distanceMeters && (
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-600 bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-mono">
                        {Number(zone.distanceMeters) >= 1000
                          ? `${(Number(zone.distanceMeters) / 1000).toFixed(1)} km`
                          : `${Math.round(Number(zone.distanceMeters))} m`}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* Title */}
                  <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 leading-snug mb-1">
                    {isBn && zone.nameBn ? zone.nameBn : zone.name}
                  </h4>

                  <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono mb-3">
                    {zone.latitude.toFixed(4)}, {zone.longitude.toFixed(4)}
                  </p>

                  {/* Action buttons */}
                  <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
                    {onNavigateSafeRoute && (
                      <button
                        onClick={() => onNavigateSafeRoute(zone)}
                        className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-1.5 px-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 !text-white text-[11px] font-bold rounded-lg transition-all shadow-xs cursor-pointer"
                        style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}
                      >
                        <Navigation className="w-3 h-3 !text-white" style={{ color: '#ffffff' }} />
                        <span className="!text-white font-bold" style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}>{isBn ? "নিরাপদ পথে চলুন" : "Navigate via Safe Path"}</span>
                      </button>
                    )}

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <a
                        href={`https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=${zone.latitude},${zone.longitude}`}
                        target="_blank"
                        rel="noreferrer"
                        className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 py-1 px-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 text-[10px] font-semibold rounded-lg transition-colors border border-slate-200"
                      >
                        <span>Google Maps</span>
                        <ExternalLink className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                      </a>

                      <a
                        href="tel:999"
                        className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1 py-1 px-2 bg-red-50 hover:bg-red-100 text-red-700 text-[10px] font-bold rounded-lg transition-colors border border-red-200 shrink-0"
                        title="Emergency 999"
                      >
                        <PhoneCall className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                        <span>999</span>
                      </a>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </Popup>
            </Marker>
          );
        })}
      </MapContainer>

      {/* Floating Map Legend */}
      <div className="absolute bottom-2.5 left-2.5 sm:bottom-3 sm:left-3 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-200/90 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 sm:px-3 sm:py-2 shadow-md z-[450] text-[9px] sm:text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-700 flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-blue-600"></span>
          <span>{isBn ? "হাসপাতাল" : "Hospital"}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-600"></span>
          <span>{isBn ? "পুলিশ স্টেশন / বক্স" : "Police Station / Box"}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-600"></span>
          <span>{isBn ? "ফার্মেসি" : "Pharmacy"}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
```

### What This Code Does
This component renders safe navigation route polylines and hazard intersection buffers on the map.
It visualizes calculated transit paths from origin to destination and highlights segments passing near active hazards.
It assists commuters in choosing safer alternative routes around danger hotspots.

```tsx
"use client";

import React, { useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import {
  MapContainer,
  TileLayer,
  Marker,
  Polyline,
  Circle,
  Popup,
  useMap,
  useMapEvents,
} from "react-leaflet";
import { useMapStore, MAP_LAYERS } from "@/store/useMapStore";
import MapLayerSwitcher from "@/components/map/MapLayerSwitcher";
import "leaflet/dist/leaflet.css";
import L from "leaflet";
import { createDangerMarkerIcon } from "@/lib/mapMarkerUtils";
import { formatCategoryLabel } from "@/lib/incidentUtils";
import { MapPin, AlertTriangle, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";
import type { RouteAlternative, LocalizedHazard } from "@repo/shared";

export type BypassedHazardItem = LocalizedHazard;

export interface RoutePathMapProps {
  startLat: number;
  startLng: number;
  endLat: number;
  endLng: number;
  waypoints?: [number, number][]; // [lat, lng] array
  bypassedHazards?: BypassedHazardItem[];
  isDiverted?: boolean;
  routes?: RouteAlternative[];
  selectedRouteId?: string;
  onSelectRoute?: (routeId: string) => void;
  onMapClick?: (lat: number, lng: number) => void;
  clickMode?: "START" | "END" | "NONE";
  language?: "en" | "bn";
  className?: string;
}

// Map Auto-Fit bounds controller
function BoundsController({
  startLat,
  startLng,
  endLat,
  endLng,
  activeGeometry,
}: {
  startLat: number;
  startLng: number;
  endLat: number;
  endLng: number;
  activeGeometry: [number, number][];
}) {
  const map = useMap();

  useEffect(() => {
    const points: [number, number][] = [];
    if (!isNaN(startLat) && !isNaN(startLng)) points.push([startLat, startLng]);
    if (!isNaN(endLat) && !isNaN(endLng)) points.push([endLat, endLng]);
    if (activeGeometry && activeGeometry.length > 0) {
      points.push(...activeGeometry);
    }

    if (points.length >= 2) {
      const bounds = L.latLngBounds(points.map(([lat, lng]) => [lat, lng]));
      map.fitBounds(bounds, { padding: [48, 48], maxZoom: 16 });
    } else if (points.length === 1) {
      map.setView(points[0], 14);
    }
  }, [startLat, startLng, endLat, endLng, activeGeometry, map]);

  return null;
}

// Map click event listener to drop pins
function MapClickObserver({
  onClick,
  clickMode,
}: {
  onClick?: (lat: number, lng: number) => void;
  clickMode?: "START" | "END" | "NONE";
}) {
  useMapEvents({
    click: (e) => {
      if (onClick && clickMode && clickMode !== "NONE") {
        onClick(Number(e.latlng.lat.toFixed(6)), Number(e.latlng.lng.toFixed(6)));
      }
    },
  });
  return null;
}

// Origin Start Pin (Emerald Green Badge)
const startIcon = L.divIcon({
  className: "origin-start-pin",
  html: `
    <div style="
      position: relative;
      width: 36px;

      display: flex;

      justify-content: center;
    ">
      <div style="
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        border-radius: 9999px;
        background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25);
        animation: ping 2s cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite;
      "></div>
      <div style="
        width: 32px;
        height: 32px;
        border-radius: 12px;
        background: #10B981;
        border: 2.5px solid #FFFFFF;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4), 0 2px 4px rgba(15,23,42,0.15);
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        color: #FFFFFF;
      ">
        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/></svg>
      </div>
    </div>
  `,
  iconSize: [36, 36],
  iconAnchor: [18, 18],
  popupAnchor: [0, -18],
});

// Destination Pin (Rose/Red Target Pin)
const destinationIcon = L.divIcon({
  className: "destination-end-pin",
  html: `
    <div style="
      position: relative;
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;

    ">
      <div style="

        height: 32px;
        border-radius: 12px;
        background: #DC2626;
        border: 2.5px solid #FFFFFF;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.4), 0 2px 4px rgba(15,23,42,0.15);
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        color: #FFFFFF;
      ">
        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 15s1-1 4-1 5 2 8 2 4-1 4-1V3s-1 1-4 1-5-2-8-2-4 1-4 1z"/><line x1="4" x2="4" y1="22" y2="15"/></svg>
      </div>
    </div>
  `,
  iconSize: [36, 36],
  iconAnchor: [18, 18],
  popupAnchor: [0, -18],
});

export default function RoutePathMap({
  startLat,
  startLng,
  endLat,
  endLng,
  waypoints = [],
  bypassedHazards = [],
  isDiverted = false,
  routes = [],
  selectedRouteId,
  onSelectRoute,
  onMapClick,
  clickMode = "NONE",
  language = "en",
  className = "w-full h-full min-h-[460px]",
}: RoutePathMapProps) {
  const activeTileLayer = useMapStore((state) => state.activeTileLayer);
  const currentTileConfig = MAP_LAYERS[activeTileLayer] || MAP_LAYERS.google_streets;
  const isBn = language === "bn";

    if (!isNaN(startLat) && !isNaN(startLng)) return [startLat, startLng];
    return [23.7570, 90.3905]; // Dhaka center
  }, [startLat, startLng]);

  // Determine active route
  const activeRoute = useMemo(() => {
    if (routes && routes.length > 0) {
      if (selectedRouteId) {
        const found = routes.find((r) => r.id === selectedRouteId);
        if (found) return found;
      }
      const recommended = routes.find((r) => r.isRecommended);
      if (recommended) return recommended;
      return routes[0];
    }
    return null;
  }, [routes, selectedRouteId]);

  // Active geometry to frame in bounds
  const activeGeometry: [number, number][] = useMemo(() => {
    if (activeRoute && activeRoute.geometry && activeRoute.geometry.length > 0) {
      return activeRoute.geometry;

    if (waypoints && waypoints.length > 0) {
      return waypoints;
    }
    return [];
  }, [activeRoute, waypoints]);

  // All detected corridor hazards across all alternatives and bypassed list
  const allCorridorHazards: BypassedHazardItem[] = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, BypassedHazardItem>();
    if (routes && routes.length > 0) {
      for (const r of routes) {
        if (r.hazards) {
          for (const h of r.hazards) {
            map.set(h.id, h);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    if (bypassedHazards && bypassedHazards.length > 0) {
      for (const h of bypassedHazards) {
        map.set(h.id, h);
      }
    }
    return Array.from(map.values());
  }, [routes, bypassedHazards]);

  // Set of hazard IDs directly intercepted by the currently active route

  return (

      {clickMode !== "NONE" && (

          <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-400" />
          <span>
            {clickMode === "START"

              : isBn ? "ম্যাপে ক্লিক করে গন্তব্য নির্ধারণ করুন" : "Click anywhere on map to set Destination"}

                  weight: 6,

                  lineCap: "round",
                  lineJoin: "round",
                }}
              />
            )}
          </>
        ) : (
          /* Legacy single waypoints path */
          waypoints.length > 1 && (
            <Polyline
              positions={waypoints}
              pathOptions={{
                color: isDiverted ? "#2563EB" : "#10B981",
                weight: 6,
                opacity: 0.9,
                lineCap: "round",
                lineJoin: "round",
              }}
            />
          )
        )}

        {/* Origin Pin */}
        {!isNaN(startLat) && !isNaN(startLng) && (
          <Marker position={[startLat, startLng]} icon={startIcon}>
            <Popup className="clean-white-popup">
              <div className="p-1 font-sans text-center">
                <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-emerald-200">
                  {isBn ? "যাত্রার শুরু (Origin)" : "Origin Point"}
                </span>
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 mt-1 font-mono">
                  {startLat.toFixed(5)}, {startLng.toFixed(5)}
                </p>
              </div>
            </Popup>
          </Marker>
        )}

        {/* Destination Pin */}
        {!isNaN(endLat) && !isNaN(endLng) && (
          <Marker position={[endLat, endLng]} icon={destinationIcon}>
            <Popup className="clean-white-popup">
              <div className="p-1 font-sans text-center">
                <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-red-700 bg-red-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-red-200">
                  {isBn ? "গন্তব্য (Destination)" : "Destination Point"}
                </span>
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 mt-1 font-mono">
                  {endLat.toFixed(5)}, {endLng.toFixed(5)}
                </p>
              </div>
            </Popup>
          </Marker>
        )}

        {/* Active Hazard Markers & Proximity Perimeter Exclusion Buffers */}
        {allCorridorHazards.map((hazard) => {
          const isInterceptedByActive = activeRouteHazardIds.has(hazard.id);
          const bufferRadius =
            hazard.severity === "HIGH" ? 250 : hazard.severity === "MEDIUM" ? 150 : 80;
          return (
            <React.Fragment key={hazard.id}>
              {/* PostGIS Street-Level Proximity Buffer Zone */}
              <Circle
                center={[hazard.latitude, hazard.longitude]}
                radius={bufferRadius}
                pathOptions={{
                  color: isInterceptedByActive
                    ? hazard.severity === "HIGH"
                      ? "#DC2626"
                      : hazard.severity === "MEDIUM"
                      ? "#EA580C"
                      : "#EAB308"
                    : "#94A3B8",
                  fillColor: isInterceptedByActive
                    ? hazard.severity === "HIGH"
                      ? "#EF4444"
                      : hazard.severity === "MEDIUM"
                      ? "#F97316"
                      : "#FACC15"
                    : "#CBD5E1",
                  fillOpacity: isInterceptedByActive ? 0.2 : 0.08,
                  weight: isInterceptedByActive ? 2 : 1,
                  dashArray: isInterceptedByActive ? "4 4" : "6 6",
                }}
              />
              <Marker
                position={[hazard.latitude, hazard.longitude]}
                icon={createDangerMarkerIcon(
                  hazard.category || "GENERAL",
                  (hazard.severity as any) || "HIGH",
                  14
                )}
              >
                <Popup className="clean-white-popup">
                  <div className="p-1.5 font-sans min-w-[200px]">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold text-xs mb-1">
                      <AlertTriangle
                        className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${
                          isInterceptedByActive ? "text-red-600" : "text-slate-500"
                        }`}
                      />
                      <span className={isInterceptedByActive ? "text-red-700" : "text-slate-700"}>
                        {isInterceptedByActive
                          ? isBn
                            ? "সক্রিয় বিপদ (রুটের মধ্যে)"
                            : "Active Street Hazard (On Route)"
                          : isBn
                          ? "বাইপাসকৃত বিপদ (এড়িয়ে যাওয়া হয়েছে)"
                          : "Bypassed Hazard (Safely Avoided)"}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-800 uppercase">
                      {formatCategoryLabel(hazard.category, language)}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                      {isInterceptedByActive
                        ? isBn
                          ? `যাত্রাপথ থেকে দূরত্ব: ${hazard.distanceFromRouteMeters} মিটার`
                          : `Distance from route: ${hazard.distanceFromRouteMeters}m`
                        : isBn
                        ? "নির্বাচিত রুট এই বিপদ সফলভাবে এড়িয়ে চলছে"
                        : "Selected route safely avoids this hazard zone"}
                    </p>
                    <div className="mt-1.5 flex items-center justify-between text-[9px] font-bold">
                      <span
                        className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded uppercase ${
                          isInterceptedByActive
                            ? "bg-red-100 text-red-800"
                            : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-600"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {hazard.severity} Severity ({bufferRadius}m Buffer)
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </Popup>
              </Marker>
            </React.Fragment>
          );
        })}
      </MapContainer>

      {/* Floating Map Legend */}
      <div className="absolute bottom-3 left-3 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 shadow-md z-[1000] text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-700 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500"></span>
          <span>{isBn ? "শুরু" : "Origin"}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-red-600"></span>
          <span>{isBn ? "গন্তব্য" : "Destination"}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="w-3.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500"></span>
          <span>{isBn ? "নির্বাচিত রুট (সড়ক পথ)" : "Active Road Route"}</span>
        </div>
        {routes && routes.length > 1 && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="w-3.5 h-1 border-b-2 border-dashed border-slate-400"></span>
            <span>{isBn ? "বিকল্প রুট" : "Alternative Route"}</span>
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full border border-red-500 bg-red-500/20"></span>
          <span>{isBn ? "বিপদ অঞ্চল (৮০-২৫০মি)" : "Hazard Buffer (80-250m)"}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
