## [File 107] `apps/web/components/alerts/PolygonDrawerMap.tsx`
> **Path:** `apps/web/components/alerts/PolygonDrawerMap.tsx`  
> **Lines of Code:** 330  
> **Language:** `tsx`

### What This Code Does
This component provides an interactive map canvas for drawing custom polygon alert geofences.
Users can click to plot vertices defining a geographic perimeter (e.g., around their home or commute path).
Saved polygons are stored in PostgreSQL to trigger automated push notifications for incidents inside the boundary.

```tsx
"use client";

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  MapContainer,
  TileLayer,
  Polygon,
  Polyline,
  Marker,
  Popup,
  Tooltip,
  useMap,
  useMapEvents,
} from "react-leaflet";
import { useMapStore, MAP_LAYERS } from "@/store/useMapStore";
import MapLayerSwitcher from "@/components/map/MapLayerSwitcher";
import L from "leaflet";
import "leaflet/dist/leaflet.css";

export interface AlertZoneItem {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  userId?: string;
  area?: {
    type: string;
    coordinates: [number, number][][];
  };
  coordinates?: [number, number][];
  createdAt?: string;
}

interface PolygonDrawerMapProps {
  activeCoords: [number, number][]; // [lng, lat]
  onAddPoint: (point: [number, number]) => void;
  savedZones?: AlertZoneItem[];
  selectedZoneId?: string | null;
  onSelectZone?: (zone: AlertZoneItem) => void;
}

// Custom Leaflet DivIcons for daylight map
const createVertexIcon = (index: number, isFirst: boolean, isClosed: boolean) => {
  if (isFirst && !isClosed) {
    return L.divIcon({
      className: "custom-vertex-start",
      html: `
        <div style="
          width: 28px;
          height: 28px;
          background: #059669;
          color: #ffffff;
          border-radius: 9999px;
          border: 3px solid #ffffff;
          box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(5,150,105,0.45);
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          font-weight: 800;
          font-size: 11px;
          cursor: pointer;
          animation: pulse 1.8s infinite;
        ">
          1
        </div>
      `,
      iconSize: [28, 28],
      iconAnchor: [14, 14],
    });
  }

  return L.divIcon({
    className: "custom-vertex-node",
    html: `
      <div style="
        width: 22px;
        height: 22px;
        background: #2563EB;
        color: #ffffff;
        border-radius: 9999px;
        border: 2px solid #ffffff;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(37,99,235,0.4);
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 10px;
      ">
        ${index + 1}
      </div>
    `,
    iconSize: [22, 22],
    iconAnchor: [11, 11],
  });
};

// Map click handler to place vertices
function MapClickHandler({ onAddPoint }: { onAddPoint: (point: [number, number]) => void }) {
  useMapEvents({
    click: (e) => {
      onAddPoint([
        parseFloat(e.latlng.lng.toFixed(5)),
        parseFloat(e.latlng.lat.toFixed(5)),
      ]);
    },
  });
  return null;
}

// Center controller for pan / zoom
function MapPanController({
  center,
  zoom,
}: {
  center: [number, number] | null;
  zoom?: number;
}) {
  const map = useMap();
  useEffect(() => {
    if (center) {
      map.flyTo(center, zoom || 14, { duration: 1.2 });
    }
  }, [center, zoom, map]);
  return null;
}

export default function PolygonDrawerMap({
  activeCoords,
  onAddPoint,
  savedZones = [],
  selectedZoneId,
  onSelectZone,
}: PolygonDrawerMapProps) {
  const activeTileLayer = useMapStore((state) => state.activeTileLayer);
  const currentTileConfig = MAP_LAYERS[activeTileLayer] || MAP_LAYERS.google_streets;
  // Convert [lng, lat] GeoJSON coordinates to Leaflet [lat, lng]
  const leafletActivePositions: [number, number][] = activeCoords.map(([lng, lat]) => [
    lat,
    lng,
  ]);

  const isClosed =
    activeCoords.length >= 4 &&
    activeCoords[0][0] === activeCoords[activeCoords.length - 1][0] &&
    activeCoords[0][1] === activeCoords[activeCoords.length - 1][1];

  const [flyTarget, setFlyTarget] = useState<[number, number] | null>(null);

  // Extract polygon coordinates safely for saved zones
  const parsedSavedZones = savedZones.map((zone) => {
    let rawCoords: [number, number][] = [];
    if (zone.area?.coordinates?.[0]) {
      rawCoords = zone.area.coordinates[0];
    } else if (zone.coordinates) {
      rawCoords = zone.coordinates;
    }
    const positions: [number, number][] = rawCoords.map(([lng, lat]) => [lat, lng]);
    return {
      ...zone,
      positions,
    };
  });

  return (
    <div className="w-full h-[340px] sm:h-[400px] lg:h-[440px] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-200/90 shadow-sm relative z-0 bg-slate-50">
      <MapContainer
        center={[23.7925, 90.4078]} // Dhaka center
        zoom={13}
        minZoom={7}
        maxZoom={18}
        attributionControl={false}
        className="w-full h-full"
        style={{ height: "100%", width: "100%" }}
      >
        {/* Active High-Detail Tile Layer (Google Streets / Satellite Hybrid / OSM) */}
        <TileLayer
          key={activeTileLayer}
          url={currentTileConfig.url}
          attribution={currentTileConfig.attribution}
          maxZoom={currentTileConfig.maxZoom}
          subdomains={currentTileConfig.subdomains || ['0', '1', '2', '3']}
        />

        <MapClickHandler onAddPoint={onAddPoint} />
        <MapPanController center={flyTarget} />

        {/* Existing Saved Alert Zones (Translucent Green/Teal) */}
        {parsedSavedZones.map((zone) => {
          if (zone.positions.length < 3) return null;
          const isSelected = selectedZoneId === zone.id;

          return (
            <Polygon
              key={zone.id}
              positions={zone.positions}
              pathOptions={{
                color: isSelected ? "#059669" : "#0D9488",
                fillColor: isSelected ? "#10B981" : "#14B8A6",
                fillOpacity: isSelected ? 0.35 : 0.15,
                weight: isSelected ? 3 : 2,
                dashArray: isSelected ? undefined : "4, 4",
              }}
              eventHandlers={{
                click: (e) => {
                  L.DomEvent.stopPropagation(e);
                  onSelectZone?.(zone);
                },
              }}
            >
              <Tooltip direction="top" offset={[0, -10]} opacity={0.95}>
                <div className="text-xs font-semibold px-1 py-0.5 text-slate-800">
                  <div className="font-bold text-teal-800">{zone.name}</div>
                  <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">Active Geofence Perimeter</div>
                </div>
              </Tooltip>
            </Polygon>
          );
        })}

        {/* Currently Drawing Active Polygon or Polyline */}
        {leafletActivePositions.length >= 3 && isClosed && (
          <Polygon
            positions={leafletActivePositions}
            pathOptions={{
              color: "#2563EB",
              fillColor: "#3B82F6",
              fillOpacity: 0.28,
              weight: 3,
            }}
          >
            <Tooltip permanent={false} direction="center">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-blue-800 bg-white/90 px-2 py-0.5 rounded shadow">
                Drawing Active Perimeter
              </span>
            </Tooltip>
          </Polygon>
        )}

        {/* Unclosed Polyline guide */}
        {leafletActivePositions.length >= 2 && !isClosed && (
          <Polyline
            positions={leafletActivePositions}
            pathOptions={{
              color: "#2563EB",
              weight: 3,
              dashArray: "6, 6",
            }}
          />
        )}

        {/* Closing guide dashed line from last point to first point */}
        {leafletActivePositions.length >= 3 && !isClosed && (
          <Polyline
            positions={[
              leafletActivePositions[leafletActivePositions.length - 1],
              leafletActivePositions[0],
            ]}
            pathOptions={{
              color: "#059669",
              weight: 2,
              dashArray: "4, 4",
              opacity: 0.7,
            }}
          />
        )}

        {/* Active Polygon Vertices with Order Badges */}
        {leafletActivePositions.map((pos, idx) => {
          // If closed, don't duplicate the marker for the final duplicate vertex
          if (isClosed && idx === leafletActivePositions.length - 1) return null;
          const isFirst = idx === 0;

          return (
            <Marker
              key={idx}
              position={pos}
              icon={createVertexIcon(idx, isFirst, isClosed)}
              eventHandlers={{
                click: (e) => {
                  L.DomEvent.stopPropagation(e);
                  // Clicking the first vertex when 3+ points placed closes the ring
                  if (isFirst && leafletActivePositions.length >= 3 && !isClosed) {
                    onAddPoint([activeCoords[0][0], activeCoords[0][1]]);
                  }
                },
              }}
            >
              <Tooltip direction="top" offset={[0, -12]}>
                <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-700">
                  {isFirst && !isClosed
                    ? "Click to Close Polygon Ring"
                    : `Vertex ${idx + 1}: ${pos[0].toFixed(4)}, ${pos[1].toFixed(4)}`}
                </span>
              </Tooltip>
            </Marker>
          );
        })}
      </MapContainer>

      {/* Floating Instructions Overlay */}
      <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 z-[1000] pointer-events-none">
        <div className="bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200/80 shadow-md text-[11px] text-slate-700 font-medium flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-blue-600 animate-ping" />
          <span>Click map to place perimeter vertices</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Legend Badge */}
      <div className="absolute bottom-3 left-3 z-[1000] pointer-events-none hidden sm:flex items-center gap-2 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200/80 shadow-md text-[10px] text-slate-600">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-blue-600 border border-white" />
          <span>Active Drawing</span>
        </div>
        <span className="text-slate-300">•</span>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-600 border border-white" />
          <span>Start Point (Click to Close)</span>
        </div>
        {savedZones.length > 0 && (
          <>
            <span className="text-slate-300">•</span>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-teal-500 border border-white" />
              <span>Saved Zones ({savedZones.length})</span>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### What This Code Does
This persistent floating emergency button provides immediate access to critical crisis services.
With one tap, it reveals rapid-dial buttons for the National Emergency Service (999) and local police stations.
It also features an emergency siren toggle that plays synthesized alarm tones to deter attackers.

```tsx
"use client";

import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import {
  PhoneCall,
  AlertTriangle,
  X,
  Copy,
  Check,
  Send,
  Navigation,
  ShieldAlert,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useLanguageStore } from "@/store/useLanguageStore";
import { useMapStore } from "@/store/useMapStore";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";

export default function EmergencySosPill() {
  const isSosModalOpen = useMapStore((state) => state.isSosModalOpen);
  const openSosModal = useMapStore((state) => state.openSosModal);
  const closeSosModal = useMapStore((state) => state.closeSosModal);
  const [coords, setCoords] = useState<{ lat: number; lng: number; accuracy?: number } | null>(null);
  const [gpsError, setGpsError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const { language } = useLanguageStore();
  const pathname = usePathname();

  const isBn = language === "bn";

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isSosModalOpen && !coords && typeof window !== "undefined") {
      // 1. Check if user previously calibrated their location
      const saved = useMapStore.getState().loadSavedLocation();
      if (saved) {
        setCoords({
          lat: saved.lat,
          lng: saved.lng,
          accuracy: saved.accuracy || 25,
        });
      }

      // 2. Query browser geolocation
      if (navigator.geolocation) {
        navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
          (pos) => {
            // Prioritize live GPS if accuracy is high or no saved calibration
            if (!saved || pos.coords.accuracy <= 100) {
              setCoords({
                lat: Number(pos.coords.latitude.toFixed(6)),
                lng: Number(pos.coords.longitude.toFixed(6)),
                accuracy: Math.round(pos.coords.accuracy),
              });
            }
          },
          (err) => {
            if (!saved) {
              setGpsError(err.message || "Failed to retrieve live coordinates");
            }
          },
          { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 8000 }
        );
      }
    }
  }, [isSosModalOpen, coords]);

  const coordsText = coords
    ? `${coords.lat}, ${coords.lng}`
    : "Acquiring live GPS...";

  const handleCopy = () => {
    if (!coords) return;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(coordsText);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  const distressMessage = coords
    ? `🚨 জরুরি সাহায্য প্রয়োজন! (EMERGENCY DISTRESS): আমি বিপদে আছি। আমার অবস্থান (Coordinates): https://maps.google.com/?q=${coords.lat},${coords.lng}`
    : "🚨 জরুরি সাহায্য প্রয়োজন! (EMERGENCY DISTRESS): আমি বিপদে আছি।";

  const whatsappUrl = `https://wa.me/?text=${encodeURIComponent(distressMessage)}`;
  const smsUrl = `sms:?body=${encodeURIComponent(distressMessage)}`;

  const showFloatingButton = pathname === "/";

  return (
    <>
      {/* Desktop Floating Emergency SOS Pill: Sleek obsidian glassmorphic pill on the Live Threat Map only */}
      {showFloatingButton && (
        <aside aria-label={isBn ? "জরুরি সহায়তা প্যানেল" : "Emergency SOS Panel"}>
          <button
            onClick={openSosModal}
            className="hidden md:flex fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-[999] items-center gap-2 bg-slate-900/90 hover:bg-slate-950 text-white font-semibold px-3.5 py-2 rounded-full shadow-lg shadow-slate-950/25 border border-slate-700/60 backdrop-blur-md active:scale-95 transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer group hover:border-rose-500/50"
            title={isBn ? "জরুরি জাতীয় সহায়তা (৯৯৯)" : "Emergency SOS Help (999)"}
          >
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-rose-500 shrink-0 group-hover:bg-rose-400" />
            <PhoneCall className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-400 group-hover:text-white transition-colors" />
            <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-bold text-slate-200 group-hover:text-white whitespace-nowrap">
              {isBn ? "৯৯৯" : "SOS 999"}
            </span>
          </button>
        </aside>
      )}

      {/* Emergency Action Sheet Modal */}
      {isSosModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[2000] flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn">
          <div className="bg-white border border-red-200 rounded-2xl max-w-md w-full p-6 text-slate-900 shadow-2xl space-y-5 relative">
            {/* Header */}
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-600 shadow-2xs">
                  <ShieldAlert className="w-6 h-6 animate-pulse" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-extrabold text-lg text-slate-900">
                    {isBn ? "জরুরি সহায়তা কেন্দ্র (৯৯৯)" : "Emergency SOS Command"}
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-red-600 font-semibold">
                    {isBn ? "জাতীয় জরুরি সেবা ও পুলিশ কল" : "National Emergency Dispatch Hotline"}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={closeSosModal}
                className="p-1 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 transition"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Direct 999 Call Button */}
            <a
              href="tel:999"
              className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-3 py-4 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-red-600 via-rose-600 to-red-700 hover:from-red-500 hover:to-rose-600 text-white font-extrabold text-lg shadow-xl shadow-red-600/30 active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform"
            >
              <PhoneCall className="w-6 h-6 animate-bounce" />
              <span>{isBn ? "৯৯৯ এ কল করুন (বিনামূল্যে)" : "Call 999 Dispatch Now"}</span>
            </a>

            {/* Coordinates & Location Copy */}
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-500">
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold text-slate-700">
                  <Navigation className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600" />
                  {isBn ? "আপনার বর্তমান অবস্থান (GPS)" : "Your Current GPS Location"}
                </span>
                {coords?.accuracy && (
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                    ±{coords.accuracy}m
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 bg-white px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200">
                <span className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-800 truncate">
                  {coordsText}
                </span>
                <button
                  disabled={!coords}
                  onClick={handleCopy}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-700 disabled:opacity-40 transition shrink-0"
                >
                  {copied ? (
                    <>
                      <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-600" />
                      <span className="text-emerald-600">{isBn ? "কপি হয়েছে" : "Copied"}</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />
                      <span>{isBn ? "কপি" : "Copy"}</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>

              {gpsError && (
                <p className="text-[10px] text-red-500 font-semibold">
                  ⚠️ {gpsError}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Quick Share with Family & Friends */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 block">
                {isBn ? "পরিবার বা বন্ধুদের অবস্থান পাঠান:" : "Dispatch Location to Contacts:"}
              </span>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <a
                  href={whatsappUrl}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 text-xs font-bold transition shadow-2xs"
                >
                  <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                  <span>WhatsApp</span>
                </a>

                <a
                  href={smsUrl}
                  className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200 text-xs font-bold transition shadow-2xs"
                >
                  <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600" />
                  <span>SMS</span>
                </a>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Disclaimer */}
            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 text-center leading-normal">
              {isBn
                ? "৯৯৯ বাংলাদেশ সরকারের জাতীয় জরুরি হেল্পলাইন (পুলিশ, ফায়ার সার্ভিস, অ্যাম্বুলেন্স)।"
                : "999 is Bangladesh Government's toll-free emergency dispatch (Police, Fire, Ambulance)."}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
export { EmergencySosPill };
```

### What This Code Does
This modal provides onboarding instructions for first-time visitors to DangerZoneBD.
It explains how to interpret threat marker colors, how to report hazards anonymously, and how to verify location.
It helps new users quickly understand the platform's public safety tools and verification badges.

```tsx
export function SafetyTutorialModal() {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const { language } = useLanguageStore();
  const isBn = language === "bn";

  // State mapping of termId -> boolean
  const [selectedTerms, setSelectedTerms] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>(() => {
    const defaults: Record<string, boolean> = {};
    SAFETY_TERMS_LIST.forEach((term) => {
      defaults[term.id] = true;
    });
    return defaults;
  });

  // Check storage on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return;

    try {
      const accepted = localStorage.getItem(SAFETY_TERMS_ACCEPTED_KEY);
      const savedConsents = localStorage.getItem(SAFETY_TERMS_CONSENTS_KEY);
      const legacyConsent = localStorage.getItem("danger_zone_terms_consent_v1");

      if (savedConsents) {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(savedConsents);
          setSelectedTerms((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...parsed }));
        } catch {
          // Fallback to defaults
        }
      }

      if (accepted !== "true") {
        if (legacyConsent) {
          localStorage.setItem(SAFETY_TERMS_ACCEPTED_KEY, "true");
        } else {
          setIsOpen(true);
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // localStorage disabled or restricted in private browsing
    }

    const handleOpenEvent = () => setIsOpen(true);
    window.addEventListener("open-safety-terms-modal", handleOpenEvent);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("open-safety-terms-modal", handleOpenEvent);
    };
  }, []);

  // Toggle individual term
  const handleToggleTerm = useCallback((termId: string) => {
    setSelectedTerms((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [termId]: !prev[termId],
    }));
  }, []);

  const mandatoryTerms = useMemo(
    () => SAFETY_TERMS_LIST.filter((term) => term.required),
    []
  );

  const optionalTerms = useMemo(
    () => SAFETY_TERMS_LIST.filter((term) => !term.required),
    []
  );

  const allMandatoryAccepted = useMemo(() => {
    return mandatoryTerms.every((term) => !!selectedTerms[term.id]);
  }, [mandatoryTerms, selectedTerms]);

  const selectedCount = useMemo(() => {
    return Object.values(selectedTerms).filter(Boolean).length;
  }, [selectedTerms]);

  const handleSelectAll = useCallback(() => {
    const updated: Record<string, boolean> = {};
    SAFETY_TERMS_LIST.forEach((term) => {
      updated[term.id] = true;
    });
    setSelectedTerms(updated);
  }, []);

  const handleResetToRequiredOnly = useCallback(() => {
    const updated: Record<string, boolean> = {};
    SAFETY_TERMS_LIST.forEach((term) => {
      updated[term.id] = term.required;
    });
    setSelectedTerms(updated);
  }, []);

  // Next / Save Action
  const handleNext = () => {
    if (!allMandatoryAccepted) return;

    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(SAFETY_TERMS_ACCEPTED_KEY, "true");
        const payload = {
          ...selectedTerms,
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        };
        localStorage.setItem(SAFETY_TERMS_CONSENTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(payload));
        window.dispatchEvent(
          new CustomEvent("safety_terms_updated", { detail: payload })
        );
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn("[SafetyTutorial] Failed to persist consent:", err);
      }
    }

    setIsOpen(false);
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="terms-dialog-title"
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[99999] flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-5 md:p-6 bg-slate-950/50 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-200"
    >
      <div className="relative bg-white border border-slate-200/90 rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl max-w-2xl w-full text-slate-900 shadow-[0_24px_56px_-12px_rgba(15,23,42,0.18),0_4px_16px_rgba(15,23,42,0.06)] flex flex-col max-h-[92vh] sm:max-h-[88vh] overflow-hidden">
        {/* Top Header Bar */}
        <header className="px-5 sm:px-7 pt-5 sm:pt-6 pb-4 border-b border-slate-100 bg-white shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
            <div className="space-y-1.5 flex-1 min-w-0">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-slate-100 border border-slate-200 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-wider font-semibold text-slate-700 uppercase">
                  <ShieldAlert className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-600" />
                  <span>{isBn ? "আইনি ও জননিরাপত্তা চুক্তি" : "Public Safety Charter"}</span>
                </span>
                <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-600 font-medium">
                  {selectedCount} of {SAFETY_TERMS_LIST.length}{" "}
                  {isBn ? "স্বীকৃত" : "Accepted"}
                </span>
              </div>

              <h2
                id="terms-dialog-title"
                className="text-base sm:text-xl font-semibold text-slate-900 tracking-tight leading-snug"
              >
                {isBn
                  ? "শর্তাবলী ও জননিরাপত্তা নীতিমালা"
                  : "Terms of Service & Safety Conditions"}
              </h2>

              <p className="text-xs sm:text-[13px] text-slate-600 leading-relaxed max-w-xl">
                {isBn
                  ? "ড্যাঞ্জার জোন বিডি ব্যবহারের পূর্বে শর্তাবলী পর্যালোচনা করুন। আপনি যেসব শর্তে সম্মত তা বেছে নিয়ে 'পরবর্তী' বাটনে চাপুন।"
                  : "Review the civic public safety charter below. You must accept statutory terms to access live reporting; optional intelligence telemetry may be toggled at any time."}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Quick Selection Filter Controls */}
          <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-600">
                {isBn ? "দ্রুত বাছাই:" : "Quick actions:"}
              </span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleSelectAll}
                className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:text-slate-950 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors inline-flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <CheckCheck className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-600" />
                <span>{isBn ? "সবগুলো নির্বাচন" : "Select All"}</span>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleResetToRequiredOnly}
                className="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors inline-flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <RotateCcw className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-slate-400" />
                <span>{isBn ? "শুধু বাধ্যতামূলক" : "Mandatory Only"}</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-slate-600">
              <Lock className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-600" />
              <span>{isBn ? "৪টি সংবিধিবদ্ধ শর্ত আবশ্যক" : "4 statutory terms required"}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </header>

        {/* Scrollable Terms Content */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 overflow-y-auto space-y-5 flex-1 divide-y divide-slate-100">
          {/* SECTION 1: Mandatory Legal & Civic Terms */}
          <section className="space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pb-1">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold tracking-wider uppercase text-slate-600">
                  SECTION A
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900">
                  {isBn ? "বাধ্যতামূলক আইনি ও নাগরিক সুরক্ষা নীতি" : "Statutory & Community Obligations"}
                </span>
              </div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200 font-semibold">
                {isBn ? "৪টি আবশ্যক" : "4 Required"}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2.5">
              {mandatoryTerms.map((term) => {
                const Icon = term.icon;
                const isChecked = !!selectedTerms[term.id];

                return (
                  <div
                    key={term.id}
                    role="checkbox"
                    aria-checked={isChecked}
                    tabIndex={0}
                    onClick={() => handleToggleTerm(term.id)}
                    onKeyDown={(e) => {
                      if (e.key === " " || e.key === "Enter") {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        handleToggleTerm(term.id);
                      }
                    }}
                    className={`w-full p-3.5 sm:p-4 rounded-xl border text-left flex items-start gap-3.5 transition-all cursor-pointer select-none group ${
                      isChecked
                        ? "bg-slate-50/80 border-slate-300 shadow-[0_1px_2px_rgba(15,23,42,0.04)]"
                        : "bg-white border-dashed border-rose-300 hover:border-rose-400 hover:bg-rose-50/30"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {/* Custom Precision Indicator */}
                    <div className="pt-0.5 shrink-0">
                      <div
                        className={`w-5 h-5 rounded-md border flex items-center justify-center transition-all ${

          <section className="space-y-3 pt-5">
```

## [File 110] `apps/web/components/auth/AdminLoginGateway.tsx`
> **Path:** `apps/web/components/auth/AdminLoginGateway.tsx`  
> **Lines of Code:** 217  
> **Language:** `tsx`

### What This Code Does
This component renders the secure administrator authentication gateway at /admin.
It provides a credential form for administrators to log in using verified email and password combinations.
Upon authentication, it stores secure session cookies and unlocks the moderation dashboard controls.

```tsx
"use client";

import React, { useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/store/useAuthStore";
import { useLanguageStore } from "@/store/useLanguageStore";
import { showToast } from "@/store/useToastStore";
import {
  Shield,
  Lock,
  Mail,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
  RefreshCw,
  ArrowRight,
  AlertCircle,
  ArrowLeft,
} from "lucide-react";

interface AdminLoginGatewayProps {
  onSuccess?: () => void;
  showBackToMap?: boolean;
}

export default function AdminLoginGateway({
  onSuccess,
  showBackToMap = true,
}: AdminLoginGatewayProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { loginAdminWithPassword, isLoading: storeLoading } = useAuthStore();
  const { language } = useLanguageStore();
  const isBn = language === "bn";

  const [email, setEmail] = useState("admin@safetymap.bd");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMessage(null);

    const trimmedEmail = email.trim();
    if (!trimmedEmail || !password) {
      setErrorMessage(
        isBn
          ? "অনুগ্রহ করে ইমেইল এবং পাসওয়ার্ড উভয়ই পূরণ করুন।"
          : "Please provide both administrator email and password."
      );
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await loginAdminWithPassword(trimmedEmail, password);
      showToast(
        isBn
          ? "প্রশাসনিক প্রমাণীকরণ সফল হয়েছে।"
          : "Administrator authenticated successfully.",
        "success"
      );
      if (onSuccess) {
        onSuccess();
      } else {
        router.push("/admin");
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      const msg =
        err.message ||
        (isBn
          ? "প্রমাণীকরণ ব্যর্থ হয়েছে। আপনার পরিচয়পত্র যাচাই করুন।"
          : "Authentication failed. Invalid email or password.");
      setErrorMessage(msg);
      showToast(msg, "error");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const isBusy = isSubmitting || storeLoading;

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-md mx-auto">
      {/* Premium Minimal Admin Card */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200/90 rounded-2xl shadow-xl shadow-slate-900/5 p-6 sm:p-8 transition-all">
        
        {/* Header: Danger Zone Shield Badge & Title */}
        <div className="text-center space-y-3 mb-6 sm:mb-8">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-red-50 text-red-600 border border-red-100 shadow-2xs mx-auto">
            <Shield className="w-6 h-6 fill-red-600/10" />
          </div>

          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
              {isBn ? "অ্যাডমিন পোর্টাল" : "Admin Portal"}
            </h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
              {isBn
                ? "মডারেশন কনসোলে প্রবেশ করতে সাইন ইন করুন"
                : "Sign in to access Danger Zone moderation tools"}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Error Alert */}
        {errorMessage && (
          <div
            role="alert"
            className="mb-5 p-3 bg-red-50/90 border border-red-200 rounded-xl text-xs text-red-800 flex items-start gap-2.5 animate-in fade-in duration-150"
          >
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <div className="flex-1 font-medium leading-relaxed">{errorMessage}</div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Login Form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          {/* Email Address */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label
              htmlFor="admin-email"
              className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700"
            >
              {isBn ? "অ্যাডমিন ইমেইল" : "Admin Email"}
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <input
                id="admin-email"
                type="email"
                autoComplete="email"
                required
                value={email}
                onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="admin@safetymap.bd"
                disabled={isBusy}
                className="w-full pl-10 pr-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs sm:text-sm bg-slate-50/50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:bg-white focus:border-red-600 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-red-600/10 focus:outline-none transition-all shadow-2xs disabled:opacity-60"
              />
              <Mail className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Password */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label
              htmlFor="admin-password"
              className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700"
            >
              {isBn ? "পাসওয়ার্ড" : "Password"}
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <input
                id="admin-password"
                type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"}
                autoComplete="current-password"
                required
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="••••••••••••"
                disabled={isBusy}
                className="w-full pl-10 pr-10 py-2.5 text-xs sm:text-sm bg-slate-50/50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:bg-white focus:border-red-600 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-red-600/10 focus:outline-none transition-all shadow-2xs disabled:opacity-60"
              />
              <Lock className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 p-1 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                aria-label={showPassword ? "Hide password" : "Show password"}
              >
                {showPassword ? (
                  <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" />
                ) : (
                  <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Primary Submit CTA - Matches "Report Threat" Navbar Button */}
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={isBusy}
            className="w-full mt-2 py-2.5 sm:py-3 px-4 bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white font-semibold text-xs sm:text-sm rounded-xl transition-all shadow-sm hover:shadow active:scale-[0.99] cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-2 disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            {isBusy ? (
              <>
                <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                <span>{isBn ? "সাইন ইন হচ্ছে..." : "Signing In..."}</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <span>{isBn ? "কনসোলে প্রবেশ করুন" : "Sign In to Console"}</span>
                <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        </form>

        {/* Back Link */}
        {showBackToMap && (
          <div className="mt-6 pt-5 border-t border-slate-100 text-center">
            <Link
              href="/"
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 transition-colors"
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{isBn ? "লাইভ ম্যাপে ফিরে যান" : "Return to Live Map"}</span>
            </Link>
          </div>
        )}

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## [File 112] `apps/web/components/admin/AdminTabsNav.tsx`
> **Path:** `apps/web/components/admin/AdminTabsNav.tsx`  
> **Lines of Code:** 126  
> **Language:** `tsx`

### What This Code Does
This component renders the navigation tab switcher within the administrator moderation portal.
It allows administrators to switch between Reports, Users, Verifications, Audit Logs, and Analytics views.
It displays notification badges indicating pending verification submissions and unreviewed reports.

```tsx
"use client";

import React from "react";
import { AdminTab } from "./types";
import {
  LayoutDashboard,
  ShieldAlert,
  UserCheck,
  UserX,
  FileText,
} from "lucide-react";

interface AdminTabsNavProps {
  activeTab: AdminTab;
  onTabChange: (tab: AdminTab) => void;
  reportsCount: number;
  verificationsCount: number;
  logsCount: number;
  isBn: boolean;
}

export default function AdminTabsNav({
  activeTab,
  onTabChange,
  reportsCount,
  verificationsCount,
  logsCount,
  isBn,
}: AdminTabsNavProps) {
  const tabs: Array<{
    id: AdminTab;
    labelEn: string;
    labelBn: string;
    icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>;
    count?: number;
    badgeColor?: string;
  }> = [
    {
      id: "overview",
      labelEn: "Overview",
      labelBn: "সারসংক্ষেপ",
      icon: LayoutDashboard,
    },
    {
      id: "reports",
      labelEn: "Incidents",
      labelBn: "সক্রিয় বিপদ",
      icon: ShieldAlert,
      count: reportsCount,
      badgeColor: "bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200",
    },
    {
      id: "verifications",
      labelEn: "Verifications",
      labelBn: "কেওয়াইসি যাচাই",
      icon: UserCheck,
      count: verificationsCount,
      badgeColor: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200",
    },
    {
      id: "users",
      labelEn: "User Defense",
      labelBn: "ইউজার প্রতিরোধ",
      icon: UserX,
    },
    {
      id: "logs",
      labelEn: "Audit Trail",
      labelBn: "অডিট ট্রেইল",
      icon: FileText,
      count: logsCount,
      badgeColor: "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-200",
    },
  ];

  return (
    <nav
      aria-label="Admin Navigation"
      className="bg-white border border-slate-200/90 rounded-2xl p-1.5 shadow-2xs overflow-x-auto scrollbar-none flex items-center gap-1 min-w-0"
    >
      {tabs.map((tab) => {
        const Icon = tab.icon;
        const isActive = activeTab === tab.id;

        return (
          <button
            key={tab.id}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onTabChange(tab.id)}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 sm:px-4 py-2 sm:py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 ${
              isActive
                ? "bg-slate-900 text-white shadow-xs"
                : "text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50"
            }`}
          >
            <Icon
              className={`w-4 h-4 ${
                isActive
                  ? tab.id === "reports"
                    ? "text-red-400"
                    : tab.id === "verifications"
                    ? "text-amber-400"
                    : "text-slate-300"
                  : "text-slate-400"
              }`}
            />
            <span>{isBn ? tab.labelBn : tab.labelEn}</span>

            {typeof tab.count === "number" && (
              <span
                className={`ml-0.5 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[10px] font-mono font-bold border ${
                  isActive
                    ? "bg-white/15 text-white border-white/20"
                    : tab.badgeColor || "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-200"
                }`}
              >
                {tab.count}
              </span>
            )}
          </button>
        );
      })}
    </nav>
  );
}
```

## [File 113] `apps/web/components/admin/AdminReportsSection.tsx`
> **Path:** `apps/web/components/admin/AdminReportsSection.tsx`  
> **Lines of Code:** 351  
> **Language:** `tsx`

### What This Code Does
This section component renders the moderation queue of all crowdsourced incident reports.
Administrators can search by description, filter by category or status, and inspect incident details.
It provides action buttons to verify reports, reclassify categories, or open the purge dialog.

```tsx
"use client";

import React, { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { AdminReport } from "./types";
import {
  ShieldAlert,
  Search,
  Trash2,
  ThumbsUp,
  ThumbsDown,
  Clock,
  Filter,
  X,
} from "lucide-react";

interface AdminReportsSectionProps {
  reports: AdminReport[];
  isBn: boolean;
  onSelectPurge: (report: AdminReport) => void;
  onSelectBanUser?: (
    user: { id: string; email?: string | null; anonymousId?: string; role?: string; trustScore?: number; isBanned?: boolean },
    action: "ban" | "unban"
  ) => void;
}

export default function AdminReportsSection({
  reports,
  isBn,
  onSelectPurge,
  onSelectBanUser,
}: AdminReportsSectionProps) {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [severityFilter, setSeverityFilter] = useState<string>("ALL");

  // Filtered reports
  const filteredReports = useMemo(() => {
    return reports.filter((r) => {
      const matchesSeverity =
        severityFilter === "ALL" || r.severity?.toUpperCase() === severityFilter;

      if (!matchesSeverity) return false;

      if (!searchQuery.trim()) return true;

      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
      const catMatch = r.category?.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const descMatch = r.description?.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const idMatch = r.id?.toLowerCase().includes(q);

      return catMatch || descMatch || idMatch;
    });
  }, [reports, searchQuery, severityFilter]);

  return (
    <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200/90 rounded-2xl shadow-xs overflow-hidden">
      
      {/* Section Header & Interactive Filter Toolbar */}
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 border-b border-slate-100 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-slate-50/50">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-red-50 border border-red-200/80 flex items-center justify-center text-red-600 shrink-0">
            <ShieldAlert className="w-4 h-4" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
              {isBn ? "লাইভ বিপদ রিপোর্টসমূহ" : "Active Hazard Reports"}
            </h2>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 font-medium">
              {isBn
                ? `মোট ${reports.length} টি রিপোর্টের মধ্যে ${filteredReports.length} টি প্রদর্শিত`
                : `Showing ${filteredReports.length} of ${reports.length} live incidents`}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Search & Severity Filters */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center gap-2.5">
          {/* Quick Search */}
          <div className="relative min-w-[200px] sm:w-56">
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={isBn ? "খুঁজুন (বিভাগ, বিবরণ বা আইডি)..." : "Search reports..."}
              className="w-full pl-8 pr-7 py-1.5 text-xs bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-red-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-600/10 transition-all shadow-2xs"
            />
            <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
            {searchQuery && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSearchQuery("")}
                className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 p-0.5"
              >
                <X className="w-3 h-3" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Severity Filter Pills */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 p-0.5 bg-slate-100 border border-slate-200/80 rounded-xl text-[11px] font-semibold shrink-0">
            {["ALL", "HIGH", "MEDIUM", "LOW"].map((sev) => (
              <button
                key={sev}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSeverityFilter(sev)}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg transition-all cursor-pointer font-bold ${
                  severityFilter === sev
                    ? "bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-2xs"
                    : "text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800"
                }`}
              >
                {sev === "ALL" ? (isBn ? "সব" : "All") : sev}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Desktop Table View (Hidden on mobile < md) */}
      <div className="hidden md:block overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
          <thead className="bg-slate-50/80 text-slate-600 font-bold border-b border-slate-200/80">
            <tr>
              <th className="p-3.5">{isBn ? "বিভাগ" : "Category"}</th>
              <th className="p-3.5">{isBn ? "তীব্রতা" : "Severity"}</th>
              <th className="p-3.5">{isBn ? "বিবরণ" : "Description"}</th>
              <th className="p-3.5">{isBn ? "রিপোর্টার" : "Reporter"}</th>
              <th className="p-3.5">{isBn ? "ভোট" : "Votes"}</th>
              <th className="p-3.5">{isBn ? "সময়" : "Time"}</th>
              <th className="p-3.5 text-right">{isBn ? "পদক্ষেপ" : "Action"}</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 text-slate-700">
            {filteredReports.length === 0 ? (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={7} className="p-10 text-center text-slate-500">
                  <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center space-y-2">
                    <ShieldAlert className="w-8 h-8 text-slate-300 stroke-[1.5]" />
                    <p className="text-xs font-medium">
                      {isBn ? "কোনো রিপোর্ট পাওয়া যায়নি।" : "No incident reports found matching criteria."}
                    </p>
                    {(searchQuery || severityFilter !== "ALL") && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          setSearchQuery("");
                          setSeverityFilter("ALL");
                        }}
                        className="text-xs font-bold text-red-600 hover:underline cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        {isBn ? "ফিল্টার রিসেট করুন" : "Reset filters"}
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ) : (
              filteredReports.map((r, idx) => (
                <tr key={r.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/70 transition-colors">
                  <td className="p-3.5 font-bold text-slate-900">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      {idx === 0 && !searchQuery && severityFilter === "ALL" && (
                        <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-700 font-mono font-bold">
                          [P] TOP
                        </span>
                      )}
                      <span>{r.category?.replace(/_/g, " ")}</span>
                    </div>
                  </td>

                  <td className="p-3.5">
                    <span
                      className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-extrabold border ${
                        r.severity === "HIGH"
                          ? "bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200"
                          : r.severity === "MEDIUM"
                          ? "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200"
                          : "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {r.severity}
                    </span>
                  </td>

                  <td className="p-3.5 max-w-sm truncate text-slate-800" title={r.description || ""}>
                    {r.description || "—"}
                  </td>

                  {/* Reporter column */}
                  <td className="p-3.5 whitespace-nowrap">
                    {r.user ? (
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <div className="flex flex-col min-w-0">
                          <span
                            className="font-bold text-xs text-slate-900 truncate max-w-[120px]"
                            title={r.user.email || r.user.anonymousId || r.user.id}
                          >
                            {r.user.email ? r.user.email.split("@")[0] : (r.user.anonymousId?.slice(0, 10) || "Anon")}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                            Trust: {r.user.trustScore ?? 50}/100
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        {onSelectBanUser && r.user.role !== "ADMIN" && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => onSelectBanUser(r.user!, r.user?.isBanned ? "unban" : "ban")}
                            className={`px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold rounded-md border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                              r.user.isBanned
                                ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200 hover:bg-emerald-100"
                                : "bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200 hover:bg-red-100"
                            }`}
                            title={r.user.isBanned ? "Restore User" : "Suspend Reporter"}
                          >
                            {r.user.isBanned ? (isBn ? "পুনরুদ্ধার" : "Unban") : (isBn ? "ব্যান" : "Ban")}
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="text-slate-400 text-[11px] italic">
                        {isBn ? "নাগরিক" : "Citizen"}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </td>

                  <td className="p-3.5 font-medium text-slate-700 whitespace-nowrap">
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 mr-2 text-emerald-600">
                      <ThumbsUp className="w-3 h-3" />
                      <span>{r.upvotes}</span>
                    </span>
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-slate-400">
                      <ThumbsDown className="w-3 h-3" />
                      <span>{r.downvotes}</span>
                    </span>
                  </td>

                  <td className="p-3.5 text-slate-500 font-mono text-[11px] whitespace-nowrap">
                    {new Date(r.createdAt).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" })}
                  </td>

                  <td className="p-3.5 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => onSelectPurge(r)}
                      className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-red-50 hover:bg-red-100 text-red-700 border border-red-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-2xs active:scale-95"
                      title={isBn ? "রিপোর্ট বাতিল ও অপসারণ" : "Purge this report"}
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>{isBn ? "মুছুন" : "Purge"}</span>
                    </button>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {/* Mobile Card View (Shown on screens < md) */}
      <div className="md:hidden divide-y divide-slate-100">
        {filteredReports.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-8 text-center text-slate-500">
            <ShieldAlert className="w-8 h-8 text-slate-300 stroke-[1.5] mx-auto mb-2" />
            <p className="text-xs font-medium">
              {isBn ? "কোনো রিপোর্ট পাওয়া যায়নি।" : "No incident reports found."}
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          filteredReports.map((r, idx) => (
            <div key={r.id} className="p-4 space-y-2.5 hover:bg-slate-50/60 transition-colors">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
                  {idx === 0 && !searchQuery && severityFilter === "ALL" && (
                    <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-700 font-mono font-bold shrink-0">
                      [P]
                    </span>
                  )}
                  <span className="font-bold text-xs text-slate-900 truncate">
                    {r.category?.replace(/_/g, " ")}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <span
                  className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-extrabold border shrink-0 ${
                    r.severity === "HIGH"
                      ? "bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200"
                      : r.severity === "MEDIUM"
                      ? "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200"
                      : "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200"
                  }`}
                >
                  {r.severity}
                </span>
              </div>

              {r.description && (
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-700 leading-relaxed line-clamp-2">
                  {r.description}
                </p>
              )}

              {/* Reporter in Mobile */}
              {r.user && (
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between py-1 px-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 border border-slate-100 text-[11px]">
                  <span className="font-mono text-slate-600 truncate max-w-[160px]">
                    Reporter: {r.user.email || r.user.anonymousId?.slice(0, 10)}
                  </span>
                  {onSelectBanUser && r.user.role !== "ADMIN" && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => onSelectBanUser(r.user!, r.user?.isBanned ? "unban" : "ban")}
                      className="text-[10px] font-bold text-red-600 hover:underline"
                    >
                      {r.user.isBanned ? "Unban" : "Ban"}
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-emerald-600 font-medium">
                    <ThumbsUp className="w-3 h-3" />
                    <span>{r.upvotes}</span>
                  </span>
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-slate-400">
                    <ThumbsDown className="w-3 h-3" />
                    <span>{r.downvotes}</span>
                  </span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-slate-400">
                    {new Date(r.createdAt).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" })}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onSelectPurge(r)}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-red-50 hover:bg-red-100 text-red-700 border border-red-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-2xs active:scale-95"
                >
                  <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{isBn ? "মুছুন" : "Purge"}</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))
        )}
      </div>

    </div>
  );
}
```

## [File 114] `apps/web/components/admin/AdminUsersSection.tsx`
> **Path:** `apps/web/components/admin/AdminUsersSection.tsx`  
> **Lines of Code:** 617  
> **Language:** `tsx`

### What This Code Does
This section component allows administrators to inspect user activity and enforce platform defense policies.
It lists user IDs, trust scores, verification statuses, report counts, and current ban states.
Administrators can ban abusive device IDs or restore suspended accounts with recorded moderation reasons.

```tsx
"use client";

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useTransition } from "react";
import { AdminLog, AdminUser, UUID_PATTERN } from "./types";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { showToast } from "@/store/useToastStore";
import {
  UserX,
  UserCheck,
  ShieldAlert,
  Clock,
  Search,
  X,
  Copy,
  Check,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  Shield,
  Smartphone,
  Phone,
  Mail,
  Users,
} from "lucide-react";

interface AdminUsersSectionProps {
  logs: AdminLog[];
  isBn: boolean;
  onSelectBanUser?: (
    user: AdminUser | { id: string; email?: string | null; anonymousId?: string; role?: string; trustScore?: number; isBanned?: boolean },
    action: "ban" | "unban"
  ) => void;
  onDirectBanIdentifier?: (
    identifier: string,
    reason: string,
    action: "ban" | "unban"
  ) => Promise<void>;
}

export default function AdminUsersSection({
  logs,
  isBn,
  onSelectBanUser,
  onDirectBanIdentifier,
}: AdminUsersSectionProps) {
  // Directory Remote State
  const [users, setUsers] = useState<AdminUser[]>([]);
  const [usersTotal, setUsersTotal] = useState(0);
  const [usersPage, setUsersPage] = useState(1);
  const [usersLimit] = useState(15);
  const [isLoadingUsers, setIsLoadingUsers] = useState(false);

  // Filters & Search State
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [roleFilter, setRoleFilter] = useState<string>("ALL");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<string>("ALL");
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState<"createdAt" | "trustScore">("createdAt");
  const [copiedId, setCopiedId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Manual Quick Action Form State
  const [manualIdentifier, setManualIdentifier] = useState("");
  const [manualReason, setManualReason] = useState("");
  const [isSubmittingManual, setIsSubmittingManual] = useState(false);

  // Fetch Users from API
  const fetchUsers = useCallback(
    async (
      search = searchQuery,
      role = roleFilter,
      status = statusFilter,
      page = usersPage,
      sort = sortBy
    ) => {
      setIsLoadingUsers(true);
      try {
        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        if (search.trim()) params.set("search", search.trim());
        if (role !== "ALL") params.set("role", role);
        if (status === "BANNED") params.set("isBanned", "true");
        if (status === "ACTIVE") params.set("isBanned", "false");
        if (status === "VERIFIED") params.set("isVerified", "true");
        params.set("page", String(page));
        params.set("limit", String(usersLimit));
        params.set("sortBy", sort);
        params.set("sortOrder", "desc");

        const data = await apiFetch<{ users: AdminUser[]; pagination: { total: number } }>(
          `/admin/users?${params.toString()}`
        );
        setUsers(data?.users || []);
        setUsersTotal(data?.pagination?.total || 0);
      } catch (err: any) {
        console.warn("[Admin Users Fetch] Error:", err.message);
      } finally {
        setIsLoadingUsers(false);
      }
    },
    [searchQuery, roleFilter, statusFilter, usersPage, usersLimit, sortBy]
  );

  // Debounced search effect
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      fetchUsers(searchQuery, roleFilter, statusFilter, 1, sortBy);
      setUsersPage(1);
    }, 250);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [searchQuery, roleFilter, statusFilter, sortBy, fetchUsers]);

  // Copy UUID to clipboard
  const handleCopyUUID = (uuid: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(uuid);
    setCopiedId(uuid);
    showToast(isBn ? "ইউজার UUID কপি করা হয়েছে!" : "User UUID copied to clipboard!", "success");
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedId(null), 2000);
  };

  // Submit manual action
  const handleManualSubmit = async (action: "ban" | "unban") => {
    const trimmedId = manualIdentifier.trim();
    if (!trimmedId) {
      showToast(
        isBn
          ? "অনুগ্রহ করে ইউজারের UUID, ইমেইল, মোবাইল বা ডিভাইস আইডি দিন।"
          : "Please enter a user UUID, email, phone, or device ID.",
        "warning"
      );
      return;
    }
    if (manualReason.trim().length < 3) {
      showToast(
        isBn ? "কারণ কমপক্ষে ৩ অক্ষরের হতে হবে।" : "Reason must be at least 3 characters.",
        "warning"
      );
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmittingManual(true);
    try {
      if (onDirectBanIdentifier) {
        await onDirectBanIdentifier(trimmedId, manualReason.trim(), action);
      } else {
        await apiFetch(`/admin/users/${encodeURIComponent(trimmedId)}/${action}`, {
          method: "POST",
          body: JSON.stringify({ reason: manualReason.trim() }),
        });
        showToast(
          action === "ban"
            ? isBn ? "ইউজার সফলভাবে স্থগিত করা হয়েছে।" : "User suspended successfully."
            : isBn ? "ইউজার অ্যাকাউন্ট সফলভাবে পুনরুদ্ধার করা হয়েছে।" : "User restored successfully.",
          "success"
        );
      }
      setManualIdentifier("");
      setManualReason("");
      fetchUsers();
    } catch (err: any) {
      showToast(err.message || `Failed to ${action} user.`, "error");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingManual(false);
    }
  };

  // Recent moderation actions from logs
  const userActions = logs.filter(
    (l) => l.action?.includes("USER") || l.targetUserId
  ).slice(0, 6);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* 1. CITIZEN DIRECTORY TABLE & SEARCH CONSOLE */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200/90 rounded-2xl shadow-xs overflow-hidden space-y-4 p-5 sm:p-6">
        {/* Header Title */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-purple-50 border border-purple-200/80 flex items-center justify-center text-purple-600 shrink-0">
              <Users className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
                {isBn ? "নাগরিক ডিরেক্টরি ও সার্চ প্ল্যাটফর্ম" : "Citizen Directory & Moderation"}
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium">
                {isBn
                  ? `মোট ${usersTotal} জন নাগরিকের মধ্যে ${users.length} জন প্রদর্শিত হচ্ছে`
                  : `Managing ${usersTotal} citizens registered via email, phone, or verified devices`}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => fetchUsers()}
              disabled={isLoadingUsers}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 rounded-xl transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              {isLoadingUsers ? (isBn ? "রিফ্রেশ হচ্ছে..." : "Refreshing...") : (isBn ? "রিফ্রেশ" : "Refresh")}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Filter Toolbar: Search Bar + Filter Pills + Role Selector */}
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-3 pt-1">
          {/* Omni Search Bar */}
          <div className="relative flex-1">
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={
                isBn
                  ? "ইমেইল, মোবাইল (+880...), ডিভাইস আইডি বা ইউজার UUID খুঁজুন..."
                  : "Search by email, phone (+880...), device ID, or user UUID..."
              }
              className="w-full pl-9 pr-9 py-2 text-xs bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:bg-white focus:outline-none focus:border-purple-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-600/10 transition-all shadow-2xs"
            />
            <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
            {searchQuery && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSearchQuery("")}
                className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 p-0.5"
              >
                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Status Filter Pills */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
            {[
              { id: "ALL", label: isBn ? "সব নাগরিক" : "All" },
              { id: "ACTIVE", label: isBn ? "সক্রিয়" : "Active" },
              { id: "BANNED", label: isBn ? "স্থগিত" : "Suspended" },
              { id: "VERIFIED", label: isBn ? "যাচাইকৃত" : "Verified" },
            ].map((f) => (
              <button
                key={f.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setStatusFilter(f.id)}
                className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  statusFilter === f.id
                    ? "bg-purple-700 text-white shadow-xs"
                    : "bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-600 border border-slate-200/60"
                }`}
              >
                {f.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Role Filter Selector */}
          <div className="shrink-0">
            <select
              value={roleFilter}
              onChange={(e) => setRoleFilter(e.target.value)}

            >
              <option value="ALL">{isBn ? "সকল ভূমিকা" : "All Roles"}</option>
              <option value="USER">{isBn ? "নাগরিক (USER)" : "Citizens (USER)"}</option>
              <option value="VERIFIED_RESPONDER">{isBn ? "রেসপন্ডার (RESPONDER)" : "Responders"}</option>
              <option value="ADMIN">{isBn ? "প্রশাসক (ADMIN)" : "Admins"}</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Dense Citizen Data Table */}
        <div className="border border-slate-200/90 rounded-xl overflow-x-auto shadow-2xs">
          <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
            <thead>
              <tr className="bg-slate-50/80 border-b border-slate-200 text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                <th className="p-3">{isBn ? "নাগরিক পরিচয়" : "Citizen Identity"}</th>
                <th className="p-3">{isBn ? "যোগাযোগ ও ডিভাইস" : "Contact & Device"}</th>
                <th className="p-3">{isBn ? "ভূমিকা" : "Role"}</th>
                <th className="p-3">{isBn ? "ট্রাস্ট স্কোর" : "Trust Meter"}</th>
                <th className="p-3">{isBn ? "কার্যক্রম" : "Activity"}</th>
                <th className="p-3">{isBn ? "অবস্থা" : "Status"}</th>
                <th className="p-3 text-right">{isBn ? "অ্যাকশন" : "Actions"}</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
              {isLoadingUsers ? (

                      <span>{isBn ? "নাগরিক তথ্য লোড হচ্ছে..." : "Loading citizens directory..."}</span>

              ) : users.length === 0 ? (

              ) : (
                users.map((u) => {
                  const isSuspended = u.isBanned;
                  const displayHandle = u.email || u.anonymousId || u.id;
                  const isVerifiedCitizen = u.isVerified;

                      <td className="p-3 whitespace-nowrap">

                          ) : (

                            </span>
                          )}
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-400 truncate max-w-[140px]" title={u.anonymousId}>

                      {/* Role Badge */}
                      <td className="p-3 whitespace-nowrap">

                            ? "bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 border-purple-200"
                            : u.role === "VERIFIED_RESPONDER"
                            ? "bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 border-sky-200"

                        }`}>
                          {u.role === "VERIFIED_RESPONDER" ? "RESPONDER" : u.role}

                          <div className="w-full bg-slate-100 h-1.5 rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-slate-200/60">
                            <div
                              className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${

                              style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, Math.max(5, u.trustScore ?? 50))}%` }}
```
