```tsx
                      </td>

                      {/* Activity */}
                      <td className="p-3 whitespace-nowrap">
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-600 font-mono space-y-0.5">
                          <div>
                            <span className="font-bold text-slate-800">{u._count?.reports ?? 0}</span> {isBn ? "রিপোর্ট" : "reports"}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                            <span className="font-bold">{u._count?.votes ?? 0}</span> {isBn ? "ভোট" : "votes"}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      {/* Status */}
                      <td className="p-3 whitespace-nowrap">
                        <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-extrabold border ${
                          isSuspended
                            ? "bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200"
                            : isVerifiedCitizen
                            ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200"
                            : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border-slate-200"
                        }`}>
                          {isSuspended
                            ? isBn ? "স্থগিত" : "SUSPENDED"
                            : isVerifiedCitizen
                            ? isBn ? "যাচাইকৃত" : "ACTIVE (KYC)"
                            : isBn ? "সক্রিয়" : "ACTIVE"}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      {/* Actions */}
                      <td className="p-3 whitespace-nowrap text-right space-x-1.5">
                        {/* Copy UUID button */}
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleCopyUUID(u.id)}
                          className="p-1.5 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-600 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                          title={isBn ? "UUID কপি করুন" : "Copy UUID"}
                        >
                          {copiedId === u.id ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                        </button>

                        {/* Ban / Restore Button */}
                        {u.role !== "ADMIN" && onSelectBanUser && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => onSelectBanUser(u, isSuspended ? "unban" : "ban")}
                            className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg border transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs active:scale-95 ${
                              isSuspended
                                ? "bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200"
                                : "bg-red-50 hover:bg-red-100 text-red-700 border-red-200"
                            }`}
                          >
                            {isSuspended ? (isBn ? "পুনরুদ্ধার" : "Restore") : (isBn ? "স্থগিত" : "Suspend")}
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        {/* Pagination Controls */}
        {usersTotal > usersLimit && (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 text-xs">
            <span className="text-slate-500">
              {isBn
                ? `পৃষ্ঠা ${usersPage} / ${Math.ceil(usersTotal / usersLimit) || 1}`
                : `Page ${usersPage} of ${Math.ceil(usersTotal / usersLimit) || 1}`}
            </span>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={usersPage <= 1}
                onClick={() => {
                  const p = usersPage - 1;
                  setUsersPage(p);
                  fetchUsers(searchQuery, roleFilter, statusFilter, p, sortBy);
                }}
                className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 disabled:opacity-40 text-slate-700 font-bold rounded-lg transition-colors flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <ChevronLeft className="w-3 h-3" />
                <span>{isBn ? "পূর্ববর্তী" : "Prev"}</span>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={usersPage >= Math.ceil(usersTotal / usersLimit)}
                onClick={() => {
                  const p = usersPage + 1;
                  setUsersPage(p);
                  fetchUsers(searchQuery, roleFilter, statusFilter, p, sortBy);
                }}
                className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 disabled:opacity-40 text-slate-700 font-bold rounded-lg transition-colors flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <span>{isBn ? "পরবর্তী" : "Next"}</span>
                <ChevronRight className="w-3 h-3" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* 2. DIRECT OVERRIDE FORM & RECENT AUDIT LOGS */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* Left (7 cols): Direct Identifier Moderation Form */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-7 bg-white border border-slate-200/90 rounded-2xl shadow-xs p-5 sm:p-6 space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-red-50 border border-red-200/80 flex items-center justify-center text-red-600 shrink-0">
              <UserX className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
                {isBn ? "সরাসরি আইডেন্টিফায়ার মডারেশন" : "Direct Multi-Identifier Enforcement"}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium">
                {isBn
                  ? "ইমেইল, মোবাইল (+880), ডিভাইস আইডি বা UUID দিয়ে সরাসরি ইউজার ব্যবস্থা নিন"
                  : "Quickly ban or unban by email, phone (+880...), anonymous device ID, or UUID"}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-3 pt-1">
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                {isBn ? "টার্গেট আইডেন্টিফায়ার *" : "Target Identifier (UUID / Email / Phone / Device ID) *"}
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={manualIdentifier}
                onChange={(e) => setManualIdentifier(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. user@dangerzone.bd, +8801700..., or UUID"
                disabled={isSubmittingManual}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 text-xs bg-slate-50/60 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-slate-900 font-mono placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:bg-white focus:outline-none focus:border-red-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-600/10 transition-all shadow-2xs disabled:opacity-60"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1">
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                {isBn ? "পদক্ষেপের কারণ *" : "Official Reason *"}
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={manualReason}
                onChange={(e) => setManualReason(e.target.value)}
                placeholder={isBn ? "যেমন: বারবার মিথ্যা জরুরি রিপোর্ট দাখিল" : "e.g., Repeated false incident reports"}
                disabled={isSubmittingManual}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 text-xs bg-slate-50/60 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:bg-white focus:outline-none focus:border-red-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-600/10 transition-all shadow-2xs disabled:opacity-60"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 pt-1">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleManualSubmit("ban")}
                disabled={isSubmittingManual}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-2xs transition-all active:scale-95 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                <UserX className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>{isBn ? "স্থগিত / ব্যান করুন" : "Suspend / Ban"}</span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleManualSubmit("unban")}
                disabled={isSubmittingManual}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-800 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 border border-slate-200 transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                <UserCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-600" />
                <span>{isBn ? "পুনরুদ্ধার করুন" : "Restore / Unban"}</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right (5 cols): Contextual Recent Enforcement Logs */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 bg-white border border-slate-200/90 rounded-2xl shadow-xs p-5 sm:p-6 space-y-4 flex flex-col justify-between">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
              <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-600" />
              <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 uppercase tracking-wider">
                {isBn ? "সাম্প্রতিক ইউজার অ্যাকশন লগ" : "Recent User Moderation History"}
              </h3>
            </div>

            <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100 mt-2">
              {userActions.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 py-6 text-center">
                  {isBn ? "কোনো ইউজার অ্যাকশন রেকর্ড নেই।" : "No recent user moderation actions."}
                </p>
              ) : (
                userActions.map((log) => (
                  <div key={log.id} className="py-2.5 space-y-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                      <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${
                        log.action?.includes("BAN")
                          ? "bg-red-50 text-red-700 border border-red-200"
                          : "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200"
                      }`}>
                        {log.action}
                      </span>
                      <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                        {new Date(log.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-700 truncate font-medium">
                      {log.reason}
                    </p>

                    {log.targetUserId && (
                      <div className="font-mono text-[10px] text-slate-400 truncate">
                        Target: {log.targetUserId}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 text-[11px] text-slate-500 flex items-center gap-2">
            <ShieldAlert className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
            <span>{isBn ? "সমস্ত অ্যাকশন অডিট ট্রেইলে সংরক্ষিত হয়" : "All user moderations are cryptographically audited"}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## [File 115] `apps/web/components/admin/AdminVerificationsSection.tsx`
> **Path:** `apps/web/components/admin/AdminVerificationsSection.tsx`  
> **Lines of Code:** 298  
> **Language:** `tsx`

### What This Code Does
This section component manages citizen verification submissions for phone OTP and NID documents.
Administrators can inspect uploaded document images, verify submitted phone numbers, and review identity claims.
It provides buttons to approve requests (upgrading user role to VERIFIED_RESPONDER) or reject them with reasons.

```tsx
"use client";

import React, { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { AdminVerification } from "./types";
import {
  UserCheck,
  CheckCircle2,
  Trash2,
  ExternalLink,
  Phone,
  FileBadge,
  Search,
  X,
} from "lucide-react";

interface AdminVerificationsSectionProps {
  verifications: AdminVerification[];
  isBn: boolean;
  onApprove: (verifId: string) => void;
  onSelectReject: (verification: AdminVerification) => void;
}

export default function AdminVerificationsSection({
  verifications,
  isBn,
  onApprove,
  onSelectReject,
}: AdminVerificationsSectionProps) {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [typeFilter, setTypeFilter] = useState<string>("ALL");

  const filteredVerifications = useMemo(() => {
    return verifications.filter((v) => {
      const matchesType =
        typeFilter === "ALL" ||
        v.type?.toUpperCase().includes(typeFilter) ||
        (typeFilter === "PHONE" && v.type?.includes("PHONE"));

      if (!matchesType) return false;

      if (!searchQuery.trim()) return true;

      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
      const userMatch = v.userId?.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const phoneMatch = (v.phoneNumber || v.user?.phoneNumber || "")
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(q);
      const typeMatch = v.type?.toLowerCase().includes(q);

      return userMatch || phoneMatch || typeMatch;
    });
  }, [verifications, searchQuery, typeFilter]);

  return (
    <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200/90 rounded-2xl shadow-xs overflow-hidden">
      
      {/* Section Header & Filters */}
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 border-b border-slate-100 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-slate-50/50">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200/80 flex items-center justify-center text-amber-700 shrink-0">
            <UserCheck className="w-4 h-4" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
              {isBn ? "নাগরিক কেওয়াইসি যাচাই কিউ" : "Citizen Verification Queue"}
            </h2>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 font-medium">
              {isBn
                ? `${verifications.length} টি অনুরোধের মধ্যে ${filteredVerifications.length} টি অপেক্ষমান`
                : `${filteredVerifications.length} of ${verifications.length} pending KYC requests`}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Search & Type Filters */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center gap-2.5">
          <div className="relative min-w-[200px] sm:w-56">
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={isBn ? "ইউজার আইডি বা ফোন খুঁজুন..." : "Search user or phone..."}
              className="w-full pl-8 pr-7 py-1.5 text-xs bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-red-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-600/10 transition-all shadow-2xs"
            />
            <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
            {searchQuery && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSearchQuery("")}
                className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 p-0.5"
              >
                <X className="w-3 h-3" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 p-0.5 bg-slate-100 border border-slate-200/80 rounded-xl text-[11px] font-semibold shrink-0">
            {[
              { id: "ALL", labelEn: "All", labelBn: "সব" },
              { id: "NID", labelEn: "NID", labelBn: "এনআইডি" },
              { id: "PHONE", labelEn: "Phone", labelBn: "ফোন" },
            ].map((t) => (
              <button
                key={t.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setTypeFilter(t.id)}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg transition-all cursor-pointer font-bold ${
                  typeFilter === t.id
                    ? "bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-2xs"
                    : "text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800"
                }`}
              >
                {isBn ? t.labelBn : t.labelEn}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Desktop Table */}
      <div className="hidden md:block overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
          <thead className="bg-slate-50/80 text-slate-600 font-bold border-b border-slate-200/80">
            <tr>
              <th className="p-3.5">{isBn ? "ইউজার আইডি" : "Citizen UUID"}</th>
              <th className="p-3.5">{isBn ? "ধরন" : "Method"}</th>
              <th className="p-3.5">{isBn ? "নথি / যোগাযোগ" : "Document / Contact"}</th>
              <th className="p-3.5">{isBn ? "জমা দেওয়ার সময়" : "Submitted"}</th>
              <th className="p-3.5 text-right">{isBn ? "সিদ্ধান্ত" : "Actions"}</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 text-slate-700">
            {filteredVerifications.length === 0 ? (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={5} className="p-10 text-center text-slate-500">
                  <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center space-y-2">
                    <UserCheck className="w-8 h-8 text-slate-300 stroke-[1.5]" />
                    <p className="text-xs font-medium">
                      {isBn ? "কোনো অপেক্ষমান কেওয়াইসি অনুরোধ নেই।" : "No pending verification requests."}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ) : (
              filteredVerifications.map((v, idx) => (
                <tr key={v.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/70 transition-colors">
                  <td className="p-3.5 font-mono text-slate-900 font-medium">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      {idx === 0 && !searchQuery && typeFilter === "ALL" && (
                        <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-700 font-mono font-bold">
                          [A/R] TOP
                        </span>
                      )}
                      <span>{v.userId.slice(0, 10)}...</span>
                    </div>
                  </td>

                  <td className="p-3.5">
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border border-slate-200">
                      {v.type?.includes("PHONE") ? (
                        <Phone className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-500" />
                      ) : (
                        <FileBadge className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-500" />
                      )}
                      <span>{v.type || "NID / Phone"}</span>
                    </span>
                  </td>

                  <td className="p-3.5 font-mono text-slate-700">
                    {v.type === "PHONE_OTP" || !v.documentUrl ? (
                      <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800">
                        {v.phoneNumber || v.user?.phoneNumber || "—"}
                      </span>
                    ) : (
                      <a
                        href={v.documentUrl}
                        target="_blank"
                        rel="noreferrer"
                        className="text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-700 hover:underline inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-sans text-xs font-medium"
                      >
                        <span>{isBn ? "নথি দেখুন" : "View Document"}</span>
                        <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />
                      </a>
                    )}
                  </td>

                  <td className="p-3.5 text-slate-500 font-mono text-[11px] whitespace-nowrap">
                    {new Date(v.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()} {new Date(v.createdAt).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" })}
                  </td>

                  <td className="p-3.5 text-right space-x-2 whitespace-nowrap">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => onApprove(v.id)}
                      className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold inline-flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-2xs active:scale-95"
                    >
                      <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>{isBn ? "অনুমোদন" : "Approve"}</span>
                    </button>

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => onSelectReject(v)}
                      className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-red-50 hover:bg-red-100 text-red-700 border border-red-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold inline-flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-2xs active:scale-95"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>{isBn ? "প্রত্যাখ্যান" : "Reject"}</span>
                    </button>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {/* Mobile Card View */}
      <div className="md:hidden divide-y divide-slate-100">
        {filteredVerifications.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-8 text-center text-slate-500">
            <UserCheck className="w-8 h-8 text-slate-300 stroke-[1.5] mx-auto mb-2" />
            <p className="text-xs font-medium">
              {isBn ? "কোনো অপেক্ষমান কেওয়াইসি অনুরোধ নেই।" : "No pending verification requests."}
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          filteredVerifications.map((v, idx) => (
            <div key={v.id} className="p-4 space-y-3 hover:bg-slate-50/60 transition-colors">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
                  {idx === 0 && !searchQuery && typeFilter === "ALL" && (
                    <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-700 font-mono font-bold shrink-0">
                      [A/R]
                    </span>
                  )}
                  <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 truncate">
                    {v.userId.slice(0, 12)}...
                  </span>
                </div>

                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 shrink-0">
                  {v.type || "NID"}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="text-xs">
                {v.type === "PHONE_OTP" || !v.documentUrl ? (
                  <div className="text-slate-700 font-mono">
                    <span className="text-slate-400 mr-1.5">Phone:</span>
                    {v.phoneNumber || v.user?.phoneNumber || "—"}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <a
                    href={v.documentUrl}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noreferrer"
                    className="text-blue-600 hover:underline inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-medium"
                  >
                    <span>{isBn ? "সংযুক্ত নথি দেখুন" : "View Attached Document"}</span>
                    <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />
                  </a>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1 border-t border-slate-100">
                <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400">
                  {new Date(v.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}
                </span>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => onApprove(v.id)}
                    className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold inline-flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer shadow-2xs active:scale-95"
                  >
                    <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>{isBn ? "অনুমোদন" : "Approve"}</span>
                  </button>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => onSelectReject(v)}
                    className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-red-50 hover:bg-red-100 text-red-700 border border-red-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold inline-flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer shadow-2xs active:scale-95"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>{isBn ? "প্রত্যাখ্যান" : "Reject"}</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))
        )}
      </div>

    </div>
  );
}
```

### What This Code Does
This section component renders an immutable, paginated audit trail of all administrative actions.
It displays logs for report purges, user bans, verification approvals, and category reclassifications.
Each entry records the acting administrator, target ID, action type, reason, and exact timestamp.

```tsx
"use client";

import React, { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { AdminLog } from "./types";
import {
  FileText,
  Search,
  Clock,
  Filter,
  X,
  Shield,
  User,
} from "lucide-react";

interface AdminLogsSectionProps {
  logs: AdminLog[];
  isBn: boolean;
}

export default function AdminLogsSection({
  logs,
  isBn,
}: AdminLogsSectionProps) {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [actionFilter, setActionFilter] = useState<string>("ALL");

  const actionTypes = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    logs.forEach((l) => {
      if (l.action) set.add(l.action);
    });
    return Array.from(set);
  }, [logs]);

  const filteredLogs = useMemo(() => {
    return logs.filter((log) => {
      const matchesAction =
        actionFilter === "ALL" || log.action === actionFilter;

      if (!matchesAction) return false;

      if (!searchQuery.trim()) return true;

      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
      const actionMatch = log.action?.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const reasonMatch = log.reason?.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const adminMatch = log.adminId?.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const reportMatch = log.targetReportId?.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const userMatch = log.targetUserId?.toLowerCase().includes(q);

      return (
        actionMatch ||
        reasonMatch ||
        adminMatch ||
        reportMatch ||
        userMatch
      );
    });
  }, [logs, searchQuery, actionFilter]);

  const getActionBadgeClass = (action: string) => {
    const act = action.toUpperCase();
    if (act.includes("PURGE") || act.includes("BAN") || act.includes("DELETE") || act.includes("REJECT")) {
      return "bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200";
    }
    if (act.includes("APPROVE") || act.includes("VERIF") || act.includes("UNBAN")) {
      return "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200";
    }
    return "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-200";
  };

  return (
    <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200/90 rounded-2xl shadow-xs overflow-hidden">
      
      {/* Header & Filter Controls */}
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 border-b border-slate-100 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-slate-50/50">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 border border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-700 shrink-0">
            <FileText className="w-4 h-4" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
              {isBn ? "অপরিবর্তনীয় অডিট ট্রেইল ও কমপ্লায়েন্স লগ" : "Compliance Audit Trail"}
            </h2>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 font-medium">
              {isBn
                ? `${logs.length} টি অডিট রেকর্ডের মধ্যে ${filteredLogs.length} টি প্রদর্শিত`
                : `Showing ${filteredLogs.length} of ${logs.length} cryptographically logged actions`}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Search & Action Filters */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center gap-2.5">
          <div className="relative min-w-[200px] sm:w-56">
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={isBn ? "লগ খুঁজুন (অ্যাকশন, কারণ বা আইডি)..." : "Search audit logs..."}
              className="w-full pl-8 pr-7 py-1.5 text-xs bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-red-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-600/10 transition-all shadow-2xs"
            />
            <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
            {searchQuery && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSearchQuery("")}
                className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 p-0.5"
              >
                <X className="w-3 h-3" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {actionTypes.length > 0 && (
            <select
              value={actionFilter}
              onChange={(e) => setActionFilter(e.target.value)}
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-slate-700 focus:outline-none focus:border-red-600 shadow-2xs cursor-pointer"
            >
              <option value="ALL">{isBn ? "সব অ্যাকশন" : "All Actions"}</option>
              {actionTypes.map((act) => (
                <option key={act} value={act}>
                  {act}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Desktop Table View */}
      <div className="hidden md:block overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
          <thead className="bg-slate-50/80 text-slate-600 font-bold border-b border-slate-200/80">
            <tr>
              <th className="p-3.5">{isBn ? "সময়কাল" : "Timestamp"}</th>
              <th className="p-3.5">{isBn ? "অ্যাকশন" : "Action"}</th>
              <th className="p-3.5">{isBn ? "অ্যাডমিন আইডি" : "Admin ID"}</th>
              <th className="p-3.5">{isBn ? "টার্গেট রেফারেন্স" : "Target Reference"}</th>
              <th className="p-3.5">{isBn ? "কারণ / বিবরণ" : "Reason"}</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 text-slate-700">
            {filteredLogs.length === 0 ? (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={5} className="p-10 text-center text-slate-500">
                  <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center space-y-2">
                    <FileText className="w-8 h-8 text-slate-300 stroke-[1.5]" />
                    <p className="text-xs font-medium">
                      {isBn ? "কোনো অডিট রেকর্ড পাওয়া যায়নি।" : "No audit records found matching criteria."}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ) : (
              filteredLogs.map((log) => (
                <tr key={log.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/70 transition-colors">
                  <td className="p-3.5 text-slate-500 font-mono text-[11px] whitespace-nowrap">
                    {new Date(log.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()} {new Date(log.createdAt).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" })}
                  </td>

                  <td className="p-3.5 whitespace-nowrap">
                    <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold border ${getActionBadgeClass(log.action)}`}>
                      {log.action}
                    </span>
                  </td>

                  <td className="p-3.5 font-mono text-slate-600 whitespace-nowrap">
                    {log.adminId.slice(0, 8)}...
                  </td>

                  <td className="p-3.5 font-mono text-slate-600 whitespace-nowrap">
                    {log.targetReportId ? (
                      <span className="text-slate-700">Report: {log.targetReportId.slice(0, 8)}...</span>
                    ) : log.targetUserId ? (
                      <span className="text-slate-700">User: {log.targetUserId.slice(0, 8)}...</span>
                    ) : (
                      "—"
                    )}
                  </td>

                  <td className="p-3.5 font-medium text-slate-800 max-w-xs sm:max-w-md truncate" title={log.reason}>
                    {log.reason}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {/* Mobile Card View */}
      <div className="md:hidden divide-y divide-slate-100">
        {filteredLogs.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-8 text-center text-slate-500">
            <FileText className="w-8 h-8 text-slate-300 stroke-[1.5] mx-auto mb-2" />
            <p className="text-xs font-medium">
              {isBn ? "কোনো অডিট রেকর্ড পাওয়া যায়নি।" : "No audit records found."}
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          filteredLogs.map((log) => (
            <div key={log.id} className="p-4 space-y-2 hover:bg-slate-50/60 transition-colors">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold border ${getActionBadgeClass(log.action)}`}>
                  {log.action}
                </span>
                <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                  {new Date(log.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()} {new Date(log.createdAt).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" })}
                </span>
              </div>

              <p className="text-xs text-slate-800 font-semibold leading-relaxed">
                {log.reason}
              </p>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-500 pt-1">
                <span>Admin: {log.adminId.slice(0, 8)}...</span>
                <span>
                  {log.targetReportId
                    ? `Report: ${log.targetReportId.slice(0, 8)}...`
                    : log.targetUserId
                    ? `User: ${log.targetUserId.slice(0, 8)}...`
                    : "—"}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))
        )}
      </div>

    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import React from "react";

interface AdminAnalyticsSectionProps {

  isLoadingTrends: boolean;
  onRefreshTrends: () => void;
}

export default function AdminAnalyticsSection({
  trends,

  isLoadingTrends,
  onRefreshTrends,
}: AdminAnalyticsSectionProps) {
  const totalReports = trends?.totalReports ?? 0;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      
      {/* 4 Executive Metric Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        
        {/* Card 1: 30-Day Hazard Volume */}

            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Card 2: Night Hazard Ratio */}
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200/90 rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
              {isBn ? "রাত্রিকালীন বিপদের হার" : "Night Hazard Ratio"}
            </span>
            <div className="p-2 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 rounded-xl border border-indigo-200">
              <Moon className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-black text-indigo-700 tracking-tight">
              {nightPercentage}%
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-1 font-medium font-mono">

            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Card 3: High Severity Threats */}
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200/90 rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
              {isBn ? "উচ্চমাত্রার সশস্ত্র হুমকি" : "High Severity Threats"}
            </span>
            <div className="p-2 bg-red-50 text-red-600 rounded-xl border border-red-200">
              <ShieldAlert className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-black text-red-600 tracking-tight">
              {highSeverityCount}
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-1 font-medium">
              {isBn ? "সশস্ত্র বা চরম ঝুঁকিপূর্ণ পিন" : "Armed or imminent danger pins"}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Card 4: Resolved Incidents */}
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200/90 rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
              {isBn ? "নিষ্পত্তিকৃত ঘটনা" : "Resolved Incidents"}
            </span>
            <div className="p-2 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 rounded-xl border border-emerald-200">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-black text-emerald-700 tracking-tight">
              {resolvedCount}
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-1 font-medium">
              {isBn ? "উদ্ধার বা নিরাপদ ঘোষিত" : "Neutralized or safe status"}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>

      {/* Visual Analytics Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
        
        {/* Category Breakdown Bars */}
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200/90 rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-xs space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <BarChart3 className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-700" />
              <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 uppercase tracking-wider">
                {isBn ? "বিপদের ধরন অনুযায়ী বিভাজন" : "Hazard Category Distribution"}
              </h3>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 font-mono">
              {isBn ? "বিগত ৩০ দিন" : "30-Day Aggregation"}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-3.5">
            {(() => {
              const rawCategories = (trends?.breakdown?.byCategory ?? {}) as Record<string, number>;
              const aggregated = new Map<string, number>();

              for (const [rawKey, rawCount] of Object.entries(rawCategories)) {
                const count = Number(rawCount) || 0;
                if (count <= 0) continue;
                const canonicalKey = CATEGORY_ALIAS_MAP[rawKey] ?? rawKey;
                aggregated.set(canonicalKey, (aggregated.get(canonicalKey) ?? 0) + count);
              }

              const entries = Array.from(aggregated.entries()).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);

              if (entries.length === 0) {
                return (
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 py-6 text-center">
                    {isBn
                      ? "বিগত ৩০ দিনে কোনো শ্রেণিবদ্ধ রিপোর্ট পাওয়া যায়নি।"
                      : "No categorized reports recorded in the last 30 days."}
                  </p>
                );
              }

              const total = trends?.totalReports || entries.reduce((sum, [, c]) => sum + c, 0) || 1;
              const categoryLabels = translations[isBn ? "bn" : "en"].categories as Record<string, string>;

              return entries.map(([key, count]) => {
                const pct = Math.min(100, Math.round((count / total) * 100));
                const label = categoryLabels[key] || key.replace(/_/g, " ");
                const color = CATEGORY_BAR_COLORS[key] || "bg-slate-500";
                return (
                  <div key={key} className="space-y-1">
                    <div className="flex justify-between text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                      <span>{label}</span>
                      <span className="font-mono text-slate-900 font-bold">
                        {count} ({pct}%)
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="w-full bg-slate-100 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden">
                      <div
                        className={`h-full ${color} rounded-full transition-all duration-500`}
                        style={{ width: `${pct}%` }}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              });
            })()}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Severity & Resolution Breakdown Grids */}
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* Threat Severity Breakdown */}
          <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200/90 rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-xs space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Shield className="w-4 h-4 text-red-600" />
                <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 uppercase tracking-wider">
                  {isBn ? "হুমকির তীব্রতা অনুপাত" : "Threat Severity Breakdown"}
                </h3>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 text-center">
              <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-red-50 border border-red-200/80">
                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-red-700 block uppercase">HIGH</span>
                <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-red-700 font-mono">
                  {trends?.breakdown?.bySeverity?.HIGH ?? 0}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200/80">
                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-700 block uppercase">MEDIUM</span>
                <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-amber-700 font-mono">
                  {trends?.breakdown?.bySeverity?.MEDIUM ?? 0}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200/80">
                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-700 block uppercase">LOW</span>
                <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-emerald-700 font-mono">
                  {trends?.breakdown?.bySeverity?.LOW ?? 0}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Incident Resolution Pipeline */}
          <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200/90 rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-xs space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Activity className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
                <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 uppercase tracking-wider">
                  {isBn ? "ঘটনা নিষ্পত্তি অবস্থা" : "Resolution Pipeline"}

            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 text-center">

            </div>
          </div>

        </div>

      </div>

      {/* Daily Incident Timeline */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200/90 rounded-2xl shadow-xs overflow-hidden">
        <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 border-b border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-50/50">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-700" />
            <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 uppercase tracking-wider">
              {isBn ? "দৈনিক ঘটনার টাইমলাইন (৩০ দিন)" : "Daily Incident Timeline"}
            </h3>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onRefreshTrends}
            disabled={isLoadingTrends}
            className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-2xs disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isLoadingTrends ? "animate-spin text-red-600" : "text-slate-500"}`} />
            <span>{isBn ? "রিফ্রেশ" : "Refresh"}</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
            <thead className="bg-slate-50/80 text-slate-600 font-bold border-b border-slate-200/80">
              <tr>
                <th className="p-3.5">{isBn ? "তারিখ" : "Date"}</th>
                <th className="p-3.5">{isBn ? "দাখিলকৃত রিপোর্ট" : "Reports"}</th>
                <th className="p-3.5">{isBn ? "বণ্টন অনুপাত" : "Distribution"}</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 text-slate-700">
              {!trends?.timeline || trends.timeline.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={3} className="p-8 text-center text-slate-400">
                    {isBn ? "বিগত ৩০ দিনে কোনো রেকর্ড পাওয়া যায়নি।" : "No timeline records in the last 30 days."}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                trends.timeline.map((row: { date: string; count: number }) => {
                  const maxCount = Math.max(...trends.timeline.map((r: any) => r.count), 1);
                  const barWidth = Math.round((row.count / maxCount) * 100);
                  return (
                    <tr key={row.date} className="hover:bg-slate-50/60 transition-colors">
                      <td className="p-3.5 font-mono font-semibold text-slate-900 whitespace-nowrap">
                        {row.date}
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-3.5 font-mono font-bold text-red-600 whitespace-nowrap">
                        {row.count} {isBn ? "টি" : "reports"}
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-3.5 w-1/2 min-w-[140px]">
                        <div className="w-full bg-slate-100 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden">
                          <div
                            className="bg-red-600 h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-300"
                            style={{ width: `${Math.max(barWidth, 6)}%` }}
                          />
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  );
}
```

## [File 118] `apps/web/components/admin/AdminPurgeModal.tsx`
> **Path:** `apps/web/components/admin/AdminPurgeModal.tsx`  
> **Lines of Code:** 140  
> **Language:** `tsx`

### What This Code Does
This modal prompts administrators for a mandatory reason before permanently purging an incident report.
Purging an incident removes it from the public map and broadcasts a real-time PURGE event over WebSockets.
The entered reason is permanently recorded in ModerationLog to maintain moderation transparency.

```tsx
"use client";

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { AdminReport } from "./types";
import { Trash2, X, RefreshCw, AlertTriangle } from "lucide-react";
import { showToast } from "@/store/useToastStore";

interface AdminPurgeModalProps {
  report: AdminReport;
  isBn: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onConfirm: (reason: string) => Promise<void>;
}

export default function AdminPurgeModal({
  report,
  isBn,
  onClose,
  onConfirm,
}: AdminPurgeModalProps) {
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [isPurging, setIsPurging] = useState(false);

  const handleExecute = async () => {
    if (reason.trim().length < 3) {
      showToast(
        isBn
          ? "অপসারণের কারণ কমপক্ষে ৩ অক্ষরের হতে হবে।"
          : "Purge reason must be at least 3 characters.",
        "warning"
      );
      return;
    }

    setIsPurging(true);
    try {
      await onConfirm(reason.trim());
      onClose();
    } finally {
      setIsPurging(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 shadow-2xl max-w-md w-full p-5 sm:p-6 space-y-4 animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
        
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-red-600 font-bold text-sm">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-red-50 border border-red-200 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
              <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
            <span>{isBn ? "রিপোর্ট বাতিল ও অপসারণ" : "Purge Hazard Incident"}</span>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 p-1 rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Content */}
        <div className="space-y-3 text-xs">
          <p className="text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">
            {isBn
              ? "এই রিপোর্টটি মানচিত্র এবং পাবলিক ফিড থেকে স্থায়ীভাবে অপসারণ করা হবে। অডিট লগে সংরক্ষণের জন্য কারণ উল্লেখ করুন:"
              : "This report will be permanently removed from live map & public feeds. Specify a mandatory audit reason:"}
          </p>

          <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-800 space-y-1">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-slate-400">ID:</span>
              <span className="font-bold">{report.id}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-slate-400">Category:</span>
              <span className="font-bold text-slate-900">{report.category}</span>
            </div>
            {report.severity && (
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-slate-400">Severity:</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-red-600">{report.severity}</span>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label htmlFor="purge-reason-input" className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
              {isBn ? "অপসারণের সুনির্দিষ্ট কারণ *" : "Mandatory Reason *"}
            </label>
            <textarea
              id="purge-reason-input"
              value={reason}
              onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={isBn ? "যেমন: সরজমিনে পরিদর্শনে কোনো হুমকি পাওয়া যায়নি" : "e.g., False alarm confirmed by local field patrol"}
              rows={3}
              disabled={isPurging}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-50/60 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-900 focus:bg-white focus:outline-none focus:border-red-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-600/10 transition-all resize-none shadow-2xs"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Actions */}
        <div className="flex gap-2.5 justify-end pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={isPurging}
            className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            {isBn ? "বাতিল" : "Cancel"}
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleExecute}
            disabled={isPurging}
            className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white shadow-2xs transition-all active:scale-95 cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            {isPurging ? (
              <>
                <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                <span>{isBn ? "মুছে ফেলা হচ্ছে..." : "Purging..."}</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>{isBn ? "স্থায়ীভাবে অপসারণ" : "Confirm Purge"}</span>
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### What This Code Does
This modal captures the formal justification required when an administrator bans a user or device ID.

Banned accounts are immediately prevented from submitting new reports or casting community votes.

```tsx
"use client";

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { UserX, UserCheck, ShieldAlert, X } from "lucide-react";
import { AdminUser } from "./types";

interface AdminBanModalProps {
  user: AdminUser | { id: string; email?: string | null; anonymousId?: string; role?: string; trustScore?: number; isBanned?: boolean };
  action: "ban" | "unban";
  isBn: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onConfirm: (reason: string) => Promise<void>;
}

export default function AdminBanModal({
  user,
  action,
  isBn,
  onClose,
  onConfirm,
}: AdminBanModalProps) {
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const presets =
    action === "ban"
      ? [
          {
            en: "False Emergency Report",
            bn: "মিথ্যা বা বিভ্রান্তিকর জরুরি রিপোর্ট",
          },
          {
            en: "Malicious Spam / Bots",
            bn: "ক্ষতিকর স্প্যাম ও স্বয়ংক্রিয় বট আক্রমণ",
          },
          {
            en: "Hate Speech / Abuse",
            bn: "বিদ্বেষমূলক বক্তব্য ও অপমানজনক আচরণ",
          },
          {
            en: "Misleading Hazard Coordinates",
            bn: "উদ্দেশ্যপ্রণোদিত বিভ্রান্তিকর অবস্থান ইনপুট",
          },
        ]
      : [
          {
            en: "Identity Verified via Phone / KYC",
            bn: "মোবাইল / কেওয়াইসি যাচাইকরণের পর পুনরুদ্ধার",
          },
          {
            en: "Sanction Period Expired",
            bn: "সাসপেনশন বা শাস্তির মেয়াদ উত্তীর্ণ",
          },
          {
            en: "Appeal Approved by Administration",
            bn: "প্রশাসনিক আবেদন অনুমোদিত",
          },
        ];

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (reason.trim().length < 3) return;
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await onConfirm(reason.trim());
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const displayName = user.email || user.anonymousId || user.id;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-150">
      <div
        className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl border border-slate-200 max-w-lg w-full overflow-hidden"
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div className={`p-5 flex items-center justify-between border-b ${
          action === "ban" ? "bg-red-50/50 border-red-100" : "bg-emerald-50/50 border-emerald-100"
        }`}>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center border shrink-0 ${
              action === "ban"
                ? "bg-red-100 text-red-600 border-red-200"
                : "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600 border-emerald-200"
            }`}>
              {action === "ban" ? <UserX className="w-4 h-4" /> : <UserCheck className="w-4 h-4" />}
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">
                {action === "ban"
                  ? isBn ? "নাগরিক সাসপেনশন নিশ্চিতকরণ" : "Confirm Citizen Suspension"
                  : isBn ? "নাগরিক অ্যাকাউন্ট পুনরুদ্ধার" : "Confirm Account Restoration"}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 font-medium">
                {action === "ban"
                  ? isBn ? "প্ল্যাটফর্মে সাময়িক বা স্থায়ী প্রবেশাধিকার স্থগিত করুন" : "Revoke active session and prevent reporting/voting"
                  : isBn ? "নাগরিকের স্থগিতাদেশ তুলে নিয়ে স্বাভাবিক করুন" : "Restore active status and allow reporting/voting"}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 p-1 rounded-lg transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Form Body */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-5 space-y-4">
          {/* Target Identity Preview */}
          <div className="bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-3 space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
              <span className="text-slate-500 font-medium">{isBn ? "টার্গেট নাগরিক:" : "Target Citizen:"}</span>
              <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 font-mono text-[11px] truncate max-w-[220px]" title={displayName}>
                {displayName}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
              <span className="text-slate-500 font-medium">{isBn ? "বর্তমান ট্রাস্ট স্কোর:" : "Trust Score:"}</span>
              <span className="font-bold text-purple-700 font-mono">
                {user.trustScore ?? 50} / 100
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono truncate">
              ID: {user.id}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Quick Preset Reason Chips */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
              {isBn ? "প্রিসেট কারণ নির্বাচন করুন:" : "Quick Reason Presets:"}
            </label>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
              {presets.map((preset, idx) => (
                <button
                  key={idx}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setReason(isBn ? preset.bn : preset.en)}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 border border-slate-200/80 font-medium transition-colors text-left"
                >
                  {isBn ? preset.bn : preset.en}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Reason Input */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
              {isBn ? "অ্যাকশনের বিস্তারিত কারণ *" : "Official Moderation Reason *"}
            </label>
            <textarea
              value={reason}
              onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={
                action === "ban"
                  ? isBn ? "যেমন: বারবার মিথ্যা ছিনতাইয়ের রিপোর্ট দাখিল ও রেটিং ম্যানিপুলেশন" : "e.g., Repeated false incident reports and suspicious spamming"
                  : isBn ? "যেমন: আবেদন পর্যালোচনা করে অ্যাকাউন্ট স্বাভাবিক করা হলো" : "e.g., Appeal reviewed and account restored to good standing"
              }
              rows={3}
              required
              className="w-full p-3 text-xs bg-slate-50/50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-slate-900 focus:bg-white focus:outline-none focus:border-red-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-600/10 transition-all resize-none shadow-2xs"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <ShieldAlert className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
            <span>{isBn ? "এই পদক্ষেপ প্রশাসনিক অডিট ট্রেইলে স্থায়ীভাবে লিপিবদ্ধ হবে।" : "This action will be permanently recorded in the immutable audit log."}</span>
          </div>

          {/* Actions */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2.5 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-xl transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              {isBn ? "বাতিল" : "Cancel"}
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isSubmitting || reason.trim().length < 3}
              className={`px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white rounded-xl shadow-xs transition-all active:scale-95 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                action === "ban"
                  ? "bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700"
                  : "bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700"
              }`}
            >
              {action === "ban" ? <UserX className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <UserCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
              <span>
                {isSubmitting
                  ? isBn ? "প্রক্রিয়াধীন..." : "Processing..."
                  : action === "ban"
                  ? isBn ? "সাসপেন্ড নিশ্চিত করুন" : "Confirm Suspension"
                  : isBn ? "পুনরুদ্ধার নিশ্চিত করুন" : "Confirm Restoration"}
              </span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### What This Code Does
This modal allows administrators to record specific explanations when rejecting a citizen verification request.
It provides predefined and custom rejection reasons (such as unreadable documents or mismatched phone numbers).
The recorded feedback is returned to the user to guide them in re-submitting valid documents.

```tsx
"use client";

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { AdminVerification } from "./types";
import { UserX, X, RefreshCw } from "lucide-react";

interface AdminRejectModalProps {
  verification: AdminVerification;
  isBn: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onConfirm: (reason: string) => Promise<void>;
}

  verification,

  onConfirm,

    if (reason.trim().length < 3) {

          : "Rejection reason must be at least 3 characters.",
        "warning"
      );
      return;
    }

    setIsRejecting(true);

      onClose();
    } finally {
      setIsRejecting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-150">

        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-red-600 font-bold text-sm">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-red-50 border border-red-200 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
              <UserX className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
            <span>{isBn ? "কেওয়াইসি অনুরোধ প্রত্যাখ্যান" : "Reject KYC Verification"}</span>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 p-1 rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Content */}
        <div className="space-y-3 text-xs">
```

## [File 123] `apps/web/components/ui/Button.tsx`
> **Path:** `apps/web/components/ui/Button.tsx`  
> **Lines of Code:** 62  
> **Language:** `tsx`

### What This Code Does
This reusable UI primitive renders styled interactive buttons with multiple visual variants and sizes.
It supports primary, secondary, danger, ghost, and outline styles with built-in loading spinner states.
It enforces consistent hover effects, focus rings, and disabled behaviors across the application.

```tsx
import React from "react";

export type ButtonVariant = "primary" | "danger" | "safe" | "ghost" | "glass";
export type ButtonSize = "sm" | "md" | "lg";

interface ButtonProps extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
  isLoading?: boolean;
}

export function Button({
  variant = "primary",
  size = "md",
  children,
  icon,
  isLoading = false,
  className = "",
  disabled,
  ...props
}: ButtonProps) {
  const baseStyles =
    "inline-flex items-center justify-center font-medium rounded-lg transition-all duration-150 active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:pointer-events-none cursor-pointer";

  const sizeStyles: Record<ButtonSize, string> = {
    sm: "px-2.5 py-1 text-xs gap-1.5",
    md: "px-3.5 py-2 text-sm gap-2",
    lg: "px-5 py-2.5 text-base gap-2.5",
  };

  const variantStyles: Record<ButtonVariant, string> = {
    primary:
      "bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/30 border border-blue-400/30",
    danger:
      "bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-500 text-white shadow-lg shadow-red-600/30 border border-red-400/30",
    safe: "bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white shadow-lg shadow-emerald-600/30 border border-emerald-400/30",
    ghost:
      "bg-transparent hover:bg-slate-800/60 text-slate-300 hover:text-white border border-transparent hover:border-slate-700/50",
    glass:
      "backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-800/80 hover:bg-slate-700/90 text-slate-200 border border-slate-600/60 shadow-md",
  };

  return (
    <button
      className={`${baseStyles} ${sizeStyles[size]} ${variantStyles[variant]} ${className}`}
      disabled={disabled || isLoading}
      {...props}
    >
      {isLoading ? (
        <span className="w-4 h-4 border-2 border-white/40 border-t-white rounded-full animate-spin" />
      ) : (
        icon && <span className="shrink-0">{icon}</span>
      )}
      <span>{children}</span>
    </button>
  );
}

export default Button;
```

## [File 125] `apps/web/components/ui/Modal.tsx`
> **Path:** `apps/web/components/ui/Modal.tsx`  
> **Lines of Code:** 88  
> **Language:** `tsx`

### What This Code Does
This reusable primitive renders accessible modal dialogs with backdrop blur and keyboard escape dismissal.
It manages focus trapping, background scroll locking, and smooth entrance and exit animations.
It serves as the foundation for reporting forms, calibration dialogs, and moderation modals.

```tsx
"use client";

import React, { useEffect } from "react";

interface ModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  title?: React.ReactNode;
  description?: React.ReactNode;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  footer?: React.ReactNode;
  maxWidth?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl" | "2xl";
}

const maxWidthMap = {
  sm: "max-w-sm",
  md: "max-w-md",
  lg: "max-w-lg",
  xl: "max-w-xl",
  "2xl": "max-w-2xl",
};

export function Modal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  title,
  description,
  children,
  footer,
  maxWidth = "md",
}: ModalProps) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") onClose();
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-200"
    >
      <div
        className="fixed inset-0 -z-10"
        onClick={onClose}
        aria-hidden="true"
      />
      <div
        className={`w-full ${maxWidthMap[maxWidth]} bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700/80 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]`}
      >
        {(title || description) && (
          <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-800 flex items-start justify-between">
            <div>
              {title && (
                <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-white tracking-tight">
                  {title}
                </h3>
              )}
              {description && (
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">{description}</p>
              )}
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="text-slate-400 hover:text-white p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-800 transition"
              aria-label="Close modal"
            >
              ✕
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="p-6 overflow-y-auto text-slate-200">{children}</div>
        {footer && (
          <div className="px-6 py-3.5 bg-slate-950/50 border-t border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
            {footer}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React from "react";

export type BadgeVariant =
  | "HIGH"
  | "CRITICAL"
  | "MEDIUM"
  | "LOW"
  | "SAFE"
  | "VERIFIED"
  | "ADMIN"
  | "CITIZEN"
  | "NEUTRAL";

interface BadgeProps {
  variant?: BadgeVariant;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  pulse?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  size?: "sm" | "md";
}

export function Badge({
  variant = "NEUTRAL",
  children,
  pulse = false,
  className = "",
  size = "sm",
}: BadgeProps) {
  const styles: Record<BadgeVariant, { bg: string; text: string; border: string; dot: string }> = {
    HIGH: {
      bg: "bg-red-500/15",
      text: "text-red-400",
      border: "border-red-500/40",
      dot: "bg-red-500",
    },
    CRITICAL: {
      bg: "bg-rose-600/20",
      text: "text-rose-300",
      border: "border-rose-500/50",
      dot: "bg-rose-500",
    },
    MEDIUM: {
      bg: "bg-amber-500/15",
      text: "text-amber-400",
      border: "border-amber-500/40",
      dot: "bg-amber-500",
    },
    LOW: {
      bg: "bg-yellow-500/15",
      text: "text-yellow-400",
      border: "border-yellow-500/40",
      dot: "bg-yellow-500",
    },
    SAFE: {
      bg: "bg-emerald-500/15",
      text: "text-emerald-400",
      border: "border-emerald-500/40",
      dot: "bg-emerald-500",
    },
    VERIFIED: {
      bg: "bg-blue-500/15",
      text: "text-blue-400",
      border: "border-blue-500/40",
      dot: "bg-blue-500",
    },
    ADMIN: {
      bg: "bg-purple-500/15",
      text: "text-purple-300",
      border: "border-purple-500/40",
      dot: "bg-purple-500",
    },
    CITIZEN: {
      bg: "bg-slate-700/30",
      text: "text-slate-300",
      border: "border-slate-600/50",
      dot: "bg-slate-400",
    },
    NEUTRAL: {
      bg: "bg-slate-800/50",
      text: "text-slate-300",
      border: "border-slate-700/60",
      dot: "bg-slate-400",
    },
  };

  const current = styles[variant] || styles.NEUTRAL;
  const sizeClasses = size === "sm" ? "px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px]" : "px-3 py-1 text-xs";

  return (
    <span
      className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 font-semibold rounded-full border ${current.bg} ${current.text} ${current.border} ${sizeClasses} ${className}`}
    >
      {pulse && (
        <span className="relative flex h-2 w-2">
          <span
            className={`animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full opacity-75 ${current.dot}`}
          />
          <span
            className={`relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2 w-2 ${current.dot}`}
          />
        </span>
      )}
      {children}
    </span>
  );
}

export default Badge;
```

```tsx
  },
  error: {
    container: "bg-rose-50/95 border-rose-200 text-rose-900",
    icon: <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />,
  },
  warning: {
    container: "bg-amber-50/95 border-amber-200 text-amber-900",
    icon: <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />,
  },
  info: {
    container: "bg-blue-50/95 border-blue-200 text-blue-900",
    icon: <Info className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />,
  },
};

export default function ToastContainer() {
  const toasts = useToastStore((state) => state.toasts);
  const dismissToast = useToastStore((state) => state.dismissToast);

  if (toasts.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div
      aria-live="polite"
      aria-atomic="false"
      className="fixed top-4 right-4 z-[9999] flex flex-col gap-2.5 w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] sm:max-w-md pointer-events-none"
    >
      {toasts.map((toast) => {
        const style = TOAST_STYLES[toast.type];
        return (
          <div
            key={toast.id}
            role={toast.type === "error" ? "alert" : "status"}
            className={`pointer-events-auto flex items-start gap-2.5 p-3.5 rounded-xl border shadow-lg backdrop-blur-md transition-all ${style.container}`}
          >
            {style.icon}
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line flex-1 break-words">
              {toast.message}
            </p>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => dismissToast(toast.id)}
              aria-label="Dismiss notification"
              className="p-0.5 rounded-lg opacity-70 hover:opacity-100 hover:bg-black/5 transition shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## [File 128] `apps/web/components/pwa/ServiceWorkerRegister.tsx`
> **Path:** `apps/web/components/pwa/ServiceWorkerRegister.tsx`  
> **Lines of Code:** 31  
> **Language:** `tsx`

### What This Code Does
This client component registers the Progressive Web App (PWA) service worker on initial page load.
It enables offline asset caching, faster repeat visits, and background Web Push notification reception.
It checks browser serviceWorker compatibility before executing registration.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";

export default function ServiceWorkerRegister() {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === "undefined" || !("serviceWorker" in navigator)) return;

    // Purge legacy caches from window context to immediately liberate browser from stale Next.js chunks
    if ("caches" in window) {
      caches.keys().then((keys) => {
        keys.forEach((key) => {
          if (key === "bd-safety-map-v1" || key === "bd-safety-map-v2") {
            caches.delete(key);
          }
        });
      });
    }

    navigator.serviceWorker
      .register("/sw.js")
      .then((reg) => {
        // Actively check for service worker updates on every page visit
        reg.update();
      })
      .catch((err) => console.warn("Service Worker registration failed:", err));
  }, []);

  return null;
}
```

```tsx
  const initSocketListeners = useIncidentStore((state) => state.initSocketListeners);
  const initAuth = useAuthStore((state) => state.initAuth);
  const { selectedSeverity, setSeverity, resetFilters } = useFilterStore();

  const stats = useStatsStore((state) => state.stats);
  const fetchStats = useStatsStore((state) => state.fetchStats);
  const initStatsListener = useStatsStore((state) => state.initStatsListener);

  // Initialize transparent device authentication, safe zones, and live DB stats on mount
  useEffect(() => {

    fetchSafeZones();
    fetchStats();
    initSocketListeners();

  // Telemetry Metrics (Derived directly from PostgreSQL database via stats endpoint)
```

```tsx
    descBn: "যানবাহন দুর্ঘটনা, গাড়ি উল্টে যাওয়া, পথচারী আহত",

  {
```
