```tsx
              className="w-full px-5 py-3.5 bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100/80 flex items-center justify-between text-left transition-colors border-b border-slate-100"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <div className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-blue-100 text-blue-700">
                  <PlusCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 uppercase tracking-wider">
                    {isBn ? "নিরাপদ আশ্রয়স্থল সংযোজন (অ্যাডমিন প্যানেল)" : "Admin Safe Haven Management"}
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                    {isBn
                      ? "পোস্টজিআইএস ডেটাবেজে নতুন অনুমোদিত আশ্রয়স্থল যুক্ত করুন (POST /api/v1/safe-zones)"
                      : "Add verified government shelters directly into PostGIS database"}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200">
                  ADMIN AUTHORIZED
                </span>
                <ChevronRight className={`w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 transition-transform ${showAdminDrawer ? "rotate-90" : ""}`} />
              </div>
            </button>

            {showAdminDrawer && (
              <div className="p-5 space-y-4">
                {createSuccess && (
                  <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 rounded-xl text-xs text-emerald-800 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
                    <span>{createSuccess}</span>
                  </div>
                )}

                {createError && (
                  <div className="p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-xl text-xs text-red-800 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-600 shrink-0" />
                    <span>{createError}</span>
                  </div>
                )}

                <form onSubmit={handleCreateSafeZone} className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3">
                  <div className="lg:col-span-2">
                    <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                      {isBn ? "আশ্রয়স্থলের নাম" : "Shelter Name"}
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      placeholder="e.g. Uttara Model Police Outpost"
                      value={newName}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewName(e.target.value)}
                      required
                      className="w-full p-2.5 text-xs bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 focus:border-blue-500"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                      {isBn ? "ধরণ" : "Category"}
                    </label>
                    <select
                      value={newType}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewType(e.target.value as any)}
                      className="w-full p-2.5 text-xs bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 focus:border-blue-500 font-semibold text-slate-700"
                    >
                      <option value="HOSPITAL">{isBn ? "হাসপাতাল" : "Hospital"}</option>
                      <option value="POLICE_BOX">{isBn ? "পুলিশ বক্স" : "Police Box"}</option>
                      <option value="PHARMACY">{isBn ? "২৪/৭ ফার্মেসি" : "Pharmacy"}</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                      {isBn ? "অক্ষাংশ (Lat)" : "Latitude"}
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      placeholder="23.8103"
                      value={newLat}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewLat(e.target.value)}
                      required
                      className="w-full p-2.5 text-xs bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl font-mono focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 focus:border-blue-500"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                      {isBn ? "দ্রাঘিমাংশ (Lng)" : "Longitude"}
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      placeholder="90.4125"
                      value={newLng}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewLng(e.target.value)}
                      required
                      className="w-full p-2.5 text-xs bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl font-mono focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 focus:border-blue-500"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-end">
                    <button
                      type="submit"
                      disabled={isCreating}
                      className="w-full py-2.5 px-4 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl transition-all shadow-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5"
                    >
                      <PlusCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>{isCreating ? (isBn ? "সংরক্ষণ..." : "Saving...") : (isBn ? "যুক্ত করুন" : "Add Shelter")}</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </form>
              </div>
            )}
          </section>
        )}

        {/* Main Content Layout based on ViewMode */}
        {isLoading ? (
          <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl p-16 text-center shadow-xs">
            <RefreshCw className="w-9 h-9 text-blue-600 animate-spin mx-auto mb-3" />
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
              {isBn ? "নিরাপদ আশ্রয়স্থল লোড হচ্ছে..." : "Querying PostGIS Verified Safe Shelters..."}
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
              {isBn ? "বাংলাদেশ সরকারের তথ্যভাণ্ডার থেকে ডেটা আসছে" : "Connecting to PostgreSQL spatial repository"}
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : error ? (
          <div className="bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 rounded-2xl p-8 text-center text-rose-800 shadow-xs">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-8 h-8 mx-auto mb-2 text-rose-600" />
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold">{isBn ? "ডেটা লোড করতে ব্যর্থ" : "Failed to Load Safe Shelters"}</h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-rose-600 mt-1 mb-4">{error}</p>
            <button
              onClick={fetchSafeZones}
              className="px-4 py-2 bg-rose-600 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-rose-700 transition-colors shadow-2xs"
            >
              {isBn ? "পুনরায় চেষ্টা করুন" : "Retry Connection"}
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : filteredSafeZones.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl p-16 text-center text-slate-500 shadow-xs">
            <Shield className="w-12 h-12 text-slate-300 mx-auto mb-3" />
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-800">
              {isBn ? "কোনো আশ্রয়স্থল পাওয়া যায়নি" : "No verified safe shelters found"}
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1 max-w-sm mx-auto">
              {isBn
                ? "আপনার ফিল্টারের সাথে মিলে এমন কোনো আশ্রয়স্থল নেই। ফিল্টার পরিবর্তন করে দেখুন।"
                : "No shelters match your current search and filter criteria. Try expanding your radius or selecting another city."}
            </p>
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setTypeFilter("ALL");
                setSearchQuery("");
                setActiveCityPreset("All Bangladesh");
                setProximityMode(false);
              }}
              className="mt-4 px-4 py-2 bg-slate-900 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors"
            >
              {isBn ? "সব ফিল্টার রিসেট করুন" : "Reset Filters"}
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div>
            {/* VIEW MODE 1: SPLIT VIEW (Map + List Side by Side) */}
            {viewMode === "split" && (
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 items-start">
                {/* Left: Interactive Leaflet Map (7 cols) */}
                <div className="lg:col-span-7 lg:sticky lg:top-24">
                  <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl p-3 shadow-xs space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-2 pt-1">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse"></span>
                        <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 uppercase tracking-wider">
                          {isBn ? "লাইভ রেডার ও ম্যাপ অবস্থান" : "Interactive Live Haven Map"}
                        </h3>
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-blue-200">
                        {filteredSafeZones.length} {isBn ? "টি কেন্দ্র প্রদর্শিত" : "Pins Loaded"}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <SafeZonesMap
                      safeZones={filteredSafeZones}
                      selectedZone={selectedZone}
                      onSelectZone={(z) => setSelectedZone(z)}
                      userLocation={userLocation}
                      language={language}
                      onNavigateSafeRoute={handleNavigateSafePath}
                      className="w-full h-[300px] sm:h-[380px] lg:h-[520px]"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Right: Shelters List (5 cols) */}
                <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-3 lg:max-h-[calc(100vh-8rem)] lg:overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                  {filteredSafeZones.map((sz) => {
                    const badge = getTypeBadge(sz.type);
                    const Icon = badge.icon;
                    const isSelected = selectedZone?.id === sz.id;

                    return (
                      <div
                        key={sz.id}
                        onClick={() => setSelectedZone(sz)}
                        className={`bg-white border rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-4.5 transition-all cursor-pointer relative ${
                          isSelected
                            ? "border-blue-500 shadow-md ring-2 ring-blue-500/20"
                            : "border-slate-200 shadow-xs hover:border-slate-300 hover:shadow-sm"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {/* Header: Type Badge & Verified Tag */}
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-2">
                          <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border flex items-center gap-1.5 ${badge.badgeClass}`}>
                            <Icon className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" />
                            <span>{badge.label}</span>
                          </span>

                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            {sz.distanceMeters && (
                              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-800 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-mono flex items-center gap-1">
                                <Sparkles className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-emerald-600" />
                                <span>
                                  {Number(sz.distanceMeters) >= 1000
                                    ? `${(Number(sz.distanceMeters) / 1000).toFixed(1)} km`
                                    : `${Math.round(Number(sz.distanceMeters))} m`}
                                </span>
                              </span>
                            )}

                            {user?.role === "ADMIN" && (
                              <button
                                onClick={(e) => {
                                  e.stopPropagation();
                                  handleDeleteSafeZone(sz.id, sz.name);
                                }}
                                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 p-1 transition-colors"
                                title="Delete Shelter"
                              >
                                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </button>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* Title */}
                        <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 leading-snug mb-1">
                          {isBn && sz.nameBn ? sz.nameBn : sz.name}
                        </h3>

                        {/* Coordinates & Copy */}
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-500 font-mono mb-3 pt-1">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-slate-500">
                            <MapPin className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                            <span>
                              {sz.latitude.toFixed(4)}, {sz.longitude.toFixed(4)}
                            </span>
                          </div>

                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={(e) => {
                              e.stopPropagation();
                              handleCopyCoords(sz);
                            }}
                            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded transition-colors"
                            title="Copy Coordinates"
                          >
                            {copiedId === sz.id ? (
                              <>
                                <Check className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-emerald-600" />
                                <span className="text-emerald-700 font-bold">{isBn ? "কপি হয়েছে" : "Copied"}</span>
                              </>
                            ) : (
                              <>
                                <Copy className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                                <span>{isBn ? "কপি" : "Copy"}</span>
                              </>
                            )}
                          </button>
                        </div>

                        {/* Actions */}
                        <div className="pt-2.5 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                          <button
                            onClick={(e) => {
                              e.stopPropagation();
                              handleNavigateSafePath(sz);
                            }}
                            className="flex-1 inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white text-xs font-bold transition-all shadow-2xs active:scale-95 min-h-[38px]"
                          >
                            <Navigation className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            <span>{isBn ? "নিরাপদ পথ দেখুন" : "Safe Path Navigation"}</span>
                          </button>

                          <a
                            href={`https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=${sz.latitude},${sz.longitude}`}
                            target="_blank"
                            rel="noreferrer"
                            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                            className="p-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center min-w-[38px] min-h-[38px]"
                            title="Open Google Maps Directions"
                          >
                            <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </a>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* VIEW MODE 2: GRID DIRECTORY (Responsive 3 Columns) */}
            {viewMode === "grid" && (
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5">
                {filteredSafeZones.map((sz) => {
                  const badge = getTypeBadge(sz.type);
                  const Icon = badge.icon;
                  const isSelected = selectedZone?.id === sz.id;

                  return (
                    <div
                      key={sz.id}
                      className={`bg-white border rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-xs hover:shadow-md transition-all flex flex-col justify-between ${
                        isSelected ? "border-blue-500 ring-2 ring-blue-500/20" : "border-slate-200"
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div>
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-2.5">
                          <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full border flex items-center gap-1.5 ${badge.badgeClass}`}>
                            <Icon className="w-3 h-3" />
                            <span>{badge.label}</span>
                          </span>

                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            {sz.distanceMeters && (
                              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-800 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-mono flex items-center gap-1">
                                <Sparkles className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-emerald-600" />
                                <span>
                                  {Number(sz.distanceMeters) >= 1000
                                    ? `${(Number(sz.distanceMeters) / 1000).toFixed(1)} km`
                                    : `${Math.round(Number(sz.distanceMeters))} m`}
                                </span>
                              </span>
                            )}

                            {user?.role === "ADMIN" && (
                              <button
                                onClick={() => handleDeleteSafeZone(sz.id, sz.name)}
                                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 p-1"
                                title="Delete Shelter"
                              >
                                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </button>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 leading-snug mb-2">
                          {isBn && sz.nameBn ? sz.nameBn : sz.name}
                        </h3>

                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-500 font-mono mb-4">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                            <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                            <span>
                              {sz.latitude.toFixed(4)}, {sz.longitude.toFixed(4)}
                            </span>
                          </div>

                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleCopyCoords(sz)}
                            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded"
                          >
                            {copiedId === sz.id ? (
                              <span className="text-emerald-700 font-bold">{isBn ? "কপি হয়েছে" : "Copied"}</span>
                            ) : (
                              <span>{isBn ? "কপি" : "Copy"}</span>
                            )}
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center gap-2">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleNavigateSafePath(sz)}
                          className="flex-1 inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white text-xs font-bold transition-all shadow-2xs"
                        >
                          <Navigation className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          <span>{isBn ? "নিরাপদ পথ খুঁজুন" : "Safe Navigation"}</span>
                        </button>

                        <a
                          href={`https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=${sz.latitude},${sz.longitude}`}
                          target="_blank"
                          rel="noreferrer"
                          className="p-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors"
                          title="Google Maps"
                        >
                          <ExternalLink className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </a>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* VIEW MODE 3: FULL INTERACTIVE MAP FOCUS */}
            {viewMode === "map" && (
              <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-xs space-y-4">
                <SafeZonesMap
                  safeZones={filteredSafeZones}
                  selectedZone={selectedZone}
                  onSelectZone={(z) => setSelectedZone(z)}
                  userLocation={userLocation}
                  language={language}
                  onNavigateSafeRoute={handleNavigateSafePath}
                  className="w-full h-[620px]"
                />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### What This Code Does
This page provides the safety-aware route navigation engine.
Users enter departure and destination points to calculate multi-modal walking and driving routes via OSRM.
The page renders the transit path overlaid on the map and highlights any active hazards intersecting the route.

```tsx
    end: { lat: 22.3275, lng: 91.8122 },

export default function RoutesPage() {
  const { initAuth } = useAuthStore();
  const { language } = useLanguageStore();
  const isBn = language === "bn";

  // Coordinates
  const [startLat, setStartLat] = useState("");
  const [startLng, setStartLng] = useState("");
  const [endLat, setEndLat] = useState("");
  const [endLng, setEndLng] = useState("");
  const [destinationLabel, setDestinationLabel] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [showGuidanceSteps, setShowGuidanceSteps] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isLocatingUser, setIsLocatingUser] = useState(false);
  const [copiedLink, setCopiedLink] = useState(false);

  // Core Safe Path calculation
  const calculateSafePath = useCallback(
    async (
      sLat: number,
      sLng: number,
      eLat: number,
      eLng: number,
      targetMode: TransportMode = mode
    ) => {
      setIsLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      setResult(null);

      try {
        if (isNaN(sLat) || isNaN(sLng) || isNaN(eLat) || isNaN(eLng)) {
          throw new Error("Please enter valid start and destination coordinates.");
        }

        const data = await apiFetch<SafeRouteOutput>("/routes/safe-path", {
          method: "POST",
          body: JSON.stringify({
            startLat: sLat,
            startLng: sLng,
            endLat: eLat,
            endLng: eLng,
            mode: targetMode,
          }),
        });

        setResult(data);
        // Default selected route to the recommended one
        const rec = data.routes?.find((r) => r.isRecommended);
        if (rec) {
          setSelectedRouteId(rec.id);
        } else if (data.routes && data.routes.length > 0) {
          setSelectedRouteId(data.routes[0].id);
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message || "Failed to calculate safe route");
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    },
    [mode]
  );

  useEffect(() => {

      const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const qStartLat = params.get("startLat");

      const qEndLat = params.get("endLat");
      const qEndLng = params.get("endLng");
      const qMode = params.get("mode") as TransportMode;
      const qDestName = params.get("destName") || params.get("name");

      if (qStartLat) setStartLat(qStartLat);
      if (qStartLng) setStartLng(qStartLng);
      if (qEndLat) setEndLat(qEndLat);
      if (qEndLng) setEndLng(qEndLng);
      if (qMode === "walking" || qMode === "driving") setMode(qMode);
      if (qDestName) setDestinationLabel(decodeURIComponent(qDestName));

      if (qStartLat && qStartLng && qEndLat && qEndLng) {
        calculateSafePath(
          parseFloat(qStartLat),
          parseFloat(qStartLng),
          parseFloat(qEndLat),
          parseFloat(qEndLng),
          qMode || "driving"
        );

    const sLng = parseFloat(startLng);
    const eLat = parseFloat(endLat);
    const eLng = parseFloat(endLng);
    if (!isNaN(sLat) && !isNaN(sLng) && !isNaN(eLat) && !isNaN(eLng)) {
      calculateSafePath(sLat, sLng, eLat, eLng, newMode);
    }
  };

  const handleCalculateRoute = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    calculateSafePath(

      parseFloat(startLng),
      parseFloat(endLat),
      parseFloat(endLng),
      mode

  };

  const handleApplyPreset = (preset: (typeof ROUTE_PRESETS)[0]) => {

    setEndLat(preset.end.lat.toString());
    setEndLng(preset.end.lng.toString());
    setDestinationLabel(null);
    calculateSafePath(
      preset.start.lat,
      preset.start.lng,

  // Acquire Citizen's live GPS for Origin

    if (!("geolocation" in navigator)) {

      return;
    }

    setIsLocatingUser(true);
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      (pos) => {
        setStartLat(pos.coords.latitude.toFixed(6));
        setStartLng(pos.coords.longitude.toFixed(6));
        setIsLocatingUser(false);
      },
      () => {
        setIsLocatingUser(false);
        showToast(
          "Failed to retrieve GPS location. Please allow browser location access.",
          "error"
        );
      },

  };

  const handleSwapEndpoints = () => {
    const tempLat = startLat;

    setStartLat(endLat);
    setStartLng(endLng);
    setEndLat(tempLat);
    setEndLng(tempLng);
  };

                <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl space-y-2.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold text-slate-800">
                      <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 shrink-0" />
                      <span>{isBn ? "যাত্রার শুরু (Origin)" : "Start Point (Origin)"}</span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={handleUseMyLocation}
                        disabled={isLocatingUser}
                        className="text-[10px] text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800 font-bold flex items-center gap-1 bg-blue-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-blue-200"
                      >
                        <Crosshair className={`w-2.5 h-2.5 ${isLocatingUser ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
                        <span>{isBn ? "আমার লোকেশন" : "My GPS"}</span>
                      </button>

                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setClickMode(clickMode === "START" ? "NONE" : "START")}
                        className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border transition-colors ${
                          clickMode === "START"
                            ? "bg-slate-900 text-white border-slate-900"
                            : "bg-white text-slate-600 border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {clickMode === "START"
                          ? isBn ? "বাতিল" : "Cancel"
                          : isBn ? "ম্যাপ থেকে নিন" : "Pick Map"}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <LocationSearchBar
                    placeholder={isBn ? "যাত্রার শুরু অনুসন্ধান করুন (যেমন: ফার্মগেট)..." : "Search origin location (e.g. Farmgate)..."}
                    onSelectLocation={(loc: GeocodedLocation) => {
                      setStartLat(loc.lat.toString());
                      setStartLng(loc.lng.toString());
                    }}
                  />

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-semibold mb-0.5">Latitude</label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={startLat}
                        onChange={(e) => setStartLat(e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="23.7570"
                        required
                        className="w-full p-2 text-xs bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-lg font-mono focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 focus:border-blue-500"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-semibold mb-0.5">Longitude</label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={startLng}
                        onChange={(e) => setStartLng(e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="90.3905"
                        required
                        className="w-full p-2 text-xs bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-lg font-mono focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 focus:border-blue-500"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Destination Point */}
                <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl space-y-2.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold text-slate-800">
                      <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-red-600 shrink-0" />
                      <span>{isBn ? "গন্তব্য (Destination)" : "Destination Point"}</span>
                    </div>

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setClickMode(clickMode === "END" ? "NONE" : "END")}
                      className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border transition-colors ${
                        clickMode === "END"
                          ? "bg-slate-900 text-white border-slate-900"
                          : "bg-white text-slate-600 border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {clickMode === "END"
                        ? isBn ? "বাতিল" : "Cancel"
                        : isBn ? "ম্যাপ থেকে নিন" : "Pick Map"}
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  {destinationLabel && (
                    <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 text-blue-900 text-[11px] font-semibold flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="truncate">{destinationLabel}</span>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setDestinationLabel(null)}
                        className="text-xs text-blue-500 hover:text-blue-800 ml-1"
                      >
                        ✕
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <LocationSearchBar
                    placeholder={isBn ? "গন্তব্য অনুসন্ধান করুন (যেমন: বনানী ১১)..." : "Search destination (e.g. Banani 11)..."}
                    onSelectLocation={(loc: GeocodedLocation) => {
                      setEndLat(loc.lat.toString());
                      setEndLng(loc.lng.toString());
                      setDestinationLabel(loc.name);
                    }}
                  />

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-semibold mb-0.5">Latitude</label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={endLat}
                        onChange={(e) => setEndLat(e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="23.7925"
                        required
                        className="w-full p-2 text-xs bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-lg font-mono focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 focus:border-blue-500"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-semibold mb-0.5">Longitude</label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={endLng}
                        onChange={(e) => setEndLng(e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="90.4078"
                        required
                        className="w-full p-2 text-xs bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-lg font-mono focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 focus:border-blue-500"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Submit CTA */}
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={isLoading}
                  className="w-full py-3 px-4 text-xs font-extrabold bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-xl shadow-xs transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 active:scale-98"
                >
                  {isLoading ? (
                    <>
                      <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                      <span>{isBn ? "সড়ক নেটওয়ার্ক পথ গণনা হচ্ছে..." : "Routing along road network..."}</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <Navigation className="w-4 h-4" />
                      <span>{isBn ? "নিরাপদ সড়ক পথ খুঁজুন" : "Calculate Road-Network Route"}</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </button>
              </form>
            </div>

            {/* Route Alternatives Selection Cards */}
            {result?.routes && result.routes.length > 0 && (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Activity className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600" />
                    <span>{isBn ? "উপলব্ধ সড়ক রুট বিকল্পসমূহ" : "Available Route Alternatives"}</span>
                  </h3>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-500">
                    {result.routes.length} {isBn ? "টি রুট" : "options"}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2.5">
                  {result.routes.map((route) => {
                    const isSelected = route.id === selectedRouteId;
                    const durationMins = Math.round(route.durationSeconds / 60);
                    const distanceKm = (route.distanceMeters / 1000).toFixed(2);

                    return (
                      <div
                        key={route.id}
                        onClick={() => setSelectedRouteId(route.id)}
                        className={`p-4 rounded-2xl border transition-all cursor-pointer relative ${
                          isSelected
                            ? "bg-blue-50/70 border-blue-500 shadow-sm ring-1 ring-blue-500"
                            : "bg-white border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50/50"
                        }`}
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                          <div className="space-y-1">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                              <span className="text-sm font-extrabold text-slate-900">
                                {route.title}
                              </span>
                              {route.isRecommended && (
                                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-300">
                                  <ShieldCheck className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-700" />
                                  <span>{isBn ? "প্রস্তাবিত নিরাপদ পথ" : "Recommended Safest"}</span>
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>

                            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs text-slate-600 font-medium">
                              <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                                <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                                <strong className="text-slate-900">{durationMins}</strong> {isBn ? "মি." : "mins"}
                              </span>
                              <span className="text-slate-300">•</span>
                              <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                                <Route className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                                <strong className="text-slate-900">{distanceKm}</strong> km
                              </span>
                              <span className="text-slate-300">•</span>
                              <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                                <AlertTriangle className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${route.hazardCount > 0 ? "text-amber-500" : "text-emerald-500"}`} />
                                <span>{route.hazardCount} {isBn ? "ঝুঁকি" : "hazards"}</span>
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          </div>

                          {/* Safety Score Pill */}
                          <div className="text-right shrink-0">
                            <div
                              className={`inline-block px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl text-xs font-black border ${
                                route.safetyScore >= 80
                                  ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200"
                                  : route.safetyScore >= 50
                                  ? "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border-blue-200"
                                  : "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200"
                              }`}
                            >
                              <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold mr-1">Score</span>
                              <span className="text-sm font-black">{route.safetyScore}</span>
                              <span className="text-[9px] font-normal text-slate-400">/95</span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 font-medium mt-0.5">
                              {route.safetyRating === "LOW_HAZARD_EXPOSURE"
                                ? isBn ? "স্বল্প ঝুঁকি" : "Low Exposure"
                                : route.safetyRating === "MODERATE_HAZARD_EXPOSURE"
                                ? isBn ? "মধ্যম ঝুঁকি" : "Moderate Exposure"
                                : isBn ? "উচ্চ ঝুঁকি" : "High Exposure"}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Right Column: Interactive Map & Turn-by-Turn Guidance (7 cols) */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-5">
            {error && (
              <div className="bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 rounded-2xl p-4 text-rose-800 text-xs flex items-center gap-2">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-600 shrink-0" />
                <p className="font-semibold">{error}</p>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Interactive Leaflet Route Map */}
            <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl p-3 shadow-xs space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-2 pt-1">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-blue-600 animate-pulse"></span>
                  <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 uppercase tracking-wider">
                    {isBn ? "লাইভ সড়ক নেটওয়ার্ক ও বিপদ করিডোর" : "Live Road Network & Hazard Corridors"}
                  </h3>
                </div>
                {activeRouteAlternative && (
                  <span
                    className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border ${
                      activeRouteAlternative.hazardCount > 0
                        ? "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200"
                        : "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {activeRouteAlternative.hazardCount > 0
                      ? isBn
                        ? `শনাক্ত বিপদ (${activeRouteAlternative.hazardCount}টি)`
                        : `Corridor Hazards (${activeRouteAlternative.hazardCount})`
                      : isBn
                      ? "করিডোর নিরাপদ"
                      : "Corridor Clear"}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>

              <RoutePathMap
                startLat={parseFloat(startLat)}
                startLng={parseFloat(startLng)}
                endLat={parseFloat(endLat)}
                endLng={parseFloat(endLng)}
                routes={result?.routes || []}
                selectedRouteId={selectedRouteId}
                onSelectRoute={(id) => setSelectedRouteId(id)}
                onMapClick={handleMapClick}
                clickMode={clickMode}
                language={language}
                className="w-full h-[400px] sm:h-[460px]"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Results Analytics & Explainability */}
            {result ? (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                {/* Explainable Trade-Off Banner */}
                {result.tradeOffSummary && (
                  <div className="bg-blue-50/90 border border-blue-200 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-2xs text-blue-950">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-xs mb-1 text-blue-800">
                      <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 shrink-0" />
                      <span>{isBn ? "রুট ট্রেড-অফ ও সুরক্ষার ব্যাখ্যা" : "Route Recommendation & Trade-Off Analysis"}</span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-blue-900 font-medium">
                      {result.tradeOffSummary}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Key Metrics Grid for Active Route */}
                {activeRouteAlternative && (
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
                    <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-3.5 shadow-2xs text-center">
                      <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400">
                        {isBn ? "প্রকৃত সড়ক দূরত্ব" : "Road Distance"}
                      </span>
                      <p className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-slate-900 mt-0.5">
                        {(activeRouteAlternative.distanceMeters / 1000).toFixed(2)} km
                      </p>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono">
                        {activeRouteAlternative.distanceMeters.toLocaleString()} m
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-3.5 shadow-2xs text-center">
                      <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400">
                        {isBn ? "আনুমানিক সময়" : "Estimated Duration"}
                      </span>
                      <p className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-slate-900 mt-0.5">
                        {Math.round(activeRouteAlternative.durationSeconds / 60)} {isBn ? "মি." : "mins"}
                      </p>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                        {mode === "walking" ? "@ 4.5 km/h" : isBn ? "শহুরে ট্রাফিক" : "Urban Profile"}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-3.5 shadow-2xs text-center">
                      <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400">
                        {isBn ? "সুরক্ষা স্কোর" : "Safety Score"}
                      </span>
                      <p
                        className={`text-base sm:text-lg font-black mt-0.5 ${
                          activeRouteAlternative.safetyScore >= 80
                            ? "text-emerald-600"
                            : activeRouteAlternative.safetyScore >= 50
                            ? "text-blue-600"
                            : "text-amber-600"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {activeRouteAlternative.safetyScore}
                        <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-normal"> / 95</span>
                      </p>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-medium">
                        {activeRouteAlternative.safetyRating === "LOW_HAZARD_EXPOSURE"
                          ? isBn ? "স্বল্প ঝুঁকি" : "Low Risk"
                          : activeRouteAlternative.safetyRating === "MODERATE_HAZARD_EXPOSURE"
                          ? isBn ? "মধ্যম ঝুঁকি" : "Moderate Risk"
                          : isBn ? "উচ্চ ঝুঁকি" : "High Risk"}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-3.5 shadow-2xs text-center">
                      <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400">
                        {isBn ? "করিডোর বিপদ" : "Corridor Hazards"}
                      </span>
                      <p
                        className={`text-base sm:text-lg font-black mt-0.5 ${
                          activeRouteAlternative.hazardCount > 0 ? "text-amber-600" : "text-emerald-600"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {activeRouteAlternative.hazardCount} {isBn ? "টি" : "Zones"}
                      </p>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">80m - 250m Buffer</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Turn-by-Turn Navigation Guidance Steps */}
                {activeRouteAlternative?.steps && activeRouteAlternative.steps.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-xs space-y-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <Navigation className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
                        <span>{isBn ? "ধাপে ধাপে নেভিগেশন ও ঝুঁকি সতর্কতা" : "Turn-by-Turn Navigation & Hazard Alerts"}</span>
                      </h3>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setShowGuidanceSteps(!showGuidanceSteps)}
                        className="text-xs text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-1"
                      >
                        <span className="text-[11px] font-bold font-mono">
                          {activeRouteAlternative.steps.length} {isBn ? "টি ধাপ" : "steps"}
                        </span>
                        {showGuidanceSteps ? <ChevronUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                      </button>
                    </div>

                    {showGuidanceSteps && (
                      <div className="space-y-2 max-h-72 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                        {activeRouteAlternative.steps.map((step, idx) => (
                          <div
                            key={idx}
                            className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-xs transition-colors ${
                              step.hazardWarning
                                ? "bg-amber-50/60 border-amber-200 text-amber-950"
                                : "bg-slate-50 border-slate-200/80 text-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-100/60"
                            }`}
                          >
                            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                              <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                                <span className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 font-bold text-[10px] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                                  {idx + 1}
                                </span>
                                <div>
                                  <p className="font-bold text-slate-900">{step.instruction}</p>
                                  <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono mt-0.5">
                                    {step.distanceMeters}m • ~{Math.round(step.durationSeconds)}s • maneuver: {step.maneuverType}
                                  </p>
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            </div>

                            {/* Localized Hazard Warning Pill */}
                            {step.hazardWarning && (
                              <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 text-[11px] font-bold border border-amber-300">
                                <ShieldAlert className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-700 shrink-0" />
                                <span>{step.hazardWarning}</span>
                              </div>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* External Maps Action */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-1">
                  <a
                    href={`https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=${startLat},${startLng}&destination=${endLat},${endLng}&travelmode=${mode}`}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noreferrer"
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl transition-all shadow-2xs"
                  >
                    <span>{isBn ? "গুগল ম্যাপে নেভিগেশন খুলুন" : "Open in Google Maps"}</span>
                    <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </a>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl p-10 text-center text-slate-500 shadow-xs space-y-2">
                <Compass className="w-10 h-10 text-slate-400 mx-auto" />
                <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">
                  {isBn ? "কোনো রুট গণনা করা হয়নি" : "No Route Calculated Yet"}
                </h4>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 max-w-sm mx-auto">
                  {isBn
                    ? "উপরে করিডোর প্রিসেট সিলেক্ট করুন অথবা ম্যাপে ক্লিক করে যাত্রাস্থল ও গন্তব্য নির্ধারণ করুন।"
                    : "Select a high-risk corridor preset above or enter origin and destination coordinates to generate your genuine road-network safe path."}
                </p>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## [File 135] `apps/web/app/alerts/page.tsx`
> **Path:** `apps/web/app/alerts/page.tsx`  
> **Lines of Code:** 1140  
> **Language:** `tsx`

### What This Code Does
This page enables users to manage personalized danger alert geofences.
Users can draw custom polygon boundaries around their home, workplace, or regular transit corridors.
It displays active geofences and allows users to toggle alert notifications for incidents within those boundaries.

```tsx
"use client";

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from "react";
import dynamic from "next/dynamic";
import Navbar from "@/components/layout/Navbar";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/store/useAuthStore";
import { useLanguageStore } from "@/store/useLanguageStore";

  Info,
  ShieldCheck,
  X,
} from "lucide-react";
import type { AlertZoneItem } from "@/components/alerts/PolygonDrawerMap";

  {

    loading: () => (
      <div className="w-full h-[340px] sm:h-[400px] lg:h-[440px] rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 border border-slate-200 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-slate-500 gap-2">
        <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-blue-600" />
        <span className="text-xs font-semibold">Loading interactive map canvas...</span>
      </div>
    ),
  }
);

interface AlertZone {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  userId: string;
  area?: {
    type: string;
    coordinates: [number, number][][];
  };
  coordinates?: [number, number][];
  createdAt: string;
}

const ZONE_PRESETS = [
  {
    nameEn: "Gulshan & Banani Diplomatic Hub (~4.2 km²)",
    nameBn: "গুলশান ও বনানী কূটনৈতিক এলাকা (~৪.২ বর্গকিমি)",
    zoneNameEn: "Gulshan-Banani Perimeter",
    zoneNameBn: "গুলশান-বনানী নিরাপত্তা বলয়",

    ] as [number, number][],

    ] as [number, number][],
  },
  {

    zoneNameEn: "Uttara Transit Perimeter",

  {

    zoneNameEn: "Motijheel Business District",
```
