```tsx
// Geodesic spherical area calculation in km²
function calculatePolygonAreaKm2(coords: [number, number][]): number {
  if (coords.length < 3) return 0;
  const radius = 6378137; // Earth radius in meters
  let area = 0;
  const len = coords.length;

  for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
    const p1 = coords[i];
    const p2 = coords[(i + 1) % len];
    const phi1 = (p1[1] * Math.PI) / 180;
    const phi2 = (p2[1] * Math.PI) / 180;
    const deltaLambda = ((p2[0] - p1[0]) * Math.PI) / 180;
    area += deltaLambda * (2 + Math.sin(phi1) + Math.sin(phi2));
  }
  area = Math.abs(area * radius * radius) / 2.0;
  return Number((area / 1e6).toFixed(2));
}

export default function AlertsPage() {
  const { user, initAuth } = useAuthStore();
  const { language } = useLanguageStore();
  const isBn = language === "bn";

  const [zones, setZones] = useState<AlertZone[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // New Zone Form
  const [zoneName, setZoneName] = useState("");
  const [activeCoords, setActiveCoords] = useState<[number, number][]>([]);
  const [coordsString, setCoordsString] = useState("");
  const [isCreating, setIsCreating] = useState(false);
  const [createError, setCreateError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [createSuccess, setCreateSuccess] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showJsonEditor, setShowJsonEditor] = useState(false);
  const [selectedZoneId, setSelectedZoneId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Web Push Status
  const [pushPermission, setPushPermission] = useState<NotificationPermission | "unsupported">("default");
  const [pushSubscribed, setPushSubscribed] = useState(false);
  const [isSubscribingPush, setIsSubscribingPush] = useState(false);

  // Live Geofence Stream
  const [liveAlerts, setLiveAlerts] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [deletingId, setDeletingId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Check notification permission and active push subscription on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    let isCancelled = false;
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      if (
        !("serviceWorker" in navigator) ||
        !("Notification" in window) ||
        !("PushManager" in window)
      ) {
        setPushPermission("unsupported");
        setPushSubscribed(false);
      } else {
        setPushPermission(Notification.permission);
        if (Notification.permission === "granted") {
          navigator.serviceWorker.ready
            .then((reg) => reg.pushManager.getSubscription())
            .then((sub) => {
              if (!isCancelled) {
                setPushSubscribed(!!sub);
              }
            })
            .catch(() => {
              if (!isCancelled) {
                setPushSubscribed(false);
              }
            });
        } else {
          setPushSubscribed(false);
        }
      }
    }
    return () => {
      isCancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  // Fetch zones on mount after auth
  const fetchZones = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await apiFetch<AlertZone[]>("/alerts/zones");
      setZones(data || []);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.warn("[Alerts] Fetch zones warning:", err.message);
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load alert zones");
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let isCancelled = false;
    let boundSocket: ReturnType<typeof getSocket> = null;

    const handleGeofenceAlert = (data: any) => {
      setLiveAlerts((prev) => [
        {
          ...data,
          receivedAt: new Date().toLocaleTimeString(),
        },
        ...prev,
      ]);
    };

    const bootstrap = async () => {
      await initAuth();
      if (isCancelled) return;

      await fetchZones();
      if (isCancelled) return;

      // Connect Socket.IO only after initAuth() finishes so the handshake carries socketToken
      const socket = getSocket();
      if (socket && !isCancelled) {
        boundSocket = socket;
        socket.on("GEOFENCE_ALERT", handleGeofenceAlert);
      }
    };
    bootstrap();

    return () => {
      isCancelled = true;
      if (boundSocket) {
        boundSocket.off("GEOFENCE_ALERT", handleGeofenceAlert);
      }
    };
  }, [initAuth, fetchZones]);

  // Compute live area
  const areaKm2 = useMemo(() => {
    return calculatePolygonAreaKm2(activeCoords);
  }, [activeCoords]);

  const isAreaExceeded = areaKm2 > 25.0;

  const isClosed = useMemo(() => {
    return (
      activeCoords.length >= 4 &&
      activeCoords[0][0] === activeCoords[activeCoords.length - 1][0] &&
      activeCoords[0][1] === activeCoords[activeCoords.length - 1][1]
    );
  }, [activeCoords]);

  // Apply Quick Preset
  const handleApplyPreset = (preset: typeof ZONE_PRESETS[0]) => {
    setZoneName(isBn ? preset.zoneNameBn : preset.zoneNameEn);
    setActiveCoords(preset.coordinates);
    setCoordsString(JSON.stringify(preset.coordinates, null, 2));
    setCreateError(null);
  };

  // Add Point via map click
  const handleAddMapPoint = (point: [number, number]) => {
    // If polygon is already closed, start a new one
    if (isClosed) {
      setActiveCoords([point]);
      setCoordsString(JSON.stringify([point], null, 2));
      return;
    }
    const updated = [...activeCoords, point];
    setActiveCoords(updated);
    setCoordsString(JSON.stringify(updated, null, 2));
    setCreateError(null);
  };

  // Undo Last Point
  const handleUndoPoint = () => {
    if (activeCoords.length === 0) return;
    const updated = activeCoords.slice(0, activeCoords.length - 1);
    setActiveCoords(updated);
    setCoordsString(JSON.stringify(updated, null, 2));
    setCreateError(null);
  };

  // Complete Ring (close loop)
  const handleCompleteRing = () => {
    if (activeCoords.length < 3) return;
    const firstPoint = activeCoords[0];
    const lastPoint = activeCoords[activeCoords.length - 1];
    if (firstPoint[0] === lastPoint[0] && firstPoint[1] === lastPoint[1]) {
      return; // Already closed
    }
    const closed = [...activeCoords, firstPoint];
    setActiveCoords(closed);
    setCoordsString(JSON.stringify(closed, null, 2));
  };

  // Clear Polygon
  const handleClearPolygon = () => {
    setActiveCoords([]);
    setCoordsString("[]");
    setCreateError(null);
  };

  // Geolocate user to start drawing near them
  const handleGeolocate = () => {
    if (!navigator.geolocation) {
      showToast(
        isBn ? "আপনার ব্রাউজারে জিপিএস সমর্থিত নয়" : "Geolocation is not supported by your browser",
        "error"
      );
      return;
    }
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      (pos) => {
        const lng = parseFloat(pos.coords.longitude.toFixed(5));
        const lat = parseFloat(pos.coords.latitude.toFixed(5));
        // Add a 500m bounding perimeter around user position
        const delta = 0.005;
        const userBox: [number, number][] = [
          [lng - delta, lat - delta],
          [lng + delta, lat - delta],
          [lng + delta, lat + delta],
          [lng - delta, lat + delta],
          [lng - delta, lat - delta],
        ];
        setActiveCoords(userBox);
        setCoordsString(JSON.stringify(userBox, null, 2));
        setZoneName(isBn ? "আমার বর্তমান অবস্থান বলয়" : "My Current Location Perimeter");
      },
      () => {
        showToast(
          isBn ? "জিপিএস অবস্থান সংগ্রহ করা যায়নি" : "Unable to retrieve your GPS location",
          "error"
        );
      }
    );
  };

  // Handle textarea edit
  const handleTextareaChange = (val: string) => {
    setCoordsString(val);
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(val);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        setActiveCoords(parsed);
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore parse error while user is typing
    }
  };

  // Submit New Geofence Zone
  const handleCreateZone = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!zoneName.trim()) return;

    if (zones.length >= 5) {
      setCreateError(
        isBn
          ? "আপনি সর্বোচ্চ ৫টি অ্যাক্টিভ জোন তৈরি করেছেন। নতুন জোন তৈরি করতে একটি পুরোনো জোন ডিলিট করুন।"
          : "You have reached the maximum quota of 5 active alert zones. Please delete an older zone to create a new one."
      );
      return;
    }

    setIsCreating(true);
    setCreateError(null);
    setCreateSuccess(null);

    try {
      let parsedCoords: [number, number][];
      try {
        parsedCoords = JSON.parse(coordsString);
      } catch {
        throw new Error(
          isBn
            ? "কোঅর্ডিনেটস অবশ্যই বৈধ JSON অ্যারে [ [দ্রাঘিমাংশ, অক্ষাংশ], ... ] হতে হবে।"
            : "Coordinates must be a valid JSON array of [longitude, latitude] pairs."
        );
      }

      if (parsedCoords.length < 4) {
        throw new Error(
          isBn
            ? "একটি বৈধ আবদ্ধ পলিগনের জন্য কমপক্ষে ৪টি বিন্দু প্রয়োজন (৩টি শীর্ষবিন্দু + ১টি সমাপনী বিন্দু)। 'Close Ring' বাটনে ক্লিক করুন।"
            : "A valid closed polygon requires at least 4 coordinate pairs. Click 'Close Ring' to complete."
        );
      }

      const first = parsedCoords[0];
      const last = parsedCoords[parsedCoords.length - 1];
      if (first[0] !== last[0] || first[1] !== last[1]) {
        throw new Error(
          isBn
            ? "পলিগনের প্রথম এবং শেষ বিন্দু অভিন্ন হতে হবে (বন্ধ বৃত্তাকার রিং)। 'Close Ring' বাটনে চাপুন।"
            : "Polygon ring must be closed: the first and last coordinates must match. Click 'Close Ring'."
        );
      }

      const calculatedArea = calculatePolygonAreaKm2(parsedCoords);
      if (calculatedArea > 25.0) {
        throw new Error(
          isBn
            ? `জোনের আয়তন ${calculatedArea} বর্গকিমি, যা অনুমোদিত ২৫ বর্গকিমির চেয়ে বেশি!`
            : `Geofence area (${calculatedArea} km²) exceeds the maximum limit of 25 km² (anti-abuse cap).`
        );
      }

      await apiFetch("/alerts/zones", {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({
          name: zoneName.trim(),
          coordinates: parsedCoords,
        }),
      });

      setCreateSuccess(
        isBn
          ? `সফলভাবে "${zoneName}" অ্যালার্ট জোন সক্রিয় করা হয়েছে!`
          : `Alert Zone "${zoneName}" successfully established!`
      );
      setZoneName("");
      fetchZones();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setCreateError(err.message || "Failed to create alert zone");
    } finally {
      setIsCreating(false);
    }
  };

  // Delete Zone
  const handleDeleteZone = async (id: string, name: string) => {
    const msg = isBn
      ? `আপনি কি নিশ্চিত যে "${name}" অ্যালার্ট জোনটি মুছে ফেলতে চান?`
      : `Are you sure you want to delete alert zone "${name}"?`;
    if (!window.confirm(msg)) return;

    setDeletingId(id);
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/alerts/zones/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" });
      fetchZones();
    } catch (err: any) {
      showToast(`Delete failed: ${err.message}`, "error");
    } finally {
      setDeletingId(null);
    }
  };

  // Web Push Subscription
  const handleSubscribePush = async () => {
    setIsSubscribingPush(true);
    try {
      if (
        !("serviceWorker" in navigator) ||
        !("Notification" in window) ||
        !("PushManager" in window)
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          isBn
            ? "আপনার ব্রাউজার পুশ নোটিফিকেশন সমর্থন করে না।"
            : "Push messaging is not supported in this browser."
        );
      }

      const permission = await Notification.requestPermission();
      setPushPermission(permission);

      if (permission !== "granted") {
        throw new Error(
          isBn
            ? "ব্রাউজারে নোটিফিকেশনের অনুমতি প্রদান করা হয়নি। ব্রাউজার সেটিংসে অনুমতি সক্রিয় করুন।"
            : "Notification permission was denied. Please allow notifications in your browser settings."
        );
      }

      // Ensure service worker is registered and ready
      const existingReg = await navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistration();
      if (!existingReg) {
        await navigator.serviceWorker.register("/sw.js");
      }
      const reg = await navigator.serviceWorker.ready;
      let sub = await reg.pushManager.getSubscription();

      const vapidPublicKey = getVapidPublicKey();
      if (!vapidPublicKey) {
        throw new Error(
          isBn
            ? "পুশ নোটিফিকেশন সার্ভার কনফিগারেশন অনুপলব্ধ। দয়া করে পরে আবার চেষ্টা করুন।"
            : "Web Push notifications are not configured on this server yet."
        );
      }
      const appServerKey = urlBase64ToUint8Array(vapidPublicKey);

      // If existing subscription was created with a different key, unsubscribe it
      if (sub && sub.options?.applicationServerKey) {
        const existingKeyBytes = new Uint8Array(sub.options.applicationServerKey);
        const keysMatch =
          existingKeyBytes.length === appServerKey.length &&
          existingKeyBytes.every((val, idx) => val === appServerKey[idx]);
        if (!keysMatch) {
          await sub.unsubscribe();
          sub = null;
        }
      }

      if (!sub) {
        try {
          sub = await reg.pushManager.subscribe({
            userVisibleOnly: true,
            applicationServerKey: appServerKey,
          });
        } catch (subErr: any) {
          // If browser throws due to key conflict or stale state, attempt unsubscribe and retry once
          const staleSub = await reg.pushManager.getSubscription();
          if (staleSub) {
            await staleSub.unsubscribe();
            sub = await reg.pushManager.subscribe({
              userVisibleOnly: true,
              applicationServerKey: appServerKey,
            });
          } else {
            throw subErr;
          }
        }
      }

      if (!sub?.endpoint) {
        throw new Error(
          isBn
            ? "ব্রাউজার থেকে বৈধ পুশ সাবস্ক্রিপশন পাওয়া যায়নি।"
            : "Unable to obtain a valid browser push subscription."
        );
      }

      // Ensure user session exists before posting subscription
      if (!useAuthStore.getState().user) {
        await initAuth();
      }

      const subJson = sub.toJSON();
      const p256dh = subJson.keys?.p256dh;
      const auth = subJson.keys?.auth;
      const pushPayload: {
        endpoint: string;
        keys?: { p256dh: string; auth: string };
      } = {
        endpoint: sub.endpoint,
        ...(p256dh && auth ? { keys: { p256dh, auth } } : {}),
      };

      await apiFetch("/alerts/subscribe", {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify(pushPayload),
      });

      setPushSubscribed(true);
      showToast(
        isBn
          ? "ব্রাউজার ওয়েব পুশ অ্যালার্ট সফলভাবে নিবন্ধিত হয়েছে!"
          : "Browser Web Push alert registration successful!",
        "success"
      );
    } catch (err: any) {
      showToast(
        err?.message ||
          (isBn
            ? "ব্রাউজার ওয়েব পুশ নিবন্ধন ব্যর্থ হয়েছে।"
            : "Failed to register browser push alerts."),
        "error"
      );
    } finally {
      setIsSubscribingPush(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-slate-50 text-slate-900 selection:bg-blue-500 selection:text-white">
      {/* Single Unified Navbar with integrated EN/বাংলা toggle */}
      <Navbar />

      <main className="flex-1 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 py-6 sm:py-8 space-y-6">

        {/* Page Title & Mission Header */}
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <div className="p-2.5 bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 text-blue-600 rounded-xl shadow-xs">
                <Bell className="w-6 h-6" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
                  {isBn
                    ? "জিওফেন্সড অ্যালার্ট জোন ও পুশ নোটিফিকেশন"
                    : "Geofenced Alert Zones & Push Notifications"}
                </h1>
                <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-600 font-medium mt-0.5">
                  {isBn
                    ? "মানচিত্রে আপনার বাসস্থান বা চলাচলের পরিধি চিহ্নিত করুন। PostGIS প্রযুক্তিতে ২৫ বর্গকিমির মধ্যে দুর্ঘটনা ঘটলে তাৎক্ষণিক নোটিফিকেশন পান।"
                    : "Establish custom perimeter boundaries (capped at 25 km²). Receive instant real-time alerts when incidents occur within your zone via PostGIS ST_Intersects."}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Zones Quota Pill */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl p-3 shadow-xs shrink-0">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm border border-blue-100">
              {zones.length}
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-800">
                <span>{isBn ? "সক্রিয় জোন কোটা" : "Active Zone Quota"}</span>
                <span className="text-slate-400 font-normal">({zones.length}/5)</span>
              </div>
              <div className="w-28 bg-slate-100 h-1.5 rounded-full mt-1 overflow-hidden">
                <div
                  className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all ${
                    zones.length >= 5 ? "bg-red-500" : "bg-blue-600"
                  }`}
                  style={{ width: `${(zones.length / 5) * 100}%` }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Web Push Notification Banner Card */}
        <section className="bg-white border border-slate-200/90 rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-xs flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3.5">
            <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 rounded-xl shrink-0 border border-blue-100 shadow-2xs">
              <Radio className="w-6 h-6 animate-pulse" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">
                  {isBn ? "ওয়েব পুশ অ্যালার্ট নোটিফিকেশন" : "Web Push Alert Notifications"}
                </h2>
                {pushSubscribed ? (
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200">
                    <Check className="w-3 h-3" />
                    {isBn ? "সক্রিয়" : "Active"}
                  </span>
                ) : pushPermission === "denied" ? (
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200">
                    <AlertTriangle className="w-3 h-3" />
                    {isBn ? "ব্লকড" : "Blocked in Browser"}
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border border-slate-200">
                    {isBn ? "অননুমোদিত" : "Inactive"}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 mt-0.5">
                {isBn
                  ? "ট্যাব বন্ধ থাকা অবস্থায়ও আপনার নিরাপত্তা বলয়ের মধ্যে অগ্নিকাণ্ড বা হামলার অ্যালার্ট পান।"
                  : "Receive high-priority crisis push notifications directly on your device even when your browser tab is closed."}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="shrink-0 flex items-center gap-2 w-full md:w-auto">
            <button
              onClick={handleSubscribePush}
              disabled={isSubscribingPush || pushSubscribed}
              className={`w-full md:w-auto px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl shadow-xs transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer ${
                pushSubscribed
                  ? "bg-emerald-600 text-white cursor-default"
                  : pushPermission === "denied"
                  ? "bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white"
                  : "bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white active:scale-95"
              }`}
            >
              {isSubscribingPush ? (
                <>
                  <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                  <span>{isBn ? "সংযোগ হচ্ছে..." : "Connecting..."}</span>
                </>
              ) : pushSubscribed ? (
                <>
                  <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>{isBn ? "পুশ অ্যালার্ট সক্রিয় রয়েছে" : "Push Alerts Active"}</span>
                </>
              ) : pushPermission === "denied" ? (
                <>
                  <Info className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>{isBn ? "সেটিংস থেকে চালু করুন" : "Enable in Browser Settings"}</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Bell className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>{isBn ? "পুশ অ্যালার্ট চালু করুন" : "Enable Push Notifications"}</span>
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* 2-Column Responsive Layout */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
          {/* Left Column: Interactive Geofence Drawer & Form (7 cols on lg) */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
            <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200/90 rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-xs space-y-4">
              {/* Card Header & Live Area Badge */}
              <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Edit3 className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
                  <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">
                    {isBn ? "ইন্টারেক্টিভ জিওফেন্স বিল্ডার" : "Interactive Geofence Canvas"}
                  </h2>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span
                    className={`text-xs font-black px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border transition-colors ${
                      isAreaExceeded
                        ? "bg-red-50 border-red-200 text-red-700 animate-pulse"
                        : areaKm2 > 20
                        ? "bg-amber-50 border-amber-200 text-amber-700"
                        : "bg-blue-50 border-blue-200 text-blue-700"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {isBn ? `আয়তন: ${areaKm2} বর্গকিমি` : `Area: ${areaKm2} km²`} / 25 km²
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Map Action Control Buttons Toolbar */}
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleUndoPoint}
                    disabled={activeCoords.length === 0}
                    className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 disabled:opacity-40 text-slate-700 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    title="Undo last vertex"
                  >
                    <Undo2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>{isBn ? "পূর্বাবস্থায়" : "Undo"}</span>
                  </button>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleCompleteRing}
                    disabled={activeCoords.length < 3 || isClosed}
                    className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 disabled:opacity-40 text-blue-700 font-bold border border-blue-200 flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>{isBn ? "রিং সম্পূর্ণ করুন" : "Close Ring"}</span>
                  </button>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleClearPolygon}
                    disabled={activeCoords.length === 0}
                    className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-red-50 hover:bg-red-100 disabled:opacity-40 text-red-700 font-semibold border border-red-200 flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>{isBn ? "মুছুন" : "Clear"}</span>
                  </button>
                </div>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleGeolocate}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <LocateFixed className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600" />
                  <span>{isBn ? "আমার অবস্থান" : "My GPS"}</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Interactive Leaflet Map */}
              <PolygonDrawerMap
                activeCoords={activeCoords}
                onAddPoint={handleAddMapPoint}
                savedZones={zones}
                selectedZoneId={selectedZoneId}
                onSelectZone={(z) => setSelectedZoneId(z.id)}
              />

              {/* Warnings and Status Banners */}
              {isAreaExceeded && (
                <div className="p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-900 rounded-xl text-xs flex items-center gap-2">
                  <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-red-600" />
                  <div>
                    <span className="font-bold">
                      {isBn ? "অনুমোদিত সর্বোচ্চ সীমা অতিক্রম করেছে!" : "Perimeter Cap Exceeded!"}
                    </span>{" "}
                    {isBn
                      ? `আয়তন ${areaKm2} বর্গকিমি। সর্বোচ্চ অনুমোদিত সীমা ২৫ বর্গকিমি। শীর্ষবিন্দুগুলো সংকুচিত করুন।`
                      : `Your geofence area is ${areaKm2} km², which exceeds the 25 km² limit. Please reduce boundary vertices.`}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {createSuccess && (
                <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-900 rounded-xl text-xs flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-emerald-600" />
                    <span>{createSuccess}</span>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setCreateSuccess(null)}
                    className="text-emerald-700 hover:text-emerald-900"
                  >
                    <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}

              {createError && (
                <div className="p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-900 rounded-xl text-xs flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-red-600" />
                    <span>{createError}</span>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setCreateError(null)}
                    className="text-red-700 hover:text-red-900"
                  >
                    <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Metropolitan Presets */}
              <div className="pt-2">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mb-2">
                  {isBn ? "দ্রুত মেট্রো প্রিসেট নির্বাচন:" : "Quick Metropolitan Presets:"}
                </label>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                  {ZONE_PRESETS.map((preset) => (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      key={preset.nameEn}
                      onClick={() => handleApplyPreset(preset)}
                      className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs rounded-xl bg-slate-50 hover:bg-blue-50 text-slate-700 hover:text-blue-700 border border-slate-200 hover:border-blue-300 font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                    >
                      {isBn ? preset.nameBn : preset.nameEn}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Create Zone Form */}
              <form onSubmit={handleCreateZone} className="space-y-4 pt-2">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    {isBn ? "জোনের নাম" : "Zone Identifier Name"}
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder={
                      isBn ? "যেমন: বাসা ও অফিস যাতায়াত রুট" : "e.g., Home & Office Commute Route"
                    }
                    value={zoneName}
                    onChange={(e) => setZoneName(e.target.value)}
                    required
                    className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:bg-white focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 transition-colors"
                  />
                </div>

                {/* Collapsible Advanced GeoJSON Coordinates Accordion */}
                <div className="border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-slate-50/50">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setShowJsonEditor(!showJsonEditor)}
                    className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 flex items-center justify-between hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
                      <span>
                        {isBn
                          ? `উন্নত জিওজেসন কোঅর্ডিনেটস (${activeCoords.length} টি পয়েন্ট)`
                          : `Advanced GeoJSON Coordinates (${activeCoords.length} points)`}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    {showJsonEditor ? (
                      <ChevronUp className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
                    ) : (
                      <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
                    )}
                  </button>

                  {showJsonEditor && (
                    <div className="p-3 border-t border-slate-200 bg-white space-y-2">
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                        {isBn
                          ? "পোস্টজিআইএস ডবল-প্রিসিশন [দ্রাঘিমাংশ, অক্ষাংশ] ফর্ম্যাটে পলিগন রিং:"
                          : "Format: [ [longitude, latitude], ... ] with matching first and last points."}
                      </p>
                      <textarea
                        value={coordsString}
                        onChange={(e) => handleTextareaChange(e.target.value)}
                        rows={4}
                        className="w-full p-2 text-[10px] font-mono bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 text-slate-800 rounded-xl resize-none focus:outline-none focus:bg-white focus:border-blue-500 transition-colors"
                      />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Submit Button */}
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={isCreating || isAreaExceeded || zones.length >= 5}
                  className="w-full py-3 px-4 text-xs font-bold bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-xl shadow-sm transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {isCreating ? (
                    <>
                      <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                      <span>{isBn ? "জিওফেন্স তৈরি হচ্ছে..." : "Creating Geofence..."}</span>
                    </>
                  ) : zones.length >= 5 ? (
                    <span>{isBn ? "জোন কোটা পূর্ণ (সর্বোচ্চ ৫টি)" : "Zone Quota Reached (Max 5)"}</span>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <PlusCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
                      <span>{isBn ? "অ্যালার্ট জোন সংরক্ষণ করুন" : "Save Active Geofence Zone"}</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </button>
              </form>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right Column: Active Alert Zones & Live Alert Stream (5 cols on lg) */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-6">
            {/* Active User Alert Zones List */}
            <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200/90 rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-xs space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-slate-100">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Bell className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
                  <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-800">
                    {isBn
                      ? `আমার সংরক্ষিত জোন (${zones.length}/৫)`
                      : `My Active Zones (${zones.length}/5)`}
                  </h3>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={fetchZones}
                  disabled={isLoading}
                  className="text-xs text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-700 font-bold flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <RefreshCw className={`w-3 h-3 ${isLoading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
                  <span>{isBn ? "রিফ্রেশ" : "Refresh"}</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              {isLoading ? (
                <div className="p-8 text-center">
                  <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 text-blue-600 animate-spin mx-auto mb-2" />
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium">
                    {isBn ? "সংরক্ষিত জোন লোড হচ্ছে..." : "Loading saved zones..."}
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : zones.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="p-8 text-center text-slate-500 text-xs bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-200 space-y-2">
                  <MapPin className="w-8 h-8 text-slate-300 mx-auto" />
                  <p className="font-semibold text-slate-700">
                    {isBn ? "কোনো সক্রিয় অ্যালার্ট জোন নেই" : "No Active Geofence Zones"}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-slate-500 text-[11px]">
                    {isBn
                      ? "মানচিত্রে ক্লিক করে বা প্রিসেট নির্বাচন করে আপনার প্রথম জোন তৈরি করুন।"
                      : "Click vertices on the map canvas or apply a metropolitan preset to establish 24/7 monitoring."}
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  {zones.map((zone) => {
                    const rawCoords =
                      zone.area?.coordinates?.[0] || zone.coordinates || [];
                    const count = rawCoords.length;
                    const zoneArea = calculatePolygonAreaKm2(rawCoords);
                    const isSelected = selectedZoneId === zone.id;

                    return (
                      <div
                        key={zone.id}
                        onClick={() => setSelectedZoneId(zone.id)}
                        className={`p-3.5 rounded-xl border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                          isSelected
                            ? "bg-blue-50/70 border-blue-300 shadow-xs"
                            : "bg-slate-50/80 border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300"
                        }`}
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                          <div className="min-w-0">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                              <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 truncate">
                                {zone.name}
                              </h4>
                              {isSelected && (
                                <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 bg-blue-600 text-white text-[9px] font-bold rounded">
                                  {isBn ? "নির্বাচিত" : "Selected"}
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-600 font-medium">
                              <span>
                                {isBn
                                  ? `${count} টি শীর্ষবিন্দু`
                                  : `${count} Polygon Vertices`}
                              </span>
                              <span>•</span>
                              <span className="text-blue-700 font-bold">
                                ~{zoneArea} km²
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          </div>

                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={(e) => {
                              e.stopPropagation();
                              handleDeleteZone(zone.id, zone.name);
                            }}
                            disabled={deletingId === zone.id}
                            className="text-slate-400 hover:text-red-600 transition-colors p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-50 cursor-pointer"
                            title={isBn ? "জোন মুছুন" : "Delete Zone"}
                          >
                            {deletingId === zone.id ? (
                              <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin text-red-600" />
                            ) : (
                              <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            )}
                          </button>
                        </div>

                        <div className="mt-2.5 pt-2 border-t border-slate-200/80 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono">
                          <span>ID: {zone.id.substring(0, 8)}...</span>
                          <span>
                            {new Date(zone.createdAt).toLocaleDateString(
                              isBn ? "bn-BD" : "en-US",
                              { month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" }
                            )}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Live Socket Geofence Trigger Stream */}
            <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200/90 rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-xs space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-slate-100">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-red-500 animate-ping" />
                  <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-800">
                    {isBn ? "লাইভ জিওফেন্স বিপদ স্ট্রিম" : "Live Geofence Incident Stream"}
                  </h3>
                </div>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono">
                  Socket: GEOFENCE_ALERT
                </span>
              </div>

              {liveAlerts.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="p-6 bg-slate-50 border border-dashed border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-center text-xs text-slate-500 space-y-1.5">
                  <ShieldAlert className="w-7 h-7 text-slate-300 mx-auto" />
                  <p className="font-semibold text-slate-700">
                    {isBn ? "বলয়ের ভেতরে কোনো সক্রিয় হুমকি নেই" : "No Incidents Inside Perimeter"}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                    {isBn
                      ? "পোস্টজিআইএস ST_Intersects অ্যালগরিদম দিয়ে যেকোনো রিপোর্ট আপনার জোনের ভেতরে প্রবেশ করামাত্রই তাৎক্ষণিক নোটিফিকেশন পাবেন।"
                      : "Incidents submitted by citizens intersecting your PostGIS geofences appear here in real time."}
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  {liveAlerts.map((alert, idx) => (
                    <div
                      key={idx}
                      className="p-3 bg-red-50/90 border border-red-200 rounded-xl text-xs text-red-900 flex items-start justify-between shadow-2xs gap-2"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
                        <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                        <div>
                          <span className="font-bold">
                            {alert.title || (isBn ? "বলয়ের ভেতরে জরুরি বিপদ!" : "Hazard Inside Alert Zone!")}
                          </span>
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-red-700 mt-0.5">
                            {alert.message || alert.description}
                          </p>
                          {alert.zoneName && (
                            <span className="inline-block mt-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-red-800 bg-red-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                              {isBn ? `জোন: ${alert.zoneName}` : `Zone: ${alert.zoneName}`}
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-red-600 font-mono shrink-0">
                        {alert.receivedAt}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### What This Code Does
This page presents a full-screen, chronological feed of all recent safety incidents across Bangladesh.
It provides advanced multi-category filters, district dropdowns, and search bars for civic awareness.
Users can review community confirmations, read press citations, and click to view map locations.

```tsx
"use client";

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";

  SOCKET_EVENTS,
  getSocketReportId,

} from "lucide-react";

interface ReportMedia {
  id: string;
  blurredUrl: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

interface Incident {
  id: string;
  category: ReportCategory;
  severity: "LOW" | "MEDIUM" | "HIGH";
  isNightReport?: boolean;
  latitude: number;
  longitude: number;
  description?: string | null;
  upvotes: number;
  downvotes: number;

}

interface IncidentComment {

  reportId: string;
  userId: string;
  content: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

type SortOption = "NEWEST" | "MOST_UPVOTED" | "SEVERITY_HIGH";

function formatRelativeTime(dateString: string, lang: "en" | "bn"): string {
  try {
    const diffMs = Date.now() - new Date(dateString).getTime();
    const diffSec = Math.floor(diffMs / 1000);
    const diffMin = Math.floor(diffSec / 60);
    const diffHour = Math.floor(diffMin / 60);

    if (diffMin < 1) {
      return lang === "bn" ? "এইমাত্র" : "Just now";
    }
    if (diffMin < 60) {
      return lang === "bn" ? `${diffMin} মিনিট আগে` : `${diffMin}m ago`;
    }
    if (diffHour < 24) {
      return lang === "bn" ? `${diffHour} ঘণ্টা আগে` : `${diffHour}h ago`;
    }
    const days = Math.floor(diffHour / 24);
    return lang === "bn" ? `${days} দিন আগে` : `${days}d ago`;
  } catch {
    return lang === "bn" ? "সাম্প্রতিক" : "Recent";
  }
}

function formatRemainingExpiry(expiresAtString: string, lang: "en" | "bn"): string {
  try {
    const remainingMs = new Date(expiresAtString).getTime() - Date.now();
    if (remainingMs <= 0) {
      return lang === "bn" ? "মেয়াদ উত্তীর্ণ" : "Expired";
    }
    const remainingMin = Math.floor(remainingMs / (1000 * 60));
    const remainingHours = Math.floor(remainingMin / 60);
    const remainingDays = Math.floor(remainingHours / 24);

    if (remainingDays >= 1) {
      return lang === "bn" ? `${remainingDays} দিন বাকি` : `${remainingDays}d left`;
    }
    if (remainingHours >= 1) {
      return lang === "bn" ? `${remainingHours} ঘণ্টা বাকি` : `${remainingHours}h left`;
    }
    return lang === "bn" ? `${remainingMin} মি. বাকি` : `${remainingMin}m left`;
  } catch {
    return "";
  }
}

function extractLocationName(incident: Incident): string {
  const desc = incident.description || "";
  if (desc.includes("সাভার") || desc.includes("আশুলিয়া")) return "Savar / Ashulia, Dhaka";
  if (desc.includes("যশোর") || desc.includes("অভয়নগর")) return "Abhaynagar, Jessore";
  if (desc.includes("মিরপুর")) return "Mirpur, Dhaka";
  if (desc.includes("নারায়ণগঞ্জ")) return "Link Road, Narayanganj";
  if (desc.includes("ধানমন্ডি")) return "Dhanmondi, Dhaka";
  if (desc.includes("গুলশান") || desc.includes("বনানী")) return "Gulshan-Banani, Dhaka";
  if (desc.includes("খুলনা") || desc.includes("সোনাডাঙ্গা")) return "Khulna Metropolitan";
  if (desc.includes("চট্টগ্রাম")) return "Chittagong Port City";
  if (desc.includes("সিলেট")) return "Sylhet Sadar";
  return `Sector (${incident.latitude.toFixed(2)}°N, ${incident.longitude.toFixed(2)}°E)`;
}

export default function FeedPage() {
  const { user, initAuth } = useAuthStore();
  const { language } = useLanguageStore();
  const isBn = language === "bn";

  const stats = useStatsStore((state) => state.stats);
  const fetchStats = useStatsStore((state) => state.fetchStats);
  const initStatsListener = useStatsStore((state) => state.initStatsListener);

  const [incidents, setIncidents] = useState<Incident[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Filters & Search
  const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState<string>("ALL");
  const [severityFilter, setSeverityFilter] = useState<string>("ALL");
  const [nightFilter, setNightFilter] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState<SortOption>("NEWEST");

  // Category horizontal scroll state
  const categoryScrollRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [canScrollLeft, setCanScrollLeft] = useState(false);
  const [canScrollRight, setCanScrollRight] = useState(false);

  const checkCategoryScroll = useCallback(() => {
    const el = categoryScrollRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const { scrollLeft, scrollWidth, clientWidth } = el;
    setCanScrollLeft(scrollLeft > 4);
    setCanScrollRight(scrollLeft < scrollWidth - clientWidth - 4);
  }, []);

  const handleScrollCategories = (direction: "left" | "right") => {
    const el = categoryScrollRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const offset = direction === "left" ? -280 : 280;
    el.scrollBy({ left: offset, behavior: "smooth" });
    setTimeout(checkCategoryScroll, 320);
  };

  const hasActiveFilters =
    categoryFilter !== "ALL" ||
    severityFilter !== "ALL" ||
    nightFilter ||
    searchQuery.trim().length > 0;

  const handleResetFilters = () => {
    setCategoryFilter("ALL");
    setSeverityFilter("ALL");
    setNightFilter(false);
    setSearchQuery("");
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    checkCategoryScroll();
    const handleResize = () => checkCategoryScroll();
    window.addEventListener("resize", handleResize);
    const timer = setTimeout(checkCategoryScroll, 350);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("resize", handleResize);
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [checkCategoryScroll]);

  // Interaction States
  const [votingId, setVotingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [expandedCommentsId, setExpandedCommentsId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [commentsMap, setCommentsMap] = useState<Record<string, IncidentComment[]>>({});
  const [loadingCommentsId, setLoadingCommentsId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [commentInputText, setCommentInputText] = useState("");
  const [submittingCommentId, setSubmittingCommentId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [copiedId, setCopiedId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Fetch all reports within Bangladesh territorial boundary
  const fetchIncidents = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      let query = "/reports?minLat=20.0&maxLat=27.0&minLng=88.0&maxLng=93.0";
      if (categoryFilter !== "ALL") query += `&category=${categoryFilter}`;
      if (severityFilter !== "ALL") query += `&severity=${severityFilter}`;
      if (nightFilter) query += `&isNightReport=true`;

      const data = await apiFetch<Incident[]>(query);
      setIncidents(data || []);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("[FeedPage] Error fetching incidents:", err);
      setError(err.message || (isBn ? "তথ্য লোড করতে সমস্যা হয়েছে" : "Failed to load safety alerts."));
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [categoryFilter, severityFilter, nightFilter, isBn]);

  useEffect(() => {
    initAuth();
    fetchStats();
    initStatsListener();
    fetchIncidents();
  }, [initAuth, fetchStats, initStatsListener, fetchIncidents]);

  // Real-time WebSocket subscriptions
  useEffect(() => {
    const socket = getSocket();
    if (!socket) return;

    const handleNewReport = (newReport: Incident) => {
      setIncidents((prev) => {
        if (prev.some((i) => i.id === newReport.id)) return prev;
        return [newReport, ...prev];
      });
      fetchStats();
    };

    const handleReportVoted = (data: ReportVotedPayload) => {
      const targetId = getSocketReportId(data);
      if (!targetId) return;
      setIncidents((prev) =>
        prev.map((item) =>
          item.id === targetId
            ? {
                ...item,
                upvotes: data.upvotes,
                downvotes: data.downvotes,
                status: data.status || item.status,
              }
            : item
        )
      );
    };

    const handleReportResolved = (data: ReportResolvedPayload) => {
      const targetId = getSocketReportId(data);
      if (!targetId) return;
      setIncidents((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== targetId));
      fetchStats();
    };

    const handleReportPurged = (data: ReportPurgedPayload) => {
      const targetId = getSocketReportId(data);
      if (!targetId) return;
      setIncidents((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== targetId));
      fetchStats();
    };

    const handleReportExpired = (data: ReportExpiredPayload) => {
      if (!data.reportIds?.length) return;
      setIncidents((prev) => prev.filter((item) => !data.reportIds.includes(item.id)));
      fetchStats();
    };

    const handleReportVerified = (data: ReportVerifiedPayload) => {
      const targetId = getSocketReportId(data);
      if (!targetId) return;
      const pressTag = `[Verified by Press: ${data.verifiedBy}]`;
      setIncidents((prev) =>
        prev.map((item) => {
          if (item.id !== targetId) return item;
          const currentDesc = item.description || "";
          const nextDesc = currentDesc.includes(pressTag)
            ? currentDesc
            : currentDesc
              ? `${currentDesc}\n\n${pressTag}`
              : pressTag;
          return {
            ...item,
            sourceName: data.verifiedBy,
            sourceUrl: data.sourceUrl ?? item.sourceUrl,
            description: nextDesc,
          };
        })
      );
    };

    socket.on(SOCKET_EVENTS.NEW_REPORT, handleNewReport);
    socket.on(SOCKET_EVENTS.REPORT_VOTED, handleReportVoted);
    socket.on(SOCKET_EVENTS.REPORT_RESOLVED, handleReportResolved);
    socket.on(SOCKET_EVENTS.REPORT_PURGED, handleReportPurged);
    socket.on(SOCKET_EVENTS.REPORT_EXPIRED, handleReportExpired);
    socket.on(SOCKET_EVENTS.REPORT_VERIFIED, handleReportVerified);

    return () => {
      socket.off(SOCKET_EVENTS.NEW_REPORT, handleNewReport);
      socket.off(SOCKET_EVENTS.REPORT_VOTED, handleReportVoted);
      socket.off(SOCKET_EVENTS.REPORT_RESOLVED, handleReportResolved);
      socket.off(SOCKET_EVENTS.REPORT_PURGED, handleReportPurged);
      socket.off(SOCKET_EVENTS.REPORT_EXPIRED, handleReportExpired);
      socket.off(SOCKET_EVENTS.REPORT_VERIFIED, handleReportVerified);
    };
  }, [fetchStats]);

  // Community Voting
  const handleVote = async (reportId: string, voteType: 1 | -1) => {
    if (votingId) return;
    setVotingId(reportId);

    const targetItem = incidents.find((item) => item.id === reportId);
    const previousCounts = targetItem
      ? { upvotes: targetItem.upvotes, downvotes: targetItem.downvotes }
      : null;

    // Optimistic UI update
    setIncidents((prev) =>
      prev.map((item) => {
        if (item.id === reportId) {
          return {
            ...item,
            upvotes: voteType === 1 ? item.upvotes + 1 : item.upvotes,
            downvotes: voteType === -1 ? item.downvotes + 1 : item.downvotes,
          };
        }
        return item;
      })
    );

    try {
      const updated = await apiFetch<any>(`/reports/${reportId}/vote`, {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({ voteType }),
      });

      if (updated?.status === "PURGED") {
        setIncidents((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== reportId));
      } else if (updated && typeof updated.upvotes === "number") {
        setIncidents((prev) =>
          prev.map((item) =>
            item.id === reportId
              ? { ...item, upvotes: updated.upvotes, downvotes: updated.downvotes }
              : item
          )
        );
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (previousCounts) {
        setIncidents((prev) =>
          prev.map((item) =>
            item.id === reportId
              ? {
                  ...item,
                  upvotes: previousCounts.upvotes,
                  downvotes: previousCounts.downvotes,
                }
              : item
          )
        );
      }
      showToast(err.message || (isBn ? "ভোট সম্পন্ন করা যায়নি" : "Failed to record vote."), "error");
      fetchIncidents();
    } finally {
      setVotingId(null);
    }
  };

  // Fetch comments / updates for an incident
  const toggleComments = async (reportId: string) => {
    if (expandedCommentsId === reportId) {

    }

    setExpandedCommentsId(reportId);
    if (!commentsMap[reportId]) {
      setLoadingCommentsId(reportId);

        setCommentsMap((prev) => ({ ...prev, [reportId]: data || [] }));
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn("[FeedPage] Failed to fetch updates:", err);

        method: "POST",

    } finally {
      setSubmittingCommentId(null);

  const handleShare = (incident: Incident) => {
    const shareUrl = `${typeof window !== "undefined" ? window.location.origin : ""}/reports/${incident.id}`;
    if (navigator.clipboard) {

      const matchesCategory = item.category.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const matchesDescription = item.description && item.description.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const matchesSource = item.sourceName && item.sourceName.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const matchesLocation = extractLocationName(item).toLowerCase().includes(q);
      return matchesCategory || matchesDescription || matchesSource || matchesLocation;
    });

    if (sortBy === "NEWEST") {
      result = result.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime());
    } else if (sortBy === "MOST_UPVOTED") {

    } else if (sortBy === "SEVERITY_HIGH") {
      const score = (s: string) => (s === "HIGH" ? 3 : s === "MEDIUM" ? 2 : 1);

                    {/* Location & Cryptographic Fuzzed Coordinates */}
                    <div className="p-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 border border-slate-100 space-y-1 text-xs">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-slate-800 font-semibold truncate">
                        <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-red-600 shrink-0" />
                        <span className="truncate">{locationStr}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-500">
                        <span>
                          {incident.latitude.toFixed(4)}°N, {incident.longitude.toFixed(4)}°E
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-emerald-700 font-semibold bg-emerald-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-emerald-200">
                          {incident.fuzzedRadiusMeters || 150}m fuzzed
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Verified Press Article Badge (if crawled or linked) */}
                    {incident.sourceUrl && (
                      <div className="px-3 py-2 bg-blue-50/80 border border-blue-200 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-blue-900">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 truncate">
                          <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 shrink-0" />
                          <span className="truncate font-semibold">
                            {isBn ? "সংবাদ সূত্রে যাচাইকৃত:" : "Verified Source:"}{" "}
                            {incident.sourceName || "Press Wire"}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <a
                          href={incident.sourceUrl}
                          target="_blank"
                          rel="noreferrer"
                          className="text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800 shrink-0 ml-1 p-1"
                          title="Open Press Article"
                        >
                          <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </a>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* Card Bottom: Voting, Field Updates Drawer, and War Room CTA */}
                  <div className="mt-4 pt-3.5 border-t border-slate-100 space-y-2.5">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                      {/* Upvote & Downvote */}
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleVote(incident.id, 1)}
                          disabled={votingId === incident.id}
                          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 text-xs font-bold border border-emerald-200 transition active:scale-95"
                          title={isBn ? "সত্যতা সমর্থন (Upvote)" : "Confirm hazard presence"}
                        >
                          <ThumbsUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                          <span>{incident.upvotes}</span>
                        </button>

                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleVote(incident.id, -1)}
                          disabled={votingId === incident.id}
                          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 text-xs font-bold border border-rose-200 transition active:scale-95"
                          title={isBn ? "ভুয়া বা সমাধানকৃত (Downvote)" : "Dispute as false or resolved"}
                        >
                          <ThumbsDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-600" />
                          <span>{incident.downvotes}</span>
                        </button>

                        {/* Inline Comments Accordion Toggle */}
                        <button
                          onClick={() => toggleComments(incident.id)}
                          className={`p-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold border transition active:scale-95 ${
                            isCommentsOpen
                              ? "bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-600"
                              : "bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-200"
                          }`}
                          title={isBn ? "মন্তব্য ও আপডেট দেখুন" : "View context updates"}
                        >
                          <MessageSquare className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>

                        {/* Share link button */}
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleShare(incident)}
                          className="p-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border border-slate-200 transition active:scale-95"
                          title={copiedId === incident.id ? "Link Copied!" : "Copy War Room Link"}
                        >
                          {copiedId === incident.id ? (
                            <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                          ) : (
                            <Share2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          )}
                        </button>
                      </div>

                      {/* War Room Deep Dive CTA */}
                      <Link
                        href={`/reports/${incident.id}`}
                        className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 shadow-sm transition active:scale-95"
                      >
                        <span>{isBn ? "ওয়ার রুম" : "War Room"}</span>
                        <ArrowUpRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </Link>
                    </div>

                    {/* Expandable Context Updates / Comments Feed */}
                    {isCommentsOpen && (
                      <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 space-y-2 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
                        <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 block">
                          {isBn ? "ফিল্ড আপডেট ও মন্তব্য:" : "Citizen Field Updates:"}
                        </span>

                        {loadingCommentsId === incident.id ? (
                          <div className="py-2 text-center text-xs text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
                            <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin text-blue-600" />
                            <span>{isBn ? "আপডেট লোড হচ্ছে..." : "Loading updates..."}</span>
                          </div>
                        ) : comments.length === 0 ? (
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 italic">
                            {isBn ? "এখনো কোনো আপডেট নেই। প্রথম আপডেট জানান।" : "No field updates yet. Be the first to report situation."}
                          </p>
                        ) : (
                          <div className="max-h-32 overflow-y-auto space-y-1.5 pr-1 scrollbar-none">
                            {comments.map((c) => (
                              <div
                                key={c.id}
                                className="bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200/70 rounded-xl p-2 text-xs space-y-0.5"
                              >
                                <p className="text-slate-800 leading-snug">{c.content}</p>
                                <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 font-mono block">
                                  {formatRelativeTime(c.createdAt, language as any)}
                                </span>
                              </div>
                            ))}
                          </div>
                        )}

                        {/* Inline Update Input */}
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 pt-1">
                          <input
                            type="text"
                            placeholder={isBn ? "পরিস্থিতির আপডেট লিখুন..." : "Post live situation update..."}
                            value={commentInputText}
                            onChange={(e) => setCommentInputText(e.target.value)}
                            onKeyDown={(e) => {
                              if (e.key === "Enter") {
                                handlePostComment(incident.id);
                              }
                            }}
                            className="flex-1 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:bg-white focus:border-blue-500"
                          />
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handlePostComment(incident.id)}
                            disabled={!commentInputText.trim() || submittingCommentId === incident.id}
                            className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white disabled:opacity-50 transition active:scale-95"
                          >
                            <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </article>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## [File 137] `apps/web/app/profile/page.tsx`
> **Path:** `apps/web/app/profile/page.tsx`  
> **Lines of Code:** 753  
> **Language:** `tsx`

### What This Code Does
This page displays the user's current identity profile, community trust score, and reporting history.
It allows anonymous users to reset their device identity or submit NID and mobile phone verification.
Approved verifications upgrade user trust, allowing their reports to gain faster community confirmation.

```tsx
"use client";

import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import Navbar from "@/components/layout/Navbar";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/store/useAuthStore";
import { useLanguageStore } from "@/store/useLanguageStore";
import { showToast } from "@/store/useToastStore";
import { BD_MOBILE_REGEX } from "@repo/shared";
import {
  UserCheck,
  Shield,
  Award,
  Smartphone,
  FileCheck,
  RefreshCw,
  LogOut,
  User,
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle2,
  Lock,
  ArrowRight,
  PhoneCall,
  Copy,
  Check,
  Fingerprint,
  Activity,
  Bell,
  ThumbsUp,
  MapPin,
  Sparkles,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronUp,
  KeyRound,
  ShieldAlert,
  Info,
  Clock,
  BadgeCheck,
  FileText,
  Scale,
} from "lucide-react";

export default function ProfilePage() {
  const { user, deviceId, initAuth, resetAnonymousIdentity, refreshProfile } = useAuthStore();
  const { language } = useLanguageStore();
  const isBn = language === "bn";

  // Verification Form State
  const [verifyType, setVerifyType] = useState<"PHONE_OTP" | "NID_DOCUMENT">("PHONE_OTP");
  const [phoneNumber, setPhoneNumber] = useState("");
  const [documentUrl, setDocumentUrl] = useState("");
  const [isSubmittingVerify, setIsSubmittingVerify] = useState(false);
  const [verifySuccess, setVerifySuccess] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [verifyError, setVerifyError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Copy Feedback
  const [copiedField, setCopiedField] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Identity Switcher (Developer Drawer)
  const [isSwitching, setIsSwitching] = useState(false);
  const [showDevSandbox, setShowDevSandbox] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    initAuth();
  }, [initAuth]);

  const copyToClipboard = (text: string, fieldName: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedField(fieldName);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedField(null), 2000);
  };

  const handleSubmitVerification = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setVerifySuccess(null);
    setVerifyError(null);

    const trimmedPhone = phoneNumber.trim();
    const trimmedDocUrl = documentUrl.trim();

    if (verifyType === "PHONE_OTP") {
      if (!BD_MOBILE_REGEX.test(trimmedPhone)) {
        setVerifyError(
          isBn
            ? "অনুগ্রহ করে একটি সঠিক বাংলাদেশি মোবাইল নম্বর দিন (+8801XXXXXXXXX বা 01XXXXXXXXX)।"
            : "Please enter a valid Bangladeshi mobile number (+8801XXXXXXXXX or 01XXXXXXXXX)."
        );
        return;
      }
    } else {
      try {
        const parsed = new URL(trimmedDocUrl);
        if (parsed.protocol !== "http:" && parsed.protocol !== "https:") {
          throw new Error("Invalid protocol");
        }
      } catch {
        setVerifyError(
          isBn
            ? "অনুগ্রহ করে একটি বৈধ নথির লিংক (URL) প্রদান করুন।"
            : "Please provide a valid document evidence URL (https://...)."
        );
        return;
      }
    }

    setIsSubmittingVerify(true);

    try {
      const res = await apiFetch<any>("/users/verify", {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({
          type: verifyType,
          phoneNumber: verifyType === "PHONE_OTP" ? trimmedPhone : undefined,
          documentUrl: verifyType === "NID_DOCUMENT" ? trimmedDocUrl : undefined,
        }),
      });

      setPhoneNumber("");
      setDocumentUrl("");
      setVerifySuccess(
        isBn
          ? `ভেরিফিকেশন অনুরোধ (${res.type}) জমা হয়েছে! অবস্থা: ${res.status}। একজন অ্যাডমিনিস্ট্রেটর অ্যাডমিন প্যানেল থেকে এটি অনুমোদন করতে পারবেন।`
          : `Verification request (${res.type}) successfully submitted! Status: ${res.status}. An administrator can now review and approve this in the Admin Portal.`
      );
      await refreshProfile();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setVerifyError(err.message || (isBn ? "ভেরিফিকেশন সাবমিট করতে ব্যর্থ হয়েছে" : "Failed to submit verification request"));
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingVerify(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSwitchIdentity = async (anonId: string) => {
    setIsSwitching(true);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem("bd_safety_device_id", anonId);
      await apiFetch("/auth/device", {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({ anonymousId: anonId }),
      });
      const switchedUser = await initAuth();
      showToast(
        isBn
          ? `সেশন সফলভাবে পরিবর্তন করা হয়েছে: ${switchedUser?.email || anonId}`

        "success"
      );

      showToast(`Identity switch failed: ${err.message}`, "error");
    } finally {
      setIsSwitching(false);

  };

        : "New anonymous device identity generated.",
      "success"
    );
  };

  // Derive verification status from latest user verification relation
  const latestVerification = user?.verifications?.[0];
  const isPendingVerification = latestVerification?.status === "PENDING";

  // Trust score coloring
  const trustScore = user?.trustScore ?? 0;
  const trustColorClass =
    trustScore >= 75
      ? "text-emerald-600 bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200"
      : trustScore >= 50
      ? "text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 border-blue-200"
      : "text-slate-600 bg-slate-100 border-slate-200";

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-slate-50 text-slate-900 selection:bg-blue-500 selection:text-white">
      {/* Single Unified Navbar with integrated EN/বাংলা toggle */}
      <Navbar />

      <main className="flex-1 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 py-6 sm:py-8 space-y-6">

        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">

              <UserCheck className="w-6 h-6" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
                {isBn

                  : "Citizen Identity, Trust Score & KYC Verification"}
              </h1>
              <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-600 font-medium mt-0.5">
                {isBn
                  ? "হার্ডওয়্যার-বাউন্ড সেশন শনাক্তকরণ, কমিউনিটি রেপুটেশন মেকানিক্স ও রেসপন্ডার ভেরিফিকেশন পোর্টাল।"
                  : "Cryptographic hardware session bindings, community trust mechanics, and verified responder elevation."}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              onClick={() => refreshProfile()}
              className="px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 rounded-xl shadow-2xs flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />

                        </>

                        <>
                          <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />
                          <span>{isBn ? "কপি" : "Copy"}</span>
                        </>

                  </div>
                  <div className="p-2.5 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-700 truncate select-all">

                          <span className="text-emerald-600">{isBn ? "কপি হয়েছে" : "Copied"}</span>

                          <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />
                          <span>{isBn ? "কপি" : "Copy"}</span>

                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Reset Device Identity Button */}
              <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">

                >

                <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />

                <ArrowRight className="w-3 h-3" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-6">

                        : "Citizen KYC Verification & Responder Elevation"}
                    </h2>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 font-medium">
                      {isBn
                        ? "পোস্টজিআইএস ডেটাবেজে বিশ্বস্ত রেসপন্ডার হিসেবে নিজেকে প্রমাণ করুন"
                        : "Elevate to Verified Responder to unlock real-time priority threat dispatch"}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                  <span className="text-xs bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-full border border-emerald-300 flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-2xs shrink-0">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
                    <span>{isBn ? "যাচাইকৃত রেসপন্ডার" : "Verified Responder"}</span>
                  </span>

              {/* Verified Responder Privileges Card */}
              {user?.role === "VERIFIED_RESPONDER" ? (
                <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-50/70 border border-emerald-200 rounded-2xl text-emerald-900 space-y-3">

                  </div>
                  <ul className="text-xs text-emerald-800 space-y-1.5 list-disc list-inside">
                    <li>
                      {isBn

                        : "Incident submissions carry maximum trust weight and display a verified badge."}
                    </li>
                    <li>
                      {isBn
                        ? "লাইভ ফিডে আপনার প্রদান করা যেকোনো আপডেট অন্যান্য নাগরিকের শীর্ষে প্রদর্শিত হয়।"
                        : "Context updates and route clearances appear pinned at the top of the incident stream."}

                        : "Recognized as a verified local emergency contact for rapid community response."}

                    <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">

                    </h3>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-amber-800 leading-relaxed">

                      : "Your verification request has been queued. An administrator will review your credentials in the moderation portal to elevate your trust status."}
                  </p>

                    <Link

                      <span>{isBn ? "অ্যাডমিন পোর্টালে গিয়ে অনুমোদন করুন" : "Review pending submissions in Admin Console"}</span>
                      <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />

                  <p className="text-xs text-blue-800 leading-relaxed">

              {/* KYC Verification Form */}

                    </label>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                      <button
                        type="button"

                          verifyType === "PHONE_OTP"
                            ? "bg-blue-50 border-blue-600 text-blue-700 ring-2 ring-blue-600/20 shadow-xs"
                            : "bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100"

                      >
                        <Smartphone className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />

                      </button>

                            ? "bg-blue-50 border-blue-600 text-blue-700 ring-2 ring-blue-600/20 shadow-xs"
                            : "bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100"
                        }`}
                      >
                        <FileCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
                        <span>{isBn ? "জাতীয় স্মার্ট আইডি কার্ড" : "Smart NID Document"}</span>
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Input Fields */}
                  {verifyType === "PHONE_OTP" ? (

                      <input

                      />
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-1">
                        {isBn
                          ? "গ্রামীণফোন, রবি, বাংলালিংক বা টেলিটক নম্বরে নিশ্চিতকরণ এসএমএস ওটিপি প্রেরিত হবে।"

                      </p>
                    </div>
                  ) : (

                      </label>
                      <input

                      />
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-1">

                    {isSubmittingVerify ? (

                      </>
                    )}
                  </button>
                </form>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Developer & QA Persona Switcher Tray (Collapsible, dev-only) */}
            {process.env.NODE_ENV === "development" && (
            <div className="bg-slate-100/80 border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xs">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowDevSandbox(!showDevSandbox)}

              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Lock className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-600" />
                  <span>
                    {isBn
                      ? "ডেভেলপার স্যান্ডবক্স ও পারসোনা সুইচিং"

                  </span>

                {showDevSandbox ? (
                  <ChevronUp className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />

                  <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />

              </button>

              {showDevSandbox && (
                <div className="p-5 border-t border-slate-200 bg-white space-y-3">
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 leading-normal">
```
