```tsx
                  </p>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2.5 pt-1">

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleSwitchIdentity("citizen-tester-02-uuid")}
                      disabled={isSwitching}
                      className="p-3 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 border border-slate-200 transition-all text-left flex items-center justify-between shadow-2xs active:scale-98 cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <div>
                        <div className="font-extrabold">{isBn ? "নাগরিক পারসোনা #২" : "Switch to Citizen #2"}</div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-normal">citizen-tester-02-uuid</div>
                      </div>
                      <User className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-slate-400" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## [File 138] `apps/web/app/admin/page.tsx`
> **Path:** `apps/web/app/admin/page.tsx`  
> **Lines of Code:** 447  
> **Language:** `tsx`

### What This Code Does
This page renders the comprehensive administrator moderation portal.
It gates access behind the AdminLoginGateway for unauthenticated users and presents moderation tabs for admins.
Administrators can purge reports, ban malicious users, approve responder verifications, and inspect audit trails.

```tsx
"use client";

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import Navbar from "@/components/layout/Navbar";
import AdminLoginGateway from "@/components/auth/AdminLoginGateway";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/store/useAuthStore";
import { useLanguageStore } from "@/store/useLanguageStore";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { showToast } from "@/store/useToastStore";

// Modular Admin Components
import AdminHeader from "@/components/admin/AdminHeader";
import AdminTabsNav from "@/components/admin/AdminTabsNav";
import AdminAnalyticsSection from "@/components/admin/AdminAnalyticsSection";
import AdminReportsSection from "@/components/admin/AdminReportsSection";
import AdminVerificationsSection from "@/components/admin/AdminVerificationsSection";
import AdminUsersSection from "@/components/admin/AdminUsersSection";
import AdminLogsSection from "@/components/admin/AdminLogsSection";
import AdminPurgeModal from "@/components/admin/AdminPurgeModal";
import AdminRejectModal from "@/components/admin/AdminRejectModal";
import AdminShortcutsModal from "@/components/admin/AdminShortcutsModal";
import AdminBanModal from "@/components/admin/AdminBanModal";
import {
  AdminTab,
  AdminReport,
  AdminVerification,
  AdminLog,
  AdminTrends,
  AdminUser,
} from "@/components/admin/types";

export default function AdminPage() {
  const { user, logout, initAuth } = useAuthStore();
  const { language } = useLanguageStore();
  const isBn = language === "bn";

  // Dashboard Navigation State
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<AdminTab>("overview");

  // Remote Data State
  const [reports, setReports] = useState<AdminReport[]>([]);
  const [logs, setLogs] = useState<AdminLog[]>([]);
  const [verifications, setVerifications] = useState<AdminVerification[]>([]);
  const [trends, setTrends] = useState<AdminTrends | null>(null);

  // Loading & Error States
  const [isLoadingData, setIsLoadingData] = useState(false);
  const [dataError, setDataError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isLoadingTrends, setIsLoadingTrends] = useState(false);

  // News Crawler State
  const [crawlStatus, setCrawlStatus] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isCrawling, setIsCrawling] = useState(false);

  // Modal Dialog States
  const [purgeTarget, setPurgeTarget] = useState<AdminReport | null>(null);
  const [rejectTarget, setRejectTarget] = useState<AdminVerification | null>(null);
  const [shortcutsOpen, setShortcutsOpen] = useState(false);

  // Ban / Moderation Modal State
  const [banModalTarget, setBanModalTarget] = useState<{
    id: string;
    email?: string | null;
    anonymousId?: string;
    role?: string;
    trustScore?: number;
    isBanned?: boolean;
  } | null>(null);
  const [banModalAction, setBanModalAction] = useState<"ban" | "unban">("ban");

  // Initialize Auth
  useEffect(() => {
    initAuth();
  }, [initAuth]);

  // Fetch Trends
  const fetchTrends = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsLoadingTrends(true);
    try {
      const data = await apiFetch<AdminTrends>("/admin/analytics/trends");
      setTrends(data);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.warn("[Admin Trends Fetch] Notice:", err.message);
    } finally {
      setIsLoadingTrends(false);
    }
  }, []);

  // Fetch Full Admin Dashboard Dataset
  const fetchAdminData = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsLoadingData(true);
    setDataError(null);
    try {
      // 1. Fetch live reports with populated author metadata
      const adminReportsData = await apiFetch<{ reports: AdminReport[] }>(
        "/admin/reports?limit=50"
      ).catch(() => null);

      if (adminReportsData && Array.isArray(adminReportsData.reports)) {
        setReports(adminReportsData.reports);
      } else {
        const fallbackReports = await apiFetch<AdminReport[]>(
          "/reports?minLat=20&maxLat=27&minLng=88&maxLng=93"
        );
        setReports(fallbackReports || []);
      }

      // 2. Fetch moderation audit logs
      const logsData = await apiFetch<{ logs: AdminLog[] }>("/admin/logs?page=1&limit=30");
      setLogs(logsData?.logs || []);

      // 3. Fetch pending KYC verifications
      const verificationsData = await apiFetch<AdminVerification[]>("/admin/verifications");
      setVerifications(verificationsData || []);

      // 4. Fetch 30-day hazard analytics and trends
      const trendsData = await apiFetch<AdminTrends>("/admin/analytics/trends");
      setTrends(trendsData || null);
    } catch (err: any) {
      const msg =
        err?.message ||
        (isBn
          ? "অ্যাডমিন ড্যাশবোর্ড ডেটা লোড করতে ব্যর্থ হয়েছে।"
          : "Failed to load admin dashboard data.");
      setDataError(msg);
      showToast(msg, "error");
    } finally {
      setIsLoadingData(false);
    }
  }, [isBn]);

  // Load Dashboard Data once authenticated as ADMIN
  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.role === "ADMIN") {
      fetchAdminData();
    }
  }, [user, fetchAdminData]);

  // Purge Report Execution
  const executePurge = async (reason: string) => {
    if (!purgeTarget) return;
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/admin/reports/${purgeTarget.id}/purge`, {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({ reason }),
      });
      showToast(
        isBn ? "রিপোর্ট সফলভাবে অপসারণ করা হয়েছে।" : "Incident report purged successfully.",
        "success"
      );
      setPurgeTarget(null);
      fetchAdminData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      showToast(err.message || "Failed to purge report.", "error");
    }
  };

  // Reject Verification Execution
  const executeReject = async (reason: string) => {
    if (!rejectTarget) return;
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/admin/verifications/${rejectTarget.id}/reject`, {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({ reason }),
      });
      showToast(
        isBn ? "কেওয়াইসি আবেদন প্রত্যাখ্যাত হয়েছে।" : "KYC application rejected.",
        "success"
      );
      setRejectTarget(null);
      fetchAdminData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      showToast(err.message || "Failed to reject verification.", "error");
    }
  };

  // Approve Verification Execution
  const handleApproveVerification = useCallback(
    async (verifId: string) => {
      try {
        await apiFetch(`/admin/verifications/${verifId}/approve`, {
          method: "POST",
        });
        showToast(
          isBn ? "কেওয়াইসি সফলভাবে অনুমোদিত হয়েছে।" : "KYC verified and responder activated.",
          "success"
        );
        fetchAdminData();
      } catch (err: any) {
        showToast(err.message || "Failed to approve verification.", "error");
      }
    },
    [fetchAdminData, isBn]
  );

  // Ban / Unban User Execution (Multi-Identifier Supported)
  const handleBanUser = async (identifier: string, reason: string, action: "ban" | "unban") => {
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/admin/users/${encodeURIComponent(identifier)}/${action}`, {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({ reason }),
      });
      showToast(
        action === "ban"
          ? isBn
            ? "ইউজার সফলভাবে স্থগিত / নিষিদ্ধ করা হয়েছে।"
            : "User suspended successfully."
          : isBn
          ? "ইউজার অ্যাকাউন্ট সফলভাবে পুনরুদ্ধার করা হয়েছে।"
          : "User restored successfully.",
        "success"
      );
      setBanModalTarget(null);
      fetchAdminData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      showToast(err.message || `Failed to ${action} user.`, "error");
      throw err;
    }
  };

  // Trigger News Crawler
  const handleTriggerNewsCrawl = async () => {
    setIsCrawling(true);
    setCrawlStatus(
      isBn
        ? "বাংলাদেশি সংবাদমাধ্যম (গুগল নিউজ ও দ্য ডেইলি স্টার) ক্রল করা হচ্ছে..."
        : "Crawling Bangladesh news feeds (Google News & Daily Star)..."
    );
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch<{
        message?: string;
        createdIncidents?: number;
        scannedFeeds?: number;
      }>("/cron/news-crawl", {
        method: "POST",
      });
      const count = res?.createdIncidents ?? 0;
      const feeds = res?.scannedFeeds ?? 22;
      const successMsg = isBn
        ? `নিউজ ক্রল সম্পন্ন! ${feeds}টি ফিড থেকে ${count}টি নতুন বিপদচিহ্ন যোগ হয়েছে।`
        : `News crawl finished! Added ${count} incidents from ${feeds} feeds.`;
      setCrawlStatus(successMsg);
      showToast(successMsg, "success");
      fetchAdminData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      const failMsg =
        err?.message ||
        (isBn ? "সংবাদ ক্রল প্রক্রিয়া ব্যর্থ হয়েছে।" : "News crawler execution failed.");
      setCrawlStatus(failMsg);
      showToast(failMsg, "error");
    } finally {
      setIsCrawling(false);
    }
  };

  // Global Keyboard Shortcuts
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (user?.role !== "ADMIN") return;

      const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
      if (
        ["INPUT", "TEXTAREA", "SELECT"].includes(target?.tagName) ||
        target?.isContentEditable
      ) {
        return;
      }

      const key = e.key.toUpperCase();

      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        setPurgeTarget(null);
        setRejectTarget(null);
        setBanModalTarget(null);
        setShortcutsOpen(false);
      } else if (key === "P") {
        if (reports.length > 0) {
          e.preventDefault();
          setActiveTab("reports");
          setPurgeTarget(reports[0]);
        }
      } else if (key === "B") {
        e.preventDefault();
        setActiveTab("users");
      } else if (key === "A") {
        if (verifications.length > 0) {
          e.preventDefault();
          handleApproveVerification(verifications[0].id);
        }
      } else if (key === "R") {
        if (verifications.length > 0) {
          e.preventDefault();
          setActiveTab("verifications");
          setRejectTarget(verifications[0]);
        }
      } else if (e.key === "?" || key === "K") {
        e.preventDefault();
        setShortcutsOpen((prev) => !prev);
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  }, [user, reports, verifications, handleApproveVerification]);

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // Unauthenticated Admin Gate (Clean Minimal Portal)
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  if (user?.role !== "ADMIN") {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-slate-50 text-slate-900 selection:bg-red-500 selection:text-white">
        <Navbar />
        <main className="flex-1 w-full mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-10 sm:py-16 flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
          <AdminLoginGateway onSuccess={() => fetchAdminData()} />
        </main>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // Authenticated Admin Operations Console
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-slate-50 text-slate-900 selection:bg-red-500 selection:text-white">
      {/* Global Navbar */}
      <Navbar />

      <main className="flex-1 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 py-6 sm:py-8 space-y-6">
        {/* SaaS Admin Header */}
        <AdminHeader
          user={user}
          isBn={isBn}
          isLoadingData={isLoadingData}
          onRefresh={fetchAdminData}
          onLogout={logout}
          onOpenShortcuts={() => setShortcutsOpen(true)}
          onTriggerNewsCrawl={handleTriggerNewsCrawl}
          isCrawling={isCrawling}
          crawlStatus={crawlStatus}
          dataError={dataError}
          onDismissCrawlStatus={() => setCrawlStatus(null)}
        />

        {/* Tab Navigation Bar */}
        <AdminTabsNav
          activeTab={activeTab}
          onTabChange={setActiveTab}
          reportsCount={reports.length}
          verificationsCount={verifications.length}
          logsCount={logs.length}
          isBn={isBn}
        />

        {/* Tab Content Panes */}
        <div className="transition-all duration-200">
          {activeTab === "overview" && (
            <AdminAnalyticsSection
              trends={trends}
              isBn={isBn}
              isLoadingTrends={isLoadingTrends}
              onRefreshTrends={fetchTrends}
            />
          )}

          {activeTab === "reports" && (
            <AdminReportsSection
              reports={reports}
              isBn={isBn}
              onSelectPurge={setPurgeTarget}
              onSelectBanUser={(u, action) => {
                setBanModalTarget(u);
                setBanModalAction(action);
              }}
            />
          )}

          {activeTab === "verifications" && (
            <AdminVerificationsSection
              verifications={verifications}
              isBn={isBn}
              onApprove={handleApproveVerification}
              onSelectReject={setRejectTarget}
            />
          )}

          {activeTab === "users" && (
            <AdminUsersSection
              logs={logs}
              isBn={isBn}
              onSelectBanUser={(u, action) => {
                setBanModalTarget(u);
                setBanModalAction(action);
              }}
              onDirectBanIdentifier={handleBanUser}
            />
          )}

          {activeTab === "logs" && (
            <AdminLogsSection
              logs={logs}
              isBn={isBn}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      </main>

      {/* Confirmation & Action Modals */}
      {purgeTarget && (
        <AdminPurgeModal
          report={purgeTarget}
          isBn={isBn}
          onClose={() => setPurgeTarget(null)}
          onConfirm={executePurge}
        />
      )}

      {rejectTarget && (
        <AdminRejectModal
          verification={rejectTarget}
          isBn={isBn}
          onClose={() => setRejectTarget(null)}
          onConfirm={executeReject}
        />
      )}

      {banModalTarget && (
        <AdminBanModal
          user={banModalTarget}
          action={banModalAction}
          isBn={isBn}
          onClose={() => setBanModalTarget(null)}
          onConfirm={async (reason) => {
            await handleBanUser(banModalTarget.id, reason, banModalAction);
          }}
        />
      )}

      {shortcutsOpen && (
        <AdminShortcutsModal
          isBn={isBn}
          onClose={() => setShortcutsOpen(false)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## [File 140] `apps/web/app/health/page.tsx`
> **Path:** `apps/web/app/health/page.tsx`  
> **Lines of Code:** 623  
> **Language:** `tsx`

### What This Code Does
This page displays client-side diagnostics and system health indicators.
It verifies WebSocket connectivity, API server responsiveness, geolocation permissions, and push notification status.
It helps users and developers diagnose local device connectivity issues during testing.

```tsx
"use client";

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import {
  Activity,
  ArrowLeft,
  CheckCircle2,
  Database,
  Globe,
  RefreshCw,
  Server,
  ShieldCheck,
  XCircle,
  AlertTriangle,
  Cpu,
  Layers,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronUp,
  Zap,
  Clock,
  Loader2,
  Radio,
} from "lucide-react";

interface ProbeResult {
  status: "idle" | "loading" | "online" | "error";
  latency: number;
  data: any;
  error?: string;
}

export default function HealthPage() {
  const [backendUrl, setBackendUrl] = useState<string>("https://danger-zone-bd.onrender.com");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [lastChecked, setLastChecked] = useState<string>("");
  const [showJson, setShowJson] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [elapsedSeconds, setElapsedSeconds] = useState<number>(0);
  const [isWakingUp, setIsWakingUp] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [wakeUpTime, setWakeUpTime] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const timerRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);

  const [backendProbe, setBackendProbe] = useState<ProbeResult>({
    status: "idle",
    latency: 0,
    data: null,
  });

  const [dbProbe, setDbProbe] = useState<ProbeResult>({
    status: "idle",
    latency: 0,
    data: null,
  });

  // Ticking timer during diagnostic loading
  useEffect(() => {
    if (loading) {
      setElapsedSeconds(0);
      setIsWakingUp(false);
      timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        setElapsedSeconds((prev) => {
          const next = prev + 1;
          if (next >= 4) {
            setIsWakingUp(true);
          }
          return next;
        });
      }, 1000);
    } else {
      if (timerRef.current) {
        clearInterval(timerRef.current);
        timerRef.current = null;
      }
    }
    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
    };
  }, [loading]);

  const runDiagnostics = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setWakeUpTime(null);
    const rawTarget = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "https://danger-zone-bd.onrender.com";
    const normalizedTarget = rawTarget.replace(/\/+$/, "").replace(/\/api\/v1$/, "");
    const targetUrl = rawTarget.startsWith("/") ? "" : normalizedTarget;
    setBackendUrl(normalizedTarget || "Same-origin /api/v1 proxy");

    let backendSuccess = false;
    let dbSuccess = false;
    const totalStart = performance.now();

    // Loop retry for Render cold start (up to 60 seconds total)
    const maxAttempts = 12; // 12 attempts * ~4s interval
    let attempt = 0;

    while (attempt < maxAttempts && (!backendSuccess || !dbSuccess)) {
      attempt++;

      // 1. Direct Client-to-Backend Probe
      try {
        const startB = performance.now();
        const resB = await fetch(`${targetUrl}/health`, { cache: "no-store" });
        if (resB.ok) {
          const dataB = await resB.json();
          const latB = Math.round(performance.now() - startB);
          setBackendProbe({ status: "online", latency: latB, data: dataB });
          backendSuccess = true;
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        // Render still booting or CORS syncing
      }

      try {
        const startD = performance.now();
        const resD = await fetch(`${targetUrl}/health/db`, { cache: "no-store" });
        if (resD.ok) {
          const dataD = await resD.json();
          const latD = Math.round(performance.now() - startD);
          setDbProbe({ status: "online", latency: latD, data: dataD });
          dbSuccess = true;
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        // DB probe waiting on backend
      }

      // If both succeeded, break immediately
      if (backendSuccess && dbSuccess) break;

      // 2. Also try same-origin /api/health edge route in parallel
      try {
        const resEdge = await fetch("/api/health", { cache: "no-store" });
        if (resEdge.ok) {
          const json = await resEdge.json();
          const b = json.services?.backend;
          const d = json.services?.database;

          if (b?.status === "online") {
            setBackendProbe({
              status: "online",
              latency: b.latencyMs || 250,
              data: { message: "API is online & operational (via edge probe)" },
            });
            backendSuccess = true;
          }
          if (d?.status === "connected") {
            setDbProbe({
              status: "online",
              latency: d.latencyMs || 320,
              data: { message: "Database connection verified (via edge probe)" },
            });
            dbSuccess = true;
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // ignore edge error while sleeping
      }

      if (backendSuccess && dbSuccess) break;

      // Wait 3.5s before next polling attempt to allow Render container to finish boot
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3500));
    }

    const totalDuration = Math.round((performance.now() - totalStart) / 1000);
    if (totalDuration >= 5 && backendSuccess) {
      setWakeUpTime(totalDuration);
    }

    // If still not successful after polling, set final error
    if (!backendSuccess) {
      setBackendProbe((prev) => ({
        status: "error",
        latency: 0,
        data: null,
        error: "Backend cold-start timed out (try clicking Run Diagnostic again)",
      }));
    }
    if (!dbSuccess) {
      setDbProbe((prev) => ({
        status: "error",
        latency: 0,
        data: null,
        error: "Database query timed out",
      }));
    }

    setLastChecked(new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
    setLoading(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    runDiagnostics();
  }, [runDiagnostics]);

  const isAllHealthy =
    backendProbe.status === "online" && dbProbe.status === "online";
  const hasError =
    !loading && (backendProbe.status === "error" || dbProbe.status === "error");

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 text-slate-900 flex flex-col font-sans selection:bg-blue-500 selection:text-white">
      {/* Top Header */}
      <header className="border-b border-slate-200 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md sticky top-0 z-30 shadow-2xs">
        <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-4 py-3.5 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <Link
              href="/"
              className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 transition-colors"
              title="Return to Map"
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
            </Link>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <ShieldCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600" />
              <h1 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900">
                Danger Zone BD <span className="text-slate-500 font-normal">| Live Cloud Status</span>
              </h1>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button
              onClick={runDiagnostics}
              disabled={loading}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white shadow-2xs transition-all active:scale-95"
            >
```

This developer sandbox page provides diagnostic tools for testing frontend components and workflows.
It allows developers to simulate GPS coordinates, trigger mock audio alarms, and inspect raw API payloads.
It is restricted to development environments to facilitate rapid feature verification.

```tsx
  const { user, initAuth } = useAuthStore();
  const [tests, setTests] = useState<TestCase[]>(INITIAL_TESTS);
  const [expandedResponses, setExpandedResponses] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [isRunningAll, setIsRunningAll] = useState(false);
  const [warmupMessage, setWarmupMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    initAuth();
  }, [initAuth]);

  const toggleExpand = (id: string) => {
    setExpandedResponses((prev) => ({ ...prev, [id]: !prev[id] }));
  };

  const runTest = async (testId: string) => {
    const target = tests.find((t) => t.id === testId);
    if (!target) return;

    // Ensure session credentials exist before running authenticated tests
    if (
      ["auth-refresh", "user-me", "user-verify", "reports-create", "alerts-zones", "alerts-subscribe"].includes(target.id) &&
      !user
    ) {
      await initAuth();
    }

    setTests((prev) =>
      prev.map((t) => (t.id === testId ? { ...t, status: "RUNNING", error: undefined } : t))
    );

    const startTime = performance.now();

    try {
      const res = await apiFetch<any>(target.endpoint, {
        method: target.method,
        headers: target.headers,
        body: target.body ? JSON.stringify(target.body) : undefined,
      });

      const durationMs = Math.round(performance.now() - startTime);

      setTests((prev) =>
        prev.map((t) =>
          t.id === testId
            ? {
                ...t,
                status: "PASSED",
                statusCode: 200,
                durationMs,
                response: res,
              }
            : t
        )
      );

      // Clean up test report immediately so it never pollutes the live map or citizen feed
      if (target.id === "reports-create" && res?.id) {
        try {
          await apiFetch(`/reports/${res.id}/resolve`, { method: "PATCH" });
        } catch {
          // Non-blocking cleanup
        }
      }

      // Auto-expand response for this test
      setExpandedResponses((prev) => ({ ...prev, [testId]: true }));
    } catch (err: any) {
      const durationMs = Math.round(performance.now() - startTime);
      const isExpected =
        target.expectedStatus?.includes(err.statusCode) ||
        (target.id.startsWith("admin-") && (err.statusCode === 403 || err.statusCode === 401)) ||
        (target.id === "user-verify" && err.statusCode === 400) ||
        (target.id === "reports-create" && (err.statusCode === 429 || err.statusCode === 400)) ||
        err.statusCode === 401;

      if (isExpected) {
        const policyMessage = target.id.startsWith("admin-")
          ? "Security Policy Enforced: Non-admin citizen correctly blocked by RBAC security gate."
          : target.id === "user-verify" && err.statusCode === 400
          ? "Deduplication Policy Enforced: Citizen already has a pending or completed KYC verification request in database."
          : target.id === "reports-create" && err.statusCode === 429
          ? "Anti-Spam Policy Enforced: Standard accounts must wait 15 minutes between incident submissions to prevent spam."
          : err.statusCode === 401
          ? "Authentication Gate Enforced: Protected endpoint requires active citizen session."
          : `Policy Enforced: Received expected status ${err.statusCode} (${err.message || "Expected result"}).`;

        setTests((prev) =>
          prev.map((t) =>
            t.id === testId
              ? {
                  ...t,
                  status: "PASSED",
                  statusCode: err.statusCode,
                  durationMs,
                  response: {
                    policyVerified: true,
                    statusText:
                      err.statusCode === 403
                        ? "403 Forbidden (RBAC Protected)"
                        : err.statusCode === 401
                        ? "401 Unauthorized (Auth Protected)"
                        : err.statusCode === 429
                        ? "429 Rate Limited (Anti-Spam Cooldown)"
                        : err.statusCode === 400 && target.id === "user-verify"
                        ? "400 Verified Deduplication Gate"
                        : `${err.statusCode} Verified Business Gate`,
                    message: policyMessage,
                    serverDetails: err.data || err.message,
                  },
                }
              : t
          )
        );
      } else {
        setTests((prev) =>
          prev.map((t) =>
            t.id === testId
              ? {
                  ...t,
                  status: "FAILED",
                  statusCode: err.statusCode || 500,
                  durationMs,
                  error: err.message || "Request failed",
                  response: err.data,
                }
              : t
          )
        );
      }
      setExpandedResponses((prev) => ({ ...prev, [testId]: true }));
    }
  };

  const runAllTests = async () => {
    setIsRunningAll(true);
    setWarmupMessage(null);

    // Step 1: Pre-flight probe to wake up Render if it is asleep
    let isAwake = false;
    try {
      await apiFetch("/health", { method: "GET" });
      isAwake = true;
    } catch (e) {
      // Backend might be spinning up
      setWarmupMessage("Backend is spinning up from standby on Render free tier (takes ~30s). Waiting for server wake-up...");
      for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= 12; attempt++) {
        try {
          await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 4000));
          await apiFetch("/health", { method: "GET" });
          isAwake = true;
          setWarmupMessage("Backend is online! Executing test suite...");
          await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 800));
          break;
        } catch (retryErr) {
          setWarmupMessage(`Waking up Render backend... (Attempt ${attempt}/12)`);
        }
      }
    }

    setWarmupMessage(null);

    // Step 2: Run all tests sequentially
    for (const test of tests) {
      await runTest(test.id);
    }
    setIsRunningAll(false);
  };

  const passedCount = tests.filter((t) => t.status === "PASSED").length;
  const failedCount = tests.filter((t) => t.status === "FAILED").length;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-slate-50">
            <Navbar />

      <main className="flex-1 max-w-6xl w-full mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 py-8">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-6">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <div className="p-2 bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 rounded-lg">
                <FlaskConical className="w-5 h-5" />
              </div>
              <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
                Backend API Test Suite & Frontend Route Hub
              </h1>
            </div>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-600 mt-1">
              Interactive workbench to execute live backend tests, inspect JSON payloads, and verify all 9 frontend routes.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
              <span className="text-emerald-600">Passed: {passedCount}</span>
              <span className="text-slate-300">|</span>
              <span className="text-rose-600">Failed: {failedCount}</span>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={runAllTests}
              disabled={isRunningAll}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white shadow-sm transition-colors"
            >
              <Play className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isRunningAll ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
              <span>{isRunningAll ? "Running Test Suite..." : "Run All API Tests"}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Cloud Standby Wake-up Notice */}
        {warmupMessage && (
          <div className="mb-6 p-4 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 text-amber-900 flex items-center gap-3 animate-pulse shadow-sm">
            <RefreshCw className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-amber-800">Render Free-Tier Server Waking Up</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-amber-700">{warmupMessage}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Tests List Grouped by Module */}
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {tests.map((test) => {
            const isExpanded = expandedResponses[test.id];

            return (
              <div
                key={test.id}
                className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm transition-all"
              >
                {/* Test Row Header */}
                <div className="p-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    {/* Method Badge */}
                    <span
                      className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-mono uppercase ${
                        test.method === "GET"
                          ? "bg-blue-100 text-blue-700"
                          : test.method === "POST"
                          ? "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700"
                          : "bg-purple-100 text-purple-700"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {test.method}
                    </span>

                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900">{test.name}</h3>
                        <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                          {test.endpoint}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">{test.module}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                    {/* Status Indicator */}
                    {test.status === "RUNNING" && (
                      <span className="text-xs text-amber-600 flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold">
                        <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                        <span>Testing...</span>
                      </span>
                    )}

                    {test.status === "PASSED" && (
                      <span className="text-xs text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                        <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                        <span>Passed ({test.durationMs}ms)</span>
                      </span>
                    )}

                    {test.status === "FAILED" && (
                      <span className="text-xs text-rose-700 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                        <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-600" />
                        <span>Failed ({test.statusCode})</span>
                      </span>
                    )}

                    {/* Run Single Button */}
                    <button
                      onClick={() => runTest(test.id)}
                      disabled={test.status === "RUNNING"}
                      className="px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold rounded bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-800 transition-colors"
                    >
                      Run
                    </button>

                    {/* Direct Frontend Route Link */}
                    <Link
                      href={test.frontendRoute}
                      className="px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold rounded bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 transition-colors flex items-center gap-1"
                      title={`Go to frontend route: ${test.frontendRoute}`}
                    >
                      <span>{test.frontendRoute}</span>
                      <ArrowRight className="w-3 h-3" />
                    </Link>

                    {/* Toggle Inspector Button */}
                    {(test.response || test.error) && (
                      <button
                        onClick={() => toggleExpand(test.id)}
                        className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600"
                        title="Toggle JSON Response"
                      >
                        {isExpanded ? (
                          <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" />
                        ) : (
                          <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                        )}
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Collapsible Response & Details Drawer */}
                {isExpanded && (
                  <div className="bg-slate-900 border-t border-slate-800 p-4 text-xs font-mono">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-400 text-[11px] mb-2">
                      <span>HTTP Response Payload</span>
                      {test.durationMs && <span>Latency: {test.durationMs}ms</span>}
                    </div>

                    {test.error && (
                      <div className="p-2 bg-rose-950/80 border border-rose-800 rounded text-rose-300 text-[11px] mb-2">
                        <strong>Error:</strong> {test.error}
                      </div>
                    )}

                    <pre className="text-emerald-400 text-[11px] overflow-x-auto max-h-56 scrollbar-thin">
                      {JSON.stringify(test.response || test.error, null, 2)}
                    </pre>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## [File 142] `apps/web/app/api/cron/news-crawl/route.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/web/app/api/cron/news-crawl/route.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 105  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This Next.js serverless route handler acts as the external webhook receiver for scheduled news crawler triggers.
It verifies incoming CRON_SECRET headers before forwarding the execution request to the backend API.
Cron scheduling services (e.g., cron-job.org or Vercel Cron) ping this endpoint on regular intervals.

```typescript
import crypto from 'crypto';
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';
export const revalidate = 0;
export const maxDuration = 60;

const DEFAULT_CRON_SECRET = 'danger-zone-bd-cron-crawler-secret-2026';

const NO_STORE_HEADERS = {
  'Cache-Control': 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, proxy-revalidate',
};

const timingSafeStringCompare = (expected: string, provided: string): boolean => {
  const expectedDigest = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(expected, 'utf8').digest();
  const providedDigest = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(provided, 'utf8').digest();
  return crypto.timingSafeEqual(expectedDigest, providedDigest);
};

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  try {
    const cronSecret = process.env.CRON_SECRET?.trim() || DEFAULT_CRON_SECRET;

    const url = new URL(request.url);
    const querySecret =
      url.searchParams.get('key') ||
      url.searchParams.get('secret') ||
      url.searchParams.get('cron_secret');

    const authHeader = request.headers.get('authorization');
    const cronHeader = request.headers.get('x-cron-secret');

    const matchesBearer =
      typeof authHeader === 'string' &&
      authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ') &&
      authHeader.length > 'Bearer '.length &&
      timingSafeStringCompare(cronSecret, authHeader.slice('Bearer '.length));

    const matchesCronHeader =
      typeof cronHeader === 'string' &&
      cronHeader.length > 0 &&
      timingSafeStringCompare(cronSecret, cronHeader);

    const matchesQuerySecret =
      typeof querySecret === 'string' &&
      querySecret.length > 0 &&
      timingSafeStringCompare(cronSecret, querySecret);

    if (!matchesBearer && !matchesCronHeader && !matchesQuerySecret) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error: 'Unauthorized cron trigger: missing or invalid credentials',
        },
        { status: 401, headers: NO_STORE_HEADERS }
      );
    }

    const rawTarget =
      process.env.INTERNAL_API_URL ||
      (process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL && !process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL.startsWith('/')
        ? process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
        : 'https://danger-zone-bd.onrender.com');

    const targetUrl = rawTarget.replace(/\/+$/, '').replace(/\/api\/v1$/, '');

    console.log(`[Vercel Cron] 🌐 Triggering automated hourly news crawl on ${targetUrl}...`);

    const res = await fetch(`${targetUrl}/api/v1/cron/news-crawl`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        Authorization: `Bearer ${cronSecret}`,
      },
      cache: 'no-store',
    });

    const data = await res.json().catch(() => null);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: res.ok,
        triggeredAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        backendStatus: res.status,
        result: data,
      },
      {
        status: res.status,
        headers: NO_STORE_HEADERS,
      }
    );
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('[Vercel Cron] News crawl trigger error:', error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error: error.message || 'Failed to trigger crawler on backend',
      },
      { status: 500, headers: NO_STORE_HEADERS }
    );
  }
}

export const POST = GET;
```

## [File 143] `apps/web/app/api/health/route.ts`
> **Path:** `apps/web/app/api/health/route.ts`  
> **Lines of Code:** 80  
> **Language:** `typescript`

### What This Code Does
This Next.js API route handler provides a lightweight health check endpoint for the web deployment.
It returns deployment status, environment name, and timestamps to monitoring services.
Hosting providers (e.g., Vercel) query this endpoint to verify frontend container availability.

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

export async function GET() {
  const rawBackend =
    process.env.INTERNAL_API_URL ||
    (process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL && !process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL.startsWith("/")
      ? process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
      : "https://danger-zone-bd.onrender.com");
  const backendUrl = rawBackend.replace(/\/+$/, "").replace(/\/api\/v1$/, "");
  const startTime = Date.now();

  let backendStatus = 'unknown';
  let dbStatus = 'unknown';
  let backendLatency = 0;
  let dbLatency = 0;

  try {
    const t0 = Date.now();
    const res = await fetch(`${backendUrl}/health`, { cache: 'no-store' });
    backendLatency = Date.now() - t0;
    if (res.ok) {
      backendStatus = 'online';
    } else {
      backendStatus = `error-${res.status}`;
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    backendStatus = `unreachable: ${err.message || 'connection failed'}`;
  }

  try {
    const t0 = Date.now();
    const res = await fetch(`${backendUrl}/health/db`, { cache: 'no-store' });
    dbLatency = Date.now() - t0;
    if (res.ok) {
      dbStatus = 'connected';
    } else {
      dbStatus = `error-${res.status}`;
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    dbStatus = `unreachable: ${err.message || 'connection failed'}`;
  }

  const allHealthy = backendStatus === 'online' && dbStatus === 'connected';

  return NextResponse.json(
    {
      status: allHealthy ? 'healthy' : 'degraded',
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      totalLatencyMs: Date.now() - startTime,
      services: {
        frontend: {
          name: 'Next.js Frontend (Vercel)',
          status: 'online',
          mode: process.env.NODE_ENV || 'production',
        },
        backend: {
          name: 'Express API (Render)',
          url: backendUrl,
          status: backendStatus,
          latencyMs: backendLatency,
        },
        database: {
          name: 'Supabase PostgreSQL + PostGIS',
          status: dbStatus,
          latencyMs: dbLatency,
          query: 'SELECT 1 (via Prisma ORM)',
        },
      },
    },
    {
      status: allHealthy ? 200 : 503,
      headers: {
        'Cache-Control': 'no-store, max-age=0',
      },
    }
  );
}
```

```json
    "build": {
      "dependsOn": ["^build"],
      "outputs": ["dist/**", ".next/**", "!.next/cache/**"]

    "lint": {},
    "typecheck": {},
    "dev": {

      "persistent": true

    "db:generate": {

    }

}
```

### What This Code Does
This infrastructure-as-code specification configures the backend deployment on Render.

It automates the production deployment of the Express.js API and WebSocket server.

```yaml
services:
  - type: web
    name: bd-safety-map-api
    runtime: node
    plan: free
    region: singapore
    buildCommand: pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile --prod=false && pnpm --filter api build
    startCommand: node apps/api/dist/server.js
    healthCheckPath: /health
    autoDeploy: true
    envVars:
      - key: NODE_ENV
        value: production
      - key: PORT
        value: 10000
      - key: CORS_ORIGIN
        sync: false
      - key: DATABASE_URL
        sync: false
      - key: DIRECT_URL
        sync: false
      - key: JWT_SECRET
        generateValue: true
      - key: JWT_REFRESH_SECRET
        generateValue: true
      - key: CRON_SECRET
        value: danger-zone-bd-cron-crawler-secret-2026
```

> **Lines of Code:** 14  
> **Language:** `json`

### What This Code Does
This file defines the configuration and metadata for the @repo/shared internal workspace package.
It configures TypeScript compilation exports so that shared types and constants can be imported by both api and web.
It ensures that shared domain contracts remain synchronized across the entire monorepo.

```json
{
  "name": "@repo/shared",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "private": true,
  "main": "src/index.ts",
  "types": "src/index.ts",
  "scripts": {
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "typescript": "^5.6.2"
  }
}
```
